description: Runs on any doc/code change and enforces doc byte budgets, anchor/header rules, paper-editor style mirror lockstep, status-manifest drift, preview-contract parity + no-oEmbed law, design-token drift (Studio/web/Go literal-color gates + self-tests), Studio link/path lint, and citation-truth guards — a large multi-surface consistency gate.
whatBreaks: Cross-surface drift (design tokens, doc anchors, preview-contract fields, literal colors bypassing the token system) merges to main undetected across Studio/web/Go/docs.

role: GitHub Actions: Elixir/Phoenix CI (format, test, prod-compile, perf gates)
description: Four jobs: advisory `format` check, blocking `mix-test` (Postgres service, OpenAPI + paper-component golden-parity drift gates, full test suite including canvas⇄reader render-parity), blocking `mix-prod-compile` (clean _build/prod, --warnings-as-errors — the merge gate per docs/ops/merge-gates.md), and a validation-perf bench gate.
whatBreaks: A broken/weakened gate here lets a PR that fails to compile in prod, breaks tests, or regresses validation perf merge to main — direct production-breakage risk, mirroring several 'Past Mistakes' in the repo's CLAUDE.md.

role: CI workflow: advisory gofmt drift check on Go PRs
description: Runs gofmt -l over all non-vendor .go files on PRs touching Go; continue-on-error keeps it advisory rather than blocking, mirroring the repo's format-gate philosophy.
whatBreaks: Being advisory, a bug here just lets gofmt drift accumulate unnoticed rather than breaking any build.

role: CI workflow: go vet + race-detector test gate for the whole Go tree
description: Runs on every push/PR touching *.go, go.mod/sum, templates/**, or pdrender golden testdata; executes `go vet ./...` and `go test -race ./...` covering the bp CLI/TUI, manifest, apiclient, pdrender, provisioner/runtime/waker. Also tripwires template/golden-fixture drift that has no .go diff.
whatBreaks: A broken or misconfigured gate lets Go build breaks, race conditions in the daemons, or vendored-template/golden-fixture drift land on main undetected.

role: GitHub Actions: JS/TS monorepo test + drift + changeset gate
description: Builds the js/ pnpm workspace, runs a codegen drift gate (web/lib/barkpark.types.ts must match a fresh regen), test/lint/typecheck/bundle-size, advisory node-import and coverage checks, plus a separate blocking `changesets` job requiring a changeset on packages/** PRs.
whatBreaks: SDK breakage, stale generated types, or missing changesets could merge to main and ship broken/undocumented releases of @barkpark packages.

role: CI workflow: Studio rich-text editor smoke test + bundle-freshness gate
description: On changes to api/assets/paper-editor or the committed IIFE bundle, runs npm test then rebuilds and diffs the bundle to catch a stale committed artifact — closing a real incident where convert.js changed but the shipped bundle didn't.
whatBreaks: A regressed or skipped gate lets a stale/broken paper-editor bundle ship to Studio, silently breaking rich-text editing features like strike/underline.

role: CI workflow: builds + smokes the pdrender-to-TUI WASM blob
description: On changes to cmd/pdrender-wasm or internal/pdrender, runs `make wasm` (GOOS=js/wasm build + gzip) and a Node smoke harness rendering a sample doc, verifying real <pre class="bp-tui-pre"> output; the wasm blob itself is intentionally not committed (non-reproducible), so no git-diff staleness check exists here.
whatBreaks: A broken gate lets a renderer/ABI break ship, causing the Studio paper reader's lazy-loaded WASM viewer to fail silently in production.

role: CI workflow: enforces every PR references an active Barkpark task
description: Task-obsession layer 1 — fetches PR context and defers the actual decision to scripts/pr-task-gate.sh; includes a merge-base cutoff (grandfathers pre-gate PRs by checking if the workflow file existed at the base SHA) and a hotfix! label escape hatch that auto-files an override task via BARKPARK_TASK_TOKEN. Must be added to required-status-checks BY NAME to actually block merges.
whatBreaks: Governs the task↔code discipline central to this repo's task-obsessed workflow; a bug either blocks all legitimate PRs or silently lets untracked work merge (per repo memory: pr-task-gate stale-event gotcha).

role: CI workflow: advisory warning when a PR re-touches recently-closed-task files
description: Task-obsession layer 3 — computes the PR's changed files, queries the guerrilla ledger for recently closed tasks' landed.files, and posts a non-blocking ::warning:: + job summary on overlap; delegates the actual comparison to tooling/task-obsession/reland_check.py and suppresses hot files and dependency-linked tasks.
whatBreaks: Being advisory-only (continue-on-error), a defect here just produces noisy or missing warnings, not a blocked merge.

role: CI workflow: precompiles api/_build and publishes it as a per-sha GitHub release
description: On api/-touching pushes to main, builds with the pinned OTP/Elixir toolchain via scripts/build-prebuilt.sh and uploads a build-<sha> release (tarball + checksum + stamp.json) consumed by scripts/fetch-prebuilt.sh so deploy boxes swap in prebuilt artifacts instead of compiling on-box; prunes to newest 15 releases.
whatBreaks: A broken artifact pipeline just makes deploy boxes fall back to on-box compiling (documented as non-breaking), but a corrupt/mismatched artifact accepted by the stamp gate could ship a bad build faster than compile-time would catch.

role: CI workflow: monthly cron renewal of the mail relay's TLS cert
description: Scheduled (and manually dispatchable) job that renews the Let's Encrypt cert for mail.barkpark.cloud via DNS-01 against Hetzner Cloud DNS, then deploys it to barkpark-cp and reloads postfix, via deploy/renew-mail-cert.sh.
whatBreaks: If this silently fails, the self-hosted outbound mail relay's TLS cert expires (~90-day LE lifetime), breaking authenticated mail delivery/DKIM for the whole platform.

role: CI workflow: unit test gate for the @barkpark/bulldocs-sdk package
description: Path-filtered on sdk/** changes; runs npm ci then npm test (tsc + node --test) for the standalone, zero-runtime-dep SDK package, closing a prior gap where its 30+ tests only ran locally.
whatBreaks: A broken build or failing test in the SDK could land on main undetected, shipping a broken published package to SDK consumers.

role: CI gate for the Studio sheet-grid client hook
description: Runs a zero-dependency node:vm harness over the shipped bp-sheet-grid.js/bp-sheet-formula.js on push/PR touching those assets or the sheet-grid source, guarding keyboard nav, clipboard TSV, fill, and drag-to-select logic that previously had zero coverage.
whatBreaks: A regression in sheet-grid keyboard/clipboard/selection logic ships unnoticed to production since this is the only automated check for that hook.

description: Fails a PR if deploy.sh and its go:embedded vendored copy at internal/cli/setup/assets diverge, closing a gap where the two copies drifted for months undetected until release time.
whatBreaks: The CLI-embedded deploy.sh silently diverges from the root script again, shipping stale/incorrect provisioning logic to new bp cloud installs.

role: Repo-wide git ignore rules
description: Excludes build artifacts (_build, dist, node_modules), secrets (.env, deploy/*.env), local dev state (tmp/, .slots/, .worktrees/), and generated tooling/doc-truth outputs; carefully negates tracked bin/ launcher scripts and the untracked wasm blob per repo conventions.
whatBreaks: Secrets or huge build artifacts could get accidentally committed, or a needed tracked file (e.g. bin/barkpark) could get silently excluded from git.

role: asdf version pin for Erlang/Elixir toolchain
description: Two-line asdf file pinning erlang 27.3.4 and elixir 1.18.4-otp-27; used by asdf-managed dev/CI/server environments (relevant given the repo's ARM Hetzner asdf requirement).

role: Repo-root pointer doc to CLAUDE.md + shell danger rules
description: Thin agent-tier doc that redirects agents to CLAUDE.md and lists non-interactive shell/rm/mix-compile danger rules verbatim-owned as canonical-for shell-danger-rules.
whatBreaks: Agents miss the danger rules (rm vs trash, partial _build clean) and repeat destructive past mistakes on the shared checkout or prod server.

role: Repo-root router doc — identity, golden rules, routing table
description: The canonical entrypoint every agent reads first: repo identity, 8 golden rules, a routing table into topic cards, prod micro-block, quick commands, past-mistakes log, and the task/doc-contract system. Read by essentially every session working this repo.

role: Human-readable status map for the Hyperquiz live-quiz feature
description: Short doc pointing to the canonical hyperquiz-epic task tree and reconstructed design papers on guerrilla; describes architecture-as-plugin plan, go-live path (merge=live via blue/green), the check_origin footgun, and parked billing/sharding work. Doc-tier: human, not the source of truth.

role: Root build/deploy/dev automation entrypoint
description: Defines all `make` targets: server ops (rebuild/restart/logs/migrate), local dev (dev/update/doctor/api/tui/web), bp CLI cross-compile release, wasm pdrender build, docker, deploy (delegates to .githooks/post-merge), domain-cutover, and the precheck merge gate mirroring CI.

role: Public-facing project overview and pitch
description: Human-tier top-level README: what Barkpark is, install/connect flow, schema-driven creation, agent capabilities, four surfaces, self-hosting, architecture summary, and live Cody quality grade table.

role: Elixir code formatter config
description: Configures `mix format` for the api/ subtree — specifies inputs glob and any import_deps. Six lines, rarely changed.
whatBreaks: mix format uses wrong settings, causing style inconsistencies or CI formatter checks to fail.

role: Git ignore rules for the Phoenix api/ subtree
description: Standard Mix project ignores: _build, deps, doc, uploads, tmp, coverage, crash dumps, hex tarballs; also covers the blue/green `_build_*` build-aside roots used by deploy/instance-deploy.sh.

role: Phoenix api/ surface card — key files, Bulldocs, Sheets, schema rules
description: Agent-tier card enumerating key api/ files (content.ex, plugin.ex, router.ex, studio_live.ex), explaining the Bulldocs/Papers split, Sheets architecture, plugin-declared vs ad-hoc schema registration, document shape/draft-publish model, and PubSub topics.
whatBreaks: Agents working in api/ misroute to wrong files, break the Bulldocs/Sheets core-vs-plugin split, or hand-insert NULL-scoped rows that become invisible — corrupting tenant-scoped data.

role: Multi-stage Docker build for the Phoenix release
description: Alpine-based build (elixir:1.19-alpine, build-base for NIFs like argon2) producing a mix release, run on a matching alpine:3.23 runtime (OpenSSL/crypto NIF version-locked); sets prod env defaults and entrypoint.sh as CMD.
whatBreaks: A Docker-based deploy path fails to build or the release crashes at boot (e.g. the documented OpenSSL symbol-mismatch failure mode) if alpine versions between build/runtime stages diverge.

role: Human signpost README for the api/ directory
description: Very short pointer doc: dev boot command and links to api/CLAUDE.md, docs/api-v1.md, and docs/setup/SETUP.md.
whatBreaks: Minor — a stale link just sends a human to the wrong doc; no functional impact.

description: .gitignore

role: Normative embed-contract spec for the <bp-paper-editor> custom element
description: Documents the framework-neutral custom element's inbound (data-block/el.block) and outbound (bp-ready, bp-op, bp-slash-insert, bp-error) event contract, styling self-injection, and patch-block shapes per block type; pins CONTRACT_VERSION 1.0.0 matching src/contract.js.
whatBreaks: Any host (Studio LiveView hook, React embedder) that drifts from this contract silently breaks editor mounting, event handling, or patch application across every portable-doc block editor instance.

role: npm manifest for the TipTap-based Barkpark paper editor bundle
description: Defines build/build:dev/build:web/smoke/test scripts (esbuild bundling to a single committed Web Component JS+CSS artifact vendored into priv/static and web/public) and pins @tiptap/* + esbuild deps; `test` chains ~25 individual node smoke/unit test files.
whatBreaks: Wrong build script or dependency pin breaks the paper editor bundle build, silently shipping a stale or broken bp-paper-editor.bundle.js to both the Phoenix Studio and the Next.js web demo (build:web vendors it).

role: Pure-Node guard against resting chrome/bare-button regressions in canvas atoms
description: Tests configControlHidden predicate plus a static-source sweep asserting no canvas node-view builds a bare <button> and that config-bearing atoms keep the hover/focus reveal gate wired; locks in the callout fold's move to native <details>/<summary>.
whatBreaks: A node-view could silently regrow always-visible button chrome or lose the hover/focus reveal gate without any automated signal.

role: Source-level View⇄Edit parity guard for the callout node-view
description: Asserts callout-node.js's DOM-building source matches the reader's callout rendering (tone-class-only color, run-in <strong> title, no icon, native <details>/<summary> disclosure), preventing edit-canvas drift from the reader.
whatBreaks: Edit canvas could re-introduce inline tone paint, an icon, or an edit-only button fold that visually diverges from the published reader view.

role: Unit test for the `> [!type]` callout authoring shorthand regex/tone normalization
description: Tests the exact SHORTHAND regex and normalizeTone from tone.js used by the editor's slash-shorthand trigger, deliberately kept separate from the smoke suite since callouts bypass convert.js round-tripping.
whatBreaks: The `> [!type]` typing shortcut for inserting callouts stops firing or mis-parses tone/collapsible modifiers, degrading a documented authoring convenience.

role: Standalone runner for the card widget smoke suite
description: Thin entry point importing shared checks from smoke/cards.mjs (round-trip zero-ops, non-vacuous mutation ops, removals, grid-section patching, echo) and reporting pass/fail; also folded into the aggregate __smoke.mjs index.
whatBreaks: Card widget round-trip/mutation regressions in the paper editor go undetected in both standalone and aggregate CI test runs.

role: Source guard locking code-block edit/reader frame parity (font/typography)
description: Pure-Node source assertions ensuring code-node.js's <pre>/<textarea> carry no inline font overrides and that both CSS sinks (styles.css bundle + root.html.heex Studio inline) bind identical --bp-codeblock-*/--paper-* tokens matching the reader's static code_block_html output.
whatBreaks: The editable code block visually diverges from the published reader's code block (wrong font/size) without any test catching the regression.

role: Pure-Node unit test for the columns canvas container node
description: Tests the block ⇄ bpColumns node ⇄ ops round-trip in run-convert.js for the nested-block-tree columns container: zero ops when unedited, coarse whole-array patch on interior edit, verbatim carry for non-first-class children, and edge cases (empty column, unknown keys, phantom nested bpId). DOM-free, imports only run-convert.js.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let the columns canvas node silently corrupt patch ops or lose nested-child fidelity without any test catching it.

role: Pure-Node unit test for the constraint-vocabulary matrix (pdd-t20c)
description: Tests constraints.js's DOM-free/ProseMirror-free decision logic: the calm veto (count-floor + relative-order) and the ghost-slot model, using a fake PM-shaped doc object.
whatBreaks: A broken constraint veto could let editors delete required structural slots (e.g. minimum block counts) without the canvas blocking it.

role: Parity gate test: edit-canvas divider DOM vs reader divider DOM
description: Asserts the TipTap Divider atom's renderHTML output structurally matches the server-rendered §-on-hairline divider from Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.Figures.section_divider_html/0, catching reader/editor visual drift.
whatBreaks: Editor and published-article divider rendering could silently diverge (different markup/styling) with no test to catch it.

role: Pure-Node unit test for the featured-image placeholder decision/copy
description: Tests DOM-free helpers from field-node.js (isEmptyPickerValue, imagePlaceholderModel, coercePickerValue) governing when the featured-image ghost placeholder shows and how a chosen asset's value is coerced into a patch.
whatBreaks: Wrong emptiness/placeholder logic could show the placeholder over a real image or fail to patch a newly chosen image asset.

role: Pure-Node unit test for editable-figure block (server-painted child + caption atom)
description: Verifies the figure block's canvas projection: the child (image/code) rides verbatim/read-only while only the caption is editable and emits a single patch-block{caption}, using run-convert.js and figure-node.js's node name.
whatBreaks: A figure edit could wrongly mutate/lose the server-painted child content or fail to emit the caption patch.

role: Pure-Node unit test for component-fleet blocks as read-only canvas atoms
description: Confirms fleet blocks (task board, cards, pipeline, form, roadmap, notes, etc.) ride the canvas verbatim as bpFleet atoms with zero content ops, structurally identical to sheet/embed atoms; enumerates the canonical fleet type list kept in lockstep with run-convert.js and shared/paper.ex.
whatBreaks: A fleet type falling out of sync with the canonical enumeration could corrupt or drop verbatim data for task boards, roadmaps, and other components during editing.

role: Pure-Node unit test for template lock guarantees (pdd-t2) in the canvas
description: Covers three guarantees: round-trip preservation of locked/role attrs (with byte-fidelity for unlocked blocks), a diff guard preventing runToOps from emitting remove/move ops for locked ids, and the transactionVetoesLock predicate rejecting deletion/move of locked nodes.
whatBreaks: Locked template blocks (e.g. forced title/featured-image) could be deleted or reordered by editors despite the lock, breaking document doctrine guarantees.

role: Standalone runner for the notes-grid 'note' widget smoke suite
description: Thin entry point that imports shared checks from ./smoke/note.mjs (projection, round-trip zero-ops, per-field mutation ops, lead-removal, insert, echo) and reports pass/fail; also folded into __smoke.mjs aggregate.
whatBreaks: Loss of this runner would only reduce standalone test invocability for the note widget since checks are shared and also run via __smoke.mjs.

role: Pure-Node unit test for keyboard/screen-reader accessibility helpers on read-only atoms
description: Tests DOM-free helpers from embed-node.js (isBlockLocked, atomAriaLabel, isActivateKey, sheetChipLabel, embedChipLabel, fleetChipLabel) that make sheet/embed/fleet canvas atoms reachable and announceable without a mouse; actual node-view wiring is manually verified separately.
whatBreaks: Accessibility affordances (ARIA labels, keyboard activation) for read-only canvas atoms could regress without detection, degrading screen-reader/keyboard usability.

role: Pure-Node vm test for the ghost-chrome media picker's pure decision logic
description: Loads the tracked static asset bp-media-picker.js in node:vm with minimal DOM stubs and asserts the ghost variant hides the actions row, the context menu offers correct items (Upload/Browse/Remove) based on state, and busy disables all items; exercises real shipped static-asset code rather than source.
whatBreaks: The media picker's context menu could show invalid actions (e.g. Remove with no value, or an enabled Upload during busy state) in production without this test catching it.

role: Pure-Node test: article-chrome ROLE nodes block⇌ops round-trip
description: Tests run-convert.js round-trip for eyebrow/byline/ingress/pullquote role nodes: unedited emits zero ops, edits emit one patch-block, legacy byline text migrates to items. DOM-free, no TipTap.
whatBreaks: A regression in role-node op generation (extra/missing ops, lost legacy-byline migration) ships silently into the paper editor.

role: Edit↔reader DOM-class parity gate for article-chrome role nodes
description: Asserts canvas/role-nodes.js renderHTML specs emit the same bp-role-* classes the /papers reader (walk.ex) produces, closing a hole where __role.test.mjs only proves ops round-trip, not DOM class parity.
whatBreaks: role-nodes.js could drop or rename a bp-role-* class in a refactor and stay green elsewhere, causing the byte-locked reader CSS to silently stop applying in Edit.

role: Edit↔reader structural parity gate for the recursive SECTION container
description: Locks the mounted section-node.js DOM shape (stack and grid variants) against the reader's HTML producer (compose.ex/walk.ex), replacing a weaker textual-proxy gate that only grepped for style-attr writes.
whatBreaks: Section layout/grid edit surface could structurally diverge from the published article rendering (wrong wrapper divs, missing cell classes, dropped title styling) without any test catching it.

role: Thin index runner aggregating the paper-editor's pure-Node smoke test suite
description: Was a 5275-line monolith, now just imports ~12 per-area smoke modules (round-trip, node-views, echo, markdown, projection-fuzz, source-mode, etc.) which self-register checks on import, then calls report() once for the aggregate pass/fail and exit code.
whatBreaks: If an import is dropped or report() isn't called, whole categories of paper-editor regressions (block round-trip, markdown conversion, projection fuzzing) go silently unchecked in CI/local `npm test`.

role: Pure-Node test for the markdown SOURCE-mode locked-prefix clamp
description: Tests clampLockedPrefix (source-realign.js) which prevents a user editing raw markdown in Source mode from deleting/moving a server-enforced locked title block, complementing the server-side veto in patch.ex.
whatBreaks: Source-mode editing could let a user's local view show a deleted/moved locked title until reload, diverging from the server's authoritative doctrine-template state.

role: Standalone runner wrapper for the stage-widget smoke suite
description: Ten-line entrypoint that imports ./smoke/stage.mjs (registers checks) then calls report() to print pass/fail and exit code; also folded into the aggregate __smoke.mjs run.
whatBreaks: If broken, only the stage widget's smoke checks fail to run standalone (they're still covered via __smoke.mjs aggregate), so low direct impact.

role: Pure-Node test: editable TABLE canvas node block⇌ops round-trip
description: Tests run-convert.js round-trip for the bpTable node tree: zero ops when unedited, coarse whole-table patch on cell edit, explicit head:[] on header removal, mark round-trip through cells, fresh-table reconstruction on insert.
whatBreaks: Table edits could silently produce malformed ops (e.g. missing explicit head:[] on removal) causing data loss or corruption when persisted through the patch pipeline.

role: Edit↔reader DOM-class parity gate for the editable table
description: Asserts table-node.js binds the same bp-table/bp-table__th/bp-table__td classes as the reader (walk.ex table/3), and explicitly justifies two known deltas (thead/tbody split, edit-only chrome islands) as intentional.
whatBreaks: table-node.js could drop shared CSS classes in a refactor, silently breaking the byte-locked reader styling on the edit surface while other tests stay green.

role: Pure-Node test: terminal container canvas node block⇌ops round-trip
description: Tests run-convert.js round-trip for bpTerminal (single body child array + title/footer/live chrome scalars): zero ops unedited, coarse patch on edit, null/false removal contract, legacy `blocks` key alias, empty-body sentinel handling.
whatBreaks: Terminal block edits (chrome clear, legacy-key load, nested atom children) could mis-serialize into wrong or missing ops, corrupting terminal content on save.

role: Pure-Node test for the `[[` wikilink-autocomplete trigger detector
description: Tests parseOpenWikilink/tagReplaceRange etc. from wikilink-trigger.js in isolation from DOM/TipTap, covering when the autocomplete popup should open (including mid-prose triggers) and replace ranges; popup DOM/keyboard wiring is explicitly out of scope here.
whatBreaks: The `[[` wikilink autocomplete could fail to trigger or compute the wrong replace range, breaking wikilink insertion UX in the paper editor.

role: Standalone browser harness page for manual/chrome-devtools canvas testing
description: Loads the built bp-paper-editor bundle+CSS directly from priv/static/assets and mounts a <bp-paper-canvas> over a 3-block prose run, exposing window.__ops/__assertRoundTrip/__assertCleanMount helpers for an orchestrator to drive via chrome-devtools and prove cross-block editing, Enter-split, Backspace-merge, and clean-mount op-emission behavior.
whatBreaks: Loses the only manual/automated browser-driven proof surface for continuous-canvas editing behavior (caret, selection, split/merge) that can't be tested in pure Node.

role: Pure-Node test for callout slot-model vs legacy inline compat
description: Proves the additive slot-form body encoding and the legacy inline encoding of the same callout body project to the identical canvas node and round-trip losslessly through run-convert.js's public pipeline. Node-runnable, no browser/TipTap mount.
whatBreaks: A regression here means legacy callouts could silently mass-churn on load or slot-form callouts could mis-round-trip, without any other test catching it.

role: Pure-Node test for task-list live-query vs legacy snapshot widget routing
description: Verifies a task-list block with a query routes to the editable-query bpTaskList atom (server-painted rows) while a snapshot-only task-list routes to the read-only bpFleet atom, mirroring task_resolver.ex:139's discriminant.
whatBreaks: Wrong routing would make live task-list widgets un-editable or legacy snapshots incorrectly treated as live queries, undetected until manual QA.

role: TipTap node-view for the CTA `action` (button) block in the canvas
description: Renders an atom-leaf control-node with href/label/priority editable attrs via native HTML controls (stopEvent/ignoreMutation island), and paints a live preview `<a class="bp-button…">` matching the reader's exact class output for view/edit parity. Byte-fidelity rules mirror compose.ex defaults.
whatBreaks: CTA buttons in Papers could render/edit incorrectly or diverge visually from the published reader output, or emit spurious ops on selection.

role: TipTap global-attrs extension preserving bpId/bpType/locked/role across DOM round-trips
description: Registers bpId, bpType, locked, and role as data-* attributes on paragraph/heading/list nodes so ProseMirror's setContent→getJSON cycle doesn't drop them; without it runToOps would mis-diff every block as new. Small file, foundational mechanism ("the make-or-break of S1").
whatBreaks: Every prose block edit in the canvas would lose its id, causing runToOps to delete-and-recreate all blocks instead of diffing, corrupting edit history and template locks.

role: TipTap content-node view for the `callout` block with view/edit parity to the reader
description: First canvas content node-view (not an atom): editable inline prose body plus non-editable chrome (bold title or native details/summary fold), reusing the reader's own bp-callout CSS classes so styling comes free via shared ancestor cascade.
whatBreaks: Callouts in the canvas could render with wrong chrome/tone, break collapsible fold behavior, or visually diverge from the published paper.

role: TipTap content-node view for the slots-native `card` widget (callout+section fusion)
description: Implements body (contentDOM inline region), title (contentEditable island attr), and media/action (present-only verbatim attrs) slots for the card block, painting via shared reader bp-card classes for zero-drift parity.
whatBreaks: Card widgets could lose slot data (title/media/action) on edit or fail to visually match the published reader, or corrupt the body-to-plain-text server flattening.

role: TipTap atom node-view for the `code` block edited via a textarea island
description: First atom-with-attr node-view: code text lives in a `value` attr edited by a non-PM <textarea> (stopEvent/ignoreMutation), with `lang` present only when non-empty to match blocks.ex's put_if_present byte-fidelity contract.
whatBreaks: Code blocks could fail to save edits, corrupt lang/value round-tripping, or leak keystrokes into ProseMirror transactions causing caret/doc corruption.

role: TipTap container node-views (bpColumns/bpColumn/bpColumnAtom) for the `columns` block
description: First canvas container node whose interior is a nested block tree rather than inline runs; bpColumns is the grid wrapper, bpColumn holds allowed block types, and bpColumnAtom verbatim-carries non-representable child block types as read-only chips, all painted via the reader's shared .bp-cols CSS.
whatBreaks: Multi-column layouts could lose child blocks on edit, allow illegal nested containers, or break caret containment (isolating:true) causing grid dissolution on Backspace.

role: Cmd-P fuzzy command palette for the canvas editor
description: Provides a keyboard-triggered launcher over editor commands (insert/format/turn-into), reusing SlashMenu's render machinery and sharing insertSlashTypeAtSelection with the slash-trigger picker so both paths produce identical blocks. Canvas-only, flag-gated, doesn't affect the legacy per-block editor.
whatBreaks: Cmd-P palette could fail to open, insert wrong/duplicate blocks, or diverge from slash-menu insert behavior, degrading a power-user affordance without affecting core save/publish paths.

role: Pure logic for template constraint declarations: ghost slots + transaction vetoes
description: Turns server-declared constraint vocabulary (required/optional, count, position, locked) into two client decisions: ghostSlots (calm placeholder affordances for absent optional blocks) and transactionVetoesConstraints (blocks transactions that violate min-count or ordering), wired into the same PM plugin as the existing lock veto. Pure, DOM-free, unit-testable.
whatBreaks: Template-constrained papers (locked title, required featured image, etc.) could allow authors to violate structural rules client-side, relying solely on server-side veto as a worse-UX backstop, or ghost-slot placeholders could appear/vanish incorrectly.

role: TipTap ATOM node-view for Mermaid diagram blocks in the continuous canvas
description: Registers the `bpDiagram` ProseMirror atom whose Mermaid source/caption ride node attrs and are edited via a stopEvent/ignoreMutation textarea island; mirrors code-node.js's attr-atom pattern almost verbatim.
whatBreaks: Diagram blocks would fail to mount, lose their source/caption on save, or leak keystrokes into ProseMirror causing doc corruption.

role: TipTap ATOM node-view for the divider block — first canvas non-prose node
description: Registers the `divider` node as a pure leaf atom rendering the reader's §-hairline markup; establishes the id-preservation (data-bp-id/data-bp-type) pattern every later canvas atom node copies.
whatBreaks: Dividers inside a prose run would be dropped or mis-diffed as new blocks on every save, and the atom pattern other nodes clone would be wrong from the start.

role: TipTap read-only ATOM node-views for sheet/embed/fleet blocks in the canvas
description: Registers bpSheet/bpEmbed (verbatim reference chips) and bpFleet (server-painted read-only atom relying on the shared bp:block-html hook), plus shared a11y helpers (wireAtomAccessibility, isBlockLocked) and an in-canvas fleet edit-island (JSON textarea) reused by figure-node.js.
whatBreaks: Sheets/embeds/fleet widgets (tasks, cards, pipeline, roadmap, etc.) would fail to render or silently lose data on save; a11y helpers imported by figure-node.js would break too.

role: TipTap CONTROL-ATOM node-view for all 9 field-* block types in canvas
description: Single `bpField` node multiplexing 7 native controls (text/slug/textarea/checkbox/select/datetime/color) plus 2 client-side pickers (media/reference), lifting the exact value-coercion logic from the shipped BarkparkFieldBlockBridge so canvas edits persist identically to per-block edits; includes the featured-image ghost-placeholder affordance.
whatBreaks: Any schema-bound field edited in the canvas (text, boolean, media, reference, etc.) could persist the wrong value type or fail to save, corrupting document data.

role: TipTap ATOM node-view for figure blocks — server-painted child + editable caption
description: Registers `bpFigure`, reusing the shipped bp:block-html paint-hole hook (via embed-node.js's Fleet pattern) to render the figure's child read-only while exposing only the caption as an editable non-PM input island; structurally prevents nesting since the child never enters the PM doc.
whatBreaks: Figure blocks (images/code/diagrams with captions) would fail to paint their child content or lose caption edits.

role: The <bp-paper-canvas> custom element — the whole continuous-canvas TipTap editor
description: Very large (~2100 line) custom element that mounts ONE TipTap Editor over a contiguous run of prose+atom blocks, wiring together every canvas node type, the op-diff/echo pipeline (run-convert.js), lock/constraint vetoes, slash menu, wikilink/tag autocomplete, command palette, and markdown source-mode; this is the top-level assembly point all other canvas/*.js files plug into.
whatBreaks: The entire Obsidian-style continuous-canvas paper editor would fail to mount, lose edits, or corrupt the block diff/op-emission pipeline for every paper in Studio.

role: Pure predicate functions vetoing deletion/move of template-locked canvas blocks
description: DOM-free module (unit-testable in plain Node) computing whether a ProseMirror transaction deletes or moves a locked mandated block (e.g. locked title/featured image); wired into index.js's filterTransaction plugin.
whatBreaks: Template-locked blocks (e.g. mandated title/featured image) could be deleted or reordered by a user despite the doctrine, or conversely legitimate edits could be wrongly blocked.

role: TipTap content node-view for the fully-editable `note` widget block
description: Registers the `note` node with an editable inline body (contentDOM) plus label/lead non-PM input islands; deliberately does NOT share reader CSS classes with the legacy notes-grid (uses bp-canvas-note* only) to satisfy a parity gate, relying instead on byte-identical compose output for reader parity.
whatBreaks: Note blocks would lose label/lead/body edits or their canvas markup could collide with the forbidden legacy grid class names, breaking a CI parity gate.

role: Mountable read-only ATOM node-view for non-canvas-eligible child blocks
description: Registers the generic `bpOpaque` node so a section/container body can hold a non-canvas child (nested section, composite, codelist, etc.) as a verbatim read-only carry instead of ProseMirror rejecting or lifting it out of the tree on open.
whatBreaks: Opening a paper whose section contains a nested section or unsupported nested block type would silently lose that child's data or throw on load.

role: Plain TipTap prose nodes for eyebrow/byline/ingress/pullquote article-chrome blocks
description:
DOM-free (no addNodeView) Node.create definitions rendering each role as a styled

matching the reader exactly, with content models (text* vs inline*) chosen per each block's actual persist shape; keeps run-convert.js importable in the pure-Node smoke harness.
whatBreaks: Article-chrome blocks (eyebrow, byline, ingress, pullquote) would fail to round-trip through getJSON, losing their id/type/marks or rendering unstyled.

role: Pure headless projector: portable-doc blocks ⇄ one TipTap doc ⇄ patch ops
description: Massive (3800+ line) core of the Papers continuous-canvas editor: projects a portable-doc block list into a single ProseMirror-style doc JSON and diffs an edited doc back into the exact op vocabulary (patch-block/insert-after/remove-block/move-block) the server's patch.ex consumes. Ships dark (nothing imports it yet per the header) as a pure, DOM-free proof of the blocks⇄one-doc⇄ops projection before any node-view wires up; defines the canonical type classification (prose/atom/content/container/fleet/etc.) that every canvas node-view file must stay in lockstep with.
whatBreaks: A wrong classification or op-diff here corrupts saved paper content or produces ops the server patch.ex rejects/mis-applies once the canvas ships live, silently losing or duplicating blocks across every canvas-eligible node type.

role: TipTap node-view for the `section` container block in the Papers canvas
description: Implements the bpSection ProseMirror node: a nested block+ region wrapped in reader-matching chrome (two <hr> rules + an editable bold title, plus a Step-2 grid/stack layout engine with per-child span/order). Mirrors compose.ex's box/hr/text reader output exactly and forbids section-in-section nesting at the schema level.
whatBreaks: A section's edit surface would diverge from the reader (wrong chrome/layout) or corrupt nested child ids/placement on save, breaking grid layouts or losing title/children across a save round-trip.

role: Pure DOM-free core of the canvas "/" slash-command block-insert menu
description: Defines the allowlist of block types insertable via slash, builds their minimal default block shape (mirroring server default_block/2) and projects them to TipTap nodes via runToTiptap, plus the guard deciding when the slash trigger may safely replace the enclosing textblock (avoiding corrupting a callout body).
whatBreaks: Slash-inserting a block type could produce a malformed default block or, via the parent-type guard, destroy an enclosing container (e.g. a callout) when triggered inside it.

role: Pure id-realignment engine for Markdown source-mode round-trips in the canvas
description: Maps freshly markdown-parsed blocks back onto their pre-edit baseline block ids via an LCS-over-serialized-markdown alignment so edits emit a single patch instead of a remove+insert storm, plus a doctrine-lock clamp that restores/protects a locked template prefix (e.g. paper title) after raw markdown edits.
whatBreaks: Editing a paper in markdown source mode could scramble block ids (causing spurious remove/insert ops or op storms) or let a user delete/reorder a server-enforced locked title block that the server would otherwise veto.

role: TipTap node-view for the `stage` (pipeline-flow) control-atom block
description: Renders a stage block (kind/title/detail/files/source scalars) as an atom leaf with native input controls in a stopEvent/ignoreMutation island, debounced-writing attrs back via setNodeMarkup; explicitly does not reuse the reader's pipeline CSS class to preserve the parity-gate's forbidden-class protection for the legacy fleet widget.
whatBreaks: Editing a stage block in-canvas could emit wrong/duplicate patch ops or desync from the reader's pipeline rendering for that block.

role: Four hand-rolled ProseMirror nodes implementing the in-canvas `table` block
description: Defines bpTable/bpTableRow/bpTableHeaderCell/bpTableCell as nested PM nodes (not @tiptap/extension-table) so cell bodies reuse the shared inline serializer for free mark editing; a node-view provides chrome plus add/remove row/col controls that rebuild the whole grid coarsely per edit.
whatBreaks: In-canvas table editing could produce a ragged/non-rectangular grid or lose cell inline formatting (bold/links) on save.

role: TipTap node-view for the live query-bound `task-list` widget atom
description: Implements bpTaskList: an editable-query atom whose rows are server-resolved and painted read-only via the shared bp:block-html fleet hook; the query/title edit islands emit a single patch-block{query} on change, distinguishing this live widget from the legacy snapshot-only task-list (which falls back to the read-only bpFleet atom).
whatBreaks: Editing a live task-list's query could fail to re-resolve/repaint rows, or corrupt the query map so the live binding silently breaks.

role: TipTap node-views (bpTerminal/bpTerminalAtom) for the in-canvas `terminal` container block
description: Second canvas container node-view: a single editable body region wrapped in reader-matching terminal chrome (title bar, live badge, footer), with non-representable children carried verbatim as read-only bpTerminalAtom chips; any interior edit coarsely re-emits the whole terminal patch.
whatBreaks: Editing a terminal block could lose non-first-class children, desync chrome from the reader's bp-term classes, or emit spurious ops on an unedited terminal.

role: Tiny DOM-free constants module: embed contract version, debounce ms, chrome-visibility rule
description: Zero-import shared constants (CONTRACT_VERSION, DEBOUNCE_MS=300, placeholders) plus one pure predicate (configControlHidden) governing when an atom's optional config control shows at rest vs on hover/focus, per the atomic-contract resting-chrome doctrine. Widely imported by node-view files for debounce timing and chrome rules.
whatBreaks: Wrong debounce timing or the hidden-chrome predicate would surface edit-only controls at rest across every canvas atom (code/diagram/stage/task-list), breaking view/reader parity.

role: Pure converters between portable-doc blocks and TipTap document JSON
description: DOM-free bidirectional mapping (inline tree <-> flat TipTap marks) for the per-block paper editor, covering text/strong/em/link/wikilink/blockref/tag/valueref node types plus heading/list/paragraph blocks. Byte-exact round-trip is a hard invariant (many comments guard 'never let a stray undefined field break round-trip'); reused by the canvas editor for callout bodies so it is a shared inline serializer, not per-editor.
whatBreaks: Any drift in mark ordering or optional-attr handling silently corrupts paper content on save/reload (lost formatting, dropped valueref/wikilink data) across both per-block and canvas editors.

role: floating text-format toolbar for paper editor
description: Implements a hand-rolled selection bubble (bold, italic, code, link) for the <bp-paper-editor> web component. Handles toolbar DOM, mark toggling via Tiptap commands, inline link input, and fixed-position repositioning on scroll/selection.
whatBreaks: Text formatting toolbar in the paper editor breaks or mis-positions, degrading the rich-text authoring experience.

role: Web Component: per-block TipTap editor for Barkpark papers
description: Defines <bp-paper-editor>, a custom element wrapping one TipTap-vanilla instance per block; emits patch-block DocPatchOp via bp-op events, and drives slash menu, wikilink/tag autocomplete, callout shorthand, and format bubble. Bundled by esbuild into a committed IIFE artifact consumed by Studio.
whatBreaks: Breaks live paper editing entirely in Studio (typing, slash-insert, wikilink/tag autocomplete) since this is the sole DOM entry point wiring TipTap to the LiveView patch-block contract.

role: Pure bidirectional PortableDoc-block ⇄ Markdown text converter
description: Serializes/parses the block AST to/from Markdown for the Phase-5 source-mode feature and export/copy-as-markdown use cases; any non-losslessly-representable block or inline node falls back to an HTML-comment JSON sentinel carrying the block verbatim so round-trips are always lossless. Not yet wired into any editor per its header note.
whatBreaks: A bug here would corrupt or lose content on a markdown source-mode round-trip, or break the sentinel fallback causing silent data loss for non-natural block types.

role: TipTap marks for wikilink/blockref/tag/valueref internal links
description: DOM-free schema-only TipTap Mark definitions so ProseMirror preserves wikilink/blockref/tag/valueref marks through setContent→getJSON round-trips; convert.js does the actual portable-doc translation. Importable in plain Node (only depends on @tiptap/core) so the pure-Node smoke harness can assert schema shape without loading index.js (which needs a DOM).
whatBreaks: Wrong attrs here desync from convert.js's reader, silently stripping internal links/valuerefs on every keystroke in the paper editor and canvas.

role: Notion-style '/' insert-block popup for the paper editor
description: Hand-rolled caret-anchored popup listing groups of insertable block types (mirrors the server's add-block dropdown), plus an EXPECTED-fields group read live from the DOM with hide-at-cap logic; base class also reused by a Phase-5 command palette via parameterization hooks.
whatBreaks: Slash-menu insert (and the derived command palette) stops working or offers wrong/stale block types, degrading paper authoring UX but not corrupting data.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for canvas slash-menu insert + command palette
description: Extracted smoke module asserting the '/'-menu direct-insert path (one insert-after per insertable type, callout shorthand, textable-node classification, a parent-type guard bug fix) and the P5 command palette registry/fuzzy-filter/Insert-parity with the slash menu. Pure Node, imports run-convert.js/slash-insert.js/command-palette.js.
whatBreaks: A regression in slash-insert defaults or palette parity ships silently since this is the only gate proving Insert commands match slash-menu output.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for the slots-native card widget projection
description: Asserts the 'card' block (an editable bpCard TipTap node with body contentDOM + tone/title/media/action chrome) projects, round-trips with zero ops when untouched, and emits exactly one patch-block per field mutation (body/tone/title, including explicit-null removals), plus nested-in-grid-section and insert/echo cases.
whatBreaks: A card widget diff bug (e.g. patch not carrying the whole slots or losing sibling cards) would silently corrupt paper content on save, undetected without this suite.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for server-echo reconcile + baseline reset
description: Proves own-echo detection (an echo of unchanged blocks is a no-op), that baseline reset makes subsequent diffs incremental not cumulative, external-edit detection, and the id-tolerant reconcile that stamps server-minted ids onto newly-inserted null-id blocks without churn.
whatBreaks: Regressions here would reintroduce caret-yanking re-renders or op-count blowup (cumulative instead of incremental diffs) in the live paper canvas editor.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for field-image/field-reference picker control-atoms
description: Asserts the two picker field types project to native bpField atom nodes (not opaque), round-trip, emit a bridge-shaped {value}-only patch on edit, insert/remove correctly, don't interfere with surrounding prose, coexist with other block kinds, and preserve a per-block dataset override.
whatBreaks: A picker-field diff bug would corrupt image/reference field values on save or leak dataset overrides across edits, undetected without this coverage.

role: Shared test harness/library for the decomposed paper-editor smoke suite
description: Central module every other smoke/*.mjs file imports: the check()/report() runner with a shared pass/fail counter, a pure-JS reference fold (applyOps) mirroring patch.ex semantics plus assertFolds gate, a seeded mulberry32 PRNG, canonical/key-order-safe deep compare, the production live-doc normalizer (normalizeCanvasDoc), project→reconstruct twin (reconstructBlock), and the full block/inline generator vocabulary + stable-id mutation family used by both the projection and markdown fuzz suites.
whatBreaks: Every smoke module in the suite depends on this file; a bug in applyOps or the generator vocabulary would make the whole fuzz/property-test suite give false confidence (or false failures) across all canvas/markdown round-trip gates.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for the blocks⇄Markdown converter (markdown.js)
description: Hand cases per block type/inline mark plus a 2000-iteration seeded fuzz gate proving blocksToMarkdown/markdownToBlocks reach a fixed point after one round-trip, are byte-lossless via a sentinel comment for non-prose/lossy blocks, and are render-equivalent for prose — includes regression tests for two real historical bugs (ambiguous nested emphasis, leading-backtick fence misparse).
whatBreaks: A markdown round-trip regression would silently garble or drop content when a paper is edited in source/markdown mode (Obsidian-style import/export).

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for canvas node-view atoms (divider/callout/code/diagram/fields/sheet/embed)
description: Large extracted smoke module (S3.x series) proving each canvas-handled block kind (divider atom, callout content node, code/diagram attr-atoms, native field-* types, sheet/embed read-only atoms) projects to its native TipTap node (not opaque), round-trips with zero ops untouched, emits exactly one correctly-shaped patch on edit including explicit-null/empty removal-safety, inserts/removes cleanly, and doesn't interfere with surrounding prose; also pins that nested-structure fields (composite/arrayOf/etc.) remain intentionally opaque.
whatBreaks: A regression in any node-view's projection/diff would silently corrupt or drop that block kind's content on every paper save across the whole canvas editor — this is the primary regression gate for that surface.

role: Pure-Node smoke tests for the singular 'note' widget projection
description: Proves the 'note' block (a callout-superset editable content node with label/lead attrs + inline body) projects correctly, byte-aligns with its materialized-slots twin, round-trips with zero ops untouched, emits exactly one patch per field edit (body/label/lead) with explicit-null removal for lead, and inserts/echoes correctly.
whatBreaks: A note widget diff bug would silently corrupt label/lead/body content or fail to persist a cleared lead field on save.

role: Seeded property/fuzz gates over the full canvas block vocabulary
description: The core regression gate: PROPERTY 1 (1000 random runs) proves load-identity — project→normalize→diff yields zero ops and every block reconstructs deep-equal; PROPERTY 2 (1000 random runs) proves a stable-id mutation's emitted ops fold back to reproduce the mutated run exactly. Includes delta-debug minimizers for failure repro and a determinism guard on the seeded PRNG.
whatBreaks: This is the broadest lossless-round-trip proof for the canvas editor; a silent regression here means the editor could corrupt or spuriously re-diff ANY block kind on load or edit, undetected by narrower per-block-kind tests.

role: Pure-Node smoke suite for PortableDoc block↔TipTap round-trip conversion
description: Verbatim-extracted set of ~40 checks pinning convert.js and canvas/run-convert.js: prose/mark/list/wikilink/blockref/tag/valueref round-trips, patch-block op shapes, and the Stage-S0 blocks⇄one-doc⇄ops projector (split/merge/reorder/front-insert fold gates). Runs through a shared check()/assertFolds harness so exit code spans all smoke modules; guards several historical data-loss bugs (dropped strike marks, flat-string list crash, valueref deletion on save).
whatBreaks: A silent regression in editor↔wire projection (e.g. dropped marks, mis-minted ids, wrong op emission) ships undetected, corrupting saved Papers/canvas content.

role: Pure-Node smoke suite for the canvas `section` container node
description: Pins projection of top-level sections to editable bpSection nodes (nested sections stay opaque, V1 forbid-nesting), the fine-vs-coarse op strategy (patch-block for interior child edits vs replace-block for structural changes), id-minting collision safety across nested trees, and the Step-2 grid layout engine (span/order hoisted to a bpId-keyed cells map, surviving reorders).
whatBreaks: Section/grid-layout edits could mis-key span/order onto the wrong child after a reorder, or a minted id could collide with a nested id and abort the whole save batch server-side.

role: Pure-Node smoke suite for the markdown source-mode toggle (P5)
description: Pins the docToBlocks→markdownToBlocks→realignBlockIds→runToOps pipeline: no-edit-zero-ops, single-patch on edit, insert/remove, id uniqueness, the L0-vs-C lag model (in-flight unconfirmed edits not re-emitted), and duplicate-signature sibling tie-breaking. Also checks the command-palette 'Toggle Markdown source' registration.
whatBreaks: Toggling markdown source mode could duplicate-insert in-flight blocks or churn/patch untouched sibling blocks, corrupting the canvas doc on exit.

role: Pure-Node smoke suite for the canvas `stage` widget node
description: Pins projection of the `stage` block (pipeline-widget) to a scalar bpStage control-atom node, present-only attrs, slots-form plain-text reads (marks dropped), zero-ops on untouched round-trip, per-field patch emission on edit/clear, and fine-grained nested patching inside a section-of-stages.
whatBreaks: Editing a stage's title/detail/source flag could emit wrong or extra ops, or a slots-form stage could leak formatting marks into the reconstructed scalar field.

role: Standalone portable CSS for the embeddable bp-paper-editor Web Component
description: De-scoped (:root,:host) copy of the Studio's .bp-paper-surface rules and --paper-*/--bp-* tokens, generated/mirrored from api/assets/paper-surface/paper-surface.css and freshness-gated by a mirror-check script; ships alongside the editor bundle as the two-file embed contract for external hosts.
whatBreaks: An embedded paper-editor Web Component in a third-party host renders unstyled or visually diverges from Studio/reader typography; drift is only caught by the mirror-check gate.

role: Pure DOM-free callout tone alias normalizer
description: Maps Obsidian-style admonition aliases (note/warn/error) plus unknown/blank input onto Barkpark's 5 canonical callout tones, falling back to 'info'; kept out of index.js so it stays unit-testable without jsdom and is shared by the `> [!type]` shorthand detector and web tone-map.
whatBreaks: A callout typed with an unrecognized tone alias would render with an undefined CSS class instead of falling back to info styling.

role: Caret-anchored `[[` autocomplete popup UI for the paper editor
description: Custom (non-TipTap-suggestion) popup mirroring slash-menu.js's shape: flat async candidate list, keyboard nav with wrap, mousedown-before-blur picking, capture-phase Escape dismissal, viewport-flip positioning. Owns popup DOM/state only; the WC decides when to open it and applies the chosen wikilink mark.
whatBreaks: Typing `[[` to link to another paper could fail to show results, mis-position off-screen, or pick the wrong candidate on Enter/click.

role: Pure DOM-free trigger-parsing logic for `[[` wikilink and `#` tag autocompletes
description: Determines from block-local text + caret offset whether the wikilink/tag popup should open and what the live query/replace-range is; boundary rules guard against mid-word `#` (C#), `##` headings, and closed `]]`/`[[` spans. Unit-tested in plain Node; consumed by index.js and paired with wikilink-menu.js for the browser half.
whatBreaks: Wikilink or tag autocomplete could trigger spuriously mid-prose (e.g. on 'C#' or 'issue #5') or fail to open/replace the correct span, corrupting inserted links.

role: Single-source canonical stylesheet for the paper reading surface across Studio/reader/export
description: Defines the --paper-*/--bp-* theme and typography tokens plus .bp-paper-surface element rules, embedded inline (never fetched) via Barkpark.PortableDoc.Render.Stylesheet.css/0 into three sinks: Studio root.html.heex, the /papers reader (bulldocs.html.heex), and sheet HTML export. Achieves View/Edit/reader parity by construction rather than hand-matched mirrors; dark-mode callout tone companions are hand-authored, light tokens generated from design/tokens.json.
whatBreaks: Visual parity breaks simultaneously across Studio, the public /papers reader, and sheet HTML export since all three compile this one stylesheet at build time.

role: Pure-Node unit test harness for the Studio sheet formula-editing kernel
description: Loads the shipped browser IIFE bundle (priv/static/assets/bp-sheet-formula.js) into a node:vm sandbox and exercises tokenize, caretContext (incl. string-literal traps), F4 $-cycling, insert/replace/extend ref matrix, depth-aware arg index, ref color stability, and normalizeFormula — testing the actual committed bundle, not a source copy.
whatBreaks: Formula-bar caret intelligence (ref highlighting, F4 cycling, autocomplete insertion) in the Sheets grid editor could silently regress since it tests the shipped bundle directly.

role: Node VM test harness for the shipped sheet-grid browser hook
description: Loads the compiled bp-sheet-grid.js (plus bp-sheet-formula.js/bp-sheet-pointing.js) verbatim into a node:vm sandbox with faked window/document, then exercises keyboard routing, drag-to-select, header selection, formula-bar sync, click-away commit, and function-autocomplete logic against fake DOM nodes. Zero deps, no lockfile; a regression in the committed static bundle reds this test directly.
whatBreaks: Undetected regressions ship to the Studio sheet grid's keyboard nav, selection, and formula-bar commit paths with no test coverage.

role: WCAG contrast gate for the sheet-grid ref-highlight color palette
description: Parses root.html.heex for the 8 --sheet-ref-N hues (both themes) and the sheet background, computes WCAG contrast ratios in pure JS, and asserts 4.5:1 minimum, pairwise distinctness, index-locking of .sheet-refc-N classes, disjointness from the live presence-cursor palette (parsed from presence_state.ex), and ghost-text legibility.
whatBreaks: A hue or theme edit could ship an invisible or ambiguous cell-reference outline/formula-bar color with no automated catch.

role: Node VM unit tests for the sheet-grid pointing/prediction kernel
description: Loads bp-sheet-pointing.js in a node:vm sandbox and tests coordinate round-trips (colLetters/refToPos), range-text normalization, the phantomStep arrow-navigation state machine (incl. stack-safety over 200k rows), predictRange auto-range prediction, shouldOfferGhost, fuzzyFns ranking, and the ghostReduce state reducer.
whatBreaks: Regressions in Excel-style arrow navigation, ghost range prediction, or function autocomplete in the Studio sheet editor go undetected.

role: Test runner manifest for the sheet-grid JS test suite
description: Trivial private package.json whose only script globs and runs every __*.test.mjs file with node, one at a time; no dependencies.
whatBreaks: `npm test` in this directory would fail to discover or run the sheet-grid unit tests.

role: deterministic benchmark document generator
description: Generates a large synthetic document and schema (200 fields, 30 contributors, 100 validation rules) for the validation performance benchmark. Deterministic — no random — so bench runs are reproducible.
whatBreaks: Validation performance benchmarks produce unreliable or non-reproducible results.

role: Validation engine performance benchmark
description: Self-contained Elixir benchmark that generates a synthetic 200-field/100-rule doc, runs Evaluator.run_rules/3 five times, and exits with status 1 if median exceeds 100 ms — used as a CI regression alarm.
whatBreaks: CI no longer catches validation engine regressions that exceed the 100ms latency target.

role: Compile-time base Elixir/Phoenix config for the Barkpark app
description: Sets ecto_repos, Endpoint defaults, Oban queues/cron, KEK/mailer defaults, and numerous feature-flag defaults (tmux console, Claude chat, public_demo_studio, task lease TTL, sync). Imports the per-env file at the bottom, so it is the base every other config layers on.
whatBreaks: Wrong Oban queue/cron wiring or a bad default flag breaks background jobs, task TTL sweeping, or security posture (e.g. accidentally exposing demo Studio) across every environment.

role: Dev-environment Phoenix/Ecto config overrides
description: Local Postgres connection, endpoint binding/secret, CORS origins, dev ingest token, SSRF allow-private-outbound, and public_demo_studio default for local development.
whatBreaks: Local dev server fails to boot or connect to Postgres, or dev-only security escapes (SSRF allowance) leak into behavior unexpectedly; no prod impact.

role: production Elixir config override
description: Minimal prod config that sets logger level to :info and comments out force_ssl (intentionally disabled per ops note until HTTPS is confirmed). All other prod config lives in runtime.exs.
whatBreaks: Uncommenting force_ssl without HTTPS causes 301 redirect loops that break all API calls.

role: Runtime (release-time) config for prod secrets, hosts, and flags
description: Reads env vars for DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY_BASE, PHX_HOST/SCHEME, check_origin allowlist, KEK/cloak keys, SMTP relay, plugin selection, sharing/sync, rate limits, self-update, and more — the canonical source for how a deployed prod box gets its identity/secrets/topology.
whatBreaks: Misconfigured host/check_origin causes LiveView websocket 403s (Studio click-dead, per documented past incident); missing/misapplied secrets can crash boot in prod or silently disable auth/mail/encryption.

role: Test-environment Elixir config
description: Sandbox Ecto pool, manual Oban testing mode, in-process mailer, fixed test secrets, pulse-channel fixtures, and various boot-time seeder/worker disables to avoid ExUnit sandbox ownership races.
whatBreaks: Test suite becomes flaky or fails to boot (sandbox ownership errors, Oban auto-running jobs unexpectedly), undermining CI reliability but with no prod impact.

description: ADR-0003-canonical-sync-tag-convention.md

role: Docker/release container entrypoint script
description: Runs DB migrations and seeds (idempotent) then starts the Phoenix release via bin/barkpark start. This is the primary entrypoint when the app runs as a container or OTP release.
whatBreaks: Container deployments fail to migrate/seed and may start with stale schema or missing seed data.

role: top-level application module stub
description: Empty module shell generated by Phoenix; holds only a moduledoc placeholder. No logic or functions — purely a namespace anchor.
whatBreaks: Compilation would fail if the module name were wrong, but the file has no real logic to break.

role: Airdrop access-grants context: mint/lookup/claim/revoke/validate
description: Core authorization context for shareable, time-boxed, account-bound scoped capability grants. Implements a fail-closed scope-containment ladder (workspace→project→dataset→type→doc_id), atomic claim (CAS on claimed_at), no-escalation minting via Tenancy.Auth, live grantor re-validation (privilege revocation propagates), and audit-chain emission on every lifecycle transition. Referenced by GrantController, AccessController, ClaimFlow, and Content.Scope's read-narrowing.

role: Single no-oracle grant-claim resolver shared by browser + API
description: The one place that decides whether an authenticated user may claim a grant token — collapsing every failure (unknown token, wrong grantee email, expired/revoked, unconfirmed account) to the same `:invalid` outcome so grant existence and account state are never leaked. Enforces a confirmed-email gate before Access.claim/2 runs.
whatBreaks: An account-enumeration or account-takeover hole: an attacker could probe token validity or claim a grant meant for someone else's mailbox.

role: Ecto schema + changeset for the access_grants table
description: Defines the Grant struct (scope ladder fields, capabilities, hashed link token, single-use/expiry/revocation) and its changeset, including fail-closed validation that capabilities are restricted to the read/write/admin vocabulary.
whatBreaks: A changeset bug could allow minting a grant with an unenforceable capability or missing scope, silently weakening the containment guarantee.

role: Emails the airdrop-grant claim link to the grantee
description: Builds and sends the /grant/<token> claim email via Swoosh/Mailer after a successful mint; fail-soft (logs and returns error on delivery failure without ever storing/deriving the token itself).
whatBreaks: Grantees never receive their claim link by email, though the grant still exists and is shown in-app (degraded UX, not a security break).

role: Core user-accounts context: auth, sessions, email tokens, TOTP MFA
description: Central identity module: registration, constant-time password login with lockout, session token mint/verify/revoke (incl. SAML SLO), email confirm/reset tokens, magic-link login, and TOTP/recovery-code MFA with replay-safe CAS consumption. Tagged @canonical capability:user-auth. Backs nearly every authenticated request path in the app.

role: Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity breached-password checker
description: Opt-in password-breach check that sends only a 5-char SHA-1 prefix to the HIBP range API and matches suffixes locally; fails open (allows the password) if disabled or if HIBP is unreachable, keeping registration/reset available.
whatBreaks: Users could register/reset with a known-breached password (degraded defense-in-depth, not an outage) or, if fail-open logic were inverted, legitimate signups could be blocked.

role: GDPR export + erasure (pseudonymisation) for a User
description: Assembles a machine-readable data export (sessions, tokens, memberships, audit events, no secrets) and implements right-to-erasure by scrubbing PII and revoking access while retaining the user row for audit-trail integrity. Emits an audit event on erasure and runs the erasure in a single DB transaction.
whatBreaks: A bug here either leaks secret material in a data export or fails to fully revoke access/scrub PII on erasure, a GDPR compliance and security failure.

role: Core-auth User Ecto schema + changesets (password/TOTP)
description: Defines the users table schema (email, argon2 password hash, encrypted TOTP secret, recovery codes, lockout fields) and changesets for registration, password change, confirmation, and TOTP enrolment, plus constant-time password verification with a no-user-verify timing defense.

role: Ecto schema for hashed single-use email tokens (confirm/reset/login)
description: Stores only the SHA-256 hash of email tokens used for confirmation, password reset, and magic-link login, with per-context validity windows; rows are deleted on use.
whatBreaks: Incorrect validity windows or hashing would let expired/forged tokens confirm emails, reset passwords, or log users in without authorization.

role: Sends core-auth transactional emails via Swoosh
description: Renders and delivers confirmation, password-reset, magic-link, and already-registered emails; deliberately fails soft (logs but doesn't error) to preserve anti-enumeration behavior in callers.
whatBreaks: Users would silently never receive verification/reset/login emails, blocking account confirmation and password recovery without any visible error.

role: Ecto schema for hashed login-session tokens + session-state predicates
description: Stores hashed session tokens with expiry/revocation/idle/MFA-freshness fields and pure predicate functions (expired?, active?, mfa_fresh?); idle-timeout logic exists but is deliberately not wired into the actual verify path yet.

role: WebAuthn/passkey registration + authentication ceremonies (wraps wax)
description: Mints and verifies WebAuthn registration/authentication challenges via the `wax` FIDO2 library, persists credentials, and enforces the monotonic signature counter to detect cloned authenticators.
whatBreaks: A verification or counter-check bug could allow passkey login bypass or fail to detect a cloned authenticator, undermining the passkey security guarantee.

role: Ecto schema for a registered WebAuthn/passkey credential
description: Stores credential_id, COSE public key, and monotonic sign_count per user; no private key material is ever stored.
whatBreaks: Corrupted or missing sign_count/cose_key data would break passkey authentication for affected users.

role: Generates the OpenAPI 3.1 spec from the capabilities manifest
description: Transforms the same manifest the CLI/MCP/SDK consume into an OpenAPI document (paths, params, request/response schemas, error table sourced from Content.Errors) so the published spec can't drift from actual routes.
whatBreaks: The published OpenAPI spec (used by external integrators/tools) would misdescribe the real API surface, breaking codegen or API-client tooling built against it.

role: Plugin API test spec executor
description: Fires HTTP requests defined in Plugin.api_test_spec structs against a configurable base URL, evaluates assertions, runs cleanup steps, and returns structured pass/fail/error results. Used to validate plugin behaviour against a live API.
whatBreaks: Plugin API self-tests cannot be executed, breaking any automated plugin validation workflow that depends on this runner.

role: built-in assertion evaluators for API test runner
description: Elixir module implementing the 8 fixed assert types (`status`, `body_contains`, `body_regex`, `json_path`, `json_keys_include`, `header`, `not_empty`, `duration_under_ms`) used by the plugin API test runner.
whatBreaks: Plugin API tests silently pass or fail incorrectly, undermining the reliability of all plugin contract tests.

role: Catalog facade for the Studio API Docs + Playground pane
description: Thin facade concatenating per-category endpoint spec modules (Reference/Query/Mutate/Export/History/Misc/Schemas/Webhooks) plus dynamically-adapted plugin-contributed api_tests, exposing all/1 and find/2 consumed by ApiTesterLive.
whatBreaks: The Studio API docs/playground pane shows wrong, missing, or crashing endpoint entries; does not affect actual API behavior, only the dev-facing tester UI.

role: Studio API Playground catalog entry for the NDJSON export endpoint
description: Declares the metadata/scenarios for the dataset-export endpoint shown and runnable in the Studio's API Docs + Playground pane; split out of the Endpoints facade.
whatBreaks: Only the Studio's interactive API documentation/playground for the export endpoint would show wrong info or fail to run, not the actual export API.

role: Studio API Playground catalog entries for revision/history endpoints
description: Declares metadata/scenarios for list/show/restore revision endpoints in the Studio's API Docs + Playground pane; split out of the Endpoints facade.
whatBreaks: Only the Studio's interactive documentation/playground for history endpoints would be wrong or non-functional, not the underlying history API.

role: Studio API-docs catalog entries: Analytics + Real-time (SSE)
description: Defines the Analytics dataset-stats endpoint and the docs-only SSE listen endpoint as catalog specs consumed by the Studio API Docs + Playground pane. Split out of the Endpoints facade for module-count leanness; entries/1 returns them in fixed order.
whatBreaks: Studio's API Docs/Playground pane shows wrong or missing Analytics/SSE documentation and playground scenarios.

role: Studio API-docs catalog entries for the 8 mutate operations
description: Declares runnable example specs (body, response shape, error codes, scenarios) for create/createOrReplace/createIfNotExists/patch/publish/unpublish/discardDraft/delete, driving the Playground's live-run feature against /v1/data/mutate.
whatBreaks: Playground 'Run' actions for mutations send malformed example bodies or document wrong behavior, misleading API consumers testing writes.

role: Studio API-docs catalog entries for query/search endpoints
description: Specs for list/filter/single-doc/expand-references/search endpoints including path/query params, response shapes, and runnable scenarios (incl. auth/404/400 cases) shown in the Studio Playground.
whatBreaks: Docs/playground for the most commonly used read endpoints (list, search) become inaccurate or scenarios fail to validate real API behavior.

role: Studio API-docs catalog: docs-only Reference pages (envelope/errors/limits)
description: Three non-runnable reference entries (envelope shape, error codes, known limitations) rendered via render_key in the Studio docs pane; no HTTP calls.
whatBreaks: Reference documentation in Studio becomes stale or missing, but no runtime API behavior is affected.

role: Studio API-docs catalog entries for Schema list/show + live schema browser
description: Specs for admin schema list/show endpoints plus a live data-driven schema-reference panel (backed by Content.list_schemas/1) that auto-reflects plugin-registered schemas.
whatBreaks: Schema documentation/playground in Studio is wrong or the live schema browser fails to reflect actual schemas, confusing API consumers.

role: Studio API-docs catalog entries for webhook list/create/delete
description: Runnable specs for the admin webhook subscription CRUD endpoints (list/create/delete), including valid event names and example payloads, shown in the Studio Playground.
whatBreaks: Webhook documentation/playground presents wrong required fields or event names, causing failed webhook setup attempts by API consumers.

role: API tester HTTP request executor
description: Builds and executes HTTP requests against the local Phoenix endpoint for the Studio API playground. Handles path interpolation, query string building, auth headers, and pass/fail verdict.
whatBreaks: The Studio API playground fails to execute requests or render results; no production data path affected.

role: OTP application entrypoint building the full supervision tree
description: Assembles core services (Repo, Vault, Plugins.Registry, Validation, SchemaBootstrap, Indx runtime, Oban with plugin-merged crontab), conditional subtrees (Sync, SelfUpdate), Sheets/StudioChat registries, webhook delivery supervisor, and finally the Endpoint; runs post-boot sharing refresh, banner, and pg_trgm check.
whatBreaks: Wrong boot ordering or a missing child crashes the entire app on startup or leaves subsystems (Oban jobs, plugin schemas, search recovery) silently broken — this file governs whether Barkpark boots at all.

role: Tenant-wide append-only tamper-evident audit event bus (write/read API)
description: Sole write path (emit/1) for audit events: serializes per-workspace via advisory lock, chains sha256 hashes via Audit.Chain, inserts, then best-effort bridges to webhook dispatch post-commit. Also provides verify_chain/1 and read helpers (recent/2, recent_for_org/2, list_for_workspace/2). Emit is synchronous/transactional by design so the hash chain and audited change never drift.

role: Pure sha256 hash-chain logic shared by audit writer and verifier
description: Deterministic canonical serialization of an audit row's business fields (sorted metadata, iso8601 timestamp) and hash(fields, prev_hash) used identically by emit/1 and verify_chain/1; verify/1 walks a row list checking hash + prev_hash linkage.
whatBreaks: A mismatch between the writer's and verifier's canonicalization would either produce false tamper alarms or silently allow undetected tampering in the audit log.

role: Ecto schema for audit_events rows (insert-only, immutable)
description: Defines fields (category/action/subject/actor/workspace/project/metadata/occurred_at/prev_hash/hash) and the insert_changeset/1 used exclusively by Barkpark.Audit.emit/1; deliberately has no update changeset since the DB table is immutable via trigger.
whatBreaks: Malformed changeset validation would reject or corrupt audit inserts, breaking the audit trail or letting invalid categories through.

role: Cursor-based tail-shipper of audit_events to SIEM/webhook sinks
description: flush/0 and flush_sink/1 read events past each sink's last_exported_id, batch (500) and POST them via the webhook Dispatcher (HMAC-signed, SSRF-guarded), advancing the cursor only on success and auto-disabling a sink after 15 consecutive failures.
whatBreaks: SIEM/webhook audit exports silently stop advancing (re-shipping duplicates or losing delivery) or a sink never auto-disables on persistent failure, masking integration outages.

role: Ecto schema for a configured SIEM/webhook audit-export destination
description: Defines `audit_export_sinks` rows (url, secret, format, cursor `last_exported_id`, failure count) that the audit-log tail-shipper streams events to. Format restricted to generic/splunk/datadog; workspace_id nil means global.
whatBreaks: Malformed changeset validation would let an invalid sink (bad URL/format) persist and silently fail every export flush.

role: Oban cron worker that flushes audit log to all active export sinks
description: Thin 1-attempt Oban worker calling `Barkpark.Audit.Export.flush/0` once a minute; relies on the cursor model in Export for idempotency/retry rather than Oban retries.
whatBreaks: If the worker stops firing or misconfigures max_attempts, SIEM export sinks silently stop receiving audit events with no retry.

role: API token authentication + login-ticket + share-token context
description: Core auth context: verify_token/1 (the single fail-closed choke point rejecting ticket-kind keys), single-use login-ticket mint/consume (including cloud-identity JIT user handoff), Personal Access Token minting with role-gated permission caps, and scoped revocable share-edit tokens with defense-in-depth validation.

role: Ecto schema for bearer API tokens (api_tokens table)
description: Defines the ApiToken schema storing SHA256 token hashes, permissions, tenant scope, PAT/ticket-key kinds, and P5 scoped-share edit fields; hash_token/1 is the canonical hashing chokepoint used everywhere a raw token is verified or created.

role: Ecto schema for single-use short-TTL Studio login handoff tickets
description: Stores a hashed opaque ticket bound to an encrypted-at-rest raw api_token (or optional user_email for JIT user provisioning); consumed exactly once via atomic UPDATE...WHERE used_at IS NULL to drop the token into a browser session without pasting it.
whatBreaks: A broken single-use guard or plaintext token storage could let a login ticket be replayed or leak a bearer token, compromising Studio one-click entry auth.

role: Helper for creating/purging weekly public-read API tokens
description: Generates random public-read tokens (via Barkpark.Auth.create_token) for the deploy pipeline and purges stale ones by label prefix, carefully excluding ticket-kind rows so it never deletes an outsider's ticket key.
whatBreaks: A bad purge query could delete live public-read tokens (breaking public API access) or fail to rotate them, leaking stale credentials indefinitely.

role: Compile-time build identity (version/release/commit/built_at) module
description: Derives version info from git tags/env vars at COMPILE time (deliberately, per its own doc, since prod always does clean rebuilds) and exposes it as the `/v1/capabilities` manifest's `build` key; used for update-available comparisons.
whatBreaks: Wrong version/release parsing would break the capabilities manifest's build info and any 'update available' comparison logic across bp CLI/TUI.

role: EDItEUR ONIX codelist XML parser/seeder
description: Streaming SweetXml parser for EDItEUR codelist XML snapshots; handles hierarchy (ParentCode), multi-language labels, and seeds results into the Codelists registry via register/3. BYO model: publishers supply their own XML.
