whatBreaks: ONIX codelist import fails or produces corrupt hierarchical/multi-language codelist data, breaking ONIX export and codelist-based Studio fields.

role: Facade context for all document/schema CRUD and lifecycle operations
description: The central Barkpark.Content module — a thin delegating facade over ~20 extracted submodules (Query, Writer, Lifecycle, Mutations, Edges, Schema, Papers, Search, Export, Revisions, etc.) that is the single public API every controller/plugin/LiveView calls for document reads, writes, publish/unpublish, edges, schemas, and Papers.

role: Pure-read document analytics aggregates (counts, stats, recent activity)
description: Extracted concern from Barkpark.Content providing type_census (desk/…Rest census), document_stats, total_documents, recent_activity — all tenancy-scoped Ecto aggregate queries over Document/MutationEvent.
whatBreaks: Wrong tenancy scoping here would misreport document counts/analytics in Studio's desk tree or leak/undercount cross-workspace data.

role: Post-mutation fan-out: PubSub broadcast, webhook dispatch, revision/event persistence
description: Single owner of per-doc/workspace PubSub topic string shapes (doc_topic/paper_topic) and the deferred-broadcast process-dictionary protocol used inside DB transactions; called by Content's write/publish/delete paths and consumed by StudioLive, BulldocsLive, Tasks, webhooks, SSE.

role: Principal/auth-context struct threaded through content reads and writes
description: Defines CallerContext (principal_type, user_id, roles, is_admin, grants) built from api tokens, user sessions, or conn assigns; drives field-level visibility and row/ownership scoping decisions downstream in Envelope.render and Content.Scope.

role: Plugin-scoped codelist registry (register/get/lookup/tree) with ETS-cached friendly-name alias resolution
description: Stores hierarchical codelists (e.g. ONIX contributor roles, Thema) per plugin+list_id+issue with idempotent re-registration, translation-based label lookup with language fallback, and a friendly-name-to-numeric-list-id alias resolver for OnixEdit schemas, cached in ETS with a TTL.

role: Ecto schema for codelist registry entries
description: Defines the `codelists` Ecto schema with plugin_name, list_id, issue, name, description fields and a has_many to codelist values. Enforces unique constraint on (plugin_name, list_id, issue).
whatBreaks: Codelist upsert/lookup fails for ONIX and schema-backed enum fields, breaking any plugin that registers or queries codelists.

role: Ecto schema for codelist value translations
description: Defines the `codelist_value_translations` schema mapping a codelist value to a language+label pair with a unique constraint on (codelist_value_id, language).
whatBreaks: Localized label lookups for codelist values break, causing missing or duplicate translations in ONIX exports and Studio UI.

role: Ecto schema for codelist values
description: Defines the `codelist_values` schema with code, position, metadata, self-referential parent/children for hierarchical codelists, and has_many translations. Unique on (codelist_id, code).
whatBreaks: Codelist value persistence and hierarchy queries fail, breaking ONIX export enum resolution and any Studio codelist field.

role: Evaluates schema-declared cross_validations rules against a document
description: Walks all/any-composed predicate trees down to leaf {field, operator} checks delegated to FieldVisibility.visible?, annotating each rule with satisfied:true/false; violations/2 filters for the editor's validation banner.
whatBreaks: Cross-field schema validation rules (e.g. 'ISBN or GTIN required') would silently pass or falsely flag documents in the Studio editor, letting invalid content through or blocking valid saves.

role: Ecto schema for the documents table — the core content row
description: Defines the single physical schema backing every content type (posts, papers, tasks, sheets) discriminated by `type`, including tenant scope, draft/published status, freeform content map, rev, and owner_id ACL; identity is (doc_id, type, dataset_id).

role: Pure string helpers for Sanity's drafts.-prefix draft/published id convention
description: Leaf, dependency-free module: draft_id/published_id/draft? — used pervasively across Content, Edges, Broadcast to convert between drafts.<id> and published <id> forms.
whatBreaks: Any bug in these prefix helpers would misidentify draft vs published documents everywhere they're used, corrupting publish/unpublish and reference resolution.

role: Ecto schema for materialized content-graph edges between documents
description: Defines content_edges rows (from_id/to_id/kind/weight/plugin_source) powering the reference graph and Studio Canvas2D visualization; kind is now an open string (source field name) rather than a closed allowlist, and dangling targets are structurally unstorable via FK constraints.
whatBreaks: Reference tracking, the Studio graph view, backlink/reverse-reference queries, and the edge projector would produce wrong or missing relationships between documents.

role: Content-graph edge concern: reference extraction, CRUD, disconnect on delete
description: Implements extract_edges (schema-driven reference-field walk incl. arrayOf), add_edge/add_edges (slug-to-UUID resolution + upsert into content_edges), list_outbound/inbound_edges, corpus_edges, and disconnect_references (drains referencing docs on delete/unpublish, arrayOf-aware, tenancy fail-closed via require_workspace).
whatBreaks: A bug here could leave dangling references after delete, corrupt the /v1/graph edge data, or leak/resolve edges across tenant boundaries.

role: Field-encryption chokepoint wiring FieldCipher into the content write path
description: encrypt_marked/3 seals schema fields marked encrypted:true before every Document.changeset write (fail-closed on any unparseable marked field); decrypt_document/3 is the privileged, explicitly-gated reveal primitive. Also encrypts bound PortableDoc block values to prevent plaintext leakage on re-projection.
whatBreaks: A failure here could persist a schema field marked encrypted as plaintext-at-rest, defeating the entire field-encryption guarantee for sensitive content.

role: Canonical v1 JSON envelope renderer and field-visibility redaction chokepoint
description: render/3 is the single point where every read surface (REST, search, share links, history, reference expansion) converts a Document into the public envelope shape while enforcing private/owner_only/readable_by field visibility fail-closed for nil/anonymous callers; also exposes field_readable?/3 to gate filter/order query clauses against hidden fields.

role: validation error code registry
description: Compile-time registry mapping validation error code atoms to message templates, severity levels, and version tags. Used by the cross-field rule evaluator and v2 error envelope.
whatBreaks: Validation error responses return wrong codes or messages, breaking SDK clients that parse structured error envelopes.

role: Maps internal error tuples to the canonical v1 JSON error envelope
description: Central error-to-HTTP mapping (code/message/status/details/hint/request_id) used by controllers' action_fallback; known_codes/0 is the canonical error-code vocabulary consumed by the OpenAPI spec generator, so adding a code without registering a hint breaks spec/runtime parity CI.

role: Read-side queries backing the SSE listen/replay stream
description: Owns keyset-paginated `replay_since/4` (Last-Event-ID replay over mutation_events, batched to avoid loading the whole backlog) and `document_present?/2` (scope-free row-existence check to distinguish delete tombstones from ACL denials) for BarkparkWeb.ListenController.
whatBreaks: SSE resume-from-cursor could replay the wrong events or leak/hide cross-tenant events, and delete-vs-ACL-denial detection in the listen stream would misclassify tombstones.

role: Reference-field expansion (?expand=) for document read responses
description: Resolves reference/arrayOf-reference fields into embedded rendered documents, threading caller_context through Envelope.render for per-field visibility on expanded refs, and enforcing published_only to prevent draft leakage on public read-share queries.
whatBreaks: The ?expand= query feature (used by REST clients, SDKs, and Studio previews to inline referenced docs) would resolve wrong/missing/leaked (draft) content, or leak private fields on expanded referenced documents.

role: Streaming full-dataset document export with field-visibility redaction
description: Streams every document in a dataset (optionally filtered by type) as rendered envelope maps via Repo.stream, applying Envelope.render/3 redaction keyed by caller_context; schema is memoised per type across the stream.
whatBreaks: A bulk export could leak private/encrypted fields to unauthorized callers, or omit/duplicate documents across a large dataset.

role: Pure predicate evaluator for schema field `visibleWhen` conditions
description: Single source of truth shared by the Studio field renderer and CrossValidator for evaluating visibility operators (eq/neq/in/empty/non_empty/starts_with) against a document, including dotted/list-flattening path walks; unknown operator defaults to visible.
whatBreaks: Conditional field visibility could drift between the editor UI and validation, showing/hiding or wrongly requiring fields inconsistently across surfaces.

role: Classic Studio editor form ↔ document content coercion + draft save
description: Maps a document/schema pair to a flat form map and back (doc_to_form/build_content), coerces number/boolean string inputs, and implements the classic_save_content data-loss guard that patches bound blocks instead of overwriting content['blocks'] when a doc was edited in the Beta block editor; upsert_draft/6 is the autosave entry point.
whatBreaks: Classic-editor autosave could silently drop FREE blocks/block order, corrupt numeric/boolean field types, or lose unbound field values on save.

role: Content-graph BFS engine powering Studio graph pane + /v1/graph API
description: Walks the materialised content_edges table (or live-extracts drafts) from a root document with node/fan-out/depth trip-wires, hydrating nodes, phantom/dangling targets, and rank-by-topology dependents. Also owns the canonical slug->doc resolver (resolve_doc) and reverse_referencers used by the Studio unpublish guard; heavy tenancy/ownership ACL logic embedded throughout.

role: Reference/codelist label resolution for View-mode rendering
description: Resolves a stored reference doc-id to its target document's title (published-preferred, tenant-scoped) and a codelist code to its human label; builds the render_opts/paper_render_opts maps threaded into PortableDoc.Render, plus paper_style resolution for article-styled papers.
whatBreaks: Reference fields and codelist values would render as raw ids/codes instead of titles/labels, or could cross-resolve into the wrong tenant's document.

role: Document publish/unpublish/discard/delete lifecycle with rev-fenced transactions
description: Implements the draft⇄published row moves inside Repo.transaction with rev-fenced deletes (fenced_delete/1) to prevent concurrent-write races from destroying newer edits, firing before/after lifecycle hooks and broadcasting only after commit.
whatBreaks: Publishing, unpublishing, or deleting documents could silently lose concurrent edits, leave orphaned draft/published rows, or broadcast stale/incorrect mutation events across the whole content system.

role: Fallback-chain resolver for v2 localizedText schema fields
description: Given a language->text value map and a fallback_chain (with a deterministic 'first-non-empty' sentinel), picks the winning language/text for rendering. Small, pure, well-isolated utility.
whatBreaks: Multi-language documents would render blank or the wrong language/text on any localizedText field.

role: Ecto schema for the mutation_events audit/outbox table
description: Records dataset/type/doc_id/mutation/rev plus workspace/project/dataset_entity tenancy FKs and an origin `source` tag used to suppress echoing pull-applied writes back out via push.

role: Atomic batch-mutation dispatcher (Sanity-style create/patch/publish/delete ops)
description: apply_mutations/2 wraps per-op dispatch (create/createOrReplace/createIfNotExists/publish/unpublish/discardDraft/delete/replace/patch with setIfMissing/unset/inc/dec/append/prepend) in a single transaction, deferring PubSub broadcasts until commit and redacting each echoed document through the real caller's schema-based visibility.
whatBreaks: The core mutate API used by all writers (Studio, CLI, SDK) could partially apply a batch, leak private fields in echoed results, or corrupt content via mishandled patch operators.

role: Papers (Bulldocs) domain module — read/resolve side for type:"paper" docs
description: Core Papers logic (1198 lines): paper fetch/topic resolution (workspace-scoped PubSub topics), wikilink target resolution across papers and tasks, and other read helpers; delegates write-path ops (upsert, block ops) to Papers.BlockOps. Extracted from Barkpark.Content as concern P.

role: One-off/idempotent data-repair pass for legacy paper block shapes
description: Backfills stable block ids onto id-less blocks (fixing canvas diff corruption) and normalizes legacy flat-string list items to canonical inline-array shape, additive-only, idempotent, render-identical, scanning all tenants in one pass with minimal (content-only) saves.
whatBreaks: Legacy papers missing block ids could keep corrupting via spurious duplicate-block inserts in the canvas editor, or list-item shape mismatches could cause editor crashes/churn.

role: Papers write path — upsert, block-op patching, and delta broadcast
description: Owns upsert_paper/1 (whole-paper upsert + whole-HTML broadcast), apply_paper_block_op/4, apply_paper_block_ops/4 (atomic batch + delta broadcast), and apply_document_block_op/5 (generalized block-op write for the Beta block editor); extracted from papers.ex to de-god-module it, handles tenancy-scoped upsert-vs-hijack lookup and sheet-embed hydration.

role: Migration: backfills locked title/featured template onto legacy papers
description: Mix-task-driven corpus scanner/migration that plans (dry-run default) and, on --apply, rewrites legacy paper block lists to conform to the PortableDoc doctrine template (locked title heading at block 0, optional featured image at block 1), re-rendering body_html/projection and bumping revs. Refuses to write unfixable or duplicate-id shapes; idempotent and additive.
whatBreaks: A bad backfill run could corrupt the corpus with duplicate block ids or double-rendered titles, or silently skip papers that should have been migrated (only matters when the human-gated --apply is run).

role: AI-proposes write path: insert-only draft block edits with mandatory provenance
description: Implements the agent-facing 'propose' loop for living-values valuerefs: applies insert-only ops to a paper's draft twin, records provenance as a content_edges edge and a content sidecar, and rejects any mutating op kind. Idempotent via explicit block ids; unresolvable source rolls back the whole transaction.
whatBreaks: Agent-proposed edits could silently overwrite existing prose, lose provenance tracking, or leak into the published document without going through the review/publish gate.

role: Core doctrine enforcement: paper's locked title/featured/ingress structural rules
description: Defines the paper template as declarative constraints (title required-exactly-1 at block 0 locked, featured optional-max-1, ingress optional-max-1), seeds new papers, derives the row title from the title block, stamps article style, and validates any block list against the declarations. Feeds both server validation and the client-side canvas constraints JSON.

role: Security-gated edit-through for inline valuerefs to their canonical source doc
description: Authorizes and performs writes from a Studio valueref panel back to the canonical target document's field, re-deriving authorization server-side (write-capability, target tenancy scope, field declared/visible) and computing an impact preview via reverse_referencers before allowing a CAS-guarded patch through the normal guarded mutation path.
whatBreaks: A bug here could let a caller write to a document/field outside their authorization scope, or silently overwrite prose/other documents without proper CAS protection — a direct security boundary breach.

role: Core document read surface: list/get/filter/order/search across all content
description: The heaviest read fan-in in Barkpark.Content — list_documents, get_document, get_documents_by_ids, wikilink/valueref/tag resolvers, and the entire filter-op/order-by query builder (JSONB field ops, nested paths, numeric/text-aware range comparisons), all funneled through the P0 tenancy leak guard (scope_to_dataset + scope_to_workspace_or_global + owner/grant scoping).
whatBreaks: Nearly every document read across the API, Studio, TUI, and SDK would fail or — worse — leak documents across workspaces/datasets/owners if the scoping or filter logic is wrong.

role: Ecto schema + changeset for document version-history revisions
description: Stores content trail rows (doc_id, type, title, status, content, action, actor_user_id) scoped by workspace/project/dataset. Straightforward schema with minimal validation.
whatBreaks: Version history / who-edited-what trail would fail to persist or attribute changes to the wrong actor.

role: Revision-history reads and restore-to-draft
description: Leaf concern listing/fetching Revision rows and restoring a document to a prior revision (always into a draft, never publishing). Reuses the same dataset/workspace scoping pattern as Query, with a defence-in-depth cross-dataset restore guard.
whatBreaks: Version history views would show wrong/leaked revisions, or a restore could cross-contaminate datasets or incorrectly publish a restored draft.

role: Schema-definition CRUD, visibility gates, and SDK serialization
description: Owns SchemaDefinition list/get/upsert/delete (with a guard against orphaning documents on delete), public-visibility/CORS gates, deterministic schema content hashes, dataset catalog listing, and the SDK-facing schema envelope serializer used by every client (SDK/TUI/Studio).
whatBreaks: Schema reads/writes are foundational to content-model correctness across every surface; a bug could expose private schemas publicly, orphan documents on delete, or corrupt the SDK schema contract every client depends on.

role: Ecto schema + v2 field-type parser/DSL for content schema definitions
description: Defines the schema_definitions table (fields, layout, prefill, owner_scoped, visibility, etc.) and a compile-time-safe recursive parser for v2 field types (composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText) plus field-visibility/encryption metadata and Expectation-layer layout/prefill derivation. Central, widely-referenced schema-shape contract.

role: Centralized tenant/workspace/owner/grant query-scoping helper (core-auth)
description: The single place every content read pipes through to apply workspace/project tenant boundaries (fail-closed on nil) and owner/grant-based row ACLs; also implements airdrop-grants scope-ladder narrowing. Extensively documented security contract; a bug here is a direct data-leak vector.

role: Thin facade over the QueryPipeline for document title/keyword search
description: Tiny wrapper that shapes search_documents(query, dataset, opts) results into {hits, total, meta} by delegating to Barkpark.Search.QueryPipeline; no scoping or DB logic of its own.
whatBreaks: Search results (autocomplete, quick-switcher, API search endpoint) would return wrong hits/counts/metadata.

role: search analytics adapter for document search
description: Thin adapter that translates `/v1/data/search/:dataset` request params into `Barkpark.Search.Intelligence` calls for recording search events, returning suggestions, computing insights, and recording user interactions/corrections.
whatBreaks: Search analytics (suggestions, insights, interaction tracking) stop recording or returning data for the document search surface.

role: Sheet-embed write-through/hydration keeping cached grid snapshots fresh
description: Refreshes every same-scope document embedding a sheet whenever the sheet saves (write-through), and hydrates a document's newly-added/changed sheet-embed blocks with a fresh snapshot on save (hydration) — both via JSONB-containment-targeted queries respecting a draft/published content boundary so draft sheet edits never leak into published embedders.
whatBreaks: Embedded sheet grids in papers could go stale, or worse, draft sheet cell values could leak into a published paper's rendered snapshot.

role: Document content validator against schema fields (v1 flat + v2 recursive)
description: Dispatches on SchemaDefinition.flat?/1 to either the legacy v1 field-rule validator or a recursive v2 walker over composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText fields, producing path-annotated error messages folded into a flat error envelope.
whatBreaks: Invalid document content could be silently accepted (data integrity) or valid content could be wrongly rejected across every schema type, including legacy v1 schemas that must round-trip byte-identically.

role: cross-field validation rule evaluator
description: Applies compiled cross-field validation rules to a document, returning categorized violations (errors/warnings/infos) with concrete JSON-Pointer paths. Central interpreter for the schema validation AST.
whatBreaks: Document validation silently passes invalid content or emits malformed violation paths, corrupting the v2 error envelope consumed by clients.

role: validation op evaluator
description: Implements built-in comparison operators (eq, in, nonempty, contains_all, starts_with, matches) used by the cross-field rule evaluator. Unknown ops return false rather than raising.
whatBreaks: Validation rules silently misevaluate, allowing invalid documents through or incorrectly rejecting valid ones.

role: JSON-Pointer path resolver with wildcard support
description: Parses and resolves JSON-Pointer-style paths (including `*` wildcards for arrays) against document maps, yielding concrete path+value tuples. RFC 6901 `~0`/`~1` escapes are supported.
whatBreaks: Wildcard path resolution produces wrong values or indices, causing validation rules to fire on wrong fields or miss array elements entirely.

role: compiled validation rule struct
description: Defines the `Rule` and `Expr` structs that represent a compiled cross-field validation rule AST. Locks decision D7: rules are interpreted data, never eval'd code.
whatBreaks: Rule struct shape changes break compilation of rules from JSON, causing the evaluator to fail or misinterpret all cross-field validations.

role: Cross-field validation rule compiler and GenServer cache
description: Compiles JSON-defined cross-field validation rules into typed Rule structs and caches them per schema_id in a GenServer. Supports ops like eq, in, nonempty, containsAll, startsWith, matches:<format> with tag-based filtering for live/mutate/export contexts.
whatBreaks: Cross-field validation rules are not applied or compile incorrectly, allowing schema-violating documents to be saved or blocking valid saves.

role: Security-critical tenancy scope resolution for writes and reads (concern K)
description: Resolves and stamps server-authoritative workspace/project/dataset_id/owner_id on every write (stripping any client-supplied scope keys), resolves dataset_id on reads with per-request memoization, and hosts lifecycle-hook helpers (build_ctx/fire_after) including the core edge-projector enqueue with its recursion guard. Directly implements several named leak-fix regressions (wykb/sknf/y9ee/s6t1).

role: Document CREATE/CLONE/UPSERT write-path core for Barkpark.Content
description: Implements the concrete write mechanics (envelope coercion, id/rev generation, hooks, encryption, projection, rev-fencing) behind Barkpark.Content's create_document/upsert_document facade. Central chokepoint for task-kind validation, block-id backfill, field encryption, paper templating, and optimistic-concurrency (ifMatch) updates.

role: Ecto schema for a wrapped per-scope Data Encryption Key row
description: Defines the data_keys table schema (scope, version, wrapped_key, kek_version, active) and its changeset/validation used by DataKeys get-or-create/rotation logic.
whatBreaks: Malformed DEK persistence or missing uniqueness constraint could allow duplicate active keys per scope, breaking field encryption/decryption across the app.

role: Get-or-create/rotate/cache manager for per-scope encryption DEKs
description: Central seam between FieldCipher and the KEK: resolves active DEKs, unwraps and ETS-caches them (bounded to 10k entries), supports rotation and KEK-rewrap-all. Used by every encrypted field read/write.
whatBreaks: Encrypted field reads/writes across all tenants fail or leak — wrong DEK resolution, unbounded memory growth, or broken rotation would break encrypted-at-rest data everywhere.

role: AES-256-GCM envelope encrypt/decrypt for one content field
description: Produces/consumes the self-describing ciphertext envelope stored in place of a marked-encrypted field, using scope as AAD so ciphertext can't be replayed cross-tenant; fails closed on tamper/malformed envelope.
whatBreaks: A bug here could leak plaintext secrets at rest, silently corrupt encrypted field values, or crash on decrypt for any encrypted field in the system.

role: Behaviour/seam for the pluggable master KEK provider
description: Defines wrap/unwrap/kek_version callbacks and dispatches to the configured implementation (default LocalKek); the indirection point for swapping to Vault/KMS later.
whatBreaks: If misconfigured or the contract breaks, no DEK could be wrapped/unwrapped, taking down all field encryption and KEK rotation.

role: Default KeyProvider impl: env-configured master KEK via AES-256-GCM
description: Wraps/unwraps DEKs using a Base64 32-byte key from config (BARKPARK_KEK), with previous-key fallback list to support rotation without breaking old ciphertext.
whatBreaks: Wrong key handling or missing previous-key fallback breaks DEK unwrap after KEK rotation, making all encrypted fields sealed under that DEK unreadable.

role: One-shot Mix-task-backing sweep to backfill content-graph edges
description: Enumerates dataset/workspace scopes owning swept document types (default paper) and rebuilds their edges via Projector.rebuild_scope, mirroring the save-event worker's tenancy fail-closed rules; dry-run by default.
whatBreaks: Pre-existing papers' valueref/wikilink/task-dependency edges would stay missing or get corrupted/cross-tenant leaked during a backfill run — an operational tool, not request-path critical.

role: content graph projection event router
description: Routes the four after_* content lifecycle events (save, publish, unpublish, delete) to the correct ProjectorWorker op (rebuild, upsert, or delete), with a recursion guard and an incremental_project feature flag. Wired directly into Content.fire_after/3 so graph projection works even with all plugins off.
whatBreaks: The content graph stops projecting on document mutations, or projects stale/phantom edges, breaking the Studio graph view.

role: content edge materialisation engine
description: Pure projection logic that extracts and materialises content graph edges into the durable content_edges Postgres table. Unions core reference-field edges (from Content.extract_edges/2) with plugin-projected edges, deduplicates by {from_id, to_id, kind}, and provides rebuild_scope/3, upsert_record/2, and delete_record/2 write paths.
whatBreaks: The content graph becomes stale or corrupt — missing or phantom edges propagate to the graph pane, unpublish guards, and all /v1/graph/* consumers.

role: Oban worker driving debounced rebuild/upsert/delete of content_edges
description: Routes rebuild/upsert/delete jobs into Projector, with dedup keys, tenancy fail-closed guards (no cross-tenant corpus rebuilds), task-edge hydration, and test-seam module overrides. Keeps the materialised graph table in sync with document saves/publishes/deletes.
whatBreaks: content_edges table would drift stale or get cross-tenant-polluted, corrupting the Studio graph pane, backlinks, and unpublish guard that depend on it.

role: edge projector settings resolver
description: Typed settings wrapper for the edge projector that resolves the incremental_project feature flag from env, DB plugin_settings row, or module default; never raises so lifecycle hooks can call it safely.
whatBreaks: The incremental_project flag resolves incorrectly, causing the projector to take the wrong path (stale edges or unnecessary full rebuilds on every save).

role: Ecto Cloak type for encrypting a single binary/string column at rest
description: Thin wrapper around Cloak.Ecto.Binary bound to Barkpark.Vault, used for single-value secrets like TOTP secrets and stored run-secrets.
whatBreaks: TOTP secrets or run-secrets could be stored in plaintext or fail to encrypt/decrypt, compromising 2FA or secret-management features.

role: Ecto Cloak type wrapper for encrypting a map column at rest
description: One-line `use Cloak.Ecto.Map, vault: Barkpark.Vault` giving transparent AES-GCM encryption for sensitive plugin settings maps.
whatBreaks: Sensitive plugin settings (e.g. credentials) could be stored in plaintext or fail to decrypt, breaking plugin config load or leaking secrets.

role: external sync registry and PubSub hub
description: Plugin-agnostic registry that merges host and plugin entries for external system sync UI (pill colors/labels) and provides PubSub subscribe/broadcast helpers for sync state transitions.
whatBreaks: External sync status pills render incorrectly or stop updating in Studio for all integrated external systems.

role: idempotency-key dedup store
description: Postgres-backed store for idempotency keys (mutation dedup P1-k and webhook delivery dedup P1-d). Hashes the key+token+method+path, stores response body/status/headers, provides lookup/store/sweep with a 24-hour TTL.
whatBreaks: Duplicate API mutations are re-executed instead of returning cached responses, risking double-writes and inconsistent state for retried requests.

role: Swoosh mailer config module for core auth transactional email
description: One-line Swoosh.Mailer use declaration; adapter (Local/Test/SMTP) is environment-selected via config, powering email verification and password reset.
whatBreaks: Email verification and password-reset flows would fail to send, blocking account recovery/signup confirmation.

role: Media context: upload, storage, search, and delete for uploaded files
description: Handles disk+DB upload with server-derived MIME validation and optional allowlist/size-cap gating, paginated/faceted file search, linked mediaAsset metadata patching, and tenancy-scoped get/delete with CDN invalidation and event dispatch. Central API surface consumed by media controllers and Studio media pane.

role: Facade re-exporting the media-delivery (CDN) layer's four submodules
description: Thin context module exposing URL builders, CDN prefixing/invalidation, unified asset JSON response shape, and lifecycle webhook dispatch as one public API so callers depend on the layer, not internals. Delegates to Urls/Cdn/AssetResponse/Events submodules.
whatBreaks: Media URLs, cache headers, CDN invalidation, and asset JSON responses across the whole media surface would break or serve stale/broken links.

role: Unified JSON renderer for media API responses (blob + mediaAsset doc)
description: Builds the response map combining a MediaFile row with optional linked mediaAsset document metadata, including scoped delivery URLs, CDN URLs, permissions, and Envelope-redacted asset payload for the caller's context.

role: CDN URL prefixing + edge-cache invalidation for media delivery
description: Prefixes relative delivery paths with the configured CDN base URL, computes invalidation paths for an asset (original + renditions), and triggers HTTP invalidation via the webhook Dispatcher's http_post seam, patching a `bp_cdn_status` field onto the linked asset document.
whatBreaks: Public media URLs stop pointing at the CDN or stale edge-cached assets never get purged after updates/deletes.

role: Outbound webhook dispatcher for media lifecycle events
description: Fires media.uploaded/processed/deleted webhooks through the same durable-row retry machinery as document webhooks (Dispatcher.deliver_media), with bounded concurrency and a degraded single-shot fallback if the durable row can't be persisted.

role: Text-match query builder for media full-text/synonym search
description: Builds the Ecto dynamic include/exclude filters (ilike + pg_trgm similarity) over media_files joined to a tenant-scoped mediaAsset Document subquery; explicitly closes a prior cross-workspace metadata leak (barkpark-vmv1) via workspace/dataset scoping on the join.
whatBreaks: Media search returns wrong/no results, or (if scoping regresses) leaks another workspace's asset titles/tags into search matches.

role: Faceted media search engine (query, filters, facets, pagination, sort)
description: Core WoodWing-style media search: builds the scoped Ecto query joining media_files to linked mediaAsset docs, computes facets (kind/mime/status/tags/etc, including a raw-SQL tags facet), paginates via cursor, and applies relevance/date sorting; heavily tenancy-scoped to avoid cross-workspace facet/text leaks.
whatBreaks: Media library search/browse (Studio, API, TUI) breaks entirely or leaks cross-tenant data in results/facets.

role: HTTP query-param parser for media search into search opts
description: Converts raw controller params (q, type, kind, status, facets, facet.*, cursor, sort, etc.) into the keyword list consumed by Search.search/2; fails soft (never raises) on malformed facets params.
whatBreaks: Media search API endpoint mis-parses filters/facets or 500s on unexpected param shapes.

role: Media delivery URL builders + HTTP cache/ETag headers
description: Builds original/thumbnail/preview/rendition URLs, applying scope prefixes, optional HMAC signing for token-visibility assets, and CDN prefixing; also sets immutable cache-control/ETag headers with 304 short-circuit for binary responses.
whatBreaks: Media URLs in API responses are wrong/unsigned (exposing private assets or breaking links), or file serving loses caching/ETag correctness.

role: Behaviour + OS-based selector for the pluggable image-rendition backend
description: Defines the `render/4`/`available?/0` callback contract and picks Vix (libvips) vs ImageMagick CLI based on config override or OS (Windows falls back to Magick since vix has no Windows NIF).
whatBreaks: Wrong backend selection breaks image rendition generation entirely on one OS class, or silently no-ops thumbnails/previews.

role: ImageMagick CLI rendition backend (Windows fallback)
description: Shells out to `magick`/`convert` to resize, crop, and watermark images, mirroring the vix pipeline; includes portable-install env-var handling for scoop-style ImageMagick builds.
whatBreaks: Windows-hosted deployments would fail to generate any image renditions (thumb/preview/hero/og) or produce mis-cropped/watermarked images.

role: libvips (Image/vix) rendition backend — canonical on macOS/Linux/Docker
description: Opens, thumbnails (fit or attention-crop), watermarks, and writes renditions via the `Image` library; this is the primary production rendition path.
whatBreaks: All image renditions (thumb/preview/hero/og cards) on the primary deployment platforms would fail or render incorrectly.

role: Pure binary parser extracting image width/height without libvips
description: Hand-rolled PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP header parsers so dimension metadata stays available even without the Image dep; used to patch fileInfo on uploaded assets.
whatBreaks: Uploaded image assets would silently lack width/height metadata, breaking layout/aspect-ratio-dependent UI and og-card sizing assumptions.

role: Post-upload pipeline orchestrator: probe → renditions → status patch
description: Runs after a blob lands: sets processing status, probes dimensions, generates all renditions, then patches the mediaAsset doc to ready/failed and dispatches CDN publish + webhook events.
whatBreaks: Uploaded media would never transition to 'ready' (or falsely report ready with missing renditions), breaking asset serving and downstream webhook consumers.

role: On-disk rendition cache manager (presets, lazy/eager generation)
description: Defines thumb/preview/hero/og presets, computes cache paths (with watermark-profile suffixes), and generates renditions on demand or eagerly via the selected ImageBackend; gates to known raster MIME types.

role: Façade context re-exporting the media storage/governance layer
description: Delegates to MediaFile, SignedUrl, Access, Checkout, Collections, Relations, Share — the bottom-most media layer callers should depend on instead of reaching into submodules directly; purely additive/thin wrapper.
whatBreaks: Any caller using the façade API (signing, access checks, checkout, collections, relations, share links) breaks across the whole media system.

role: Per-asset permission engine (view/preview/original/edit_metadata)
description: Computes the WoodWing-style permission set for a request against an asset's visibility (public/token/private), auth state, signed-URL verification, and checkout lock state; drives both delivery gating and the API's reported permissions list.
whatBreaks: Private/token-gated media is exposed publicly, or legitimate users are denied access/edit rights to assets.

role: Editorial checkout lock on mediaAsset documents
description: Implements check-out/undo-checkout by patching checkedOutBy/checkedOutAt on the linked asset document, with actor/admin authorization guards; releasing a checkout also invalidates cached renditions.
whatBreaks: Concurrent editors can clobber each other's metadata edits, or a locked asset can't be released/edited by legitimate actors.

role: Media folder/virtual-collection membership CRUD and queries
description: Lists/gets tenant-scoped mediaCollection documents, resolves a collection's member assets (folder membership list or virtual-filter-driven search), and patches add/remove membership onto asset documents' collection(s) fields; also renders the collection API shape including share-link fields.
whatBreaks: Media folders/smart collections show wrong members, cross-tenant leak of collections, or membership add/remove silently fails.

role: Ecto schema for uploaded media blobs + dangerous-MIME neutralization
description: Defines the `media_files` table schema (filename, path, mime_type, workspace/project/dataset scoping) and a changeset that neutralizes browser-executable MIME types (svg/html/xml/js) into application/octet-stream at write time to block stored XSS, since ingest trusts client-supplied content-type. Paired with a serve-edge check in MediaController.

role: Resolves outbound/inbound asset relation graph for a media file, tenant-scoped
description: Builds the relatedAssets graph (outbound edges from an asset doc's content, inbound back-links found via jsonb query) for the media detail view, threading workspace/project scope through every read to prevent cross-tenant leakage (fix for barkpark-m21z).
whatBreaks: Dropping the scope_opts threading would leak another workspace's related-asset docs, titles, or signed URLs across tenant boundaries in the media relation graph.

role: Public share-link creation/revocation/resolution for media collections
description: Mints/rotates/revokes a token-based public share URL stored on a mediaCollection doc's content.shareLink, and resolves an incoming token to the collection doc (checking expiry). Tenancy scope is threaded into reads and writes to prevent cross-workspace share-link takeover (barkpark-ukzs).
whatBreaks: A scope bug lets a workspace-B writer mint or rotate a share token on workspace-A's collection, or a broken share_active? check could serve expired/disabled galleries publicly forever.

role: HMAC-signs and verifies public media embed URLs
description: Appends an HMAC-SHA256 signature + expiry to media delivery paths and verifies them on serve; used for token-visibility assets on /media/files and /media/renditions routes.
whatBreaks: A broken verify?/3 (e.g. skipping secure_compare or exp check) would let anyone forge signed URLs and access token-gated private media indefinitely.

role: SSRF guard for all tenant-influenced outbound HTTP (webhooks, mirrors)
description: Validates URLs before outbound requests by resolving DNS and rejecting loopback/private/link-local/CGNAT/multicast/reserved addresses (IPv4 and IPv6, including mapped forms), forcing redirect:false so a 302 can't smuggle a blocked destination past the check; used by webhook delivery and other tenant-shaped HTTP calls (e.g. GitHub plugin).
whatBreaks: A hole here lets a tenant-configured webhook or outbound call reach cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), internal services, or perform an internal port-scan — a classic blind SSRF vulnerability across every shared cloud host.

role: Pure line-level LCS diff engine for Papers' diff modal
description: Elixir port of a classic JS line-diff (DP-LCS with backtrack), HTML-escaping output for the shift-click goal-path diff view; falls back to a coarse whole-block diff above size caps to avoid OOM on the public unauthenticated route.
whatBreaks: The Papers diff modal would show wrong/garbled diffs, or a public unauthenticated request could OOM the server if the size guard is broken.

role: The canonical Barkpark.Plugin behaviour — plugin contract for the whole system
description: Massive behaviour/`use` macro defining every plugin extension point (routes, schemas, hooks, resolvers, CLI commands, edge extraction, checkers, etc.) plus the forbidden-surfaces contract and resolver-chain defaults. This is the seam every first-party plugin (Tasks, Bulldocs, Sheets, OnixEdit, Media, Frt) compiles against.

role: boot-time plugin schema installer
description: Walks the plugin registry on every server start and upserts each plugin's declared schemas into the database. Called by Application.start/2 and seeds.exs; idempotent on (name, dataset) uniqueness.
whatBreaks: Plugin-declared schemas (e.g. paper, sheet, book) are missing or stale after a deploy, causing schema-not-found errors for documents of those types.

role: Bulldocs plugin wiring — the Papers surface's schema/routes/CLI/edge-extraction
description: Declares the `paper` schema, mounts the public reader (`/papers/:slug`) and token-gated ingest/proposals/intents API, contributes CLI verbs, and projects internal-reference edges (wikilink/valueref/embed/proposal-source) into the content graph. Core block-engine logic lives elsewhere; this is the thin plugin wiring per the Bulldocs split.
whatBreaks: The entire Papers product surface breaks: paper schema stops registering, public reader/ingest routes vanish, or graph edges (wikilinks, valuerefs, provenance) stop being tracked.

role: Ecto schema for append-only paper_events (goal-path rail)
description: Defines the `paper_events` schema backing the native goal-path rail: event_type, branch (for gitGraph-style lineage), parent_event_id, payload_html, plus tenancy fields (workspace_id/project_id, dataset assoc) and a processed_at intent marker. Changeset requires event_type and at least one of goal_id/paper_slug.
whatBreaks: Malformed changeset or missing required fields would corrupt or block every paper lifecycle event, breaking the goal-path rail's lineage tracking and the paper-intents loop-closer.

role: Context module (CRUD) over the paper_events store
description: Pure Ecto context wrapping Event: create_event, list_for_goal/list_for_paper (tenancy-scoped), get_event/mark_processed (UUID-safe lookups that return nil/:not_found instead of raising on bad ids), and list_pending_intents for the paper-side reader loop closer (P6.U6a).
whatBreaks: Bugs here break the rail's event feed, the diff viewer's open-diff lookup, or the intent-draining loop that turns action:/simplify- clicks into real work.

role: Assembles and projects the /v1/capabilities manifest (auth-tier gated)
description: Builds the full superset capabilities manifest from Registry.all/collect_routes/collect_cli_commands, then applies a pure default-deny existence-hiding projection by caller auth tier (none/read/write/admin plus scoped_admin/ingest side channels). Large (1800+ lines) — the canonical single source every CLI/SDK/TUI client reads to discover what's callable.

role: Shape-safe reader for doc.content across struct/map/string-key variants
description: content_get/2 safely reads nested values from a Studio doc's content regardless of whether it's a %Document{} struct, atom-keyed map, or string-keyed map, avoiding the Access-behaviour raise that previously silently killed plugin doc-action buttons (e.g. GitHub adopt, ONIX hide-publish).
whatBreaks: A regression reintroduces the raise-then-rescue-swallow bug where Studio doc-action resolvers silently drop buttons like 'Adopt from GitHub' with only log spam as a clue.

role: Per-workspace plugin enablement/placement resolver merging defaults + overrides
description: effective/1 merges each plugin's compile-time declaration (default_enabled?, structure_placement) with a workspace's jsonb settings override into the resolved enabled/placement map consumed by desk items, top-menu tabs, and the tiered-tree builder; nil workspace or any lookup failure falls back to declaration defaults only, deliberately kept off the Registry registration path to avoid deadlocking on a Repo read.
whatBreaks: A bug here could hide an enabled plugin from Structure/desk entirely, wrongly surface a disabled one, or reintroduce a Repo-read deadlock in plugin registry boot.

role: BARKPARK_PLUGINS env var parser for plugin registry
description: Translates the `BARKPARK_PLUGINS` OS env var into the value fed to `config :barkpark, :plugins`, mapping nil/empty/whitelist semantics and implicitly adding 'media' to any whitelist.
whatBreaks: Wrong plugin parsing could silently disable all plugins (including media) or fail to apply operator's intended whitelist on boot.

role: Plugin registering 25 game-content schemas mirroring a Godot game's tick loop
description: Off-by-default plugin ("Frickin Real Time") that loads 25 JSON schema files from priv/plugins/frt/schemas and exposes them as 8 tick-ordered desk groups (singletons via :link, collections via :document_list). Excludes its own private schemas from the host's auto-generated Settings group via owned_schema_types/0.
whatBreaks: Only breaks the frt plugin's Studio desk and schema registration for teams that enable it; malformed schema JSON raises loudly at compile/boot rather than corrupting other plugins.

role: GitHub bridge plugin — routes, workers, settings, doc actions wiring
description: Thin Barkpark.Plugin wiring for the GitHub↔Barkpark task mirror: declares settings_schema/validate_settings for App credentials, register_routes (webhook, adopt, ops LiveView, status), register_workers (Auth + DrainWorker singletons, off by default), and the 'Adopt from GitHub' Studio doc action gated on content.github.state == intake. Off by default until whitelisted in BARKPARK_PLUGINS.

role: Flips a GitHub-intake task into Barkpark ownership (idempotent operator action)
description: adopt/3 strips the needs-human gate label, flips content.github.state from intake to adopted, best-effort posts a backlink comment on the source issue, and is idempotent (re-adopting an already-adopted task is a safe no-op). Writes are stamped source: :github so the outbound mirror's outbox reader excludes them, cutting the sync loop.
whatBreaks: A bug could re-trigger duplicate backlink comments, fail to strip the needs-human gate (task stays hidden from claim), or break the loop-cut stamp causing an adopt write to echo back out as a spurious outbound GitHub mutation.

role: GitHub App installation-token cache GenServer (JWT mint + token exchange)
description: Singleton GenServer that mints an RS256 App JWT from the configured private key and exchanges it for a ~1h installation access token, caching it with a 60s safety margin; all GitHub API calls in the plugin depend on token/0 for auth. Lazy — no boot-time fetch.
whatBreaks: If token minting/caching breaks, every GitHub API call (mirror, comments, status) fails auth, and the whole GitHub sync bridge goes dark or throws AuthErrors.

role: bp CLI command manifest for the github plugin (adopt, status)
description: Declares the `github adopt` and `github status` cli_command() maps consumed by the capabilities manifest and Go CLI, with no bespoke Go code required. Notable: adopt is bearer-gated read-tier but writes:true; status is read-only JSON output because its payload is maps-of-maps, not row-shaped.
whatBreaks: bp github adopt/status would be missing or malformed from the CLI manifest, breaking operator workflows for adopting GitHub-sourced tasks and viewing sync health.

role: Req-based HTTP client for GitHub REST/GraphQL issue operations
description: Wraps GitHub's issues API (create/get/update/close/labels/comments/sub-issues) plus GraphQL, with unified auth-refresh, retry, and 4-type error classification (AuthError/RateLimitError/NotFound/NetworkError). All outbound mirror writes to GitHub funnel through this module.

role: Ecto schema for github_sync_conflicts quarantine rows
description: Defines the conflict record (repo/issue/doc_id/dataset/kind/detail/resolved_at) with a changeset enforcing the 3 valid kinds and a unique-open-row constraint per (repo,issue,kind). Deliberately DB-only bookkeeping, never touches Content or triggers sync.
whatBreaks: Drift detection (out-of-band edits, detached issues, dedup refusals) would fail to persist or validate, hiding sync problems from operators.

role: Recorder/query API for the GitHub sync conflict quarantine
description: Provides record/1 (dedup-upsert with detail merge under row lock), list/1, and resolve/1 for github_sync_conflicts. Handles insert-race collapse via the partial unique index and normalizes string/atom-keyed attrs.
whatBreaks: Concurrent conflict recordings could duplicate rows or lose merged detail, and the ops console/CLI status would show inaccurate quarantine state.

role: Durable outbound-mirror high-water-mark cursor per dataset
description: Thin wrapper over Barkpark.Sync.PushCursor keyed on source "github:outbound", tracking the largest local mutation_events.id already drained. put/2 is monotonic; bootstrap_if_absent/1 seeds to current head only when no row exists, preventing backlog flood on first enable.
whatBreaks: The drain worker could replay already-mirrored events (duplicate GitHub writes) or skip events, and first-enable could flood GitHub with the entire pre-enable task backlog.

role: GenServer pump draining mutation_events into debounced GitHub mirror jobs
description: Level-triggered poll/drain loop (structural copy of Sync.PushWorker) that, per whitelisted dataset, bootstraps the cursor on first active sight, fetches outbox events past the cursor, enqueues debounced MirrorJobs, and advances the cursor only after successful enqueues (write-then-advance). Honors an idle gate memoized for ~5s so a dark/unconfigured plugin does zero DB work.
whatBreaks: The entire outbound Barkpark-to-GitHub sync pipeline would stall, double-fire, or mass-mirror historical backlog, and loop-immunity/idle-gate guarantees could be violated.

role: Typed error structs for the GitHub client/auth layer with token redaction
description: Defines AuthError/RateLimitError/NetworkError/NotFound structs used across Client and Auth, each with a custom Inspect implementation that redacts bearer tokens from logs/dumps via Barkpark.Redaction.
whatBreaks: Error handling/retry logic downstream (mirror job, drain worker) could pattern-match incorrectly, or worse, bearer tokens could leak into logs.

role: Field-ownership/direction matrix enforcing GitHub sync directional purity
description: Pure declarative map of every mirrored task aspect's owner (barkpark/github/derived) and direction (outbound_only/inbound_intake_only/never), structurally preventing any GitHub-to-task field writer from existing. Property-tested against the epic charter's ownership table.
whatBreaks: A bidirectional sync bug (GitHub values silently overwriting ledger fields, or claim/epoch/fence primitives leaking to GitHub) would become possible, undermining the whole bridge's safety invariant.

role: Pure local-read sync-health aggregate for GitHub mirror observability
description: snapshot/1 composes conflict counts, per-dataset cursor lag/pending, and Oban queue depth into one map used by the admin console, JSON status endpoint, and `bp github status`. Zero GitHub calls; every sub-read is defensively wrapped to degrade to zeros rather than raise.
whatBreaks: Operators would get inaccurate or crashing sync-health views (console/CLI status), masking real drift/backlog problems.

role: Handles GitHub webhook deleted/transferred/closed events for intake tasks
description: Routes issue deleted/transferred/closed webhook actions to detach a gh-<num> intake task (state flip + visible conflict record), bot-dropping first to avoid reacting to the App's own close echo. Strictly bookkeeping-only — never writes lifecycle_status or reads GitHub fields back.
whatBreaks: Deleted/transferred GitHub issues could leave stale live-looking task links forever, or a bot echo could incorrectly detach an adopted task, breaking the inbound intake lifecycle.

role: Inbound GitHub Issue → born-dark Barkpark task birther
description: Turns `issues.opened` webhook payloads into `gh-<number>` tasks via the same Content/Dedup create path every task uses, dropping bot echoes and surfacing dedup refusals with a maintainer comment + dead-letter row instead of silently swallowing them. Idempotent by short-circuit read (re-delivery never rewrites) and never reads a GitHub field back into a task after birth.
whatBreaks: A bug here would either duplicate tasks on webhook redelivery, silently drop genuine outsider issues, or create an inbound/outbound mirror echo loop.

role: content.github bookkeeping read/write helper with de-loop stamp
description: Get/put helper for the flat `content.github` sub-map (repo/issue/synced_rev/state) on a task, always writing through Content.upsert with `source: :github` and collapsing the resulting draft twin back into a published row so mirroring never leaves a phantom draft. Core seam for both MirrorJob and Intake idempotency/loop-cut logic.
whatBreaks: A broken stamp/collapse would either loop-echo mirror writes back out to GitHub or leave every previously-published task permanently forked into an unpublished draft twin.

role: Debounced Oban worker that reconciles a task to its GitHub Issue
description: Level-triggered outbound sync engine: loads task state draft-first, gates on detached/intake link states, creates or PATCHes the mirrored issue, fingerprints for out-of-band drift detection, classifies GitHub errors into snooze/cancel/error, and drives failure-isolated Projects v2 + sub-issue relations projections with bounded relink/cap-flatten retry logic. The largest and most decision-dense file in the bridge.
whatBreaks: A bug could create duplicate GitHub issues, PATCH the wrong issue, spin an infinite mirror loop, or silently stop reconciling task state to GitHub across the whole bridge.

role: Read-only mutation_events query feeding the outbound GitHub drain
description: Fetches un-mirrored, non-`source=github`, `type=task` mutation_events rows after a cursor in id-ASC order for the drain worker to enqueue MirrorJobs from. Tiny, pure-read module but the sole gate implementing loop-cut #2 (excluding github-originated events).
whatBreaks: Removing the source filter would make every inbound-applied GitHub write re-mirror back out, creating an infinite sync loop.

role: Pure task-document → GitHub Issue shape projector
description: Computes desired title/body/labels/state/state_reason from a task doc, including idempotent fenced markers (acceptance checklist, blockers, parent) and sentinel-neutralization to stop outsider text forging Barkpark's own fences. No I/O; consumed by MirrorJob for the PATCH/CREATE payload.
whatBreaks: A bad projection would corrupt every mirrored issue's body/labels/state, break the acceptance-checkbox liveness signal, or let an outsider forge a fence to hijack idempotent regions.

role: One-directional GitHub Projects v2 board field sync
description: Paints task Status/Priority/Worker/Goal onto a configured Projects v2 board via GraphQL, gated on a configured project_id and diffed via fingerprint to write zero GraphQL when unchanged; read-only board, never reads values back into a task.
whatBreaks: A bug could spam GraphQL writes on every reconcile or silently stop updating the operator's project dashboard; isolated failure so it can't break the core Issues mirror.

role: Blocker-ref hydration + native GitHub sub-issue tree linker
description: Hydrates a task doc's mirrored blocker issue numbers for the body fence, and mirrors `content.parent_id` to a native GitHub sub-issue link (with defer-until-parent-mirrored and cap-flatten-to-marker fallback for deep/wide trees). Reads DB and calls GitHub but never mutates a task itself.
whatBreaks: A bug would misrender blocker/parent relationships in mirrored issues or mis-link/duplicate sub-issue trees on GitHub, though failures are isolated from the core issue mirror.

role: Env→DB credential resolver + gate for the GitHub plugin
description: Resolves repo/app_id/installation_id/private_key/webhook_secret/project_id/api_base from app env falling back to the encrypted plugin_settings DB row, exposes `active?/0` fail-closed gate, mirror `datasets/0`, and a short-TTL memoized `webhook_secret_cached/0` to protect the hot webhook path from DB/audit-row flooding.

role: HMAC-SHA256 verifier for GitHub webhook X-Hub-Signature-256
description: Pure sign/verify pair matching GitHub's webhook signing scheme, constant-time compared, fail-closed on blank/malformed secret or header. No routes/plugs of its own; wired in by the wave-3 webhook controller.
whatBreaks: A verification bug could let forged webhook payloads bypass auth and inject fake issues/events, or reject all legitimate GitHub deliveries.

role: Admin-gated read-only LiveView dashboard for GitHub sync health
description: Polls Github.Health.snapshot/1 every 5s to render per-dataset cursor/lag/pending, mirror queue depth, and open sync conflicts grouped by kind, with a single 'Resolve' action wired to Conflicts.resolve/1. Mounted under the :ops admin auth gate at /admin/github.
whatBreaks: Operators would lose visibility into mirror lag/conflicts or be unable to clear resolved conflict rows, but no sync/mirror logic itself would be affected.

role: plugin lifecycle-hook dispatcher
description: Dispatches before_* and after_* lifecycle events to all registered plugins; before_* hooks run sequentially and can halt the operation, after_* hooks run async via Task.async_stream with 5s timeout. This is the plugin extension point for save/publish/unpublish/delete events.
whatBreaks: Plugin hooks (validation, side-effects) silently skip or crash on content mutations, making plugin interception unreliable.

role: Indx JWT token cache GenServer
description: Single-process GenServer that caches a JWT from a dedicated Indx instance's /api/Login endpoint with a fixed TTL and safety margin. Serializes concurrent callers to avoid duplicate logins; supports static API token shortcut for Indx v5+.
whatBreaks: All Indx plugin requests fail authentication, taking down the entire Indx retriever/search surface.

role: HTTP client for the dedicated single-tenant Indx search engine wire API
description: Wraps every Indx REST verb (login, CreateOrOpen, AnalyzeString, SetFieldConfiguration, LoadString, IndexDataSet, Search, GetJson, insert/update/delete record) with empirically-confirmed wire quirks (text/plain vs application/json bodies, v5 field-configuration ordering, 401-retry). Large file (781 lines) documenting hard-won engine gotchas.
whatBreaks: Any deviation from the documented content-type/ordering contract silently corrupts the Indx index (empty documents) or 400/415/500s the whole rebuild and search pipeline.

role: Tagged error structs + redaction for the Indx client
description: Defines AuthError/IndexError/SearchError/NetworkError structs with custom Inspect implementations that redact the Indx JWT and stored password from logs/dumps via the shared Barkpark.Redaction engine.
whatBreaks: Missing redaction leaks the Indx bearer token/password into logs and test failure dumps; wrong error shapes break pattern-matching classification in the indexer worker (upsert/delete/rebuild error routing).

role: Blue/green corpus rebuild + live-pointer + delete-key logic for Indx
description: Core Indx indexing engine (989 lines): performs the multi-step blue/green rebuild (create dataset, analyze, configure fields, load, index, poll, verify, swap), computes deterministic SHA-256-derived numeric keys per _id with collision probing, and maintains a per-scope :persistent_term live pointer + key_map used by delete/upsert. Critically documents that re-loading a live dataset hangs the engine.
whatBreaks: Wrong key derivation or pointer/swap logic corrupts or wedges the live search index, causes deletes to target the wrong record, or causes search to silently return stale/empty results after a restart.

role: Oban worker driving debounced Indx rebuild/upsert/delete jobs
description: Runs on the :indx Oban queue, unique per scope over a debounce window; dispatches rebuild (full blue/green), upsert (incremental single-doc), and delete ops, with error classification that snoozes on NetworkError, cancels on 404/no-live-dataset, and falls back to full rebuild on :reindex_required or (upsert-only) missing live dataset post-restart.
whatBreaks: Misrouted ops or wrong error classification either hammer the Indx engine with redundant rebuilds, silently drop document updates from the index, or fail to self-heal after a restart, leaving search results stale.

role: Indx search index lifecycle hook dispatcher
description: Hooks into Content save/publish/unpublish/delete events to enqueue debounced Oban indexer jobs (rebuild, upsert, or delete) for the Indx search engine. Includes a recursion guard to prevent worker re-entrancy storms.
whatBreaks: Document changes stop propagating to the Indx search index, causing stale search results across all datasets.

role: GenServer + ETS counter for Indx retriever success/fallback telemetry
description: Tracks per-scope success/fallback/error counts in a public ETS table with atomic increments, exposes snapshot/snapshot_all for `bp doctor`, and emits a telemetry event per outcome. Self-bounds via wholesale ETS wipe at 30k rows to avoid unbounded tenant-driven growth.
whatBreaks: Operators lose visibility into silent Indx fallback (empty results indistinguishable from real 'no matches'), or the ETS table could grow unbounded/crash if the capacity check is broken.

role: Disk persistence for Indx per-scope key_map/dataset state
description: Writes %{dataset, key_map} atomically (temp file + rename) to disk per scope so Indx.Recovery can restore exact post-restart state, replacing a risky bare-hash-fallback delete path; scope names are URI-encoded to prevent path traversal.
whatBreaks: A restart could lose or corrupt the Indx key_map, forcing fallback to lossy bare-hash deletes (collision risk) or losing delete-target tracking entirely, and a broken scope-sanitization could allow path traversal writes.

role: Boot-time GenServer that re-seats the Indx live-dataset pointer after restart
description: Async (handle_continue) recovery pass run at boot: lists Indx datasets, groups by parsed <prefix>_<scope>_v<n> name, and calls Indexer.restore_pointer/2 for the max version per scope only if no live pointer is already seated — self-heals the :persistent_term pointer wiped by every restart. Fully tolerant of Indx being down (no-op + debug log).
whatBreaks: Without correct recovery, every Barkpark restart loses the live-dataset pointer and search silently returns empty results until a manual reseed or the first edit triggers the upsert rebuild-fallback.

role: Indx search-engine retriever behind Barkpark.Search.Retriever
description: Implements the Retriever behaviour for the Indx search engine: queries Indx's CloudQuery API, re-ranks hits by title affinity to match Postgres ranker semantics, applies exclude filters, and hydrates the display slice back to authoritative Postgres documents with tenant/grant scoping.
whatBreaks: A bug here could leak documents across workspaces/grants via search, misrank results, or crash search entirely when the Indx engine is configured for a surface.

role: Indx plugin settings resolver
description: Resolves Indx connection settings (API base URL, credentials, dataset prefix, weights, v5 team token, feature flags) from env vars, app config, and encrypted DB rows with defined precedence. Gates v5 API routing via the team setting.
whatBreaks: Indx indexer cannot connect to the search engine or uses wrong credentials/weights, breaking all search functionality.

role: plugin manifest compile-time + runtime validator
description: Validates plugin.json manifests against a JSON Schema (embedded at compile time) during plugin module compilation via the Plugin.__using__ macro. Raises InvalidError with structured field-level errors on schema violations.
whatBreaks: Invalid plugin manifests pass silently or crash compilation with unhelpful errors, breaking plugin loading.

role: Media plugin entrypoint — mediaAsset/mediaCollection schemas + upload/delete hooks
description: Registers the native media library schemas and wires upload-completion/delete side-effects that create/remove companion mediaAsset documents for blobs in media_files. Delegates the actual document work to Assets and dispatches processing/events.
whatBreaks: Uploaded files would have no metadata document (no alt text/tags/collection UI) and deleting a blob would leave orphaned asset docs.

role: declarative smoke-test specs for Media plugin
description: Defines a set of declarative HTTP probe specs (search, collections, auth checks, share links) surfaced in the Studio API-tester UI. These are not ExUnit tests — they run live against the deployed API via the api-tester framework.
whatBreaks: Media plugin smoke probes in Studio become inaccurate or missing, silently hiding Media API regressions from operators.

role: CRUD + tenancy-scoped lookup layer for mediaAsset documents
description: Creates/finds/deletes mediaAsset documents linked to media_files blobs, with careful NULL-tolerant workspace/dataset scoping to avoid cross-tenant leaks while staying backward-compatible with legacy unscoped rows; also backfills missing asset docs.

role: Media plugin codelist seeder
description: Idempotent boot-time seeder that registers three Media plugin codelists (asset_role, license, relation_type) into the Barkpark codelist registry. Called at plugin startup via codelist_seeders/0.
whatBreaks: Media asset role, license, and relation type dropdowns are missing from the Studio UI and API validation fails for media documents.

role: OnixEdit plugin entrypoint — book schema, routes, actions, lifecycle hooks
description: Top-level ONIX 3.0 book metadata plugin module: parses/splices the book schema (contributors/textContents subschemas), registers routes/action handlers/lifecycle hooks for Bokbasen publishing, content preview renderer, CLI commands, and document-level actions (export/publish buttons).
whatBreaks: The entire OnixEdit plugin (book editing, ONIX export button, Bokbasen publish flow, schema registration) fails to load or wire up correctly.

role: Dispatch shim for the book document's dryrun/real Bokbasen publish action
description: Stateless handler invoked by Studio's action-bar clicks: dryrun renders ONIX XML in-memory for preview, real enqueues the PublishWorker Oban job and marks a pending status, both tenancy-scoped via a threaded scope keyword list.
whatBreaks: Clicking 'Publish to Bokbasen' in Studio would fail silently, enqueue nothing, or (if scope is dropped) act on the wrong tenant's book document.

role: Declarative smoke-test specs for OnixEdit's public/admin API surfaces
description: Four API test specs (schema exposure via legacy and admin routes, Studio top-menu tab render, and a create+delete mutation round-trip) consumed by an external test runner; extracted verbatim from the old plugin facade callback.
whatBreaks: Only the automated API-smoke-test runner is affected — false confidence or missed regressions in OnixEdit's schema/route/mutation surfaces, no runtime impact.

role: OAuth2 token cache GenServer for Bokbasen integration
description: Single-process GenServer that caches OAuth2 client_credentials tokens for Bokbasen, de-duplicating concurrent fetches and handling TTL with a 60s safety margin.
whatBreaks: All Bokbasen metadata submissions would fail with auth errors or flood the token endpoint with concurrent requests.

role: HTTP client for Bokbasen metadata import API
description: Implements stage/poll/cancel against Bokbasen's async single-phase ONIX ingestion API (`POST /metadata/import/onix/v2`, GET status, DELETE). Used by the Oban PublishWorker.
whatBreaks: ONIX submissions to Bokbasen would fail entirely — books cannot be submitted or their status polled.

role: Typed error structs for the Bokbasen HTTP client with credential-redacting Inspect impls
description: Defines HTTPError/AuthError/SchemaRejectionError/NetworkError/RateLimitError structs so PublishWorker can pattern-match on failure modes, and custom Inspect implementations that scrub bearer tokens/OAuth secrets from logs and crash dumps.
whatBreaks: PublishWorker's retry/terminal-failure branching would misclassify errors, or worse, leak OAuth client_secret/access_token values into logs.

role: Oban worker driving the async stage→poll→accepted/rejected Bokbasen submission state machine
description: Core publish pipeline: stages a book as ONIX XML, polls Bokbasen for status, persists a composite bp_export_status field, broadcasts on two PubSub topics, handles retry/backoff/cancel logic, and carries the tenancy scope through Oban job args so a re-enqueued job re-reads the correct tenant's document.

role: Credential resolver for Bokbasen plugin settings
description: Resolves Bokbasen OAuth2 credentials and API endpoints from app env (runtime.exs) with fallback to the encrypted plugin_settings DB row, providing a typed credentials map to the auth and client modules.
whatBreaks: Auth and HTTP client would receive nil credentials, causing all Bokbasen operations to fail with auth errors.

role: Bokbasen export status read/write facade
description: The single sanctioned entry point for reading and writing the bp_export_status composite field on book documents. Handles backwards-compat normalization of legacy string/JSON shapes, derives signed_off from accepted_at, and broadcasts PubSub events on write.
whatBreaks: Bokbasen export status is corrupted or inconsistent, breaking the publisher's view of submission state and LiveView status updates.

role: CLI command manifest entry for OnixEdit's ONIX export endpoint
description: Declares the single `onixedit.export` CLI/capabilities verb (GET /v1/plugins/onixedit/export/:dataset/:id, admin-tier) contributed to the /v1/capabilities manifest; deliberately omits non-HTTP surfaces like the admin LiveViews.
whatBreaks: The `bp` CLI/TUI would show a wrong or missing export command, or claim wrong auth tier, breaking scripted ONIX exports via the CLI.

role: OnixEdit codelist seed functions + declarative codelist requirements list
description: Exposes seeders/0 (EDItEUR bundled + Thema seed functions run at boot) and requirements/0, a long declarative list of ~70 {plugin_name, list_id, issue} entries the WI3 importer uses to know which codelists the book schema needs.
whatBreaks: Missing/incorrect codelist requirements would leave book schema fields without valid enum options or break ONIX export validation against EDItEUR/Thema codelists.

role: ONIX codelist staleness analyzer
description: Pure functions detect_stale/2 and revalidate/2 that classify ONIX codelist refs in book documents as :current, :stale, :deprecated, or :acknowledged based on issue version drift. Used by the Bokbasen export pipeline and admin UI to surface outdated codelist pins.
whatBreaks: ONIX codelist drift goes undetected, resulting in stale/deprecated refs being exported to Bokbasen without warning.

role: Top-level ONIX 3.0 XML export/serialization entrypoint for book documents
description: Orchestrates building the full <Product> element from Header/DescriptiveDetail/CollateralDetail/PublishingDetail/ProductSupply builders, sanitizes illegal XML control chars, gates output on XSD validation, and converts codelist-resolver raises into a structured {:invalid_code,...} error envelope shared by the export controller, dryrun preview, and PublishWorker.

role: Static EDItEUR ONIX codelist code→label lookup/validation tables
description: Hand-maintained maps for ~15 ONIX codelists (contributor role, product form, Thema subjects, currency, country, etc.); each resolver raises ArgumentError on an unrecognized code, which Export.to_iodata catches and converts into a structured error rather than letting it escape as a crash.

role: Builds the ONIX <CollateralDetail> block (marketing text + supporting resources/cover images)
description: Constructs TextContent and SupportingResource XML sub-elements from book.collateralDetail, enforcing ONIX XSD-mandatory children (dropping incomplete entries rather than emitting invalid XML), and implements a Norwegian-first locale fallback chain with BCP-47→ISO 639-2/B language code mapping.
whatBreaks: Cover images or marketing descriptions would be missing from exported ONIX, or the language attribute could emit a non-ONIX-valid code causing XSD/Bokbasen rejection.

role: Builds the ONIX <DescriptiveDetail> block (title, contributors, product form, Thema subjects)
description: Constructs ProductForm/ProductFormDetail/TitleDetail/Contributor/Subject sub-elements from the book document, resolving codes through Codelists and applying the Thema MainSubject-first convention; skips sub-blocks with no data rather than emitting empty tags.
whatBreaks: Exported ONIX would be missing or malform title/contributor/subject data — the core bibliographic metadata trading partners consume — potentially failing XSD validation or shipping wrong book info.

role: ONIX 3.0 Header element builder
description: Builds the ONIX 3.0 `<Header>` XML element with SenderName, SentDateTime (compact YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS format required by XSD), and a dataset MessageNote. Simple but must produce XSD-valid datetime format.
whatBreaks: Every ONIX export fails XSD validation due to a malformed Header element, breaking all Bokbasen submissions.

role: ONIX 3.0 ONIXMessage root wrapper
description: Wraps a Header and one or more Product elements into the top-level `<ONIXMessage>` XML document with the correct release attribute and EDItEUR namespace. Uses an ordered keyword list for attributes to ensure byte-stable output.
whatBreaks: All ONIX exports produce invalid XML (wrong namespace or release attribute), causing complete rejection by Bokbasen.

role: Builds ONIX 3.0 <ProductSupply> XML block for book export
description: Constructs Market/MarketPublishingDetail/SupplyDetail/Price XML elements from book.json, synthesizing a Norwegian-locale default supply (with placeholder UnpricedItemType) when the document carries none, so Bokbasen ingestion always sees a valid envelope. Encodes several XSD-required-ordering gotchas (e.g. mandatory MarketPublishingStatus, non-scientific-notation PriceAmount formatting) discovered from real export failures.
whatBreaks: A malformed ProductSupply makes xmllint reject the whole ONIX export, turning the HTTP export endpoint into a 500 and blocking Bokbasen publishing for that book.

role: Builds ONIX 3.0 <PublishingDetail> XML block (Imprint/Publisher/PublishingDate)
description: Maps book.publishingDetail into the ONIX Imprint/Publisher/PublishingDate elements, applying codelist defaults (PublishingRole 01, PublishingDateRole 01) and converting ISO dates to ONIX compact YYYYMMDD with the correct dateformat attribute for partial dates. Returns nil when empty so callers avoid emitting an XSD-invalid empty wrapper.
whatBreaks: Incorrect date formatting or a missing role code produces an XSD-invalid ONIX document, breaking the export endpoint and Bokbasen delivery for affected books.

role: Bokbasen export status color/label mapping
description: Single source of truth for mapping Bokbasen export status states (pending, staged, accepted, rejected, failed, etc.) to CSS pill classes and human-readable labels. Accepts atom, binary, or nil inputs.
whatBreaks: Status pills in all Bokbasen-related UI surfaces show wrong colors or labels, degrading operator visibility into export state.

role: ONIX 3.0 XSD validation gate via xmllint
description: Validates generated ONIX XML against the vendored EDItEUR reference XSD using `xmllint --noout --schema`, blocking invalid ONIX from being submitted; skips gracefully when xmllint is absent.
whatBreaks: Invalid ONIX XML could be submitted to Bokbasen undetected, causing rejections at the Bokbasen end rather than locally.

role: Parses ONIX 3.0 XML into barkpark book.json content maps
description: Inverse of the OnixEdit exporter; walks <Product> nodes via SweetXml/xmerl and flattens DescriptiveDetail/CollateralDetail/PublishingDetail/ProductSupply into book.json shape, designed to round-trip byte-stably through the exporter. Hardens against XXE/billion-laughs by rejecting any DOCTYPE and disabling entity expansion (dtd: :none) before parsing untrusted publisher-supplied XML.
whatBreaks: A parsing/security regression could either corrupt imported book documents (silent data loss on round-trip) or reopen an XXE/DoS vector against untrusted ONIX uploads.

role: OnixEdit Bokbasen auto-publish lifecycle hook
description: after_publish hook that automatically enqueues Bokbasen.PublishWorker for book documents when they are published. Includes a recursion guard (ctx.source == :worker) to prevent infinite re-enqueue loops.
whatBreaks: Book publications no longer auto-submit to Bokbasen on publish, or the recursion guard fails causing an infinite worker loop.

role: Studio top-menu tab and desk-item contributions for OnixEdit/Bokbasen
description: Defines the 'Bokbasen' top-menu tab (points at the staleness console) and two Structure-pane desk items (divider + link to pending submissions), both gated on the `book` schema being registered in the workspace.
whatBreaks: Studio navigation would fail to surface the Bokbasen console, or show it in workspaces without the book schema, confusing operators.

role: plugin route highway smoke-test LiveView
description: A minimal LiveView mounted at /studio/onixedit/ping that proves the plugin_routes/1 macro correctly mounts plugin-contributed routes. Returns a static confirmation page; no real functionality.
whatBreaks: The plugin route highway smoke-test page returns wrong output, but no production feature is affected.
