description: Tracks the last-known remote _rev per {source,dataset,doc_id}, used as the ifRevisionID CAS base for pushes; primed both by successful push acks and by the pull applier's observed remote rev so clone-then-edit-then-push works without spurious conflicts.
whatBreaks: A stale or missing remote rev causes fail-closed create attempts that spuriously conflict (safe) or, if a wrong rev is trusted, an unconditional overwrite of remote changes (invariant violation) — limited to push-sync-enabled deployments.

role: GenServer drain-tick loop that pushes local mutations to a remote Barkpark
description: Polls the local outbox on a timer, runs each batch through Barkpark.Sync.Pusher.drain/3 with injected transport/backoff seams, and advances a push cursor only on ack/conflict (never on transient error). Default-off — only started when Sync.Settings.push_active?/1 is true.
whatBreaks: Push-sync sources would silently stop replaying local writes to the remote (or double-push/replay them), corrupting the remote CAS chain or halting sync entirely.

role: Pure per-event push-replay engine for the sync PUSH subsystem
description: Drains outbox events to a remote Barkpark, routing task.* events through the claim/close contract and everything else through createOrReplace+CAS doc pushes; records conflicts durably before advancing the cursor (write-then-advance) and defaults to real Req.post transport. Core of the tenant-scoped push wire seam.
whatBreaks: Could overwrite remote documents unsafely, lose conflict records, or mis-route task claim/close events into content merges, corrupting cross-instance sync integrity.

role: Typed config resolver for the pull+push sync subsystem
description: Loads BARKPARK_SYNC_* env into a struct, computing enabled/push_enabled gates only when full creds (url/token/dataset/workspace) are present; fresh installs default to sync off. Single source of truth read by Worker, PushWorker, and Pusher.
whatBreaks: Sync could activate without required tenancy scoping (writing to the wrong workspace) or fail to activate/deactivate as configured, since every sync process derives its behavior from this struct.

role: Pure SSE frame parser for the pull-sync wire protocol
description: Splits an accumulated byte buffer into complete/incomplete SSE frames and decodes 'mutation' event JSON envelopes, dropping welcome/keepalive frames; the deterministic counterpart to BarkparkWeb.ListenController's producer side.
whatBreaks: Malformed or dropped frame parsing would corrupt or silently lose incoming sync mutations, or desync the Last-Event-ID resume cursor across chunk boundaries.

role: Long-lived GenServer that streams remote SSE mutations into local sync
description: Opens a streaming Req.get to the remote /v1/data/listen/:dataset endpoint, buffers chunks across TCP boundaries, drains them through Sync.apply_frames/2, and reconnects with capped exponential backoff+jitter on failure or unresolved workspace. Runs the streaming GET in a monitored child process to avoid blocking the GenServer.
whatBreaks: The pull-sync subsystem would stop receiving remote updates, hang on a half-open connection, or reconnect-storm/lose its cursor position, breaking one-way sync for any dependent deployment.

role: Public API/facade for the task-document substrate (claim/close/queue/edges)
description: Everything-is-a-task engine: defines the task schema/content contract, delegates to Claim/Close/Queue/Edges/Move/Prime/Rail/Mutations submodules for atomic claim (CAS+fencing), close with cascading unblock, dependency graph, relabeling, paper refs, and re-parenting, emitting durable mutation_events for realtime/webhook parity. This is the core engine behind `bp task`.

role: Pure organizer + impure loader for the native Barkpark Projects kanban board
description: Large module: snapshot/1 loads the type:task corpus and derives a board projection (columns, momentum, ready overlay) via the pure build/2; also implements realtime re-bucketing (apply_change/3), drag-restage legality (restage_plan/4), and group/filter/family-fold views. Single source of truth for board glyphs, asserted parity-tested against the Go TUI's StatusGlyph table.
whatBreaks: The Projects board UI would show wrong columns/momentum/ready state, allow illegal drag transitions (e.g. closing another worker's claim), or drift visually from the TUI's shared glyph vocabulary.

role: Task claim primitives — atomic queue claim, targeted claim, resource-claim overlap fencing
description: Implements claim/2 (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED queue pop) and claim_by_id/3 (advisory-locked targeted claim with readiness/dependency/resource checks and same-worker lease renewal), both CAS-writing content.claim with epoch/work_digest and emitting task.claimed mutation events. Extracted from the Barkpark.Tasks facade.
whatBreaks: Concurrent workers could double-claim the same task, bypass resource-conflict fencing, or lose the work_digest close-guard, corrupting the task-obsession claim/epoch contract across CLI/TUI/API/sync.

role: Task close primitives — fencing CAS, work-digest guard, blocked→open cascade, land-digest notify
description: Implements close/3: epoch fencing, edited-under-you work-digest check, atomic content write (lifecycle/close_reason/landed/acceptance_criteria merge), cascades dependent blocked tasks to open, and emits advisory task.landed_under_you notices on scope overlap. Extracted from the Barkpark.Tasks facade.
whatBreaks: A stale or foreign close could silently overwrite an edited brief, fail to unblock dependent tasks, or corrupt the acceptance-criteria evidence trail relied on by the whole task lifecycle/CI gates.

role: Oban worker for task document storage compaction
description: Oban background worker that bounds storage growth on terminal-state task documents by snapshotting pre-compaction content to the revisions table and replacing live content with a compact summary. The history-length eligibility arm is latent; only the byte-size arm fires in production.
whatBreaks: Task document table bloats unboundedly over time; a bug could corrupt task content or lose mutation history if the revision snapshot step fails before the summary write.

role: Pure computation of a task's acceptance-criteria met/total progress
description: Single canonical owner (@canonical capability:task-criteria-progress) of the {met,total} progress used by the task chip, /v1/tasks envelope, and Studio checklist badge; tolerant of malformed entries, returns nil rather than 0/0 when criteria are absent.
whatBreaks: Task progress chips/badges across Studio, API, and TUI could show incorrect counts or crash on malformed acceptance_criteria data.

role: Find-or-create duplicate gate for newly created tasks
description: On a new type:task document birth (no prev_doc), fetches scoped candidates, scores them via Barkpark.Tasks.Similarity, optionally escalates gray-zone matches through an LLM Judge, and refuses creation of near-duplicates unless declared distinct_from. Fails open on any candidate-fetch error so dedup never blocks legitimate work.
whatBreaks: Task creation could either wrongly block legitimate new tasks or silently allow duplicate task births, undermining the task-obsession dedup guarantee across bp task create.

role: Ecto schema for task dependency edges
description: Defines the task_edges table schema representing typed dependency edges between documents (blocks / discovered-from). Enforces non-self-edges, FK constraints, and uniqueness per (from_id, to_id, kind).
whatBreaks: Task dependency graph becomes corrupt — self-edges or duplicate edges are admitted, breaking the bp task ready / claim queue that depends on correct blocking relationships.

role: CRUD module for typed task dependency graph edges
description: Owns add_dep/remove_dep/dependencies/dependents/edges over the task_edges table (blocks / discovered-from kinds), idempotent insert via on_conflict:nothing. Barkpark.Tasks delegates its public edge functions here.
whatBreaks: Dependency edges could silently fail to insert/delete or double-count, corrupting the ready-queue blocker graph and close-time unblock sweep.

role: Reverse view: tasks that cite a paper, with acceptance-criteria status
description: Read-only module (living-values lvw-t8/t9) built on Content.Graph.reverse_referencers to list tasks referencing a paper via design_doc/papers edges, hydrating each with criteria progress and a satisfied flag; fail-closed and budget-capped at 1000 nodes.
whatBreaks: A paper's 'driven tasks' panel would show wrong/missing tasks or incorrect satisfied state, misleading readers about whether a spec's acceptance criteria are met.

role: Allow-and-fence wrapper for adding a dependency edge onto an in-progress task
description: Wraps Edges.add_dep in a transaction with an advisory lock; if the dependent task is in_progress, bumps content.claim.epoch so the holder's next close is fenced_off and must resync, without ever rejecting the mutator. Preserves Edges.add_dep's return contract.
whatBreaks: A worker could keep working against a stale brief after a new blocker lands (fence never fires), or legitimate edge adds could be wrongly rejected/rolled back.

role: Shared low-level primitives (rev/event/broadcast helpers) for task CAS writes
description: Private substrate reused by Tasks.Mutations, Tasks.Move, Tasks.Fence etc.: generate_rev, current_epoch, insert_mutation_event!, caller_stamp, task_broadcast/emit_broadcasts. No public task API of its own.

role: Tier-2 LLM semantic dedup judge for task creation (Anthropic API call)
description: Env-gated, fails-open HTTP call to Claude (structured JSON output) that classifies two similar tasks as duplicate/expands/already_landed/distinct, escalating tier-1's gray-zone 'advise' verdict to a refuse. Swappable HTTP adapter for tests; no key configured = skipped entirely.
whatBreaks: Task-creation dedup guard could wrongly block legitimate creates or fail to catch true duplicates, but since it fails open on any error, worst case is just noisier task ledger — not a system outage.

role: Re-parents a task (content.parent_id) with cycle detection and CAS
description: rail-l3 structural mutation mirroring Mutations' CAS shape: advisory lock, cycle check via ancestor-chain walk, idempotent no-op on same-parent, emits task.reparented event, and folds an allow-and-fence epoch bump for in_progress tasks into the same write.
whatBreaks: Moving a task could create an undetected parent cycle (infinite loops in rail/tree reads) or silently drop the fence, letting a holder keep working against a stale task location.

role: CAS-guarded relabel and paper-reference mutations for a single task
description: Two near-identical functions (relabel_by_id, update_paper_refs_by_id) that add/remove entries from content.labels / content.papers under advisory lock + rev CAS, emitting task.relabeled / task.referenced mutation_events.
whatBreaks: Task labels or paper cross-references could be lost or duplicated under concurrent writes, or stale writes could silently overwrite newer state (CAS bypass).

role: Composes the multi-table reads for GET /v1/tasks/prime (agent rehydration)
description: Builds in_progress claims, recent task mutation_events, and lifecycle_status counts for a scope, lifted verbatim from the former controller so the web layer delegates to the Tasks context; tenancy fail-closed via Scope.scope_to_workspace.
whatBreaks: Agents calling `bp task prime` (or the TUI) to rehydrate context would get wrong in-progress lists, stale event history, or wrong counts, degrading task-obsession workflows but not corrupting data.

role: Shared composable content-jsonb filter fragments for task index queries
description: One owner for maybe_filter_type/kind/lifecycle/parent/label/dataset/claim helpers reused by TasksController.Params (GET /v1/tasks) and rows_for_query/2 (PortableDoc task-block live-plan resolver). Large file (761 lines); keeps filter semantics from drifting between the two callers.
whatBreaks: Both the /v1/tasks HTTP index and any PortableDoc paper embedding a live task query would return wrong/incomplete task rows, or leak across tenancy if the fail-closed scope filter regresses.

role: The dependency-aware ready-queue query shared by ready/1 and claim/2
description: Builds the single ready_query/1 Ecto query gating readiness on three axes (blocks-edge NOT EXISTS, content.dependencies satisfied-done check, draft/published twin collapse) plus optional phase scoping; both the read-only ready list and the row-locked atomic claim ride this same query so they can never disagree.
whatBreaks: The task ready-queue could surface blocked tasks as claimable (agents grab work they shouldn't) or hide legitimately ready tasks, and claim/ready could diverge — a core correctness guarantee of the whole task system.

role: Computes rail_rev ETag for a task's children/blockers
description: Computes a deterministic sha256-derived digest over a parent task's children (id, lifecycle_status, priority, rev) plus blocks-edges touching them, letting burst agents detect their rail changed without re-listing it. Also exposes unsatisfied_blockers/1 for the blocked_while_claimed notice. Fail-closed on missing workspace_id via Scope.scope_to_workspace.
whatBreaks: Agents would fail to notice new siblings/priority bumps/blocks edges mid-flight, or falsely think a rail changed, degrading the multi-agent rail-awareness notices.

role: Voluntary task-lease release primitive (holder-only unclaim)
description: Implements on-demand release of an in_progress task's lease by its holder only, using advisory lock + CAS on claim.epoch, flipping lifecycle back to open, clearing assignee, and emitting a task.released mutation_event + broadcast. Mirrors TtlSweeper's reap but enforces holder identity and clears assignee (a deliberate divergence).
whatBreaks: A buggy release could let a non-holder release a task, silently keep stale assignee, or fail to bump the epoch, corrupting the claim/lease fencing invariant used across claim/close.

role: Defines the `task` SchemaDefinition (dossier fields/groups/validations)
description: Pure data builder returning the %SchemaDefinition{} for kind:task — Brief/Work/Close/System editor groups, desk_groups, cross_validations, and all field declarations (title, description, acceptance_criteria, claim, dependencies, etc). Delegated from Barkpark.Tasks; registered via seeds.exs and Plugins.Bootstrap.
whatBreaks: Wrong field/group declarations break Studio task editing UI, hide fields from agents, or desync the schema from validate_task_content/1's actual write contract.

role: Pure tier-1 dedup similarity scorer for find-or-create task gate
description: Computes Jaccard-based similarity (0.7*title/desc + 0.3*labels) between a new task and candidates, excludes sibling/chain structural relations as benign, and buckets remainder into refuse/advise/excluded using calibrated thresholds. No DB access; fully unit-testable.
whatBreaks: Miscalibrated thresholds or broken structural exclusion would either block legitimate epic-seeding creates or let true duplicate tasks through the find-or-create gate.

role: Oban worker reaping crashed-agent task claims via TTL expiry
description: Periodically finds task docs stuck in_progress with a stale/missing claim.ts_iso, and under the same per-task advisory lock Tasks.close/3 uses, bumps the fencing epoch, clears the worker, and flips lifecycle_status back to open — preserving assignee — so a dead worker's late writes are rejected and the task becomes claimable again.
whatBreaks: Crashed workers' claims would never be reaped, permanently stalling tasks (unclaimable forever) or, if the fencing/lock logic is wrong, letting a dead worker's stale write clobber a legitimate re-claim.

role: Content-shape validator for kind:task documents
description: Pure validation module enforcing the task field contract (required kind/lifecycle_status, shape checks for priority/assignee/dependencies/claim/dossier fields) called by Content.create_document/upsert_document on task writes. Delegated from Barkpark.Tasks.
whatBreaks: A loosened or broken validator lets malformed task documents (bad lifecycle_status, wrong types) into storage, corrupting downstream readers like the ready query and Studio.

role: Semantic digest guarding against silent close after brief edits
description: Computes per-field and combined hex digests over a task's work-defining fields (title, description, acceptance_criteria) stamped at claim time; close recomputes and refuses if they drifted, deliberately excluding non-brief fields like labels/code_refs so self-edits don't trip the fence.
whatBreaks: A broken digest could either let a close proceed against a silently-changed brief, or spuriously block closes when unrelated fields change.

role: telemetry event attachment for Oban and plugin observability
description: Attaches telemetry handlers at boot that log Oban job lifecycle events (start/stop/exception) and plugin_settings read/write events by forwarding Oban's native events into the barkpark namespace. Idempotent attach/detach pair.
whatBreaks: Oban job and plugin settings activity becomes invisible in logs, reducing operational observability without breaking functionality.

role: Context for the Workspace→Project→Dataset tenancy hierarchy
description: Core CRUD/lookup for workspaces/projects/datasets, workspace theme + plugin-settings persistence, multi-tenant detection, per-principal workspace listing, and the atomic create_workspace_with_owner/delete_workspace flows (the latter walking media/document cleanup hooks before cascading delete). Widely imported across the whole tenancy/plugin/content stack.

role: Authorization chokepoint for the hard workspace tenant boundary
description: The single authorize/3 entry point combining membership + grant (API token permissions or user role, plus airdrop CallerContext grants) to decide read/write/admin per workspace; data-driven role_permits? with a compiled-in fail-safe for built-in roles so a missing DB row can never cause a silent lockout or an escalation.

role: Ecto schema for the Dataset row under a Project
description: Simple schema/changeset for the first-class Dataset entity (slug unique per project) that promotes the legacy 'dataset' string; additive seam, the string stays authoritative for reads/uniqueness while dataset_id rides alongside.
whatBreaks: Malformed dataset rows or a broken uniqueness constraint could let duplicate/colliding datasets exist per project, confusing the dual dataset_id/string resolution paths.

role: Ecto schema binding a principal (token or user) to a workspace with a role
description: Table + changeset only for workspace_memberships; validates principal_type (api_token/user) and role against a caller-supplied valid_roles set (built-ins plus custom roles), enforcing one membership row per (workspace, principal_type, principal_id).

role: Ecto schema for Organization, a tier above Workspace
description: Simple schema (slug, name, require_mfa, has_many workspaces) grouping workspaces under one enterprise identity; nullable workspace.organization_id and no authorization path reads it yet — additive-only future anchor for SSO/SCIM.
whatBreaks: Currently low blast radius since nothing reads organization_id yet; a changeset bug would only affect org creation/require_mfa enrollment, not live authorization.

role: Ecto schema for Project tenancy entity
description: Defines the Project schema (belongs to a Workspace, unique slug within workspace) with changeset validations including reserved slug list and format constraints.
whatBreaks: Invalid or reserved project slugs could be persisted, breaking routing or allowing namespace collisions.

role: Ecto schema for custom/global RBAC roles
description: Defines a named role (global built-in when workspace_id is nil, else workspace-scoped custom role) with has_many permissions; part of era-w1-custom-rbac user-principal authorization.
whatBreaks: Malformed role rows or a broken changeset could allow duplicate/invalid role names or block RBAC role creation, affecting user permission assignment.

role: Ecto schema for one granted action on a Role
description: Join-row schema mapping a role to one of read/write/admin actions, enforcing uniqueness per (role, action); the atomic unit of the user-principal RBAC authorization path (distinct from token permission strings).
whatBreaks: An invalid or missing permission row would silently deny or wrongly grant an action to users assigned that role, a direct authorization correctness issue.

role: Ecto schema for the Workspace — the hard tenant boundary entity
description: Defines the workspaces table (slug/name/settings/organization_id) with reserved-slug exclusion and format validation; moduledoc is a hard warning to never call Repo.delete/1 directly — always go through Tenancy.delete_workspace/1 to avoid leaking media blobs/CDN cache and skipping plugin hooks.

role: Rail-shaped line-diff wrapper serving /v1/rail/diff
description: Wraps Barkpark.Papers.TextDiff (the vendored LCS diff port) and translates its op shape into the rail's {op,text} wire form (context op '=' -> ' '), plus an HTML pre-block renderer for the diff modal. Deliberately not a re-implementation — keeps one canonical LCS algorithm.
whatBreaks: The goal-path rail's diff modal (/v1/rail/diff) would render wrong or garbled hunks/HTML.

role: Validation checker behaviour definition
description: Defines the Elixir behaviour contract (callback `check/2`) that all value-checkers must implement, including plugin-contributed checkers. It is the interface contract for the validation DSL's `{:matches, name}` op.

role: ONIX codelist validation checker
description: Validation checker that looks up a value against a versioned codelist in the database (Codelists/Values tables), distinguishing between unknown codelist, version mismatch, and unknown value within a known codelist. Wires the codelist registry into the rule DSL for ONIX fields like ContributorRole.
whatBreaks: ONIX codelist fields (ContributorRole, etc.) accept any value without validation — invalid ONIX codes pass through to export and downstream EDI systems.

role: GTIN-14 checksum validator
description: Validates GTIN-14 product identifiers by checking length (14 digits after stripping hyphens/spaces) and the standard alternating-weight check digit algorithm.
whatBreaks: Invalid GTIN-14 product codes pass schema validation and can be exported in ONIX feeds, causing downstream retailer/distributor ingestion failures.

role: ISBN-13 checksum validator
description: Validates ISBN-13 identifiers: strips hyphens/spaces, checks length (13 digits), and verifies the alternating 1,3-weight checksum.
whatBreaks: Invalid ISBN-13 codes pass validation and can appear in ONIX exports, breaking book industry supply-chain systems that depend on correct ISBNs.

role: ISO-4217 currency code checker
description: Validates currency codes against a hardcoded MapSet of ~50 active ISO-4217 codes covering major publishing markets. Exists as a zero-dependency alternative to the full codelist registry for catching obvious typos.
whatBreaks: Invalid currency codes (typos like 'USDD') pass pricing field validation and end up in ONIX exports, causing pricing ingestion errors in retailer systems.

role: ISO-639 language code validator
description: Implements a compile-time MapSet of ~80 ISO-639-2/T and 2-letter language codes used to validate language fields at schema-validation time. Returns :ok or {:error, :unknown_language}.
whatBreaks: Invalid language codes pass validation silently, corrupting ONIX exports and any language-gated publishing logic.

role: Non-empty value validator
description: Trivial checker that returns {:error, :empty} for nil, empty string, empty list, or empty map, and :ok otherwise. Used as a validation behaviour implementation.
whatBreaks: Required fields can be saved as blank/nil, breaking downstream consumers that expect non-empty values.

role: Cross-field codelist consistency helper
description: Pure module providing `consistent?/2` to check that a dependent document field satisfies a predicate derived from a driver field's value. Used for cross-field ONIX-style validation rules (e.g. ProductForm constrains PageCount).
whatBreaks: Cross-field validation rules silently pass or crash, allowing invalid ONIX/codelist documents to be saved.

role: ETS-backed validation checker registry GenServer
description: GenServer that owns an ETS table of named checker modules (built-ins: isbn13, gtin14, iso639, iso4217, nonempty) plus plugin-contributed checkers. Provides fast read-path `find/1` for the hot evaluator and `reload_plugin_checkers/0` called at boot.

role: Cloak encryption vault — single cipher source for encrypted-at-rest fields
description: Tiny `use Cloak.Vault` module configured via config/runtime.exs (AES.GCM keyed by BARKPARK_CLOAK_KEY); production raises if the key is unset. Backs Barkpark.EncryptedMap used for plugin settings and any other encrypted-at-rest field.
whatBreaks: Any encrypted field (e.g. plugin settings, secrets) could fail to encrypt/decrypt or leak an insecure dev key into prod.

role: Context module for webhook CRUD, tenancy scoping, delivery bookkeeping
description: Central Ecto-query API for webhooks/deliveries: list/get/create/update/delete with strict tenant-scope stamping (drops client-supplied scope keys), secret rotation, active-webhook selection for content and audit events, auto-disable/re-enable on consecutive failures, and the CAS-fenced schedule_retry used to avoid in-task sleeps. Heavily commented with tenant-leak and race-condition rationale.

role: Ecto schema for webhook_deliveries rows (document/media/audit sources)
description: Schema + changeset for the durable delivery-attempt row that RetryWorker/StuckDeliverySweeper resume from; validates required fields conditionally by source_kind (document needs endpoint_id+event_id, media/audit need payload_snapshot) and enforces the dedup unique constraint.

role: Webhook delivery engine — signing, retries, SSRF-safe HTTP, audit bridge
description: The core delivery mechanics: HMAC signing/verification (Stripe-style, JS-twin-parity), jittered backoff, Retry-After honoring, bounded concurrent fan-out via async_stream, scheduled (not in-task-sleep) retries via Oban RetryWorker, and the audit-event delivery bridge. Large, heavily documented module that is the single source of truth for delivery semantics shared with media deliveries.

role: Rebuilds webhook {webhook, body} for durable delivery resume
description: Single shared branch point for source_kind (document vs media) used by both RetryWorker and StuckDeliverySweeper to reconstruct a webhook delivery's payload — document rows rebuild from mutation_events, media rows replay their payload_snapshot via a transient unpersisted Webhook struct. Returns :gone when unrecoverable.
whatBreaks: A bug here would break crash-recovery webhook retries for either document or media events, causing silently dropped or malformed webhook redeliveries after a crash.

role: Oban worker running the next backoff attempt of a retrying webhook delivery
description: One-shot Oban job that CAS-claims a webhook_deliveries row on its updated_at fence, rebuilds the signed payload via PayloadRebuild, and resumes the attempt loop through Dispatcher.redeliver/5. Replaced an in-task Process.sleep backoff that starved the delivery pool during retry storms; shares crash-safety machinery with StuckDeliverySweeper via the same CAS fence.
whatBreaks: webhook retries either double-deliver or never resume, breaking the at-least-once contract and stranding events in pending

role: Oban cron job recovering webhook deliveries crash-stranded in pending status
description: Runs every minute, CAS-claims pending deliveries older than a threshold (default 300s), rebuilds the payload from durable mutation_events, and re-dispatches via Dispatcher.redeliver/4; without it a crashed dispatcher permanently orphans an event behind the UNIQUE(endpoint_id, event_id) constraint.
whatBreaks: crash-orphaned webhook deliveries become permanently undeliverable with no recovery path, or the sweeper double-delivers an in-flight row

role: Ecto schema for webhooks table — endpoint config, secrets, tenancy
description: Defines the webhook row shape (url/events/types/secret/previous_secret rotation window/audit subscription fields/tenant FKs), changeset validation including URL shape defense-in-depth, and effective_secrets/2 for the rotation-window signature check.

role: Oban worker shim for search analytics crystallization
description: Thin 10-line Oban worker wrapper that delegates to Barkpark.Search.Workers.Crystallize.perform/1; exists to register the worker in the correct Oban queue without duplicating logic.
whatBreaks: Search analytics crystallization jobs fail to enqueue or execute, degrading search ranking data over time.

role: Oban worker shim for search analytics pruning
description: Thin 10-line Oban worker wrapper that delegates to Barkpark.Search.Workers.Prune.perform/1; registers the prune job in the default Oban queue.
whatBreaks: Old search analytics rows are never pruned, causing unbounded table growth and eventual query degradation.

role: Oban smoke-test worker
description: Minimal Oban worker that echoes its args or succeeds silently; used to verify queue, executor, and telemetry wiring end-to-end without a real plugin job.
whatBreaks: Oban queue integration tests lose their baseline smoke worker, making it harder to diagnose queue/telemetry regressions.

role: Phoenix web module macro factory
description: Defines `use BarkparkWeb, :controller/:live_view/:html/etc` macros that inject standard Phoenix boilerplate into every controller, LiveView, and component. All web modules depend on it compiling correctly.
whatBreaks: Every controller, LiveView, and HTML component fails to compile if this macro factory is broken.

role: Single source of truth pinning anonymous readers to the published perspective
description: resolve/2 forces :published for any caller without an api token, preview JWT, or :edit share, ignoring a ?perspective= query param so anonymous callers can't read drafts/raw; used by search controllers as well as QueryController to close a duplicated-guard gap.
whatBreaks: anonymous callers could read draft/unpublished content across any surface that calls resolve/2, a tenant-wide data leak

role: Phoenix channel for Shared Storm's public realtime strike feed + cursor presence
description: Handles pulse:<channel> joins (fails closed on unconfigured channels), tracks socket presence with hue metadata, rebroadcasts throttled ephemeral cursor frames, and receives durable 'strike' broadcasts from PulseController; never itself writes to the DB.
whatBreaks: the public pulse live-cursor/strike feed breaks or an unknown channel silently admits joins

role: Anonymous Phoenix socket entry point for Pulse channels
description: Always accepts connect/3 (no token gate), delegates all authorization to PulseChannel.join/3; deliberately separate from UserSocket and relies on endpoint-level check_origin (no per-socket override, avoiding a known past landmine).
whatBreaks: the public pulse websocket surface stops accepting connections or a stray check_origin override reintroduces the CORS landmine

role: Player-facing hyperquiz realtime channel — join/presence/answer/tally/cursor/heatmap
description: Handles quiz:room:<pin> joins for players and observers, tracks Presence, throttles cursor/hover/submit frames, forwards room PubSub events (tally, player_joined/left, binary cursor/heatmap frames) as pushes, and cleans up player state on terminate.
whatBreaks: quiz gameplay (joining, answering, live tallies, cursors) breaks or observers get miscounted as players, corrupting player_count

role: Anonymous but server-authoritative identity socket for hyperquiz players
description: connect/3 mints a random player_id or verifies a signed reconnect token (Phoenix.Token, 24h max age), closing a spoofing gap where a client could claim an arbitrary id; carries QuizChannel on quiz:room:*.
whatBreaks: players could spoof another player's identity, or reconnecting players lose their stable identity/answers

role: Phoenix Channel for per-keystroke live search over WebSocket
description: Handles socket join with tenant auth (workspace/project resolution + Tenancy.Auth authorize), per-keystroke 'query' frames, and live push of updated results on document mutation via PubSub subscription — mirrors SearchController's response shape and scope resolution for parity with HTTP search.
whatBreaks: Live search in Studio could leak cross-tenant results, fail to authorize a socket, or stop pushing live updates on document changes.

role: Phoenix WebSocket auth gate for SearchChannel
description: Defines the public realtime socket, authenticates Bearer tokens via Auth.verify_token/1, and routes `search:*` topics to SearchChannel. Rejects connections with invalid tokens.
whatBreaks: All WebSocket-based live search connections fail to authenticate, breaking real-time search for all clients.

role: generic two-stage confirm modal LiveView component
description: A presentational Phoenix Component implementing a dry-run-then-real two-stage confirmation dialog for schema-declared `kind: "modal"` actions in Studio; accepts event name strings so plugin-defined phx-click handlers work without JS literals.
whatBreaks: Destructive Studio actions (e.g. schema publish) lose their confirmation gate, allowing accidental data mutations without a dry-run preview.

role: Studio UI component for draft-vs-published field diff
description: Renders a top-level field-level diff table between a draft and published document using the schema's declared field list; handles nil published doc gracefully.
whatBreaks: Studio draft diff view shows incorrect or missing change indicators, misleading editors about unpublished changes.

role: UI status pill for external sync integrations
description: Thin stateless Phoenix component that renders a colored badge showing the current sync state for any registered external system (e.g. Bokbasen); parent LiveView owns the subscription and state.
whatBreaks: External sync status indicators in the Studio toolbar display incorrectly or crash on unknown states.

role: Function-component rendering v1 leaf field inputs in Studio editor form
description: Byte-identical extraction of the legacy StudioLive private render_input clauses (select/text/richText/boolean/datetime/color/reference/image/slug/array/object/default), reworked to avoid phantom-default persistence for optional color/select fields, and bridges several field types to Web Components via hidden inputs + BarkparkFieldBridge hook.
whatBreaks: Every v1 schema field editor in Studio (post, page, author, etc.) could render wrong controls, corrupt values, or silently persist phantom defaults.

role: HEEx component for v2 arrayOf field type with reorder/add/remove
description: Renders one row per array element via the matching sub-field component (composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText/reference/leaf), exposes pure list-op helpers (move_up/move_down/add_row/remove_row) that the parent LiveView calls on phx-click events, and shows a checklist-progress badge for composite rows with a boolean `met` subfield.

role: Studio form component for codelist fields
description: HEEx LiveView component rendering codelist (enum) fields as a flat select, a datalist combobox for large flat lists (>100 entries), or a tree picker component for hierarchical codelists like Thema. Handles missing-registry placeholders.
whatBreaks: All codelist fields in the Studio editor render broken or blank, preventing editors from selecting coded values on book and other ONIX-typed documents.

role: recursive composite field form component
description: Phoenix function component that renders a labeled fieldset for v2 `composite` schema field types, recursing into nested composite, arrayOf, codelist, and localizedText children. Handles readonly mode, path-based nesting, and per-subfield error display.
whatBreaks: Studio document editing for any schema using composite fields renders incorrectly or crashes, breaking structured content entry.

role: HEEx component for v2 localizedText field with per-language inputs
description: Renders one textarea (or rich-text Web Component) per configured language, resolves the fallback chain via Barkpark.Content.LocalizedText.resolve/2, and shows a missing-primary warning badge when falling back to another language.
whatBreaks: Multi-language content fields in Studio could fail to display/save per-language text or silently mask missing translations.

role: hierarchical codelist picker LiveComponent
description: Renders a tree browser for large hierarchical codelists (e.g. Thema ~3000 nodes) as a single-select picker in the Studio editor. Delegates to Codelists.tree/3 and indexes nodes for O(1) lookups; falls back to empty placeholder when no codelist is registered.
whatBreaks: ONIX/Thema subject category fields in the Studio editor become unusable for any codelist with >100 hierarchical entries.

role: Web-layer delegate for visibleWhen field-visibility predicate
description: Thin alias module that delegates visible?/2 to Barkpark.Content.FieldVisibility, ensuring the Studio field renderers and CrossValidator share the exact same operator semantics (eq, neq, in, empty, non_empty, starts_with) for conditional field display.
whatBreaks: If it diverges from Content.FieldVisibility, Studio field visibility and cross-field validation could disagree, showing/hiding fields inconsistently with validation rules.

role: Inline SVG icon set for Studio UI (zero JS dependency)
description: Defines a large map of Lucide-derived SVG path strings and an emoji-to-icon-name lookup, exposing an <.icon> Phoenix component; used pervasively across Studio chrome, editor headers, nav, and type glyphs.

role: doc-type-agnostic content preview sidebar component
description: Server-rendered Phoenix Component that displays plugin-provided pre-rendered iodata in a `<pre>` pane; doc-type agnostic via `content_preview/1` with a legacy `onix_preview/1` shim for backwards compat with tests and existing bookmarks.
whatBreaks: The Studio editor sidebar content preview (ONIX XML, Bulldocs, or any registered plugin renderer) stops rendering, leaving editors without document preview.

role: Shared emitter for a document's OpenGraph/Twitter/JSON-LD social-share head block
description: head/1 renders og:*/twitter:*/JSON-LD tags from a preview manifest (content["preview"] or a read-time projection via Barkpark.Preview.project/3, else a degraded default); absolutizes relative URLs against Endpoint.url(), never crashes on nil, and is the sole place link unfurls are produced across the app.
whatBreaks: every shared paper/post/document link unfurls blank or with wrong/broken metadata on Slack, Twitter, etc.

role: Facade re-exporting all Studio LiveView components via defdelegate
description: Aggregates component implementations from Panes/Nav/Modals/Editor/EditorFields sub-modules into one module so `import BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents` brings every <.component> into scope; compile-time attr/slot validation lives in the sub-modules, not here.

role: Tokenized Studio form-control component kit (inputs, selects, switches, checkboxes)
description: Thin Phoenix function components wrapping root.html.heex CSS primitives (.form-input, .form-switch, etc.) so every Studio control draws color from design tokens with zero inline literals, passing the studio-literal-check.sh guard; widely reused across Studio screens.

role: Core Studio editor-pane components — document header, field renderer, editor shell
description: Renders the editor column StudioLive delegates to: document_header, editor_field, studio_field_renderer (dispatches v1 FieldInputs vs v2 PluginAdapter), studio_editor_shell (title/schema fields/diff/conflict/cross-validation banners/doc actions), extracted from the former monolithic StudioComponents and re-exported there for compatibility.
whatBreaks: the entire Studio document editing surface (field rendering, save, publish, conflict/diff UI, doc actions) breaks across every schema type

role: Studio editor secondary chrome: bulk-publish bar, secondary pane, presence-nav
description: Phoenix.Component module holding the bulk-publish floating action bar, read-only secondary-editor card + picker modal, and the presence-nav overlay (with load-bearing id/phx-hook for PresenceIdentity). Split out of the former editor god-module; re-exported via defdelegate from the StudioComponents facade so call sites are unaffected.
whatBreaks: Bulk publish/unpublish UI or the multi-user presence nav (jump-to-user, avatars) breaks across every Studio pane that uses the shell.

role: Studio modal/popover component library (image picker, shares, access, history, delete)
description: Large Phoenix.Component module implementing every Studio overlay: image picker, network-shares panel, item-share popover, airdrop access-grant sheet, access panel, reference picker, history, delete/discard confirmation, and profile-edit — plus the `studio_modals/1` umbrella that composes five of them. Security-sensitive UI gating (`@admin?`) is presentation-only; handlers re-check server-side per the module's own docs.
whatBreaks: Any Studio modal workflow (image upload, sharing, access-grant minting, revision restore, document delete) fails or renders incorrectly across the whole Studio surface.

role: Studio chrome/nav components: flash, update/env banners, tabs, topbar, shell
description: Defines Studio's outer chrome — flash banners, self-update banner, staging env banner, sign-out/theme-toggle buttons, and critically `default_top_menu_entries/4` (the canonical nav-tab model, marked @canonical capability:studio-nav-model) plus `studio_tabs/1`, `studio_topbar/1`, and `studio_shell/1`. Drives the plugin top-menu registry resolver chain.
whatBreaks: Wrong or missing Studio top nav tabs (Structure/Media/API/Settings/tmux/chat/Style), broken active-tab highlighting, or a crashed layout shell across every Studio LiveView.

role: Studio pane-layout primitives: columns, dividers, doc list rows
description: Core structural building blocks every Studio pane composes from: pane_layout, pane_column (with collapse), pane_item, pane_doc_item (rich doc row with status dot/badge/meta), document_preview Web Component wrapper, empty states, and section headers. Re-exported via the StudioComponents facade.
whatBreaks: Every Studio multi-pane layout (document lists, structure browser, editor panes) loses its column/row rendering, collapse behavior, or bulk-select checkboxes.

role: JSON API controller for airdrop scoped-access grants
description: Implements mint/index/show/revoke/claim/mine for the Access (airdrop grants) capability, whitelisting output fields (never leaking link_token_hash) and funneling claim failures through a shared no-oracle ClaimFlow shared with the browser GrantController.
whatBreaks: Scoped access-grant minting, listing, revocation, or claiming could leak secrets, allow privilege escalation, or break the `bp access` CLI/UI entirely.

role: 302 redirect funnel from flat admin Studio URLs to scoped ones
description: Small controller redirecting legacy flat `/studio/settings` and `/studio/:dataset/_plugins...` links to the canonical `/w/:ws/p/:proj/...` scoped routes via ScopeResolver, always 302 (never cached) since scope depends on session.
whatBreaks: Old bookmarks/links to admin Studio settings or plugin-admin pages 404 or teleport into the wrong workspace.

role: Dataset analytics REST endpoint
description: Thin controller serving GET /api/analytics/:dataset — aggregates document stats, total count, and recent activity from Content context and returns JSON. Depends on scope helpers for multi-tenant isolation.
whatBreaks: Analytics endpoint returns wrong or unscoped data, potentially leaking cross-tenant document stats.

role: Core user-auth JSON API controller (register/login/MFA/sessions/reset)
description: Large, security-critical controller implementing register, login with TOTP/recovery MFA, session listing/revocation, logout with SAML SLO, email verification, password reset, magic-link passwordless login, MFA enroll/verify/disable with step-up re-auth, and self-mint of owned personal access tokens with strict no-escalation binding to the session user. Heavy anti-enumeration discipline throughout.

role: Renders a published Paper as an email-safe HTML byte stream
description: GET /papers/:slug/email — serves the same published paper as the reader route but composed with the :email render style (inline CSS, evergreen palette, live task resolution), themed by the paper's workspace. Public, published-only, mirrors reader visibility contract.

role: HTTP ingest API for Papers (Bulldocs) — create/patch/propose blocks
description: Token-gated controller accepting native block or raw-HTML paper ingest, batch/single DocPatchOp application with optimistic-concurrency (ifRev), and an AI-proposes draft-insert loop with mandatory provenance; upserts documents of type 'paper' and broadcasts PubSub deltas for live reader updates.

role: Token-gated API exposing pending paper_events intents for external readers
description: Simple index/mark_processed controller over Barkpark.Plugins.Bulldocs.Events, letting the paper-side reader loop drain actionable events (action:*/simplify-*) recorded by the ingest pipeline.
whatBreaks: External automation polling for pending intents stalls or double-processes events, breaking the loop-closer workflow between paper edits and downstream actions.

role: GET /v1/capabilities controller — the CLI/MCP/SDK contract endpoint
description: Resolves the caller's auth tier from an optional token, builds/projects the capabilities manifest through an existence-hiding allow-list, and serves it with ETag/If-None-Match 304 support; an opt-in ?build=1 param includes the build identity key for back-compat safety.
whatBreaks: Every bp CLI, SDK, and MCP client discovers the API surface via this endpoint — a bug here breaks capability discovery for all external tooling or leaks manifest data across auth tiers.

role: Phoenix RenderErrors handler for HTML (browser) requests
description: Renders a minimal, self-contained dark-themed error page from just the status code/template name (never user input); required or Phoenix's error renderer itself crashes on any unmatched browser route.

role: Phoenix RenderErrors handler for JSON (API) requests — canonical error envelope
description: Last line of defense for uncaught exceptions/unmatched routes on JSON requests; emits the same v1 error envelope as FallbackController via Barkpark.Content.Errors so crash-path 500s are byte-identical to controller-emitted errors and never leak exception detail.
whatBreaks: Every SDK/CLI consumer parsing error.code would get inconsistent or malformed error bodies on crashes, or the error renderer itself could crash, dropping the connection.

role: NDJSON document export controller
description: Streams all documents of a dataset (optionally filtered by type) as chunked NDJSON via a database transaction. Handles the GET /v1/data/export/:dataset endpoint.

role: API error envelope router
description: Routes controller error tuples through the v1 structured error envelope defined in Barkpark.Content.Errors. Every controller using `action_fallback` depends on this to produce consistent JSON error responses.

role: GET /v1/search/:dataset — unified documents+media search controller
description: Fans out parallel Task.async searches across documents and media surfaces, pins anonymous callers to the published perspective, redacts per-type schema fields via Envelope, clamps limit to 100, dedups requested surfaces, and records search intelligence/analytics.

role: Operator API to adopt a GitHub-intake task into Barkpark
description: POST /v1/plugins/github/adopt/:id — bearer-gated operator action delegating to Barkpark.Plugins.Github.Adopt.adopt/3 via an overridable seam, mapping :not_intake/:not_found/other errors to 409/404/422 respectively, threading tenant scope opts.

role: Read-only GitHub sync-health status API
description: GET /v1/plugins/github/status — bearer-gated operator read returning a sync-health snapshot (conflicts, cursor lag, mirror queue depth) via an overridable seam to Barkpark.Plugins.Github.Health.snapshot/1. Never mutates; always 200.
whatBreaks: `bp github status` reports wrong/missing sync health, misleading operators about GitHub bridge state, but no mutation risk.

role: Inbound GitHub webhook dispatcher for the github plugin's intake
description: Handles POST /v1/plugins/github/webhook after signature verification, branching on X-GitHub-Event/action to route issue events to Intake.ingest (birth) or InboundEvents.handle (detach bookkeeping), always answering 2xx unless a genuine ingest failure occurs so GitHub never retry-storms.

role: Browser endpoint claiming an airdrop scoped-access grant link
description: GET /grant/:token binds a shared grant to the authenticated account via Access.ClaimFlow.resolve/2 (shared with the JSON API), enforcing a no-oracle failure contract so token existence/validity can't be probed, then redirects into the scoped Studio.
whatBreaks: A broken no-oracle guard could leak grant/token existence or let a claim bind to the wrong account, an access-control security bug.

role: Document revision history API — list/show/restore controller
description: Lists revisions, shows a single revision (redacted via Envelope for non-authorized callers), and restores a prior revision; routes plugin lifecycle vetoes and not-found/invalid-uuid cases through the canonical Errors envelope.

role: Back-compat controller matching the Go TUI's original REST endpoints
description: CRUD (index/show/create/delete) plus schemas listing under the legacy wire shape (id/title/status/values), routing content through Envelope.render for field-visibility redaction and enforcing the forbidden-filter-field guard before querying. Kept for old Go TUI clients; re-nests redacted content under `:values` to preserve the historic shape.

role: Back-compat 301/302 redirect controller
description: Handles two legacy URL patterns — /admin/bokbasen and /studio/:dataset/onixedit/book/:doc_id — redirecting them to current canonical paths after the plugin-highway refactor. Preserves query strings.
whatBreaks: Bookmarked legacy URLs return 404 or route to wrong paths, breaking external integrations and editor deep links.

role: SSE controller streaming real-time document mutation events with resume
description: Implements /v1/data/listen/:dataset — subscribes to PubSub topics (workspace-scoped or global), replays missed events via Last-Event-ID, and re-renders every emitted document through Envelope.render/Envelope.redact per-subscriber caller context so private/owner-scoped fields and rows never leak to an unauthorized listener. Central to realtime sync (bp CLI listen, SDK live queries).

role: Mints single-use login handoff tickets for control-plane one-click Studio entry
description: POST /v1/auth/login-tickets, bearer-authed, calls Barkpark.Auth.mint_login_ticket to create a 60s ticket bound to the raw bearer (never exposing the api_token itself); consumed later by SessionController.ticket/2.
whatBreaks: A flawed binding or leaked api_token could let an attacker mint sessions or hijack a control-plane admin token.

role: Controller for media file upload/list/serve/delete and rendition delivery
description: Handles multipart upload, listing, metadata show, raw file serving and on-demand rendition serving with access checks (Access.allowed?) and defensive MIME/content-disposition handling to prevent stored-XSS via dangerous mime types. Delegates storage/rendition logic to Barkpark.Media.

role: SDK handshake / schema-drift detection endpoint
description: Serves GET /v1/meta — returns API version window, server time, and schema hash(es) so SDK clients can detect schema drift without fetching full schemas. No auth required.
whatBreaks: SDK clients cannot detect schema or API version drift, causing silent mismatches between client codegen and server schema.

role: Controller for the core /v1/data/mutate write endpoint
description: Applies a batch of mutations via Content.apply_mutations, injects If-Match header as ifMatch CAS guard for single-mutation requests, and renders canonical v1/v2 error envelopes (including plugin lifecycle halts) instead of ad-hoc error bodies. This is the single write chokepoint for nearly all document creation/updates.

role: OIDC relying-party start/callback endpoints for SSO login
description: GET /v1/auth/oidc/:org_slug/start redirects to the org's IdP with PKCE state stashed in session; /callback verifies state, completes the auth-code flow via Sso.Oidc.handle_callback, and mints a user session, branching HTML vs JSON response by Accept header.
whatBreaks: A missing/incorrect state check or session handling would allow CSRF-style auth bypass or broken SSO login for org accounts.

role: Serves the public OpenAPI 3.1 descriptor at /v1/openapi.json
description: Public, unauthenticated GET returning the OpenAPI spec JSON from Barkpark.Api.OpenApi with content-addressed weak ETag and 304 support, mirroring CapabilitiesController's pattern; used by SDK generators and external tooling.
whatBreaks: SDK generators or procurement tooling relying on this descriptor would get a stale/incorrect API contract or lose 304 caching efficiency.

role: Root redirect controller
description: Redirects bare / and /studio requests to the scoped Studio URL determined by StudioRedirectController, or to /login on failure.

role: Renders 'Used by' / 'Linked mentions' backlink sections on the Papers reader
description: Given Content.Graph.reverse_referencers/2 results, emits inline-styled HTML partitioned by valueref-kind (Used by) vs other (Linked mentions), splicing '' when empty; uses theme-aware CSS var fallbacks to avoid dark-mode invisibility bugs.

role: Renders the 'Driven tasks' section on the Papers reader (living-values reverse view)
description: Given Tasks.Expectations.driven_tasks/2 results, emits an HTML block showing each citing task's title, lifecycle status, criteria progress, and per-claim satisfied/unmet rows with evidence, splicing '' when no tasks cite the paper.

role: Admin-only REST controller for per-plugin settings (masked secrets)
description: show/update/delete plugin_settings gated by :require_admin; update reconciles submitted masked values against stored ones (Masking.restore) so a partial edit through a masked GET→PUT round trip doesn't corrupt untouched secrets.

role: GET /v1/plugins roster endpoint
description: Admin-only endpoint that returns the installed plugin roster (name/version/capabilities) sourced from the plugin Registry; gated by require_admin pipeline.
whatBreaks: bp plugin.ls and any admin tooling querying the plugin roster fail or return wrong data.

role: Public anonymous event-firing/read API for the Pulse plugin (Shared Storm)
description: Handles create/recent/stats/preflight on /v1/plugins/pulse/:channel, with no auth by design; enforces per-channel schema validation, per-IP token-bucket rate limits (write and read separately), and per-channel daily caps via Barkpark.RateLimiter, broadcasting new events over PubSub.

role: Core read controller for /v1/data/query (list/show/backlinks)
description: The primary document read path: perspective resolution, pagination, filter/order parsing (including scalar-string shorthand shared with CLI), field-visibility guards against filter/order oracle attacks, expand/resolve-tasks features, ETag/conditional-GET, and the canonical response envelope with syncTags. Extremely dense, security-critical (anon-pinned perspective, forbidden-field guards).

role: Authed GET endpoint exposing rolling request throughput/latency stats
description: Single show/2 action returning {req_per_s, p95_ms, window_s} from BarkparkWeb.RequestStats, on the require_token pipeline, used by the on-box agent's health beat; p95_ms is null (not 0) when no samples.
whatBreaks: The cloud-console agent's health beat would report wrong/fabricated latency metrics or fail its probe.

role: SAML 2.0 Service-Provider endpoints: SSO login and IdP-initiated logout
description: start/2 redirects to the org's IdP; acs/2 validates the signed SAMLResponse (SP- and IdP-initiated), JIT-provisions the user, and mints a session; slo/2 validates a signed IdP LogoutRequest, revokes named sessions, audits, and returns an auto-submit LogoutResponse.

role: Admin CRUD controller for document schema (type) definitions
description: index/show/upsert/delete for /v1/schemas — validates field defs via SchemaDefinition.parse at write time (rejecting reserved plugin: namespace for ad-hoc schemas) and guards delete against orphaning documents unless ?force=true.

role: SCIM 2.0 Groups endpoint controller (directory-sync role mapping)
description: Implements /scim/v2/Groups CRUD for enterprise directory sync; a SCIM group maps to a Barkpark role, and PATCH add/remove member operations grant/revoke that role in the org's workspaces. Org-scoped via RequireScimToken, all membership changes audited through Barkpark.Scim.
whatBreaks: IdP-driven group membership sync would silently fail to grant/revoke roles, leaving users over- or under-privileged in enterprise SSO orgs.

role: SCIM 2.0 Users endpoint controller (directory-sync provisioning/deprovisioning)
description: Implements /scim/v2/Users CRUD; POST provisions a confirmed user + org membership, DELETE or active:false PATCH/PUT immediately revokes all sessions and membership. Org-scoped via RequireScimToken, mutations audited via Barkpark.Scim.
whatBreaks: A broken deprovision path means an offboarded employee's account and sessions stay live after their IdP marks them inactive — a security incident.

role: Static, workspace/project-scoped read-only paper (Bulldocs) HTML renderer
description: Serves GET /w/:ws/p/:proj/papers/:slug by fetching a scoped paper doc and rendering cached ingest-time body_html plus backlinks/driven-tasks sections; currently noted as retired from routing in favor of BulldocsLive but kept self-consistent. Relies on RequireShareScope/ResolveWorkspace upstream for reachability.
whatBreaks: If re-routed, a scoped Papers reader would break or leak cross-tenant content; currently low blast radius since it's dead-routed.

role: HTML view module for scoped paper controller
description: Thin view module that embeds the show.html.heex template for ScopedPaperController, wrapping body_html in the bulldocs paper shell layout.
whatBreaks: Scoped paper show action crashes with a missing view/template error, breaking the /w/:ws/p/:proj/papers/:slug reader.

role: HEEx template rendering ScopedPaperController's paper body + backlinks/tasks
description: Wraps cached body_html plus server-rendered backlinks and driven-tasks sections inside the .bp-paper-shell container; mirrors BulldocsLive's markup for parity.
whatBreaks: Only affects the currently-dead-routed scoped paper controller's rendered markup.

role: Controller for document search, suggestions, synonyms, insights, reindex
description: Handles /v1/data/search (public, tenancy-scoped, anon-pinned to published) and /v1/data/search_local (loopback fast-path), plus search analytics endpoints (interaction/correction recording, insights, synonyms CRUD, settings) and Indx blue/green reindex enqueue. Renders results through Envelope.render_many_by_type for per-type field-visibility redaction.

role: Admin REST controller for cloud run-secrets (/v1/secrets)
description: Index/show/update/delete for run-secrets; unlike plugin settings, GET reveals the unmasked value and writes a 'reveal' audit row (the deliberate design point). Gated by :api + :require_admin pipeline, errors go through FallbackController's v1 envelope.
whatBreaks: Admins could be locked out of retrieving secrets needed for deploy/config, or worse, a broken auth guard could leak secret values to non-admins.

role: Admin controller triggering/status-polling the instance self-update runner
description: POST /v1/admin/self-update triggers Barkpark.SelfUpdate.Runner (fail-closed unless BARKPARK_SELF_UPDATE_APPLY=1), returns 409 if already running; GET returns runner + checker status for Barkpark Cloud's per-instance update badge. Never exposes the underlying command, only output lines.
whatBreaks: Self-hosted instances could fail to self-update or, if the disabled-by-default guard broke, could unexpectedly execute update commands.

role: Browser auth controller: token/password/magic-link/MFA sign-in
description: Handles /login, /login/account, /login/magic, /auth/reset, ticket-based one-click sign-in, and TOTP/MFA second-factor for the Studio browser surface. Mints user_session or api_token session cookies and shares complete_sign_in/3 logic across password and magic-link paths so both enforce the same MFA gate.

role: HEEx view module for auth pages: brand mark, flash, and theme CSS
description: Defines auth_brand, auth_flash, and auth_styles components shared across login/MFA/reset templates, including a machine-generated per-theme CSS block (design/tokens.json) that must not be hand-edited.
whatBreaks: Broken styling or missing brand/theme colors on every auth page (login, MFA, reset, magic-link) if this view module or its generated CSS block is wrong.

role: HEEx template for the passwordless magic-link request page
description: Renders the /login/magic form (email input) and a post-send 'check your email' confirmation state; shares the bp-auth card layout/components with other auth templates.
whatBreaks: Users could not request a magic sign-in link, breaking the passwordless login flow's entry point.

role: HEEx template for the two-step MFA verification page
description: Renders the /login/mfa form for a 6-digit authenticator code plus a recovery-code fallback via <details>; posts to /login/mfa with return_to preserved.
whatBreaks: MFA-enrolled users could not complete login, locking them out entirely since there'd be no way to submit the second factor.

role: Login page template (email/password, token, cloud SSO, magic link)
description: The actual /login HTML form markup: cloud login button, email/password form, collapsible API-token form, and a magic-link/reset link, plus a small inline JS password show/hide script.
whatBreaks: Studio's primary login page renders incorrectly or a sign-in path (token/password/cloud) becomes unusable if this template is wrong.

role: HEEx template for setting a new password from a reset token
description: Renders the password-reset-completion form at /auth/reset/:token with a client-side show/hide password toggle (inline <script>); enforces min length from Barkpark.Accounts.User.min_password_length().
whatBreaks: Users with a valid reset token would be unable to actually set a new password, stranding the reset flow.

role: HEEx template for requesting a password-reset email
description: Renders /login/reset form (email input) and the post-submit 'check your email' confirmation; same bp-auth card pattern as magic_request.html.heex.
whatBreaks: Users could not initiate password reset, forcing them to rely on other recovery paths or contact support.

role: Admin CRUD API for scoped-sharing registry (/v1/shares)
description: Backs `bp share ls/add/rm` and the Studio Shares panel: create/list/delete persistent shares and mint/list/revoke scoped share-edit tokens, validating through the same parser as BARKPARK_SHARES so a malformed request can't widen access.
whatBreaks: Wrong validation here could widen public data exposure (a bad share) or break the ability to grant/revoke external access via bp share/Studio Shares panel.

role: Public single-item share-link resolver and admin link management
description: GET /s/:token publicly serves one shared paper/doc/media item (scoped to the link's own workspace/project/dataset, published data only); paper links 302 to the canonical scoped reader URL. Admin endpoints under /v1/shares/links mint/list/revoke item share links.

role: OAuth social-login controller (Google/GitHub/Microsoft)
description: GET .../start redirects to the provider with session-stored CSRF state; GET .../callback verifies state, exchanges the code, and mints a user session (find-or-link by social identity/email) via Barkpark.Sso and Accounts.create_user_session_token.
whatBreaks: Social login would fail outright, or a broken state check could open a CSRF/account-takeover hole during OAuth callback.

role: Pre-login controller resolving an email domain to its org SSO start URL
description: Given an email, looks up whether its domain is a VERIFIED org domain via Barkpark.Sso.Domains and returns the OIDC start_url if so, else {sso:false}; unverified domains never route, keeping JIT SSO discovery safe.
whatBreaks: Enterprise users typing their email at login wouldn't be redirected to their IdP (broken SSO discovery), or worse, an unverified domain could be routed to an attacker-controlled org.

role: Public status page + JSON status API + admin incident endpoints
description: Serves /status (self-contained HTML), /status.json, and admin incident create/resolve routes; health data comes from Barkpark.Status (DB/migrations/plugin probes) and colors from Studio TokensGen.

role: GET /v1/structure/:dataset — serves the canonical desk tree JSON
description: Thin controller wrapping Barkpark.Structure.build/2, serializing the desk node tree (host groups + plugin contributions) consumed by both Studio and the Go TUI so both render the same navigation structure.
whatBreaks: The TUI and Studio desk navigation trees would diverge or fail to render plugin-contributed groups if this endpoint's serialization is wrong.

role: 302 funnel from flat /studio URLs to scoped /w/:ws/p/:proj/d/:ds URLs
description: Resolves the caller's workspace/project (via ScopeResolver, honoring Referer-based workspace stickiness) and redirects flat or legacy-scoped Studio URLs to the canonical scoped path, preserving path and query string. Always 302 (never cacheable) since target depends on token+Referer.

role: HTTP surface for the bp task CLI: claim/close/list/edges/graph/move
description: Large controller (12+ endpoints) implementing the entire task substrate API — ready/prime/index/claim/close/edges/labels/papers/move plus generic content graph traversal (graph_show/graph_tasks/graph_corpus/orphans/dangling) and rail-awareness notices (rail_rev, blocked_while_claimed, rail_changed). Backs all `bp task` CLI operations used throughout this very project's own workflow.

role: Param parsing/coercion/filter/render helpers for the Tasks HTTP controller
description: Pure-ish helper module extracted from TasksController: query filter delegation (tenancy-scoped via Scope.scope_to_workspace, fail-closed on nil), body coercion, render_doc/render_doc_with_counts shaping the bd-compatible bp-task-CLI JSON, criteria-close parsing, and batch edge-count queries to avoid N+1.

role: Admin controller for minting/rotating/pausing/revoking Tickets plugin keys
description: Operator-facing /v1/plugins/tickets/keys surface; mints a key with a one-time raw secret + quickstart handoff card, and manages rotate/pause/unpause/delete. Wraps Barkpark.Plugins.Tickets.Keys, with careful x-forwarded-proto/port handling for building correct public URLs behind Caddy.

role: Ticket-scoped attachment upload/download controller (outsider-media trust boundary)
description: Handles multipart upload and streamed retrieval of ticket attachments for both submitter (key-owned) and operator personas, enforcing MIME/size/count validation via Attachments and strict 404-not-403 ownership checks; sets defensive content-disposition/nosniff headers for untrusted uploads.

role: HTTP controller for the Tickets plugin (submitter + operator personas)
description: Implements create/list/show/reply for key-holding submitters and inbox/show/answer/close for token-authenticated operators over /v1/tickets; identity always derived from the credential (key name / token label), never the request body, and status transitions go through Thread.transition.

role: Admin-gated mint endpoint for read-only, workspace-bound API tokens
description: POST /w/:ws/p/:proj/v1/tokens mints a token restricted to a fixed read-only permission allowlist (public-read, read); rejects any write/admin/ops request with 422 before creation, used to bootstrap Next.js site tokens for non-Default workspaces.
whatBreaks: A privilege-escalation bug here could let a workspace admin mint write/admin tokens, or legitimate site provisioning could fail to get a working public-read token.

role: v1 API for media collections: CRUD, membership, and share links
description: Handles /v1/media/:dataset/collections index/show/assets/share/revoke_share/add_member/remove_member, delegating to Barkpark.Media.Storage.Collections and Share, with write-permission gating via require_write/1.

role: Core v1 media API: search, CRUD, upload, checkout, relations
description: Large controller covering media search (with intelligence recording, synonyms, insights, suggestions), index/show/relations, upload/update/delete, and checkout/undo_checkout locking; enforces write permission (including share-edit-token writers) and tenancy scoping throughout.

role: Webhook receiver for external media processor callbacks
description: Handles inbound status callbacks (transcode/AI-tagging) from external media processors, patching the mediaAsset document with processing status/metadata and firing CDN publish or failure events. Normalizes vendor-specific status vocab (complete/error/etc.) to internal ready/processing/failed.
whatBreaks: Media assets processed by external services would never flip to ready (or silently mismatch dataset), leaving uploads stuck in processing or breaking CDN publish.

role: WebAuthn/passkey HTTP controller (login, registration, step-up MFA)
description: Implements the full passkey ceremony (challenge/verify) for registration, usernameless login, and step-up MFA, delegating crypto to Barkpark.Accounts.Webauthn (wax); challenges are stateless Phoenix.Token-signed round-trips with no server-side store.
whatBreaks: Passkey login/registration/step-up MFA breaks account-wide, either locking users out or (if verification logic is wrong) allowing forged authentication.

role: CRUD + operational controller for tenant-configured webhook endpoints
description: Full webhook lifecycle API: list/show/create/update/delete, delivery history, event replay (with strict tenant-scope enforcement to prevent cross-tenant event exfiltration), secret rotation, and re-enable after auto-disable. Coded not-found envelopes distinguish real 404s from missing-capability routes.

role: Membership-scoped workspace/project/dataset list+create API for the web switcher
description: GET /api/workspaces (caller's memberships only), project/dataset listing, and workspace/project creation with owner-membership bootstrap. Enforces the tenant boundary entirely via Tenancy queries and membership checks, collapsing non-member/unknown-slug to 404 to avoid leaking existence.

role: Phoenix Endpoint — top-level HTTP/WS pipeline and socket registry
description: Defines all Phoenix sockets (LiveView, public /socket search channel, Pulse, Hyperquiz), static file serving, body parsing (with raw-body tee for GitHub webhook HMAC verification and oversized-payload handling), session cookie security, and mounts BarkparkWeb.Router. Central wire-seam for the entire web app.

role: API error envelope serializer (v1/v2)
description: Serializes validation outcomes into v1 (flat string list) or v2 (hierarchical JSON Pointer) error envelopes. Accepts validation_result maps, legacy per-field maps, or string lists; version is selected via Accept-Version header.
whatBreaks: All API validation errors are serialized incorrectly or crash, breaking client error handling across the TUI, CLI, and any HTTP consumer.

role: i18n backend module
description: Defines the BarkparkWeb.Gettext backend using the Gettext library. Boilerplate module enabling translation macros across the web layer.
whatBreaks: Translation macros fail to compile across the web layer, causing compile errors in any module using gettext/ngettext.

role: HTML layouts module — embeds layout templates and theme-attribute helper
description: Thin `use BarkparkWeb, :html` module that embeds all layouts/*.heex templates and exposes bp_theme_attr/1, which maps a workspace's resolved theme to the html data-bp-theme attribute (omitted for the default theme to preserve byte-identity).
whatBreaks: Any layout referencing bp_theme_attr would fail to compile, or a bug would mis-stamp/omit the theme attribute across every themed surface (Studio, papers, sheets).

role: app shell layout template
description: Minimal 6-line HEEx layout that wraps inner content in a `.app-shell` div with flash messages. Serves as the root layout container for the Studio LiveView.
whatBreaks: Studio UI fails to render or loses flash messaging across all LiveView pages.

role: Paper reader HTML layout (theme skin, Reader/TUI/Email view toggle chrome)
description: The root HEEx layout for the public Bulldocs paper reader: emits per-workspace-theme CSS token overrides layered over the shared paper-surface stylesheet, article chrome, print rules, and the Reader<->TUI(WASM pdrender)<->Email view-toggle UI including the terminal and mail-client chrome (only the head/style/toggle portion was inspected; file continues beyond 1025 lines with additional script logic).
whatBreaks: A CSS/token regression here would break paper rendering, dark-mode contrast, or the WASM TUI/email view toggles for every publicly-shared Barkpark paper.

role: Standalone HTML layout for the Hyperquiz player/host public pages
description: Self-contained (no Studio chrome) layout with the Kahoot-style 4-colour choice palette and LiveView JS bootstrapping for /quiz/* routes; game-surface colors are intentionally hardcoded pending a themed re-skin (filed as hq-w2-theme-reskin).
whatBreaks: Hyperquiz host/player pages fail to render or LiveSocket never connects, breaking the live quiz game entirely.

role: Root HTML layout for Studio/general Phoenix pages (not read — file too large)
description: Presumed to be the top-level HEEx layout wrapping Studio and other non-Bulldocs pages (head/meta/asset loading), analogous in role to bulldocs.html.heex but for the Studio surface; the file exceeded the 256KB read limit so its contents were not inspected in this pass.
whatBreaks: As the shared root layout it likely affects every Studio page's head/scripts/styles; an error would be a broad, highly visible regression, but this assessment is inferred from naming/convention, not direct inspection.

role: Root HTML layout for the public read-only Sheets reader (/sheets/:slug)
description: Parchment-themed reader chrome mirroring the papers reader aesthetic over a read-only subset of the Studio grid CSS (.sheet-* rules) — pager, tabs, filter funnel, find bar; LiveView JS loaded at body end for live cell deltas and tab switching. Explicitly documented as a cohesion mirror of Studio's grid CSS in root.html.heex requiring dual edits.
whatBreaks: The public sheet reader page would break visually or lose live-update/tab-switching behavior; drift from the Studio grid mirror causes inconsistent sheet rendering between edit and read surfaces.

role: Studio shell layout — topbar, nav, workspace/dataset switcher, presence
description: Wraps every Studio LiveView page in the shared chrome: self-update/env banners, topbar with workspace/dataset switcher, tabs, right-aligned action group (api-tester controls, share, theme toggle, sign-out, presence avatars), flash, and footer. Central navigation shell for the entire admin/editor surface.
whatBreaks: Every Studio page loses its top navigation, workspace switcher, or presence indicators, making the editor effectively unusable or mis-scoped across workspaces/projects.

role: Bare app layout for the styleguide theme-swatch iframe cells
description: Minimal pass-through layout (just @inner_content) used inside /studio/styleguide's showroom matrix; relies on the root layout's generated token CSS plus SwatchLive forcing data-bp-theme/data-theme attributes per cell.
whatBreaks: The theme swatch preview grid in the styleguide breaks or shows wrong colors; no production-facing impact.

role: Admin LiveView for editing a plugin's encrypted settings
description: Browser form (replacing SSH + mix run) for viewing/editing/testing a plugin's settings_schema fields, grouped into DB rows via Plugins.Settings, with careful secret handling (masked inputs, empty-means-keep-existing, explicit Reveal/Clear, audit-logged writes) and an optional Test Connection button driven generically via test_connection/1.
whatBreaks: A bug could leak a plugin secret into the rendered DOM, silently fail to persist a credential while flashing success, or make plugin configuration (e.g. Bokbasen/OnixEdit credentials) impossible via the UI.

role: Admin LiveView listing plugins + reloading schemas/seeders
description: Studio admin page at /w/:ws/p/:proj/d/:dataset/studio/_plugins listing every registered Barkpark.Plugin, which callbacks it overrides vs. defaults, last bootstrap/seed run status, and per-plugin or all-plugin in-process reload buttons (no restart needed). Uses reflection (apply/3 + classify by default-return-value) to distinguish default vs overridden callbacks.
whatBreaks: Admin loses visibility into plugin health/reload capability, but core plugin registry and data paths are unaffected — mostly a debugging/ops tool.

role: Public/scoped LiveView reader for Papers (Bulldocs plugin)
description: Core reader LiveView for /papers/:slug (and scoped /w/.../papers/:slug), rendering a paper document either via a block-backed Phoenix.LiveView stream (live per-block deltas with rev-gap refetch recovery) or legacy whole-HTML re-assign. Handles PubSub subscriptions scoped by workspace, preview/share metadata, goal-path rail with Mermaid gitGraph + diff modal, action buttons (create-plan/grill/build/submit), Simplify accept/reject flow, backlinks and driven-tasks sections, live task-block resolution, and theme identity — a large, heavily-documented convergence point for the entire Papers feature.
whatBreaks: The public Papers reader (a flagship, externally-linked surface) breaks — wrong tenant scoping could leak cross-workspace paper content or drop live updates entirely.

role: LiveView for the Hyperquiz host/projector big-screen surface
description: Mounts a room via Barkpark.Quiz, subscribes to room PubSub events, and renders the live question with animated per-choice tally bars; player_count is set authoritatively from roster broadcasts rather than accumulated deltas.
whatBreaks: The host/projector view of a live quiz shows stale or wrong tallies/player counts, or fails to update in real time.

role: Hyperquiz player-side LiveView at /quiz/play/:pin
description: Auto-joins a player into a quiz room over LiveView's WebSocket, renders the current question with live tally bars via PubSub `{:tally,_}` broadcasts, and leaves the room's roster on terminate/disconnect. Dead (HTTP) mount never joins the room, so a bare GET has no side effect.
whatBreaks: Quiz players couldn't join rooms, submit answers, or see live tallies, and disconnects would leak stale players into the roster count.

role: Public LiveView reader for published Sheets at /sheets/:slug
