description: Core LiveView mounted by the Sheets plugin's :public_root route bucket; resolves the PUBLISHED-only sheet doc (never peeking the live draft session to avoid leaking unpublished edits), hosts SheetGrid in read_only mode, and refreshes via published-doc PubSub topic on publish.
whatBreaks: Public sheet reader either breaks entirely or, worse, could leak draft/unpublished sheet content to anonymous visitors if the published-only guard is violated.

role: Studio pane: interactive API docs + request playground
description: Three-column LiveView (endpoint list / docs+form / response) that dispatches real authenticated HTTP requests server-side (Task-based, non-blocking) against the local API to let admins explore and test the v1 API contract; also renders static reference docs (envelope, error codes, known limitations, schema browser).
whatBreaks: The interactive API documentation/testing tool in Studio breaks or misfires requests; no impact on the actual API or other Studio panes.

role: Function components for the Studio API-tester's docs/playground/response panes
description: Renders the endpoint docs table, the interactive playground form (with generated curl command), and the response viewer (asserts, cleanup steps, headers, body) used by the parent ApiTesterLive shell.
whatBreaks: The Studio API-tester page would fail to render endpoint docs, the request-builder form, or response results.

role: Pure display formatters (icons/badges/body pretty-print) for the API tester
description: Small set of pure functions mapping endpoint metadata to icon names, auth badges, assertion tuples to readable strings, and response bodies to pretty JSON/text. No side effects.
whatBreaks: API tester UI would show wrong icons/badges or crash formatting an unrecognized assertion/response shape.

role: Pure request/curl-building and cleanup-runner logic for the API tester
description: Builds the shell-escaped curl string from an endpoint+form state via `Runner.build_request`, computes plugin-assert pass/fail status, and executes post-test cleanup HTTP steps (used by plugin-declared endpoint tests) via Req.
whatBreaks: Copy-as-curl would produce broken commands or plugin test cleanup steps (e.g. deleting test fixtures) would silently fail to run.

role: Studio's Claude-chat LiveView — admin agent chat UI orchestrator (5000+ lines)
description: The huge stateful LiveView backing `/studio/chat`: manages sessions, lazy CLI subprocess spawn, streaming message reconciliation, plan/bypass mode ceremonies, the agents mission-control rail, TodoWrite living checklist, and interrupt/approval flows. Delegates rendering of individual tool rows to ChatToolRenderer; persistence to StudioChat/Recorder.
whatBreaks: The entire in-Studio Claude chat feature (agent conversations, streaming, approvals, session history) would break or misrender — a large, complex, high-blast-radius surface even though it's UI-only (not core CRUD/API).

role: Renders Studio-chat tool-call rows as terminal-style diffs/cards
description: Classifies tool_use input maps by SHAPE (not name) into edit/write/multi_edit/generic and renders colored line diffs via `Barkpark.Papers.TextDiff`, plus TodoWrite checklist cards and sub-agent spawn rows with indentation. Pure rendering module shared by live view and replay.
whatBreaks: Tool-call output in Studio chat (file edits, todo lists, sub-agent spawns) would render incorrectly or as generic unlabeled rows, losing the terminal-parity UX.

role: Studio graph pane LiveComponent
description: LiveComponent that bridges server-side graph topology (nodes/edges/root from Content.Graph.traverse) to the Canvas2D client renderer via data-* attributes. Encodes JSON once in update/2 and emits a stable-id div with a GraphPane hook.
whatBreaks: The Studio graph pane fails to render or update, breaking the content-graph visualization feature in the Studio UI.

role: Studio Media tab hosting the native asset-explorer Web Component
description: Thin LiveView shell that mounts the dataset/scope-prefix into a phx-update="ignore" host div wrapping the <bp-asset-explorer> web component; actual upload/sync logic lives client-side and in the Media plugin.
whatBreaks: Studio's Media Library tab fails to render or misses its dataset/token context, but underlying media storage and upload endpoints are unaffected.

role: Organization admin portal LiveView (SSO/SCIM/members/audit) at /studio
description: Admin-gated page listing each organization's SSO (OIDC/SAML) status, SCIM token minting, member counts, org-wide MFA toggle, and recent audit log. Mounts, mints SCIM tokens, and toggles require_mfa via Tenancy/Scim contexts.
whatBreaks: Org admins couldn't view or manage enterprise SSO/SCIM/MFA settings or audit activity for their organization.

role: LiveComponent editing v2 composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText paper blocks
description: Nested LiveComponent (one per v2 composite field block) that renders type-specific inner field components (CompositeField, ArrayField, CodelistField incl. tree variant, LocalizedTextField), merges flat form params back into structured values via bracket/dot path parsing, and notifies the parent paper LiveView via a canonical {:paper_op, patch-block} message. Guards against a hostile large array index (@max_array_index) to prevent OOM.
whatBreaks: In-Studio editing of composite/array/codelist/localizedText paper fields breaks or corrupts nested values on save; a missing index guard could OOM the BEAM.

role: Dispatch adapter routing v2 schema field types to Studio field components
description: Sits in front of StudioLive's legacy v1 render_input/2 dispatch: detects v2 field types (composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText), converts raw schema-field maps into %SchemaDefinition.Field{} structs (mirroring private SchemaDefinition.parse_field/2 without Code.eval_*), resolves the owning plugin (for codelist registry scoping) via explicit field/schema hints or codelistId prefix, and dispatches to FieldComponents. v1 fields never enter this module (no-regression guarantee).
whatBreaks: Every v2 plugin field type (used by ONIX/Bokbasen and other plugin schemas) fails to render or edit correctly in Studio; legacy v1 schemas are unaffected by design.

role: Studio plugin field component adapter
description: Thin delegation layer that gives the Studio plugin adapter a single import surface for v2 field type components (composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText). Delegates to base implementations under BarkparkWeb.Components.Fields.*.
whatBreaks: Plugin field rendering in the Studio editor breaks for composite, array, codelist, and localized text field types.

role: Workspace Settings admin LiveView (theme, plugin enablement, credentials)
description: Scoped admin panel with three sections: workspace theme picker, per-workspace plugin enable/disable + Desk-Structure placement (via Plugins.Enablement + Tenancy.set_workspace_plugin_settings), and an encrypted-JSON plugin credential editor supporting both typed-form (from a plugin's settings_schema) and raw-JSON paths with masking/reveal-with-audit. Includes a fail-closed stale-scope write guard comparing rendered vs. live-bound workspace id.
whatBreaks: Admins could misconfigure or fail to configure workspace theme/plugins/credentials, or worse — a broken scope guard could write settings to the wrong workspace.

role: Studio spreadsheet-grid LiveComponent (editing + read-only rendering)
description: The full sheet editing surface (grid, formula bar, keyboard nav/selection, clipboard TSV/paste, row/col structure ops, merges, freeze panes, sort, fill, find, conditional format, per-user undo/redo, collaborator presence overlay) as one large facade LiveComponent delegating pure logic to sibling Geometry/GridData/Cells/Ops/Filter modules. All edits flow through Session.apply_ops (never direct assign mutation); read-only hosts (public reader) get every editing affordance and server-side mutation guard stripped for fail-closed safety. Extremely large, heavily documented, performance-tuned (presence overlay split from cell body for ~50x render cost reduction).
whatBreaks: The entire in-Studio spreadsheet editing experience (and its read-only public sheet rendering) breaks, corrupts cell data, or — if the read_only guard is wrong — could let an anonymous reader mutate published sheet content.

role: Pure cell-presentation helpers for the Studio sheet grid
description: Computes a cell's display string (fmt-aware, checkbox glyphs), formula-bar raw value, TSV clipboard value, CSS classes, and URL-link detection for the sheet grid's `<td>` rendering. No socket/side effects; extensively commented with ordering invariants (e.g. checkbox clauses must precede bool clauses).
whatBreaks: Sheet cells could display wrong values/formatting, break formula-bar round-tripping, or mis-render checkboxes/links across the Studio sheets editor.

role: Pure per-viewer row-filter predicate for the Studio sheet grid
description: Implements Excel/Sheets-style column filter criteria (blank/nonblank/gt/lt/eq/between/contains) as socket-local view-state only — never mutates the document. Delegates value-op matching to `CondFormat.matches?/2`, the single eval kernel shared with conditional formatting.
whatBreaks: Sheet 'Filter views' would hide/show wrong rows or (given its fail-open design) silently stop filtering, though it can never corrupt stored data since it's view-only.

role: Pure grid geometry math for the Studio sheet grid (selection/px/peer cursors)
description: Selection-rectangle math, A1 range parsing, Excel-style Ctrl+Arrow data-edge jump, peer cursor/selection overlay box computation, and frozen-band pixel offsets (left_px/top_px) used by the sheet grid template and Cells module.
whatBreaks: Sheet selection, keyboard navigation (arrow/Ctrl+Arrow jumps), frozen-pane alignment, and collaborator cursor overlays would misbehave or misalign across the Studio sheets editor.

role: Derives SheetGrid's rendered assigns (grid, pager, CF) from content
description: Pure/socket helper module computing the change-tracking-safe derived assigns for the Studio sheet grid: row/col bounds, filter-aware pagination, merged-cell spans, conditional-formatting style map, frozen row/col clamping. Everything the grid body renders from must be persisted on the socket here (never in render/1) or Phoenix's change tracking is defeated on every presence frame.
whatBreaks: Sheet grid mis-renders (wrong pagination, misaligned merged cells, stale CF, or a full-grid re-render storm on every presence tick) for every Studio sheet editor.

role: Commit/persistence + delta-remap plumbing for the Studio sheet grid
description: Routes every sheet edit through Sheets.Session.apply_ops (no direct assign mutation), applies incoming session deltas/refetches with epoch/rev handling, remaps selection/editing/filters across remote structural ops (row/col insert/delete, tab reorder, sort), and pushes presence updates. Central to multi-user sheet collaboration correctness.
whatBreaks: Concurrent sheet edits diverge across clients, edits land on wrong cells/tabs after a remote structural op, or read-only hosts leak mutations.

role: Multi-pane Studio LiveView shell — top-level router/dispatcher
description: The central Studio LiveView: mount/handle_params/render plus dozens of thin handle_event/handle_info routing heads delegating to per-domain Handlers modules (Scope, Fields, Media, Refs, History, Delete, Discard, Doc, Shares, ItemShare, Schema, Secondary, Bulk, Paper, Airdrop, AccessPanel). Also owns airdrop-grant live-expiry/revoke handling (rebuilding caller_context + caps + re-running desk admission) and a load-bearing server-side Caps deny-gate reattached on every socket. This is the single entry point for nearly all Studio interactivity.
whatBreaks: The entire Studio multi-pane editing UI (structure/type/documents/editor, papers, sheets, media, settings, sharing, access grants) becomes unusable or, if the caps/admission gates are wrong, could expose or deny access incorrectly across all of Studio.

role: Pure PortableDoc block-patch builders + default-block catalog
description: Stateless helpers used by StudioLive's paper/beta block editor: builds patch maps from submitted form params per block type, defines default_block/2 for every insertable block type (mirroring Render.compose_block/1,2), MVP inline<->text converters, and block-id lookup/generation. No socket, no side effects.
whatBreaks: Adding/editing a block in Studio's paper/beta editor produces a shape Render.compose_block doesn't understand, silently corrupting or failing to render that block for readers.

role: Studio's function components: paper view, doc sidebar, full shell
description: Large HEEx function-component module: studio_paper_view/1 (in-Studio live paper rendering, View/Edit toggle, canvas gating), paper_metadata_sidebar/1 (WordPress-style Publish/Slug/Context/Labels/Relations panel), and studio_live_shell/1 (the entire multi-pane Studio render/1 template — panes, editor dispatch by view type, every modal). Imports Components.PaperEditor for the Beta block-editor cluster.
whatBreaks: The whole Studio UI (pane layout, paper viewing, doc editor dispatch, delete/unpublish/valueref/share modals) fails to render or loses functionality — a near-total Studio outage.

role: Beta paper/block editor components: canvas runs, properties panel, per-type fields
description: The Beta block-editor function-component cluster (editor_mode_toggle, paper_block_editor, properties_panel, paper_block_fields, canvas_run, ghost_slots_group) split out of Components to stay under the token budget. Drives the continuous-canvas partitioning of prose runs vs non-prose boundary blocks, per-block-type edit forms/pickers, live task-block previews, and doctrine ghost slots.
whatBreaks: Editing any paper block type in Studio (rich text, callout, code, field-*, composite, image) breaks or corrupts saved content; the always-on canvas editor could fail to mount entirely.

role: Editor-header doc-actions registry (baseline + plugin resolver dispatch)
description: Builds the host's built-in editor-header action list (History, Delete, Publish/Unpublish, Diff, Duplicate, Open another, View blast radius) as :baseline for Plugins.Registry.collect_doc_actions/1, and dispatches schema-declared plugin actions (e.g. OnixEdit export) through collect_action_handlers/1 with proper scope/ctx.
whatBreaks: Editor-header buttons (publish, delete, plugin actions like Export ONIX) disappear or dispatch to the wrong handler across all document types in Studio.

role: Studio Access panel handler: view/revoke scoped-access grants
description: Handles opening/closing the Access panel and revoking a workspace grant, reusing Access.list_active_grants_for_grantee/list_grants_for_workspace with a membership-read gate mirroring AccessController.index. Revoke defers real authorization to Access.revoke/2 (grantor-or-admin), never trusting the UI gate.
whatBreaks: Users can't view/revoke their scoped access grants in Studio, or (if the gate is loosened) an unauthorized viewer could see workspace grant details.

role: Studio Share-access sheet: mint + deliver a scoped grant link
description: Grantor-facing flow to mint a time-boxed, capability-scoped access grant via Access.mint/2 (in-process, same no-escalation gate as CLI/API), narrowed by held capabilities, with email typeahead and delivery (email + best-effort live PubSub toast). Raw token is dropped from assigns after mint.
whatBreaks: Share-access links fail to mint/deliver, or (if the held-cap filter regresses) the UI could offer capabilities the grantor doesn't hold — though mint/2 still re-checks server-side.

role: Studio list-pane multi-select + bulk publish/unpublish handler
description: Small handler module: toggles doc checkboxes with a 500-item selection cap, clears selection, and delegates bulk publish/unpublish to Shared.bulk_action/2.
whatBreaks: Bulk publish/unpublish and multi-select checkboxes in Studio's pane list stop working or allow unbounded selection.

role: Studio delete-with-reference-check handler
description: Opens the delete confirmation modal after computing inbound references via the arrayOf-aware Content.Graph.reverse_referencers/2 (not the scalar-only finder, to avoid undercounting), optionally disconnects references, then calls Content.delete_document/4 and navigates away or surfaces an error/halt flash.
whatBreaks: Deleting a document in Studio could silently strand dangling references, undercount affected docs in the warning modal, or misreport failure as success.

role: StudioLive handler: discard-draft flow
description: Handles open/close/confirm for discarding a draft back to its last published state, calling Content.discard_draft and navigating to the published doc on success. Small, behaviour-preserving extraction from the monolithic StudioLive module.
whatBreaks: Discarding a draft in Studio would fail silently or corrupt the nav path, leaving editors unable to revert unwanted draft edits.

role: StudioLive handler: publish/unpublish/duplicate document
description: Implements publish (with validation), unpublish (with a reverse-reference blast-radius guard and modal), and duplicate-document flows for the Studio editor, delegating persistence to Barkpark.Content and Content.Graph.
whatBreaks: Publishing could bypass validation or unpublishing could silently break other documents' references (no blast-radius warning), corrupting content integrity across the dataset.

role: StudioLive handler: doc create/save/autosave + array field ops
description: Handles new-document creation (via collision-safe Content.create_document), save/autosave with dirty-flag tracking for concurrent-edit conflict detection, slug generation, mode toggles, and ArrayField add/remove/move operations.
whatBreaks: Autosave/dirty-flag logic underlies concurrent-edit safety across all of Studio; a bug here risks silent data loss or clobbering another editor's changes.

role: StudioLive handler: revision history panel + user profile edit
description: Lists/restores document revisions via Content.list_revisions/restore_revision, and manages the editor's user-profile popover (name/color) including presence broadcast on save.
whatBreaks: Editors could lose the ability to view or roll back document history, or profile identity (name/color used in presence) could stop syncing.

role: StudioLive handler: per-item share-link popover + jump-to-user
description: Admin-gated (Caps.admin?) open/close/create/revoke for per-document share links via Barkpark.Sharing.Links, plus jump_to_user to navigate the pane tree to a given doc.
whatBreaks: Share-link creation/revocation could bypass the admin gate or fail, exposing or breaking access-controlled sharing of individual documents.

role: StudioLive handle_info bodies + handle_params finish
description: Central dispatch for PubSub-driven events (doc_updated, paper_block, paper_updated, sheets_op/persisted, presence_diff, document_changed) plus finish_handle_params which sets up subscriptions, panes, and presence on navigation; encodes the self()-sender guards and dirty-flag conflict-banner logic used throughout Studio's realtime sync.
whatBreaks: Realtime multi-user editing in Studio would break: remote updates could clobber local unsaved edits, or self-echoes could cause redundant reloads/test flakiness (sandbox 'client exited' errors).

role: StudioLive handler: image field picker/select/upload
description: Handles opening the media picker (filtered to image/*), selecting/clearing an image field, and uploading via Media.upload, autosaving the form after each change.
whatBreaks: Image fields in the Studio editor would fail to pick, clear, or upload media, breaking any content type using image fields.

role: StudioLive handler: in-Studio Paper (Bulldocs) block editor events
description: Largest handler module (645 lines, ~25 public functions): edit-mode toggle, block-level autosave/patch, callout fold state, sidebar toggles, backlinks, task-preview refresh, valueref inspect/writeback, block add/delete/move/materialize-slot, slash-insert, wikilink/tag search — every editing action funnels through Shared.paper_op/2 to a single DocPatchOp.
whatBreaks: The entire in-Studio Papers (Bulldocs) block-editing experience — adding, moving, deleting, and autosaving blocks — would break or corrupt paper content, since nearly all paper edit paths route through this module.

role: StudioLive handler: reference field picker
description: Handles opening a reference-field picker (listing candidate docs of a given type via Content.list_documents), search filtering, select, and clear, autosaving the form after selection.
whatBreaks: Reference fields (doc-to-doc links) in the Studio editor would be unable to be set or cleared, breaking any schema relying on reference fields.

role: StudioLive handler: schema-declared modal actions + confirm-modal dry-run/real
description: Dispatches schema-declared document actions (modal kind) through DocActions, supporting a two-stage dry-run-then-real confirm flow with error/success flash and pane rebuild.
whatBreaks: Schema-declared custom actions (e.g. bulk ops triggered from Studio) would fail to preview or execute, or could execute without the intended dry-run safety check.

role: StudioLive handler module for pane/workspace/project/dataset scope switching
description: Handles pane selection, desk/group nav, workspace/project/dataset switching, and switcher create-affordances for the Studio LiveView. Delegates path/scope math to Shared and Tenancy; behaviour-preserving extraction from the original StudioLive god-module.
whatBreaks: Studio users could not switch workspaces/projects/datasets or navigate panes, breaking core Studio tenancy navigation.

role: StudioLive handler for the read-only split-view secondary editor pane
description: Opens/closes the secondary document picker, searches candidates, selects a secondary doc to view, and opens the blast-radius graph pane. A moderate-scope feature handler, not core to Studio mount.
whatBreaks: Split-view secondary pane and graph-open affordance would fail or show wrong documents; core editing still works.

role: StudioLive handler for the admin-only network shares panel
description: Open/close/add/remove scoped shares, re-checking admin capability server-side on every mutate (defense against forged events even if the UI button is hidden). Writes through Barkpark.Sharing, the same registry the admin API and bp CLI use.
whatBreaks: Either shares panel breaks for admins, or worse, a missing admin re-check could let non-admins mutate sharing scopes — a security-relevant handler.

role: StudioLive mount/init — seeds the entire initial socket assign set
description: init/1 reads user identity from connect params, seeds ~60 assigns covering every Studio subsystem (graph, shares, airdrop grants, sheets, papers, editor modes, validation, presence), opens the paper_blocks stream, and allows image upload. Also owns shares_admin?/1, the single-sourced shares-panel auth gate.
whatBreaks: Any missing/wrong assign here crashes or silently breaks the entire Studio LiveView on mount — this is the seed for nearly every Studio feature's state.

role: Feature flag + block-run partitioning logic for the always-editable paper canvas
description: Defines paper_canvas_enabled?/0 (default-on opt-out flag) and partition_runs/1, which groups an ordered block list into maximal contiguous canvas-eligible runs vs boundary blocks, plus sidebar metadata helpers (slug validation, labels, relations). Must stay in lockstep with the JS run-convert.js block-type sets; heavily commented with the type taxonomy driving the whole canvas editor.

role: Pure path-string parser/descent for nested arrayOf/composite form editing
description: Parses phx-value-path strings (doc[a][b].c[d] grammar) into key lists, walks schema fields to resolve nested types, and provides hand-rolled get/put helpers for the editor form data. Socket-free, unit-testable, guards against a known data-corruption bug (barkpark-i2d4) from dropping array indices.
whatBreaks: Editing nested arrayOf/composite fields in Studio forms could corrupt or silently drop data on reorder/edit operations.

role: Single owner of the Studio URL/path-building grammar
description: Socket-free builders for every Studio URL shape: dataset-scoped studio paths, scoped/flat roots, paper reader URLs, desk-chip hrefs, and plugin link href canonicalization. Shared.studio_path/4 is a thin socket-aware wrapper delegating here.

role: Socket-coupled shared helper module used across all StudioLive handlers
description: Large grab-bag of state-coupled helpers (subscriptions, presence, autosave, bulk publish/unpublish, pane rebuilding, tenancy scope resolution, paper-op delegation to Shared.Paper) extracted from the original StudioLive god-module. Central choke point most handler modules depend on.

role: Paper-editing engine: block ops, canvas sync, stream/delta application for Studio
description: Applies block ops/batches to papers, pushes canvas echoes and fleet/figure server-painted HTML, resolves live task-block previews, manages the :paper_blocks stream and delta application, and loads backlinks. This is the operational core of the in-Studio paper (Bulldocs) editing and canvas feature.
whatBreaks: Paper editing in Studio (the flagship canvas editor) could corrupt block data, desync the canvas from the server, or crash live collaborative editing.

role: Admin-only living style guide LiveView for Studio's design tokens
description: Renders every token (palette, status, chrome, type ladder, lifecycle glyphs, mail-chrome skins) live from generated sources (TokensGen, root.html.heex token block) with a light/dark theme toggle and a per-registered-theme showroom grid. Admin-gated via live_session :admin_studio.
whatBreaks: Only the internal design-token reference page breaks; no impact on core Studio functionality, though it would mask real token drift.

role: Admin theme-swatch preview cell rendered inside StyleguideLive's iframe matrix
description: Renders one theme×mode cell of the styleguide showroom, forcing data-bp-theme/data-theme on its own document root so real shipped CSS vars paint every chrome/status/reader/callout role plus the generated email-skin hex row. Admin-gated via its own live_session and the bare :swatch layout.
whatBreaks: The theme showroom matrix in Studio mis-renders or crashes for specific theme/mode cells, but no production data path is affected.

role: Studio LiveView hosting a real host PTY via xterm.js over the LiveView channel
description: Mounts at /studio/tmux, gated by TmuxConsole.enabled? and admin on_mount; spawns a lazily-created tmux PTY on first term-init, relays keystrokes/output as base64 term-input/term-out events, and preserves the tmux session across LiveView reconnects (terminate only kills the client, not the session).
whatBreaks: A bug here could let unintended input reach the host shell or break the admin console (persistence, resize, PTY lifecycle) — high blast radius for an admin feature that executes real commands on the host.

role: LiveView on_mount auth hooks (admin/ops/token/user session)
description: Defines on_mount hooks that gate LiveViews by permission (:admin, :ops), resolve API tokens from session (with dev fallback), and resolve the account/user session for Studio.
whatBreaks: Incorrect authorization logic could expose admin/ops-only Studio surfaces to unauthenticated users, or lock out legitimate operators.

role: LiveView scope resolver + re-auth for the URL-scoped Studio
description: on_mount(:resolve) and a handle_params hook resolve workspace/project from URL params on every live navigation, authorize read (member/anonymous-default/share/grant), and attach deny-by-default readonly or write-narrowing event gates for share/grant sockets. This is the socket-side twin of the ResolveWorkspace conn plug and the sole cross-tenant check during live_patch navigation.
whatBreaks: A bug here lets an authenticated socket patch into another tenant's workspace/project or lets a read-only/grant-scoped viewer perform writes outside their scope.

role: Shared query-param binary coercion helper (bin/1) for controllers
description: Collapses any non-binary query-param shape (list/map/etc from Plug.Conn.Query) to nil so downstream String/Ecto calls don't crash with FunctionClauseError/CastError; single owner replacing per-controller duplicate defp bin/1 implementations.
whatBreaks: Malformed query params (e.g. ?q[]=a) could 500 controllers instead of degrading to the missing-param path across every controller importing bin/1.

role: HTTP-to-LiveView scope bridge for plugin scoped LiveViews
description: Bridges the resolved workspace/project tenant scope across the HTTP→WebSocket boundary by serializing ids+slugs into the LiveView session cookie on dead-render and restoring them as socket assigns on mount.
whatBreaks: Scoped plugin LiveViews (Studio, admin) run unscoped, bypassing tenant isolation and potentially leaking or mixing cross-workspace data.

role: Plug normalizing vendor/SSE Accept headers for :accepts matcher
description: Rewrites Accept headers containing the vnd.barkpark+json vendor type or text/event-stream by appending application/json so Plug's :accepts pipeline step doesn't 406 them; also sets barkpark_filterresponse and barkpark_vendor_accept assigns.
whatBreaks: SDK vendor-media-type requests or SSE listen clients would get 406 responses instead of reaching their controllers.

role: Plug adding baseline security headers (nosniff, referrer-policy) to :api pipeline responses
description: Runs via register_before_send on every JSON API response, adding x-content-type-options and referrer-policy headers only if not already present so a controller/CORS plug can override; deliberately omits CSP/X-Frame-Options/HSTS which don't apply to JSON API.
whatBreaks: Every /v1/* JSON response would silently lose baseline security headers, a minor but repo-wide security regression.

role: Back-compat plug assigning default workspace/project for flat routes
description: Assigns the seeded Default Workspace and Default Project to conn assigns for legacy flat routes that lack workspace/project slugs in their path, only when not already set by a resolver.
whatBreaks: Flat v1 API routes lose their default tenant scope, causing unscoped queries or nil-reference errors in downstream handlers.

role: Flat-route (/v1/data) companion plug admitting airdrop-grant scoped read access
description: Runs after AssignDefaultScope and ResolveTokenOwner; for a non-member owned-token user with an active grant covering the Default workspace, assigns a grant-bearing CallerContext + :grant_scoped_read flag so Content.Scope.scope_to_grants narrows reads; a fail-closed no-op for members/unowned tokens/no-covering-grant, mounted ONLY on flat read routes to avoid downgrading write/admin callers.
whatBreaks: A grantee could read the whole Default workspace instead of their narrow grant scope (data leak), or a legitimate grantee could be denied reads entirely.

role: Plug.Parsers body_reader that tees raw bytes for the GitHub webhook path only
description: Replaces Plug.Conn.read_body/2 as the endpoint's body_reader, accumulating raw chunks into conn.assigns[:raw_body] ONLY when request_path matches the GitHub webhook path, so GithubWebhookSignature can verify the exact signed bytes; every other request path is an unbuffered pass-through.
whatBreaks: GitHub webhook HMAC verification would fail (raw bytes lost to the JSON parser) or, if scoping breaks, every request body would be double-buffered in memory.

role: Endpoint-level per-dataset CORS reflection plug
description: Runs before routing to handle CORS preflight and reflect access-control-allow-origin only for origins matched against a dataset's cors_origins allow-list (project-aware via /w/:ws/p/:project prefix) plus always-allowed prod origins; fails closed (no wildcard) and lets plugin-owned routes (/v1/plugins/*) pass through untouched for their own CORS handling.
whatBreaks: A bad match either blocks legitimate SDK/Studio browser requests cross-origin, or reflects an untrusted origin and leaks credentialed dataset content.

role: Error envelope version negotiation plug
description: Reads the Accept-Version request header and sets conn.assigns.error_envelope_version to :v1 (default) or :v2. Enables gradual migration of API error response format without breaking existing clients.
whatBreaks: API error responses return the wrong envelope format version, breaking clients that depend on v2 error structure or preventing v1 clients from parsing errors correctly.

role: Fail-closed HMAC gate authenticating inbound GitHub webhook deliveries
description: The sole auth on the :github_webhook pipeline; verifies X-Hub-Signature-256 against the raw body (teed by CacheBodyReader) and a cached webhook secret via constant-time Signature.verify, halting 401 on any failure including missing raw body or unprovisioned secret.
whatBreaks: Either GitHub webhook deliveries are all rejected (integration silently breaks) or, worse, forged webhook payloads are accepted and trusted.

role: Idempotency-Key dedup plug for mutating API requests
description: Intercepts mutating HTTP requests carrying an Idempotency-Key header, replays cached responses for duplicate keys (keyed on raw_key+token+method+path), and stores first-time non-5xx responses before send.
whatBreaks: Duplicate mutating API requests are not deduplicated, causing double-writes, duplicate documents, or inconsistent state for clients relying on idempotency guarantees.

role: HTTP plug adding deprecation headers to legacy routes
description: A tiny Plug that injects Deprecation, Sunset, and Link response headers onto legacy /api/* routes, signalling clients to migrate to /v1/data/query.
whatBreaks: Clients hitting legacy routes get no deprecation signal and may never migrate.

role: Soft-auth plug resolving Bearer or session cookie into api_token
description: Cookie-aware sibling of OptionalToken for the :scoped_browser pipeline: assigns api_token from Authorization Bearer header, session api_token, or (dev-only) a configured dev_browser_token, and resolves current_user from user_session; never halts, so downstream ResolveWorkspace enforces the actual gate.
whatBreaks: A signed-in browser member could get 403'd on every scoped Studio route, or the dev fallback could leak into prod and grant anonymous access.

role: Soft auth plug for optional Bearer token verification
description: Attempts to verify an Authorization Bearer token and assigns :api_token if valid; never halts, allowing anonymous requests to pass through for endpoints that serve both authenticated and unauthenticated callers.
whatBreaks: Authenticated context is lost on routes using this plug, causing permission checks downstream to treat valid token holders as anonymous.

role: Soft user-session resolver plug — sets :current_user without 401ing on absence
description: Mirrors RequireUserSession's bearer/cookie credential handling (including CSRF enforcement on mutating cookie requests) but never halts when no credential is present, letting a downstream ResolveTokenOwner supply the principal instead; used on routes like /v1/access/claim.
whatBreaks: A CSRF check regression here could allow cross-site mutation via cookie sessions, or an auth bug could leave routes without any resolved principal, breaking grant-claim flows.

role: Plug verifying short-lived preview JWT for draft preview reads
description: Extracts a Preview-scheme bearer or ?preview_token= JWT, verifies it via Barkpark.PreviewToken, checks the token's dataset claim matches the requested dataset (anti cross-dataset draft leak), records the JTI to prevent replay, and forces perspective to drafts; denies with envelope JSON on any failure.
whatBreaks: A broken dataset-scope check would let a preview token minted for one dataset read draft content from any other dataset in the workspace.

role: CORS plug scoped exclusively to the :public_api plugin route bucket
description: Sets permissive Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and related headers only on the anonymous public_api bucket (deliberately not on the core API, which serves no CORS), and terminates OPTIONS preflights with 204 before the controller runs.
whatBreaks: If misapplied more broadly it could open credentialed core API routes to cross-origin browser access (auth bypass surface); if broken on its bucket, plugin browser integrations fail preflight.

role: Public-read token enforcement plug
description: Deny-by-default enforcement for tokens with only the 'public-read' permission: allows GET query/doc routes on published perspective for public-visibility schemas only; halts with 403/404 on everything else.
whatBreaks: Public-read tokens can access private schemas or mutation endpoints, breaking the API's tenant isolation and data visibility contract.

role: Tunnel host-gate security plug for public sharing mode
description: When BARKPARK_SHARE_HOST is configured, restricts tunnel-facing traffic to an explicit allow-list of read/share paths (GET/HEAD only), returning 404 for everything else including Studio, admin, write APIs, and token-less media endpoints.
whatBreaks: In tunnel/sharing mode, write APIs, Studio, and admin surfaces become publicly accessible over the tunnel URL, exposing the entire application to the internet.

role: per-token token-bucket rate limiting plug
description: Implements method-class and dataset-aware rate limiting using separate read/write token buckets, keyed by hashed API token or client IP. Halts with 429 and Retry-After on exhaustion.
whatBreaks: API abuse goes unthrottled, or legitimate traffic is incorrectly rate-limited, breaking all API callers.

role: Admin permission gate plug
description: Halts the conn with 403 unless the caller's token has the 'admin' permission. Must run after RequireToken so api_token is already assigned.
whatBreaks: Non-admin tokens gain access to admin-only endpoints, breaking access control for schema management and other privileged operations.

role: dual-mode auth plug for media upload routes
description: Accepts authentication from either a Bearer token or a session cookie, with a CSRF header guard on the cookie branch. Used by media upload/delete so Studio browser sessions work without a token.
whatBreaks: Media upload/delete routes become either unauthenticated (security hole) or broken for browser sessions.

role: Plug authenticating the paper-ingest POST endpoint
description: Accepts either a constant-time match against the effective (DB-first, env-fallback) ingest shared secret, or a valid admin api_token; rejects with 401 JSON otherwise. Guards Barkpark's Bulldocs/paper ingest surface.
whatBreaks: A timing leak or logic slip could let an unauthenticated caller ingest arbitrary papers, or legitimate ingest pipelines could be locked out.

role: Plug restricting a route to loopback-only callers (127.0.0.0/8, ::1)
description: Used by the Barkpark Cloud localhost fast-path search endpoint so it is only reachable from co-located processes on the same box; halts non-loopback callers with a bare 403 to avoid revealing the surface exists.
whatBreaks: A broken loopback check would expose the lean fast-path search endpoint to the open internet, bypassing its intended host-local isolation.

role: media callback auth plug
description: Validates a Bearer token on external media-processing callback routes using constant-time compare against the configured media_processing_callback_token. Rejects with 401 on failure.
whatBreaks: Media processing callbacks either become unauthenticated or stop working entirely, breaking async media transcoding/processing flows.

role: Plug enforcing org-wide MFA enrolment on session routes
description: After RequireUserSession, 403s any request from a user in an org with require_mfa=true who has no MFA factor enrolled, except a small exempt allowlist (me/logout/enroll/verify/webauthn). Fails closed if current_user is absent, emits audit events on halt.
whatBreaks: A bug here could either lock out compliant users org-wide or silently let unenrolled users past an org's MFA requirement, a security-policy break.

role: Terminal 401 gate requiring a resolved user identity on grantee routes
description: Simple guard plug used on the access-claim/mine pipeline: passes only if :current_user is a %User{} (set by session or owned-token resolution upstream), otherwise 401s. Very small, single pattern-match dispatch.
whatBreaks: Wrong pattern match could let unauthenticated callers claim/read access grants, or block all legitimate owned-token callers from the claim/mine surface.

role: Step-up MFA gate requiring a fresh factor for sensitive user actions
description: Runs after RequireUserSession; if the user has MFA enrolled but their session's step-up freshness has expired, halts with 401 mfa_required and logs an audit challenge event. Users without MFA enrolled pass through untouched (opt-in).
whatBreaks: A logic error could bypass step-up verification for sensitive actions (security hole) or block all MFA-enrolled users from ever completing step-up-gated actions.

role: SCIM bearer-token auth plug scoping requests to one Organization
description: Parses `Authorization: Bearer` and resolves it via Barkpark.Scim.resolve_org/1, assigning :scim_org on success or returning a SCIM-shaped 401 error envelope on failure. Small, single-purpose gate for the whole SCIM provisioning surface.
whatBreaks: A broken resolve/assign would break all SCIM identity-provisioning integrations (user/group sync from IdPs), or could leak cross-org access if org scoping is mis-resolved.

role: Plug granting scoped anonymous WRITE via a share-edit token
description: Write counterpart to RequireShareScope: grants scoped write access only when a presented token carries the opaque "share-edit-<surface>" permission, its share_scope matches the request's ws/proj/dataset, and the live Sharing registry still has that scope :edit-shared; on grant it bypasses ResolveWorkspace's membership gate and satisfies RequireWritePermission via share_writer=true. Never halts; falls through to normal membership auth otherwise.
whatBreaks: A loosened scope/permission check could let a share-edit token write outside its granted scope or into an unrelated workspace, an unintended global write escalation.

role: public-share grant plug (default-off)
description: Gates anonymous access to shared scopes by verifying the (workspace, project, dataset, surface) tuple against the Sharing registry, with method-aware read/edit access levels and item-token support. Sets :share_public assign to bypass ResolveWorkspace membership gate.
whatBreaks: Public share links either stop working (blocking all anonymous readers) or grant access to non-shared scopes (security breach).

role: Auth gate for the low-trust Tickets submitter ticket-key tier
description: Resolves a Bearer key via Barkpark.Plugins.Tickets.Keys.verify/1 (distinct from the normal token verifier which rejects ticket keys), assigns :ticket_key on success, touches last_used_at, and returns a byte-identical 401 to a generic unauthorized token except for the distinguishable 403 'paused' case.
whatBreaks: Ticket submitters (external, low-trust) could be locked out entirely, or worse, an auth bypass could let unverified callers open tickets/attachments on the public-facing Tickets surface.

role: Base Bearer-token auth plug assigning :api_token
description: Verifies the Authorization Bearer header via Barkpark.Auth.verify_token/1, touches last-used timestamp, and assigns api_token; on failure returns a 401 error envelope and halts. Baseline auth for API routes.
whatBreaks: Any bug here either locks every authenticated API request out (total outage) or lets a bad/expired token through, breaking the entire API's auth boundary.

role: Core plug gating routes on a valid user login session
description: Accepts a session via Authorization bearer or signed user_session cookie, verifies via Accounts.verify_user_session/1, assigns :current_user/:current_user_session/:caller_context, and enforces CSRF (x-requested-with) on mutating cookie-based requests. Widely relied upon as the base auth gate for authenticated user routes.
whatBreaks: Any user-authenticated route (most of the app's session-based surface) would either reject all legitimate logged-in users or, worse, let unauthenticated/CSRF requests through as if authenticated.

role: workspace admin role gate
description: Enforces that the calling token holds owner/admin membership role in the resolved workspace before allowing scoped admin operations like schema upsert and webhook CRUD. Fails closed with 403 if either assign is missing.
whatBreaks: Workspace admin operations (schema management, webhooks, synonyms) become accessible to any workspace member regardless of role, or completely inaccessible if the check is broken.

role: Write permission gate plug
description: Halts with 403 unless the token has 'write' or 'admin' permission, or the request is a validated share-edit token. Guards all mutation routes before they reach the controller.
whatBreaks: Read-only tokens can submit mutations, bypassing the write access control layer and allowing unauthorized document modifications.

role: project resolution plug
description: Resolves the :project_slug path param into conn.assigns[:current_project] scoped to the already-resolved workspace, returning 404 if the project doesn't exist or belongs to a different workspace.
whatBreaks: All project-scoped routes either fail to resolve projects (404 on all requests) or allow cross-workspace project access (data isolation breach).

role: Non-halting plug mapping an owned api_token to a user identity
description: On the claim/mine pipeline only, if no session user is already assigned, loads the owner user of an api_token with a non-nil owner_user_id and assigns :current_user; otherwise no-ops. Deliberately never wired on grantor routes so token principals there stay tokens.
whatBreaks: If mistakenly wired onto grantor routes or if precedence logic breaks, a token's owner identity could override or leak into contexts that must stay token-principal, or claim/mine could stop recognizing valid owned tokens.

role: Router-layer plug enforcing the hard tenant workspace boundary
description: Resolves :workspace_slug into current_workspace, then authorizes via Tenancy.Auth (membership token or user), with special-cased pass-throughs for share_public, anonymous-Default demo allowance (flag-gated per pipeline), and airdrop-grants non-member admission with row-narrowing context; halts 404/403 or redirects to /login otherwise.
whatBreaks: A logic error here is the single largest cross-tenant leak surface: it could expose one workspace's private documents to another tenant or to anonymous callers across the whole scoped API/Studio.

role: Shared tenancy-scope extractor for conn/socket assigns
description: Turns `current_workspace`/`current_project` assigns into the `[workspace_id:, project_id:]` opts every Content/Media query and write path expects, with nil-safe fallback to unscoped. Carries memoize:true only for request-scoped conns (never LV/channel sockets) to avoid pinning a deleted dataset_id; also threads caller_context and grant-scoped-read flags.

role: Per-key token-bucket rate limiter for Tickets write endpoints
description: Mounted after RequireTicketKey; exempts GET/HEAD (the polling loop must never throttle), classifies POST paths into create/message/attachment buckets each with independent hourly budgets (env-tunable), and returns a 429 envelope with Retry-After on exhaustion. Unknown write paths fall back to the strictest (:create) budget.
whatBreaks: Misclassification or a broken bucket could let ticket-key abuse (spam) through unmetered, or could wrongly throttle legitimate ticket creation/messaging traffic.

role: Phoenix Presence module definition
description: Defines BarkparkWeb.Presence by delegating to Phoenix.Presence backed by Barkpark.PubSub. Required for any collaborative presence tracking in LiveView.
whatBreaks: Any feature relying on presence tracking (e.g. collaborative editing indicators) fails at runtime.

role: GenServer aggregating rolling per-request throughput and p95 latency
description: Attaches to Phoenix's [:phoenix, :endpoint, :stop] telemetry event, writes durations into a public ETS ring buffer (write path never touches the GenServer mailbox), and on GenServer.call computes req_per_s and p95_ms over a bounded ~60s window with honest zero/nil fallbacks. Read shape is pinned by charter OC24 for a parallel-built on-box agent consumer.
whatBreaks: Operational monitoring only — a bug would give wrong/misleading throughput or latency numbers to the ops dashboard/agent but would not affect request handling itself (write path is wrapped in rescue to never crash requests).

role: Central Phoenix router — all HTTP/LiveView route + pipeline definitions
description: Defines every pipeline (browser, api, scoped_api, shared_*, ticket_key, etc.) and route scope for the whole app: core CRUD API, auth, Studio LiveViews, plugin route buckets, scoped tenant mirrors. Extremely large (1900+ lines) and is the wire-seam for auth/tenancy gating across the entire surface.

role: Compile-time macro folding plugin-contributed routes into the router
description: Reads Barkpark.Plugins.Registry.collect_routes/1 at macro-expansion time and emits Phoenix.Router AST (live/get/post/etc.) filtered by an auth scope tag (:admin/:ops/:public/:api/:token/:ingest/etc.). Central to the plugin route contract; requires a router recompile after editing a plugin's register_routes/1 (stale-route gotcha documented in moduledoc).
whatBreaks: Wrong scope filtering or AST emission could route a plugin endpoint into the wrong auth tier (e.g. admin-only leaking to public) or make plugin routes silently 404.

role: Shared request-metadata helpers for search-intelligence headers
description: Pure functions reading `x-bp-search-*` headers/params (actor key, session key, tags, recording toggle) used by search endpoints to build analytics events. Small, self-contained, fail-soft on malformed input.
whatBreaks: Search analytics/telemetry would misattribute or crash on malformed query params, degrading search-intel recording but not core search functionality.

role: Shared helper minting a user login session response
description: Single choke point where a successful login (password or passkey) becomes a session: creates the session token via Accounts.create_user_session_token/2, sets the signed user_session cookie, and returns the 201 JSON body, additively flagging mfa_enrolment_required when an org requires MFA and the user has none.
whatBreaks: Both password and passkey login flows share this code; a bug here breaks all user login (session cookie not set, wrong token, or wrong MFA-enrolment signal to clients) across the entire app.

role: Studio capability map + server-side deny-gate for LiveView events
description: Derives {read,write,admin} caps from tenancy membership union'd with fresh access-grant reload, and attaches a default-DENY event classifier/gate on every Studio socket so a forged phx-event whose tier the caller lacks is halted server-side, independent of UI hiding.

role: Subprocess/wire seam spawning the Studio Claude-chat CLI session
description: Admin-only, public-demo-refusing, per-host-optable gate that spawns the `claude` CLI in streaming stream-json mode, builds its argv (session/model/effort/permission-mode flags with fail-closed bypass-arming), parses NDJSON events, and manages the GenServer Session (single-writer registry, permission asks, control requests, sink adoption).
whatBreaks: A broken fail-closed guard (e.g. bypassPermissions normalization) could let an untrusted event arm dangerous unrestricted shell/file access, or a wire-parsing bug could crash/leak the Claude chat feature entirely.

role: Studio function component: dataset <select> dropdown
description: Renders a themed <select> of known datasets that navigates to /studio/:dataset[/:subpath] on change, preserving the current section (structure/media/api-tester). Small, presentation-only.
whatBreaks: Dataset switching in Studio would break or navigate to the wrong section/dataset.

role: Pure pane-tree builder for the multi-pane Studio desk
description: Given a dataset and nav path, builds the list of pane maps plus an optional editor map (field-form, paper, sheet, graph, media explorer) by walking the Structure tree; handles desk-group filtering, list_preview/manifest-driven row badges, and reserved nav segments (graph/open). Core to Studio's desk navigation and reused for both flat and scoped surfaces.
whatBreaks: Studio desk navigation could show wrong/missing content, open the wrong editor view, or leak unscoped documents across tenants.

role: Pure helpers for Studio collaborative presence (topic, color, filtering)
description: Owns the workspace-keyed PubSub presence topic naming, deterministic user color picking, and presence-list materialisation/filtering by doc+dataset. Deliberately does not call Presence.track/subscribe (those stay in the LiveView). Fixed a cross-tenant/cross-dataset co-presence leak.
whatBreaks: Presence avatars could leak across workspaces/datasets, or presence UI could crash/misbehave in collaborative Studio editing.

role: Open-redirect guard for Studio's flat-surface `return_to` deep-link param
description: Validates/sanitizes a `return_to` query value against a strict canonical Studio-path regex (rejecting absolute/scheme-relative/dot-segment paths) so flat surfaces like chat/tmux can offer a truthful back-link without becoming an open redirect.
whatBreaks: A regex or dot-segment bypass would let a crafted return_to param redirect an authenticated admin off-origin or to a sensitive same-origin path (e.g. logout), an open-redirect / phishing vector.

role: Resolves {workspace,project} for flat/under-determined Studio URLs
description: Shared brain behind the flat→scoped 302 redirect funnel: prefers a membership-verified same-origin Referer scope, else falls back to first-membership/default workspace+project, replacing an old behavior that silently teleported users to the alphabetically-first workspace.
whatBreaks: Wrong resolution teleports users into the wrong workspace/project (data confusion, or Referer-based auth bypass if membership check is dropped) across every flat Studio entry link.

role: Gate + PTY seam for the Studio browser-terminal tmux console
description: Admin-only, public-demo-refusing, per-host-optable wrapper that spawns/attaches a tmux client via a configurable PTY backend, forwarding input/output/resize/close through a swappable `apply/3` seam so tests can inject fakes.
whatBreaks: A gating regression exposes an arbitrary-code-execution shell to anonymous or non-admin users; a backend bug could hang/crash the LiveView but not compromise data.

role: Generated design-token constants for Studio (presence/CF colors, lifecycle mirror)
description: Auto-generated (do-not-edit) from design/tokens.json by design/emit.mjs; supplies persisted categorical hex palettes (presence avatars, Sheets conditional-format) and the lifecycle glyph/ascii/hue mirror consumed by the styleguide and other UI, gated for consistency by design/check.mjs.
whatBreaks: Stale/hand-edited tokens cause visual drift or wrong persisted color data in Sheets CF/presence avatars versus the canonical design source; low blast radius (cosmetic/data-consistency only).

role: Studio function component: workspace/project/dataset scope-switcher popover
description: Renders the Miller-column scope picker (workspace -> project -> dataset) with preview/create affordances; emits scope-menu-* / scope-open events handled by StudioChrome. Presentation-only, delegates all logic/security to the chrome's event handlers.
whatBreaks: The Studio top-bar scope switcher UI would break or misrender, though the underlying navigation/auth logic (in StudioChrome) stays intact.

role: Shared on_mount + event hook providing the Studio top-bar contract to every LiveView
description: Fills in chrome assigns (dataset, scope_prefix, current_workspace/project hydration, shares_admin?, current_path, scope_menu) for every studio-layout LiveView and attaches handle_event/handle_params hooks for scope-menu navigation, legacy switch-* events, and workspace/project creation. Central authorization boundary for the Share button and admin chrome across Studio surfaces.
whatBreaks: Any Studio LiveView could crash on unhandled events, show/hide the wrong admin chrome, or a scope switch could navigate into an unauthorized tenant.

role: telemetry supervisor and metrics definitions
description: Defines the telemetry supervision tree and registers Phoenix, database, search, and VM metrics. Standard Phoenix telemetry boilerplate with a search intelligence counter added.
whatBreaks: Metrics and observability stop working; no operational impact on core API functionality.

role: Mix task — seed ONIX EDItEUR codelist registry
description: Parses a publisher-supplied EDItEUR ONIX XML and seeds the codelist registry. Supports --issue versioning (idempotent re-runs, coexisting issues). Used by ONIX plugin operators, not during normal boots.
whatBreaks: ONIX codelist data cannot be seeded, breaking codelist lookups in the ONIX export plugin for affected issues.

role: Mix task: one-shot backfill of content-graph valueref/wikilink edges
description: Dry-run-by-default CLI wrapper around Barkpark.EdgeProjector.Backfill that rebuilds content_edges for every dataset/workspace scope's published paper corpus, needed because edge projection is save-event-driven and pre-existing papers have none.
whatBreaks: An incorrect --apply run could wipe or mis-populate content_edges tables across tenants; safe-by-default dry-run mitigates but a bug in the apply path corrupts the graph feature (backlinks/wikilinks) repo-wide.

role: deprecated plugin scaffold shim
description: A deprecated Mix task that prints a notice and immediately delegates to mix barkpark.plugin.new; it exists only to avoid breaking callers of the old task name.
whatBreaks: Callers of the old mix barkpark.gen.plugin task get an error instead of a deprecation notice and redirect.

role: Mix task — backfill mediaAsset documents
description: Creates missing mediaAsset Barkpark documents for rows that exist in media_files but lack a document, with dry-run support. A one-off operational recovery task.
whatBreaks: Media files uploaded before the mediaAsset model existed remain inaccessible via the content API until manually repaired.

role: Mix task generating/verifying the checked-in OpenAPI 3.1 descriptor
description: Writes docs/openapi.json from Barkpark.Api.OpenApi.spec/0 (the same manifest /v1/capabilities serves) or, with --check, fails CI if the file is stale, acting as a drift gate between the route registry and the published API contract.
whatBreaks: A stale/incorrect openapi.json misleads API consumers/SDK generation and lets undocumented routes ship silently if the CI drift gate is bypassed or broken.

role: Mix task backfilling missing block ids + flat-string list items on legacy papers
description: Dry-run-by-default CLI wrapper around Barkpark.Content.Papers.BackfillBlockIds fixing two legacy corpus bugs (id-less blocks causing duplicate-block corruption on edit; flat-string list items causing spurious shape-flip patches) — additive, idempotent, render-identical.
whatBreaks: Without this fix legacy papers with id-less blocks corrupt (duplicate blocks) on first edit in the canvas; a buggy backfill could itself corrupt paper content across the corpus.

role: Mix task backfilling the title/featured-image doctrine template onto legacy papers
description: Dry-run-by-default, human-gated CLI wrapper around Barkpark.Content.Papers.DoctrineBackfill that synthesizes a locked title block and promotes an existing image to a locked featured block for papers predating the PortableDoc doctrine, refusing to write any paper that would still fail Template.validate/1.
whatBreaks: A faulty backfill could mis-title papers, duplicate/lose image blocks, or desync body_html/body from the new blocks across the legacy paper corpus; safe-by-default dry-run and human-gated apply limit blast radius.

role: Mix task generating cross-surface PortableDoc component golden-parity fixtures
description: Builds pure structural-projection JSON fixtures (task-board, status-legend, notes, cards, card, pipeline, stage, task-detail, roadmap, columns, terminal) from StatusVocab and writes byte-identical copies into api/web/Go pdrender test trees. Guards cross-surface (Elixir View, Go TUI, web reader) rendering parity for PortableDoc components; a freshness test asserts the committed fixture equals build/1.
whatBreaks: A stale or wrong fixture silently certifies false parity across three renderers, letting real component-rendering divergence (dropped columns, reordered slots, wrong glyphs) ship undetected.

role: Mix task to regenerate plugin TypeScript types
description: Reads priv/plugin_manifest_schema.json and shells out to npx json-schema-to-typescript to regenerate priv/plugin_types.d.ts; falls back gracefully if Node is absent.
whatBreaks: Plugin TypeScript type definitions drift from the JSON Schema, causing silent type mismatches in plugin authors' code.

role: plugin scaffold generator Mix task
description: Implements `mix barkpark.plugin.new` which generates a plugin skeleton (manifest, entry module, test, schemas dir) mirroring the OnixEdit layout so auto-discovery works. Supports capability flags, module override, and --force.
whatBreaks: Plugin scaffolding generates malformed skeletons that fail to register or compile, slowing down plugin development but not affecting runtime.

role: One-shot migration stamping content["preview"] onto legacy published documents
description: Dry-run-by-default Mix task that re-projects Barkpark.Preview.project/3 for every published block-bearing doc and writes the manifest via a no-broadcast Repo.update, so non-Elixir consumers (web finder, Studio rows, TUI rows) can read a stamped preview instead of relying on read-time fallback. Idempotent via map-equality skip; ordering-hazard gated on pc-w2b deploy to avoid stamping garbled descriptions.
whatBreaks: Running before pc-w2b or with a wrong tenancy scope would permanently stamp garbled or cross-tenant preview data into published documents, corrupting OG cards across surfaces.

role: Mix task generating the cross-surface preview-manifest parity fixture
description: Produces a rich + core preview manifest via Barkpark.Preview.project/3 (the same function the write path uses) and writes it to three mirror paths (api/web/Go) so the papers reader, v1 envelope, web finder, Studio rows, and TUI rows all agree on preview-manifest shape. A freshness test locks the committed fixture to build/0.
whatBreaks: A stale fixture would mask a preview-manifest regression (e.g. garbled description or broken image resolution) across five consuming surfaces at once.

role: One-shot backfill re-rendering stale content["body_html"] caches
description: Sweeps documents whose frozen body_html cache predates the current PortableDoc render version, re-renders from content["blocks"] with the same render_opts the write path uses, and rewrites both the cache and its version stamp (bumping rev). Idempotent per doc via version-stamp comparison; skips docs with no block list.
whatBreaks: Papers whose frozen HTML cache is never rehydrated after a renderer semantics change keep serving divergent/stale markup on the public reader and API indefinitely.

role: Mix task for weekly public-read token rotation
description: Generates a new public-read API token, writes it to /opt/barkpark/.env.public_token, notifies Vercel via deploy hook, and purges tokens older than 8 days. Invoked by a systemd timer.
whatBreaks: Public-read token rotation fails, leaving a stale or compromised token active for the Next.js deploy.

role: Mix task generating the cross-surface Sheets golden-parity fixture
description: Builds one canonical sheet (formulas, merges, formats, conditional formatting, error codes, sparkline) via Core.snapshot_for/2 and writes byte-identical JSON to api/web/Go pdrender fixture paths, pinning snapshot/display parity across the Elixir renderer, web SDK, and Go TUI. Freshness-locked against build/0 in an Elixir test.
whatBreaks: A stale fixture would hide a Sheets rendering/formatting regression (wrong formula result, dropped error code, broken conditional-format compose) across three independent renderers.

role: One-shot backfill re-synthesizing stale embedded sheet snapshots
description: Sweeps every sheet document (preferring the draft), re-runs the embed write-through (Sheets.refresh_sheet_embeds) so papers embedding a `{type:sheet}` block get their cached snapshot refreshed after a synthesis change. Idempotent — a doc's write-through only rewrites when the fresh snapshot differs.
whatBreaks: Papers with embedded sheets keep serving stale display values (e.g. pre-v2-format numbers) after a Sheets synthesis change until manually re-saved.

role: Mix task copying plugin content-type schemas into a new workspace
description: Dry-run-by-default admin task that copies named schemas (default paper/sheet/mediaAsset/mediaCollection/task) from a source workspace into a target workspace's tenancy scope via upsert, since workspace creation does not auto-register plugin schemas. Idempotent upsert keyed on (name, dataset) within scope.
whatBreaks: A freshly created dedicated workspace stays stuck with an empty Studio desk (no Papers/Sheets/Media/Tasks surfaces) until this is run correctly with --apply.

role: Mix task: list Bokbasen submissions by state
description: CLI Mix task that queries the DB for Bokbasen export submissions, filters by lifecycle state, and prints a colored table. Pure read — no HTTP calls.
whatBreaks: Operators cannot inspect Bokbasen submission state via the CLI, hampering ONIX export debugging.

role: Bokbasen publish replay operator tool
description: Mix task for operators to re-enqueue a Bokbasen ONIX publish job via Oban or dry-run it by rendering the XML in-memory and running the XSD gate without hitting the live Bokbasen API.
whatBreaks: Operators cannot replay failed Bokbasen publishes and have no dry-run validation path for debugging export issues.

role: Mix task: Bokbasen publish status summary or per-book detail
description: CLI Mix task that prints either a per-state count summary or detailed bp_export_status fields for a single book document. Pure DB read.
whatBreaks: Operators cannot audit Bokbasen publish pipeline status from the CLI.

role: Mix task for ONIX codelist staleness reporting and revalidation
description: Iterates book documents, checks codelist refs against the current registry issue, and reports stale refs or revalidates a single book. Ops tool for ONIX codelist hygiene.
whatBreaks: Stale ONIX codelist refs go undetected, leading to invalid metadata in book exports.

role: Mix task: FRT dataset export to game-ready JSON
description: Reads published documents from the `frt` dataset and flattens them into a byte-deterministic, hashable JSON artifact for Godot game builds. Supports `--out` and `--dataset` flags; prints a content hash to stderr.
whatBreaks: Game build pipeline produces a wrong or non-deterministic JSON artifact, breaking CI hash gates or game runtime content loading.

role: Mix task: FRT dataset seeder
description: Seeds the `frt` dataset with 25 schemas and ~45 published documents mirroring live Godot game tables (enemy types, game clock, player stats, etc.). Idempotent via on_conflict: :nothing.
whatBreaks: FRT demo/dev dataset is missing or incorrect, breaking frt.export and any game-content demos.

role: Mix task: regenerate the committed ONIX 3.0 proof fixture XML
description: Reads a source book JSON fixture, runs it through the OnixEdit exporter (with XSD validation), and writes the validated XML to the committed test fixture path with a pinned timestamp for byte-stability. Drift is enforced by a companion test.
whatBreaks: Only the ONIX export proof-artifact regeneration workflow breaks; a stale/incorrect fixture would cause export_proof_test.exs to fail, not affect runtime.

role: Mix task: ONIX 3.0 XML -> draft book documents importer
description: CLI entrypoint `mix onix.import <file.xml>` that parses <Product> elements via Barkpark.Plugins.OnixEdit.Importer and creates draft book documents through Barkpark.Content.create_document/3; supports --dataset and --dry-run, and fails loudly (non-zero exit) if any product import errors.
whatBreaks: ONIX bulk-import workflow silently drops books or crashes with a misleading error, breaking the Bokbasen ingest path.

role: Mix task — golden search evaluation harness
description: Runs golden JSONL queries against the search engine for documents or media surface, reports zero-hit rate and optional baseline regression. Exits non-zero on regression. Used in CI/QA, not in production runtime.
whatBreaks: Search quality regressions go undetected when this task is broken or absent from CI.

role: Elixir project manifest — deps, compile paths, release config
description: Defines the whole app's dependency graph (Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto, auth libs, media/image backend, sheets xlsx libs, tmux console NIF), compile path split per env, release assembly steps, and dev aliases (setup/test/precommit). Central single point of failure for build/compile across the entire API.
whatBreaks: Wrong or missing dependency/version breaks compilation of the entire Phoenix app, or ships a broken release (missing ERTS, wrong image/media backend on a platform).

description: Registers Barkpark.Plugins.Pulse with routes/workers/node capabilities; describes anonymous rate-limited public event channels with durable counters and a cursor-based recent feed (the Shared Storm substrate). Discovered by the plugin loader via this JSON manifest.

description: Registers Barkpark.Plugins.Quiz with routes/workers/schemas/node capabilities; describes the live-quiz game (host projector, phone-as-controller, realtime GenServer per room) authored as private quiz documents. Discovered by the plugin loader via this JSON manifest.

description: JSON schema for spreadsheet documents: ordered tabs array, each tab carrying frozen rows/cols, column/row sizing, merges, sparse cell map, and conditional-format rules; private visibility. Drives Sheets Core/Engine validation and Studio grid rendering.

description: Declares plugin identity for the Tickets system: named low-trust API keys act as identity, submitters file `type:ticket` documents with an append-only message thread, status (open/answered/closed) doubles as a turn indicator. Registers capabilities ["schemas","routes"] and module Barkpark.Plugins.Tickets.
whatBreaks: If malformed or missing, the Tickets plugin fails to register its schemas/routes and the external support-ticket surface (Studio inbox + key-holder access) disappears entirely.

whatBreaks: Legacy-scoped document reads (NULL dataset_id rows) full-scan and slow down as data grows, degrading list_documents performance for pre-tenancy fixtures.
