role: Unit tests for Barkpark.Tasks.Similarity (duplicate-task heuristic scoring)
description: Tests text similarity scoring, label weighting, stopword filtering, structural relation classification (sibling/chain/cross), and the assess/3 refuse/advise/excluded bucketing used for tier-1 duplicate detection, including drafts.-prefix normalization.
whatBreaks: A miscalibrated similarity/threshold bug could spam false duplicate-refusals on legitimate sibling tasks or miss real duplicates during task creation.

role: Test: TtlSweeper reaping stale task claims (fencing epoch bump)
description: 531-line suite proving the TTL sweeper reaps crashed-agent task claims, bumps the fencing epoch, flips lifecycle_status back to open, emits task.lease_expired, handles concurrency/advisory-lock contention against a simultaneous close, and skips closed/fresh tasks correctly.
whatBreaks: Stale claims could stay locked forever (starving the bp task queue) or double-close/double-bump races could corrupt task state under concurrent sweeps.

role: Pure unit tests for Barkpark.Tasks.Validation (task content shape checks)
description: Covers kind discriminator checks, required lifecycle_status enum, priority bounds, and a regression suite proving literal `false` values are rejected as type errors rather than silently treated as absent (the falsy-masking bug class).
whatBreaks: A validation regression could let malformed task content (bad priority, bad lifecycle_status, false-masked fields) persist and corrupt downstream queue/rail/claim logic that assumes well-shaped content.

role: test for task claim/close primitives (CAS + fencing)
description: Tests CAS claim semantics, fencing epoch close, advisory-lock cascading unblock, and durable-then-ack mutation_events — covering the full W7a step 4 claim contract plus the N-workers burst regression.
whatBreaks: Claim/close primitive regressions go undetected — double-claims, fencing bypasses, or lost mutation_events in production.

role: test for task dependency graph edges
description: Tests add_dep/remove_dep, dependency/dependent direction, idempotency, kind discrimination across edge types, cascading delete, and tenancy isolation for the task_edges table.
whatBreaks: Edge graph bugs go undetected — wrong dependency ordering, cross-kind bleed, or orphan edges when documents are deleted.

role: test for Tasks.ready/1 and claim skeleton
description: Tests that ready/1 returns correct tasks based on blocker state, phase scope, lifecycle filter, tenancy isolation, and SKIP LOCKED concurrency correctness.
whatBreaks: Ready-queue logic regressions go undetected — blocked tasks surface prematurely, cross-tenant leakage, or concurrency double-claims.

role: Coverage tests for Tasks.update_paper_refs_by_id and resource-scoped claims
description: Tests content.papers slug add/remove/idempotence/rev-bump behavior, plus resource claims riding content.claim.resources including overlap-conflict refusal against other live claims in the same tenancy.
whatBreaks: Without this coverage, a tasks.ex refactor could silently break paper-linking or let two workers double-claim the same file resource, causing concurrent edit collisions.

role: test for task schema shape integrity
description: Guards the rich task schema against v2 parse failures, groups invariant violations (silent field vanish), and engine-safety drift of load-bearing stored shapes like claim/history/history_summary.
whatBreaks: Task schema regressions go undetected — Studio silently drops fields, compactor's markers collide, or v2 validation fails open.

role: test for task document schema and registration
description: Tests schema registration, field contract, validation (required fields, invalid status rejection), hierarchy/tenancy isolation, and status-axis non-interference between lifecycle_status and documents.status.
whatBreaks: Task document schema regressions go undetected — invalid tasks accepted, tenancy leaks, or dual-status semantics break.

role: Tests for Barkpark.Tenancy.Dataset schema and Tenancy dataset CRUD
description: Covers Dataset.changeset validation (slug/name length + required fields), DB-level project FK and unique-slug-per-project constraints, and Tenancy functions (create_dataset, get_dataset, list_datasets, get_or_create_dataset) including on_conflict :nothing idempotence.
whatBreaks: Dataset scoping is foundational to tenancy isolation (production/staging separation); a regression here could let datasets collide across projects or fail to isolate content correctly.

role: Unit tests for Tenancy.Membership changeset (roles, principal_type)
description: Covers roles/0, changeset required fields, valid roles (owner/admin/member), default principal_type (api_token), and inclusion validation on role/principal_type. Pure changeset tests, no DB writes needed for most cases.
whatBreaks: Undetected regressions in membership role/type validation could let invalid roles or principal types onto workspace membership rows, weakening RBAC.

role: Tests for Tenancy.Organization CRUD, slug rules, and workspace attachment
description: Verifies default org backfill, org creation/slug validation/uniqueness, and the org<->workspace many-to-one relationship (assign/detach), plus that a workspace without an org stays valid.
whatBreaks: A broken org/workspace linkage test would let regressions ship in multi-tenant organization scoping (e.g. workspaces silently losing/gaining org association).

role: Tests for Tenancy.Project changeset (slug rules, reserved slugs, uniqueness)
description: Exercises reserved_slugs/0 (routing-critical slugs like admin/api/studio/v1/w/p), slug format/length validation, per-workspace slug uniqueness, and the workspace_id assoc_constraint. Guards against project slugs colliding with router paths.
whatBreaks: If reserved-slug or uniqueness enforcement regresses undetected, a project could be created with a slug that shadows a core route (e.g. /admin), breaking routing.

role: Tests for Tenancy.Workspace changeset (slug rules, reserved slugs, global uniqueness)
description: Mirrors the project test but for workspaces: reserved slugs (admin/api/studio/v1/w/p/media/login), format validation, required fields, and global slug uniqueness constraint enforcement.
whatBreaks: Loss of workspace slug uniqueness/reserved-word enforcement could let a workspace slug collide with a top-level route, breaking the entire router's scoping.

role: Tests for workspace theme persistence/resolution (Tenancy.workspace_theme)
description: Covers default theme fallback for missing/unknown/nil settings, set_workspace_theme/2 persistence and merge-not-replace semantics, and that known_themes/0 delegates to the generated TokensGen theme list (design/themes/*.json driven codegen).
whatBreaks: A regression here could let an unknown/stale theme value leak into rendering, or break the generated-theme-list sync invariant when a new theme is added.

role: test for tenancy bootstrap transaction atomicity
description: Proves that create_workspace_with_owner/2 and create_project_with_dataset/2 roll back ALL inserts on mid-transaction failure — no orphan workspace, membership, project, or dataset rows survive partial failure.
whatBreaks: Tenancy atomicity regressions go undetected — partial bootstrap leaves orphan rows that corrupt workspace/project scoping.

role: Test: Tenancy.Auth authorize/3 permission matrix for API tokens
description: Exercises the read/write/admin permission matrix for workspace membership + API token authorization primitives (Barkpark.Tenancy.Auth), the gate behind all scoped API/token access.
whatBreaks: Broken authorization checks could let under-permissioned tokens perform writes/admin actions, or lock out legitimate members — a security-relevant regression.

role: Test: dataset seed/backfill migration correctness (production dataset, paperflow removal)
description: Confirms migration 20260527132000 seeded a 'production' Dataset under the Default project and migration 20260622120000 removed the vestigial 'paperflow' dataset, and that list_datasets/1 reflects both.
whatBreaks: A broken migration/backfill could leave content unscoped to any dataset or resurrect the retired paperflow dataset, silently breaking dataset-scoped reads.

role: Test: Tenancy.delete_workspace/1 cascade correctness + atomicity
description: 475-line suite closing two prior bugs (obhg-P0, 0f7g-P1): proves workspace deletion cleans up media blob/CDN/plugin hooks (not just SQL cascade), extends cascade to seven extra tables (webhooks, mutation_events, paper_events, search_synonyms, etc.) instead of nilifying workspace_id, rolls back atomically on mid-delete failure, and leaves other workspaces untouched.
whatBreaks: Deleting a workspace could leak orphaned media/CDN cache entries, resurrect deleted-workspace rows under Default via NULL workspace_id, or partially delete data on failure.

role: meta-test for cross-workspace isolation harness
description: Proves the cross-workspace leak harness itself works: a row in workspace A is visible under A's scope and invisible under B's scope, validating the assert_no_cross_workspace_leak/7 helper.
whatBreaks: Cross-workspace data isolation regressions go undetected if the test harness itself is broken.

role: Tests for org-level require_mfa flag and ANY-org-governs enforcement rule
description: Verifies require_mfa is settable, org_requires_mfa_for_user?/1 correctly implements 'any requiring org governs, no bypass from a laxer org' semantics, filters by principal_type user (not api_token), and handles orphan workspaces/malformed ids safely.
whatBreaks: If the ANY-org-governs MFA rule regresses silently, a user could bypass a required-MFA org policy via membership in a laxer org — a security control gap.

role: Tests for custom-role RBAC at the Auth.authorize/3 chokepoint
description: Verifies data-driven custom roles (era-w1 Stage A) enforce read/write/admin correctly, workspace-scoped role isolation, fail-safe built-in role fallback when DB has no seeded rows, and that a tenant cannot redefine a built-in role (e.g. 'admin') to escalate/narrow privileges.
whatBreaks: A regression in authorize/3's custom-role or built-in-precedence logic could let a user with a narrowly-scoped custom role gain admin/write access, or vice versa lock out legitimate access — a core authorization defect.

role: Test: core Tenancy defaults (Default Workspace/Project) + safe id lookups
description: Verifies the seeded Default Workspace/Project backfill shape and that by-id lookup functions (get_workspace_by_id/get_project_by_id) safely return nil on non-UUID input instead of raising Ecto.CastError (guards the #672-style 500 bug).
whatBreaks: Malformed :id path params reaching a bare Repo.get could crash requests with a 500 instead of a clean 404/nil, and default workspace/project resolution could break across the app.

role: static-analysis regression for workspace delete callsites
description: Scans lib/ source to assert no code calls Repo.delete/1 directly on a Workspace struct — all deletes must route through Tenancy.delete_workspace/1 to fire plugin/blob cleanup.
whatBreaks: A developer adding a direct Repo.delete(workspace) call bypasses cleanup and this guard won't catch it if the test is broken.

role: Test: TextDiff rail-shaped wrapper (hunks/2, format_diff_html/1)
description: Small suite for the thin rail wrapper around Papers.TextDiff — asserts op-translation ('=' -> ' '), pure add/change hunks, nil-safety, and that format_diff_html HTML-escapes untrusted content (XSS defense check).
whatBreaks: A broken escape path could allow XSS in rendered diff HTML, or diff hunks could mis-render additions/removals in the Papers UI.

role: test for ONIX codelist reference checker
description: Tests Barkpark.Validation.Checkers.CodelistRef — validates that field values reference valid ONIX codelist entries (e.g. ContributorRole list 17), used by the OnixEdit plugin Phase 4.
whatBreaks: Invalid ONIX codelist references pass validation undetected, corrupting exported ONIX data.

role: test for cross-codelist constraint validation
description: Tests Barkpark.Validation.CrossCodelist — asserts consistent?/2 predicates (:gt, :any) that enforce cross-field ONIX rules (e.g. Hardback ProductForm requires PageCount > 0).
whatBreaks: Cross-field ONIX validation constraints fail silently, allowing invalid content through.

role: test for validation rule GenServer/ETS registry
description: Tests Barkpark.Validation.Registry — a named GenServer + ETS table managing validation rules. Runs async: false due to shared global state; includes teardown for ETS leak prevention.
whatBreaks: Registry state leaks between tests causing flaky failures, or registry correctness regressions ship undetected.

role: Unit tests for Barkpark.Vault encrypt/decrypt round-trip
description: Small, focused test confirming symmetric encryption round-trips, produces distinct ciphertext per call (random IV), differs from plaintext, and errors cleanly on invalid ciphertext.
whatBreaks: If Vault encrypt/decrypt regresses undetected, stored secrets (API credentials, tokens) could become unrecoverable or use a non-random/weak IV, a data-loss or security risk.

role: Tests for auth-event webhook matching + Audit.emit -> Dispatcher bridge
description: Verifies audit_webhooks_for/3 category/action/org-scope matching (including global vs org-scoped and no-cross-tenant-delivery), that content-type webhooks are excluded from audit fan-out, and that Audit.emit fires a durable signed delivery via the shared Webhooks.Delivery machine.
whatBreaks: A regression could cause audit events to leak across organizations to the wrong webhook subscribers, or silently fail to deliver security-relevant events like sso_login/mfa_failed.

role: Unit tests for Webhooks.Delivery changeset (status/attempts defaults)
description: Pure changeset tests: required fields (endpoint_id, event_id), default status 'pending'/attempts 0, and inclusion validation over declared statuses (pending/ok/failed_giveup).
whatBreaks: If Delivery's status validation regresses, invalid delivery states could be persisted, corrupting the webhook retry/giveup state machine's assumptions.

role: Test: Webhooks.Dispatcher delivery, retry, and backpressure behavior
description: 867-line suite (largest here) covering webhook delivery via Oban-backed RetryWorker, deterministic retry-chain draining, a scripted FakeHTTP adapter, and a blocking adapter used to test in-flight concurrency backpressure — core correctness for the outbound webhook system.
whatBreaks: Webhook deliveries could silently fail, retry incorrectly (duplicate or dropped deliveries), or exceed intended concurrency caps under load.

role: Test: webhook dispatcher SSRF-guard behaviour
description: Verifies ReqAdapter refuses internal/private IP targets (e.g. 127.0.0.1, link-local metadata IP) with no network call, that a blocked delivery terminally fails without retry, and that HTTP redirects (302) are never followed to a second internal request. Exercises the real Dispatcher.deliver/3 path via Bypass-mocked HTTP.
whatBreaks: An SSRF bypass in the webhook delivery path could let a tenant-configured webhook URL be used to probe or reach internal/private network services.

role: Test: crash-recovery sweeper for stuck webhook deliveries
description: Covers StuckDeliverySweeper.sweep/1 re-dispatching stale pending deliveries (crashed dispatcher orphans), leaving fresh/terminal rows untouched, handling both endpoint-backed and durable media-snapshot-backed deliveries, and guaranteeing exactly-once re-dispatch (no duplicate delivery rows).
whatBreaks: A broken sweeper could either resurrect already-delivered webhooks (duplicate delivery) or leave crash-orphaned deliveries stuck forever, silently dropping webhook events.

role: Test: Webhook changeset URL validation
description: Small unit test asserting the Webhook changeset accepts well-formed http(s) URLs and rejects hostless URLs, URLs with embedded userinfo/credentials, and non-http schemes (ftp, javascript:).
whatBreaks: A regression here could allow malformed or credential-carrying/non-http webhook URLs to be persisted, widening the SSRF/injection surface at the changeset layer.

role: Test: cross-tenant mass-assignment guard on webhook writes
description: Confirms create_webhook/update_webhook ignore client-supplied workspace_id/project_id (scope is server-authoritative from request opts, not attrs) and that secret/previous_secret fields are not client-castable on update, only via rotate_secret/3.
whatBreaks: A regression would let an attacker smuggle a foreign workspace_id into webhook attrs to move a hook into another tenant (cross-tenant event exfiltration) or forge a webhook signing secret.

role: cross-tenant webhook isolation test
description: Tests that webhooks are scoped by workspace_id and not just dataset, verifying that workspace A's webhooks are never selected or delivered when workspace B's content changes.
whatBreaks: Cross-tenant webhook isolation regressions go undetected, potentially leaking webhook deliveries between workspaces.

role: Unit tests for the Webhooks context (delivery, signing, rotation)
description: Covers CRUD, D55 re-enable/auto-disable semantics, dual-secret HMAC signing + rotation with replay-window checks, and delivery dedup/claim/giveup logic. Encodes several subtle invariants (no fabricated disable_reason on manual disable, stale-struct delete returns :not_found not a crash, non-UUID id lookups fail closed).
whatBreaks: Regressions in webhook auto-disable, signature verification, or delivery dedup would ship silently, risking replay attacks or webhook storms.

role: test for search analytics pruning worker
description: Tests the search analytics pruning background worker, verifying that old analytics records are deleted on schedule.
whatBreaks: Analytics data accumulation bugs (no pruning or over-pruning) go undetected.

role: worker smoke test
description: Minimal smoke test ensuring background workers start and respond without crashing.
whatBreaks: Broken worker startup goes undetected until production.

role: Test: anonymous-caller perspective pinning (draft-leak guard)
description: Pure/DB-free unit tests for BarkparkWeb.AnonPerspective — anonymous requests are always pinned to :published regardless of a ?perspective=drafts|raw param, authenticated/preview/edit-share callers are exempt, and read-only public shares stay pinned.
whatBreaks: A regression here is a direct draft-content leak: anonymous API callers could read unpublished/raw documents by passing a perspective query param, as previously happened in the search-controller leak this test guards against.

role: Test: anonymous Shared Storm realtime PulseChannel
description: Covers PulseSocket/PulseChannel join (durable totals, unknown-channel refusal), HTTP POST -> broadcast -> subscriber push loop, throttled cursor frames, cost-vitals fastlane push, and presence roster tracking with hue metadata.
whatBreaks: Breakage would silently kill the real-time Shared Storm feed (join failures, duplicate/missing cursor or vitals pushes, or broken presence roster) without failing any HTTP endpoint.

role: Test: anonymous Hyperquiz player channel (P1 room mechanics)
description: Extensive coverage of QuizChannel/QuizSocket: join snapshot + nickname moderation, answer submit + validation + rate limiting, live tally fan-out, presence, cursor throttling/encoding, observer (non-player) joins, reconnect-token signing/forgery rejection, and no double-counting on re-join.
whatBreaks: Regressions would corrupt live quiz gameplay — wrong tallies, spoofable player identity, double-counted players, or broken presence/cursor sync during a live session.

role: Test: workspace-scoped realtime SearchChannel (join auth + live push)
description: Covers join-time topic/authorization validation (malformed topic, unauthorized workspace/token), empty-query fast path, and P5 live-push behavior: a cached query re-runs and pushes fresh results on same-workspace document mutation but must NOT push across workspace boundaries or when no query is cached.
whatBreaks: A regression could either cross-leak live search results between tenants (serious tenancy breach) or silently stop live search updates, degrading the search UX.

role: test for array field reference row component
description: Tests the LiveView component that renders a single reference row inside an array field in the Studio editor.
whatBreaks: Regressions in reference-row rendering inside array fields go undetected.

role: test for confirm modal component
description: Tests the Studio confirm/delete modal component, verifying rendering and interaction behaviour.
whatBreaks: Confirm modal regressions (wrong button labels, missing callbacks) go undetected.

role: test for draft diff component
description: Tests the component that renders a visual diff between draft and published document versions in the Studio.
whatBreaks: Draft/published diff display regressions go undetected, potentially confusing editors about pending changes.

role: test for external sync status pill component
description: Tests the pill badge component that shows external sync status on documents in the Studio, covering various sync states.
whatBreaks: Incorrect sync status display goes undetected, misleading editors about document sync state.

role: Unit tests for the FieldInputs Studio form-field renderer component
description: Exercises every field type clause (select, text/richText, boolean, color, reference, mediaAsset, image, string/slug/number/datetime fallback), pinning exact HTML/attribute contracts (phx-debounce values, hidden-input bridging to Web Components, phantom-default guards) that Studio's editor and autosave rely on.
whatBreaks: A broken field renders wrong input type/attrs in Studio, silently corrupting autosave payloads or breaking the WC bridge for rich text/media/reference fields.

role: Unit tests for the ArrayField Studio component (reorder/add/remove)
description: Tests move_up/move_down/add_row/remove_row pure functions plus array_field/1 rendering (ordered vs unordered controls, inline row errors, and the checklist progress badge for composite arrays with a boolean `met` field).
whatBreaks: Array field reordering or the task-checklist progress badge in Studio could break or crash on malformed data.

role: test for codelist field component
description: Tests the codelist (enum/select) field component in the Studio editor, covering rendering and option selection.
whatBreaks: Codelist field regressions go undetected, breaking content editing for ONIX and other codelist-heavy schemas.

role: test for composite field component
description: Tests the composite (nested object) field editor component in the Studio, verifying nested field rendering and edit interactions.
whatBreaks: Composite field editing regressions go undetected, breaking structured data entry for schemas with nested objects.

role: Unit tests for the LocalizedTextField Studio component (i18n fallback chain)
description: Verifies per-language textarea rendering, the fallback-chain warning/error UI when a primary translation is missing, and behavior when fallback_chain is unconfigured (schema-parse default).
whatBreaks: Editors could silently lose visibility into missing translations or see incorrect fallback content in Studio.

role: test for tree codelist field component
description: Unit tests for the TreeCodelistField component that renders hierarchical codelist values in Studio forms.
whatBreaks: Tree codelist field rendering bugs go undetected in CI.

role: test for field visibility logic
description: Unit tests verifying field visibility rules (show/hide conditions) rendered by Studio field components.
whatBreaks: Field visibility regressions in Studio forms are not caught.

role: Test: BarkparkWeb.Icons emoji-to-SVG icon mapping component
description: Checks icon_name/1 emoji->name mapping (including desk-type glyphs and shared/no-longer-shared emoji), and the icon/1 render component producing distinct SVG paths per icon name with correct fallback to 'file' for unknown names/sizes.
whatBreaks: Wrong icon mapping is a cosmetic Studio/TUI-desk regression (wrong or fallback glyphs shown), not a functional break.

role: test for ONIX preview component
description: Unit tests for the ONIX preview LiveView component that renders an ONIX XML preview in the Studio.
whatBreaks: ONIX preview rendering bugs go undetected.

role: Test: Studio environment-identity banner component (staging canary strip)
description: Pure component-render tests for Nav.studio_env_banner/1 driven by the :instance_env app env var: no markup for prod/production/nil/blank, a staging-specific canary strip with a11y attributes and token-only theming, and a generic uppercased-tag strip for any other env value.
whatBreaks: Wrong banner rendering could mislead operators about which environment (prod vs staging) they're viewing in Studio, or leak hex/hsl literals violating the studio-literal-check theming contract — low functional impact.

role: Unit tests for Studio ref-picker/delete/discard modal function components
description: Tests BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents.Modals rendering: ref_picker_modal filtering, delete_modal clean-vs-ref-blocked paths, discard_modal, and dialog a11y semantics (role, aria-labelledby, escape-close). Pure render_component tests, no DB.
whatBreaks: Regressions in Studio modal rendering, filtering, or accessibility semantics ship unnoticed

role: Unit tests for canonical Studio nav model and tab-active boundary matching
description: Guards BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents.Nav.default_top_menu_entries/4 (the sole nav-model owner) and plugin_tab_active?/2 boundary semantics (prevents sibling-prefix false-actives like 'media' vs 'media-library'). Replaces a retired dead-fork test.
whatBreaks: Studio top-nav could reorder/mis-scope tabs or wrongly highlight sibling routes across all studio surfaces

role: Unit tests for Studio pane status badge and doc-item list row components
description: Tests BarkparkWeb.StudioComponents.Panes status_badge/1 and pane_doc_item/1 (bulk-select checkbox, checked state, badge slugification). Pure render_component tests.
whatBreaks: Bulk-publish checkbox UI or badge rendering could break silently across Studio panes

role: Tests for Studio presence UI accessibility and per-doc presence-dot hoisting
description: DataCase-backed tests for presence_nav/1 a11y (real buttons, aria-labels) and pins that StudioLive.Components' grouped presence hoist is byte-equivalent to the old per-item PresenceState.on_doc/3 filter, including cross-dataset and nil-doc_id exclusion.
whatBreaks: Collaborator presence indicators could leak across datasets/docs or lose accessible names in the live Studio

role: Unit tests for shared Studio pane-layout components
description: Covers pane_layout, pane_column (collapse, flex, header actions), pane_empty, pane_section_header (collapsible chevron), pane_divider, pane_item, and pane_doc_item — the primitives that build every Studio multi-pane view.
whatBreaks: Broken pane primitives would visually/functionally break Studio's multi-pane layout across every screen that uses it.

role: test for general Studio UI components
description: Unit tests covering a range of Studio UI components (buttons, badges, panels, etc.) for correct HTML rendering.
whatBreaks: Regressions in core Studio UI components are not caught before deploy.

role: test for vendor Accept-header contract
description: Contract test ensuring the API correctly handles vendor Accept headers (content negotiation) for published documents.
whatBreaks: Content-type negotiation regressions silently break API consumers relying on vendor MIME types.

role: contract test for analytics HTTP API
description: Integration tests that pin the analytics API endpoints to their expected request/response shapes.
whatBreaks: Analytics API contract drift goes undetected, breaking consumers.

role: contract test for anonymous/public perspective access
description: Tests that public (unauthenticated) requests see only public-visibility documents and are correctly gated.
whatBreaks: Anonymous access control bugs (data leaks or false 403s) go undetected.

role: Contract test for GET /v1/data/backlinks/:dataset/:id endpoint
description: Verifies reverse-reference lookup returns referencing documents via materialised content_edges, empty-list for unreferenced docs, and 404 existence-hiding for unauthenticated callers.
whatBreaks: Backlinks API could leak document existence anonymously or return wrong/incomplete reference graphs

role: Contract tests pinning the GET /v1/capabilities manifest against real routes
description: Large regression suite guarding that CLI/SDK manifest entries (flag names, path templates, methods, auth tiers, arg shapes) exactly match the live router for doc, search, media, webhook, schema, workspace, auth-MFA, and build-identity commands — catching drafts.loop-class contract bugs where manifest and server disagree.
whatBreaks: A drifted manifest breaks the bp CLI and every generated SDK/cloud client silently (wrong param names, 404s, or wrong auth tiers) since they trust this contract at runtime.

role: contract test for CORS preflight behaviour
description: Integration tests verifying that CORS preflight OPTIONS requests return correct headers based on schema-level cors_origins config.
whatBreaks: CORS regressions block browser-based SDK consumers from accessing the API.

role: contract test for API response envelope shape
description: Short test pinning the standard JSON response envelope ({data, meta, errors}) to its expected structure.
whatBreaks: Envelope shape regressions break all SDK consumers that parse the standard response wrapper.

role: contract test for document expand/reference resolution
description: Tests the HTTP API's document expansion feature, verifying that reference fields are resolved and author/post cross-references work correctly via the query endpoint.
whatBreaks: Regressions in reference expansion go undetected, silently returning unresolved refs to API consumers.

role: contract test for document export endpoint
description: Tests the export endpoint behaviour, seeding published and draft documents then asserting correct export payload shape and publish-state filtering.
whatBreaks: Bugs in the export route (wrong draft/published filtering) go undetected and corrupt client exports.

role: Contract test proving federated search never widens via airdrop grants
description: Part of the ag-deny-matrix: confirms GET /v1/search/:dataset rides the bare :api pipeline (no AssignGrantScope), so a grant-only principal never sees cross-workspace docs their grant covers, proven non-vacuously against a Default-scope hit.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let a grant silently widen federated search, leaking documents across workspace boundaries

role: Regression test for a cross-workspace media leak in federated search
description: Stands up two workspaces sharing a dataset string, seeds media in each, and asserts the federated search route never leaks workspace A's media blob into workspace B's results — guards the fix for barkpark-se5b.
whatBreaks: A regression here means one tenant's private media assets become visible to another tenant via federated search — a serious multi-tenant data leak.

role: Contract tests for the /v1/search federated multi-surface search endpoint
description: Covers surfaces=documents,media fan-out, malformed ?surfaces[] fail-soft handling, dedup of duplicate surfaces, the anonymous limit clamp (doctested), and schema-driven private-field redaction on document hits.
whatBreaks: Broken surface handling could 500 the search endpoint or leak private fields to anonymous federated callers.

role: Contract tests for the document query filter DSL (bracket + scalar forms)
description: Exercises both filter[field][op]=value and scalar `field op value` filter syntaxes (eq, in, contains, is null, ^=, $=, *=, in/not in, ambiguous ' in ' text), field projection (?fields=), multi-field ordering, and fail-closed 400 handling for unknown/malformed operators.
whatBreaks: A filter-DSL regression could silently return wrong or unfiltered rows (e.g. an unrecognized op returning every document) — a correctness and data-exposure risk across all query consumers.

role: contract test for filter response shape
description: Tests that filtered query responses include correct document shape, field projection, and pagination metadata.
whatBreaks: Response shape regressions break SDK deserialization and client field access without obvious errors.

role: Contract tests for document revision history, get-revision, and restore endpoints
description: Covers listing/limiting revisions, fetching a single revision, restoring a revision as a draft (including publish-action revisions restoring as drafts not published rows), canonical halted-restore error envelopes, and cross-dataset revision IDOR guards (barkpark-vdmk).
whatBreaks: A regression could let one dataset's revision be read or restored via another dataset's URL (IDOR leak) or corrupt published documents during restore.

role: contract test for legacy API deprecation headers
description: Verifies that the legacy /api/* surface emits correct deprecation headers and that token-gating is enforced while schema discovery remains public.
whatBreaks: Missing deprecation headers or incorrect auth gating on legacy routes goes undetected, breaking clients that rely on header signals.

role: Contract test for SSE listen replay/format wire shape
description: Tests BarkparkWeb.ListenController.replay_since/2 and format_event/2 — cursor-based replay ordering and the mutation event frame's syncTags shape targeting the published id.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let real-time listen clients silently miss mutations or receive malformed SSE frames without any test catching it.

role: Tenant-isolation contract test for the SSE listen stream
description: Proves workspace-scoped replay_since/3 and forward_event?/2 isolate two workspaces sharing one dataset string, including delete-tombstone forwarding after the documents row is gone; guards a real cross-tenant leak class.
whatBreaks: Without this test a regression in ListenController's tenant scoping could leak one workspace's document events (including deletes) to another workspace's live listener, a serious multi-tenant data leak.

role: contract test for /v1/meta handshake endpoint
description: Tests the /v1/meta endpoint, asserting the handshake envelope contains all required keys (minApiVersion, maxApiVersion, serverTime) and that serverTime is parseable.
whatBreaks: Handshake envelope regressions break SDK version negotiation and client initialization checks.

role: Contract test for POST /v1/data/mutate batch semantics
description: Covers atomicity/rollback, revision-guard (ifRevisionID/If-Match) 412 handling, and every patch verb (set/unset/inc/dec/setIfMissing/append/prepend) including composition ordering and draft-id delete-guard coherence.
whatBreaks: A broken mutate pipeline (e.g. non-atomic batches or a mis-ordered patch verb) could corrupt documents or silently ignore concurrency guards across every consumer (CLI, SDK, Studio).

role: Contract test for GET /v1/data/query filtering/sorting/paging/etag
description: Exercises limit/offset, order (promoted columns, JSONB content fields, nested paths), scalar and structured filter forms (incl. TUI/CLI wire quoting quirks), count=true, and the query envelope's etag/If-None-Match caching contract.
whatBreaks: Query is the primary read path for every SDK/CLI/web consumer; a regression could return wrong pages, wrong sort order, or stale cached results via broken etags.

role: contract test for rate limiting
description: Tests that the API enforces rate limits, returning 429 after the threshold is exceeded on repeated requests.
whatBreaks: Rate-limit bypass or false-positive throttling goes undetected.

role: contract test for request-id header
description: Verifies that every API response includes a unique X-Request-Id header, enabling traceability.
whatBreaks: Missing request-id propagation goes undetected, hindering production debugging.

role: contract test for schema response envelope
description: Tests the shape and content of schema API responses — field structure, visibility, and envelope fields — across create/update/list operations.
whatBreaks: Schema envelope regressions silently break JS SDK and CLI schema introspection.

role: Contract test for schema index/show/upsert endpoints
description: Verifies _schemaVersion presence, rejection of structurally-invalid or reserved-prefix field payloads, and that a fields-less partial upsert skips re-validation of the stored definition.
whatBreaks: A broken schema upsert could let invalid field definitions persist or spuriously reject legitimate title-only edits, corrupting the schema registry consumers rely on.

role: Contract test pinning anonymous callers to published-only search results
description: DB-backed lock ensuring both /v1/data/search and federated /v1/search ignore ?perspective=drafts/raw for anonymous callers while authed callers still get drafts; seeds distinguishable draft/published content to prove non-vacuous.
whatBreaks: Unpublished/draft content could leak to anonymous public search callers, a security regression

role: Contract test for document/media search settings endpoints
description: Checks admin get/update of zero-hit strategy and searchable_fields, plus the §9 validation_failed error envelope (code + request_id) for a bad settings payload.
whatBreaks: Search settings misbehavior would degrade search relevance tuning or silently drop the standardized error envelope SDKs key off of.

role: Contract test for search synonyms CRUD, promote/preview, insights
description: Covers synonym create/list/delete, query expansion via synonym target, insights (zeroHitRate/recoveryRate/synonymCandidates), and the standardized validation_failed/not_found error envelope across both document and media surfaces.
whatBreaks: Broken synonym handling would degrade search quality (missed expansions) or break error-code contracts CLI/SDK exit codes depend on.

role: contract test for search query API
description: Tests the search endpoint: returns matching documents, respects filters, and returns correct envelope shape for search results.
whatBreaks: Search API contract drift goes undetected, breaking web finder and SDK consumers.

role: Contract test for webhook CRUD + auto-disable/reenable lifecycle
description: Covers full CRUD, admin-auth gating, validation, and the auto-disable-after-failures → reenable recovery flow with fresh failure-budget reset.
whatBreaks: A regression could leave webhooks stuck disabled after a valid reenable, or fail to auto-disable a flaky endpoint, silently breaking downstream integrations.

role: Controller tests for the /v1/access airdrop-grant JSON API
description: Covers mint/list/show/revoke/claim for Barkpark.Access grants: no-escalation on mint, workspace-scoped listing with no link_token_hash leak, grantor/admin-only show, idempotent revoke, and the shared no-oracle ClaimFlow (byte-identical failures across wrong-account/expired/used/unconfirmed, shared with the browser GrantController).
whatBreaks: Grant minting could escalate permissions, leak token hashes, or the claim endpoint could become an oracle revealing grant/account state

role: Tests for api_token owner_user_id identity binding on the access-grant surface
description: Proves NULL-owner tokens cannot claim grants (fail closed), owned tokens claim and bind grantee_user_id, self-mint cannot escalate to another user's ownership, owned tokens are user-scoped in 'access mine', and org-required-MFA gates both claim and token-mint issuance paths.
whatBreaks: A CLI/terminal principal could claim grants as the wrong user, or an unowned token could improperly authenticate as a user, or MFA issuance gates could be bypassed

role: Controller tests for the core /v1/auth HTTP surface
description: Covers register (incl. no email-enumeration), login/me/logout, TOTP MFA enroll/verify/disable with re-auth, multi-session management, step-up MFA for sensitive actions, and email verify/reset flows including malformed-param 422-not-500 hardening.
whatBreaks: Authentication, session, or MFA regressions would compromise account security or lock out users across the entire API

role: Test: GDPR export/erase HTTP surface (/v1/auth/export, /v1/auth/erase)
description: Exercises the data-subject GDPR endpoints end-to-end via ConnCase: export returns the caller's own account/sessions/memberships bundle, erase requires password reauth and cascades to revoke sessions and scrub PII, with 401/403/400 edge cases covered.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let GDPR export/erase silently break (no confirmation the erase actually revokes sessions or scrubs the password) without any test failing.

role: Test: passwordless magic-link auth HTTP surface
description: Covers POST /v1/auth/request-magic-link (no email-enumeration leak, generic ok) and POST /v1/auth/magic-login (single-use token consumption, session issuance, invalid/missing token handling).
whatBreaks: A broken magic-link flow (e.g. token reuse allowed, or email enumeration leaking) would go undetected, weakening passwordless auth security guarantees.

role: Test: Bulldocs paper-as-email route (GET /papers/:slug/email)
description: Ingests a published paper with heading/paragraph/callout/task-list blocks and asserts the email route serves a complete standalone inline-styled HTML document via the :email render style (evergreen palette, no <style> tags), plus a 404 for unknown slugs.
whatBreaks: Broken email rendering would ship malformed or unstyled emails (or leak <style> tags that email clients strip/mangle) without detection.

role: Controller test for the Bulldocs paper-ingest + block-ops API
description: Exercises ingest-token auth, upsert-by-slug, single and batch block ops (append/patch), atomic batch rollback on mid-batch failure, constraint-vocabulary vetoes (e.g. max-1 featured block), and optimistic-concurrency ifRev guard — the wire contract external producers (paperflow) and the Papers/Bulldocs plugin depend on.
whatBreaks: A regression could corrupt Papers content (partial batch applies), break external plan-ingest pipelines, or let constraint-violating block structures persist, both of which core render/edit machinery assumes hold.

role: Controller test for Bulldocs pending-intents API (loop-closer)
description: Verifies ingest-token auth, that GET lists only actionable pending intents (excluding lifecycle events), and that POST .../processed marks an intent so it's omitted from subsequent listings, including 404 handling for unknown/non-UUID ids.
whatBreaks: A regression could cause the same actionable intent to be processed repeatedly or lost entirely, breaking the automation loop that consumes pending action:*/simplify-* events.

role: Test: AI-proposes-into-paper draft/publish/provenance loop (lvw-t4)
description: Large adversarial suite for POST /v1/plugins/bulldocs/papers/:slug/proposals proving three invariants: proposals never mutate the published doc, every proposal carries a provenance edge pinned to the draft row (rolled back atomically if the source is unresolvable), and approval reuses the existing publish_document/discard_draft gate with provenance surviving publish/extraction.
whatBreaks: If these invariants regress, an AI proposal could silently corrupt published prose, lose provenance, or leave orphaned draft/edge rows on failure — a data-integrity risk for the core Papers content model.

role: Test: BarkparkWeb.ErrorHTML template rendering (404/500/catch-all)
description: Directly renders ErrorHTML templates and asserts they return safe iodata with expected minimal markup for 404, 500, and arbitrary status catch-all pages; guards against the render/2 output being HTML-escaped instead of raw markup.
whatBreaks: A regressed ErrorHTML module would make every unhandled browser-route error crash or render escaped/garbled text instead of a usable error page.

role: Test for crash-path error envelope renderer
description: Asserts BarkparkWeb.ErrorJSON emits the same canonical v1 error envelope (error.code/message/request_id) as FallbackController on 404/500/other crashes, and never leaks exception detail. Guards SDK/CLI's ability to key on error.code uniformly across controller errors and crashes.
whatBreaks: A regressed ErrorJSON template would leak stack traces or emit a shape SDKs can't parse on unhandled crashes.

role: Test: full endpoint→RenderErrors→ErrorJSON/HTML crash-safety integration
description: Uses a test-only /__error_test__/boom route to raise inside the real Endpoint and asserts RenderErrors produces well-formed JSON/HTML error envelopes without leaking exception detail, plus verifies unknown routes 404 cleanly in both formats; pins a prior real bug where the renderer crashed and dropped the connection.
whatBreaks: Without this guard, any unhandled exception could crash the connection outright or leak internal error detail (e.g. stack messages) to clients instead of the generic envelope.

role: Test: NDJSON dataset export field-visibility leak-guard (GET /v1/data/export/:dataset)
description: Verifies the export endpoint routes through the same Envelope.render/3 redaction chokepoint as all other reads: non-admin tokens never see private/visibility:private fields (including per-type schema redaction across a multi-type export and encrypted-field ciphertext-at-rest), admin tokens see everything, and schemas with no privacy metadata are byte-identical for both.
whatBreaks: A regression would let a non-admin token bulk-export private/PII fields (e.g. SSNs) via the export endpoint, a serious data leak.

role: Test: scoped-access grant enforcement on legacy flat /v1/data read routes
description: Proves the ag-enforcement grant plugs (ResolveTokenOwner + AssignGrantScope) correctly narrow an owned token with an active Default-workspace grant to exactly its (dataset,type) scope on the back-compat flat routes, while non-grantees/unowned tokens stay byte-identical, the write path is unaffected, and expired/revoked grants stop narrowing live.
whatBreaks: A regression could let a grant-scoped token read outside its intended (dataset,type) scope, or a write-capable grant could wrongly elevate write access — a tenancy/authorization leak.

role: Test: GithubAdoptController param handling + status-code mapping
description: Drives GithubAdoptController.adopt/2 directly with a stubbed injected adopt function (config seam) to isolate controller responsibilities: dataset default, tenant-scope threading (workspace/project assigns → scope_opts), and mapping of {:ok}/{:error, :not_intake}/{:error, :not_found}/other to 200/409/404/422.
whatBreaks: Wrong status mapping or dropped tenant scope would make GitHub-adopt intake operations silently succeed/fail incorrectly or write into the wrong workspace/project.

role: Test: GithubStatusController read-only health passthrough
description: Drives GithubStatusController.status/2 directly with a stubbed health-snapshot function, verifying the optional ?dataset= filter is forwarded (blank coerced to nil for whole-fleet view) and the snapshot is wrapped as {ok:true, health:...} at 200, even when the plugin is dark (empty map).
whatBreaks: A broken status endpoint would give operators a false picture of GitHub sync health (wrong dataset filter or malformed envelope) without any visible failure.

role: Unit tests for GitHub webhook controller's event dispatch
description: Tests GithubWebhookController.receive/2 in isolation by injecting stub Intake/InboundEvents handlers via config seams, covering issues-event routing (opened→Intake, deleted/transferred/closed→InboundEvents), status-code contracts for every outcome tuple (born/exists/dropped/ignored/refused/error), workspace_id threading (D15), and non-issues event no-ops.
whatBreaks: regressions in webhook status-code mapping could cause GitHub retry-storms or silently drop issue intake without being caught pre-deploy

role: End-to-end test proving the GitHub webhook HMAC+intake pipeline
description: Posts a raw signed JSON body through the live /v1/plugins/github/webhook endpoint (real Plug.Parsers/CacheBodyReader/router/Signature/Intake), asserting a real gh-<num> task is born on a valid signature and that a tampered body 401s with zero tasks created — closing a gap left by the layer-isolated controller/signature tests.
whatBreaks: a HMAC gate bypass or Intake integration break in production (e.g. forged webhook payloads accepted, or genuine deliveries silently failing) would go undetected

role: Tests for the airdrop-grant claim flow (GET /grant/:token)
description: Covers happy-path claim + account binding, anonymous redirect to /login with return_to, and the critical no-oracle security property (wrong-grantee, expired, already-spent, and unconfirmed-account failures are all byte-identical to a nonexistent token).
whatBreaks: a broken no-oracle guarantee lets an attacker probe which grant tokens/emails exist, or lets an unconfirmed/wrong account bind someone else's granted access

role: Regression/reproduction test for a grant-scoped search authorization leak
description: Proves search over a granted dataset returns in-scope results, with a positive control for unowned tokens; the actual deny assertion is committed @tag :skip as a documented, executable reproduction of a CONFIRMED leak (QueryPipeline drops grant_scoped, Postgres retriever never calls maybe_scope_to_grants) tracked as task ag-search-grant-leak.
whatBreaks: if silently unskipped/deleted without the underlying product fix landing, the repo loses its only executable proof that grant-scoped search leaks out-of-scope documents

role: Deny-matrix tests for grant-scoped single-doc read and backlinks endpoints
description: Proves QueryController.show correctly 404s on out-of-scope dataset/type for a grantee (enforced), while QueryController.backlinks does NOT apply grant narrowing — that deny case is committed @tag :skip as a reproduction of a confirmed leak (task ag-backlinks-grant-leak), with positive controls for both.
whatBreaks: loses the executable proof of the backlinks grant-scope leak, or a regression in show's enforcement (currently correct) would go undetected letting grantees read out-of-scope documents

role: Contract tests for /v1/graph/* content-graph endpoints
description: Covers graph_show/orphans/dangling/tasks routes on TasksController, including a deliberate stale-router-beam trip-wire (route must not 404) and the expectation reverse-view (tasks citing a design doc via design_doc edges, criteria_progress). Exercises Content.Graph and EdgeProjector wiring.
whatBreaks: Regressions in graph traversal, edge projection, or router recompilation would go undetected, silently breaking task/paper backlink features.

role: test for legacy URL redirects
description: Smoke-tests 301/302 redirects for legacy /studio/:ds/onixedit/book/* and /bokbasen/* URLs, verifying correct status codes and query-string preservation after the plugin-highway cutover.
whatBreaks: Legacy URL redirect regressions silently break bookmarked/hardcoded client URLs.

role: Tests for SSE stream field-visibility redaction and owner-row ACL
description: Exercises ListenController.redacted_result/4 and replay_since/3 as public test seams (since the live SSE loop can't be driven directly), proving private/encrypted fields never leak to non-admin subscribers on both live and replay paths, keyset-paginated replay correctness across batch boundaries (including cross-tenant leak guards), owner_scoped ACL dropping, and live/replay previousRev serialization parity, plus Accept-header negotiation for text/event-stream.
whatBreaks: a redaction regression would stream private/PII fields (e.g. SSNs) or another tenant's/owner's document rows to unauthorized SSE subscribers in real time

role: Tests for the signed one-time login-ticket handoff (dwb-7)
description: Covers minting requiring a valid bearer, consume setting session api_token + redirect, a real LiveAuth :admin mount pass-through, a 25-way concurrent single-use race proving exactly one winner, expiry enforcement, no-oracle failure parity across unknown/used/expired tickets, and one-time-link hardening headers (no-store, no-referrer).
whatBreaks: a race-condition regression could let a login ticket be double-spent (session hijack), or an oracle leak could let an attacker distinguish valid-but-expired tickets from nonexistent ones

role: Tests for USER-shaped login tickets (Barkpark Cloud identity handoff)
description: Pins security properties on top of the base login-ticket flow: minting with an email requires admin privilege, consume JIT-provisions a user + grants Default-workspace owner and mints a user_session (not api_token), existing users/memberships are reused not duplicated/downgraded, tickets stay single-use, and omitting email falls back to legacy token-shaped behavior.
whatBreaks: a privilege-gate regression could let a read-only token mint an owner-granting login ticket, or JIT provisioning could downgrade/duplicate an existing user's membership

role: Contract tests for /v1/data/mutate write endpoint
description: Covers the RequireWritePermission gate, v1-vs-v2 (Accept-Version) error envelope shaping, and a critical draft-vs-published merge-base regression (patches must merge from and write to the draft row, not the published row, to avoid data loss).
whatBreaks: A regression here could silently overwrite published content with stale draft merges or let read-only tokens write, causing data loss or an auth bypass.

role: Class-sweep regression guard against non-binary query-param 500s
description: Unit-tests the shared BarkparkWeb.ParamCoercion.bin/1 seam plus a table-driven sweep firing array (?q[]=) and map (?q[k]=) query params at every controller endpoint that reads a scalar param (search, media, legacy, federated, pagination), asserting none crash with 500; documents two real endpoints that 500'd pre-fix.
whatBreaks: a newly-added controller reading a raw scalar query param without the ParamCoercion seam would 500 on crafted/malformed input instead of failing cleanly, and this guard would no longer catch it

role: Tests for the OIDC Relying-Party HTTP surface (era-w3-oidc-rp)
description: Uses a mock IdP behaviour (signed JWT + JWKS) to test GET start redirecting to the IdP authorize endpoint with PKCE (code_challenge_method=S256) and stashed verifier/state, callback minting a valid user session on matching state, callback rejection on mismatched state (CSRF guard), and 404 for an org with no OIDC connection.
whatBreaks: a state-mismatch check regression would open an OIDC login CSRF hole; a callback regression could break SSO sign-in for organizations using OIDC

role: Test: GET /v1/openapi.json route, ETag/304 behavior
description: Pins the published token-free OpenAPI 3.1 descriptor endpoint — asserts 200 with valid body, weak ETag header, and If-None-Match short-circuit to 304, mirroring CapabilitiesController's caching contract.
whatBreaks: A regression in the OpenAPI descriptor route or its ETag caching would ship undetected, breaking API-doc consumers and cache-aware clients.

role: Test: org-level require_mfa enforcement gate on session surface
description: Covers the era-w2-org-require-mfa enforcement: unenrolled governed users get 403 mfa_enrolment_required on most routes but keep /me, /logout, and enrolment reachable; enrolling opens the gate; ungoverned orgs stay a zero-tax no-op.
whatBreaks: A broken MFA gate could either lock out compliant users or silently fail to enforce org-mandated MFA, a security-relevant regression.

role: test for root/studio redirect
description: Two assertions confirming that GET / and GET /studio both 302 redirect to the scoped studio URL pattern.
whatBreaks: Studio entry-point redirect regressions go undetected.

role: Test: PaperBacklinks.section_html/1 reader render logic
description: Pure unit tests for the Papers reader's 'Linked mentions'/'Used by' backlink section — covers empty input, HTML escaping, unresolved-referencer skipping, and the valueref-kind 'Used by' grouping split from generic mentions.
whatBreaks: Backlink rendering could leak unescaped HTML (XSS) or show broken/opaque links to unresolvable docs in the public Papers reader.

role: Test: PaperTasks.section_html/1 'Driven tasks' render logic
description: Covers the reverse view (lvw-t8) rendering of tasks a paper drives — satisfied vs unmet criteria markers, evidence display, progress chip omission when nil, and HTML escaping of all user strings.
whatBreaks: Malformed or unescaped task/criteria data could XSS the paper reader or show misleading fake progress (e.g. bogus 0/0).

role: Contract tests for /v1/plugins/settings/:plugin_name admin API
description: Covers admin-only auth gating, canonical error envelopes, and the secret-masking round-trip (masked GET body re-PUT must not clobber the real stored secret) for plugin settings storage.
whatBreaks: A masking regression could leak or destroy stored plugin secrets (e.g. API keys) via the settings UI round-trip.

role: test for book-type document queries
description: Tests query controller behaviour for book-type documents in a dedicated dataset, covering scoped workspace/project fixture seeding and read operations via flat routes.
whatBreaks: Book-query regressions in scoped tenancy go undetected.

role: regression test for cross-tenant expand leak
description: Proves that the ?expand= query parameter correctly applies workspace scope when resolving references, preventing the cross-tenant read leak where workspace B's documents could be embedded in workspace A's responses.
whatBreaks: If removed or broken, a cross-tenant data leak via ?expand= could go undetected, exposing one workspace's content to another.

role: Test: QueryController fail-closed filter-op validation guard
description: Pure unit test (no DB) for invalid_filter_op/1 which rejects unknown filter ops and non-scalar values for range ops (gt/gte/lt/lte), ensuring the query API fails closed rather than silently accepting malformed filters.
whatBreaks: A weakened filter guard could let malformed query filters through to the DB layer, risking incorrect results or errors across the widely-used /v1/data/query endpoint.

role: Test: ?resolve=tasks query-API resolve seam for task-list blocks
description: Verifies the opt-in resolve seam that turns a paper's task-list query block into a resolved snapshot (for pdrender/web/exports) on both index and show routes, preserves author-pinned snapshots untouched, and fails closed on cross-tenant task leakage.
whatBreaks: Consumers relying on resolved task snapshots (Go pdrender, web, exports) could get stale query blocks or, worse, leak another tenant's task rows into resolved output.

role: Test: GET /v1/instance/request-stats agent-token endpoint
description: Covers auth (401 without/with bogus token) and the response contract shape {req_per_s, p95_ms, window_s} for the instance request-stats endpoint, asserting p95_ms is honestly null rather than a fake 0ms when no samples exist.
whatBreaks: Broken auth could expose instance telemetry without a token, or malformed stats could mislead operators/agents monitoring API load.

role: Test: SAML SP HTTP surface (ACS login, JIT provisioning, SLO)
description: Exercises the full SAML SP flow: POST ACS consuming a signed assertion mints a session and JIT-provisions org membership, malformed base64 returns 400, and IdP-initiated Single Logout revokes sessions only when signed by the trusted cert (untrusted-signer forgery is rejected with 401); also covers SP-initiated logout returning slo_url.
whatBreaks: A SAML signature-validation or session-mint bug is a severe auth vulnerability — could allow unauthorized login or block legitimate SSO users, and an SLO bug could let forged logout requests kill arbitrary sessions.

role: Test: SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2/Groups group-to-role mapping
description: Covers group→custom-role mapping enforced at Auth.authorize/3 (membership add/remove flips permissions), audit logging of membership changes, validation of unknown mapped roles, org isolation of groups, and the Ecto.CastError-to-404 guard for malformed group ids.
whatBreaks: A broken SCIM group mapping could grant or revoke the wrong permissions via IdP-driven group sync, or leak/500 on cross-org group access.

role: Test: SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2/Users provisioning + instant deprovision
description: Covers user provisioning (confirmed user, workspace membership, passwordless login), audit events, DELETE hard-deprovision (revokes all sessions + membership) and PATCH active:false soft-deprovision, org isolation, and the Ecto.CastError-to-404 guard for malformed user ids.
whatBreaks: A broken deprovision path is a security incident (ex-employee retains access); broken org isolation could let one org see or delete another org's users via SCIM.

role: Security contract tests for the scoped public paper reader
description: Verifies /w/:ws/p/:project/papers/:slug is public ONLY when its scope is explicitly shared via Barkpark.Sharing for the :papers surface, with anonymous-Default-workspace allowance, tenancy isolation of backlinks, and no-leak on missing slugs.
whatBreaks: A gating regression could expose private workspace papers to anonymous callers or leak cross-tenant backlink data — a security breach.

role: Test: loopback-only fast-path search endpoint
description: Covers GET /v1/data/local/search/:dataset — asserts the loopback IP gate (IPv4/IPv6) silently 403s non-local callers and that response shape matches the standard search endpoint.
whatBreaks: A regression here misses a broken loopback gate that could expose the local fast-path search endpoint externally or diverge its response shape from /v1/data/search.

role: Test: admin-only /v1/secrets CRUD + masking contract
description: Covers 401/403 auth gating, admin PUT/GET/DELETE lifecycle, masked list values vs unmasked reveal-on-GET, and canonical error envelope shape (code + request_id).
whatBreaks: Undetected breakage could let non-admin tokens read/write secrets or leak unmasked secret values in list responses.

role: Test: /v1/admin/self-update runner contract
description: Covers auth gating, fail-closed 503 when disabled, the 202 run + log-capture happy path, and 409 single-flight guard against concurrent runs via the Runner GenServer singleton.
whatBreaks: A broken self-update endpoint could allow concurrent shell command execution or leak the configured command instead of just its output.

role: test for browser session login/logout controller
description: Tests GET /login form rendering and POST /login success/failure paths including redirect, open-redirect defense, and POST /logout session teardown.
whatBreaks: Auth regressions in the session controller (invalid-token leaks, open-redirect holes) go undetected.

role: Test: branded login/reset/magic-link HTML pages
description: Covers the /login page's optional Cloud login button, forgot-password and magic-link request/landing pages, anti-enumeration behavior, and TOTP-armed magic-link routing through the second MFA step instead of signing in directly.
whatBreaks: A regression could let magic-link logins bypass 2FA, break password reset, or leak whether an email is registered (enumeration).

role: Admin CRUD contract tests for /v1/shares registry
description: Covers auth gating (admin-only), canonical error envelopes, add/remove/list of scope-level shares, and env-vs-stored share source tagging that drives the anonymous public-reader gates elsewhere in the app.
whatBreaks: A bug in share add/remove could make private content publicly readable or fail to revoke exposure as expected.

role: Contract tests for per-item /s/:token share links
description: Covers minting/revoking item share links for paper/doc/media, anonymous serving with private-field redaction, media MIME-sniffing neutralization for dangerous legacy blobs, and static-render fallback when the link's scope no longer resolves.
whatBreaks: A regression could leak private fields, serve executable SVG/script content inline (stored XSS), or 500 instead of gracefully falling back.

role: test for share token mint/list/revoke API
description: Tests /v1/shares/tokens endpoints for minting, listing, and revoking share tokens, verifying admin-only gating and that raw tokens are never re-exposed after minting.
whatBreaks: Token management security bugs (token re-exposure, missing auth gates) go undetected.

role: test for share-aware document read routes security contract
description: Tests that a :docs share opens anonymous read-only document queries for the exact shared scope and surface, while writes and cross-scope reads remain gated; the largest and most thorough sharing security test suite in the batch.
whatBreaks: Critical document sharing security regressions (write escalation, cross-scope leaks, surface confusion) go undetected.

role: test for scoped-share edit write path security
description: Tests that edit-share tokens can mutate only their exact bound scope, verifying scope isolation (workspace, project, dataset), privilege escalation prevention on the flat mutate route, anonymous write denial, and live registry kill-switch.
whatBreaks: Edit-share privilege escalation or scope isolation bugs go undetected, enabling unauthorized writes.

role: Security tests for share-aware scoped media surface
description: Verifies the media list/meta/file-serve routes under a shared workspace scope are strictly scope-isolated (no cross-workspace file access) and surface-exact (a :media share does not open via :docs/:papers shares or vice versa).
whatBreaks: A scoping bug could let an anonymous caller with one workspace's media share read another workspace's uploaded files.

role: Route-level tests for Sheets wire-op API (POST .../ops)
description: Exercises the ingest-token-gated cell/structural/undo-redo op endpoint over Barkpark.Plugins.Sheets.Session, including batch caps, session-death 503 handling, and the export-flush read-your-writes guarantee (failed flush must 503, never serve stale data as fresh).
whatBreaks: A regression could serve stale sheet data as fresh, corrupt formula recompute, or let a dead session silently drop writes.

role: Route-level tests for Sheets import/export conversion API
description: Covers ingest-token auth, xlsx/csv/tsv import with size/cell caps (413), and export in xlsx/csv/tsv/md/html formats including a full HTTP round-trip fidelity check (import -> export -> re-import equality).
whatBreaks: A regression could corrupt spreadsheet conversions (lost formulas/formatting) or let oversized uploads bypass caps and exhaust resources.

role: Test: social OAuth login start/callback HTTP surface
description: Covers GET /v1/auth/social/:provider/start redirect and callback session minting via a mocked HTTP client, including state-mismatch rejection and 404 for unconfigured providers.
whatBreaks: A broken state-check test could hide a CSRF vulnerability in social login callbacks (state mismatch not actually rejected).

role: Test: SSO domain routing + OIDC JIT provisioning
description: Covers POST /v1/auth/sso/route domain lookup and a full OIDC callback flow with a mocked IdP verifying JWT signature, asserting just-in-time user provisioning into org workspaces via membership creation.
whatBreaks: A regression could break enterprise SSO login routing or silently fail to provision new SSO users into the correct organization workspace.

role: Test: public status page + admin incident management
description: Covers GET /status.json and /status HTML rendering of component health/SLA, admin-created incidents degrading overall status, resolution restoring it, and 401 for anonymous incident management.
whatBreaks: A broken status page could misreport system health publicly or allow unauthenticated incident creation.

role: Conn tests for GET /v1/structure/:dataset (Studio/TUI desk tree)
description: Verifies the canonical structure tree endpoint returns typed nodes matching what Studio renders, including the tiered MAIN/Plugins/…Rest grouping. Guards that TUI and Studio desk share one server-built tree.
whatBreaks: Regressions here would let the TUI and Studio navigation trees silently diverge or omit document types.

role: Test: Studio flat-URL redirect Referer-based scope preference
description: Pins the fix for the 'teleport' bug where flat /studio/:dataset links always landed on the alphabetically-first workspace membership; verifies Referer-derived workspace preference is membership-verified and safely falls back (missing/cross-origin/non-member/unparseable Referer) to first-membership, always via 302.
whatBreaks: Regression could either reintroduce the teleport bug (wrong workspace) or let a forged Referer header steer users into a workspace they don't belong to.

role: Test: Studio account login, MFA, org-require-MFA, admin gate
description: Covers /login/account email+password sign-in with TOTP second step and org-mandated MFA blocking, user-principal access to scoped Studio (member vs non-member 403), LiveAuth admin gate for owner-in-Default users, logout revocation, and coexistence with legacy token-paste login and JSON SSO callback errors.
whatBreaks: A regression could let users bypass MFA, access foreign workspace Studio scopes, or reach the org-admin LiveView without owner rights.

role: Test: pure Ecto.Query builders for Tasks controller param parsing
description: DB-free unit tests for TasksController.Params filter/parse helpers — asserts array-style query params fail soft (no 500), parse_int/parse_limit clamp safely, and workspace-scope filtering unifies with Content.Scope.scope_to_workspace under a fail-closed nil rule.
whatBreaks: A regression could crash bp task ready/list on malformed query params, or reopen a fail-open nil-scope hole exposing all tenants' task data.

role: Contract tests for the bd-shim Tasks HTTP surface (bp task CLI backend)
description: Covers ready/claim/close/edges/add_edge endpoints including error shapes (no_ready, fenced_off) and auth failure; large file (1442 lines) mirroring the whole bp task CLI contract.
whatBreaks: Undetected regressions would break `bp task` claim/close semantics used for all repo-wide task tracking.

role: Test: POST /v1/tasks/:doc_id/move envelope contract
description: Exercises rail_rev/from_rail_rev semantics on task-move (root moves, cycle/invalid-parent 409s, no-op moves, bare-id resolution). Guards the task-tree reparenting HTTP surface used by the rail-awareness system.
whatBreaks: A regression here means move endpoint could silently allow cycles or corrupt rail_rev digests undetected, breaking multi-agent task-tree integrity.

role: Test: rail-awareness fields on claim/close/prime task endpoints
description: Covers rail_rev presence rules, blocked_while_claimed notices, and rail_changed detection across claim/queue-claim/close/prime — the core multi-agent coordination contract for bp task.
whatBreaks: Silent breakage would let concurrent agents claim/close tasks without seeing blockers or rail changes, causing lost or conflicting work in the task system.

role: Unit test for TicketKeysController.host_base/1 URL derivation
description: Verifies the base-URL computation used in ticket handoff cards behaves correctly behind proxies (x-forwarded-proto, port elision). Narrow unit scope, no route wiring tested.
whatBreaks: Wrong host_base would make the handoff card's verbatim curl commands 308-redirect-fail for key holders behind the prod proxy.

role: Test: Tickets controller logic (submitter/operator actions)
description: Directly invokes TicketsController actions with hand-built conns to test identity-from-credential, derived status, and tenancy-scoped fail-closed triage rows, independent of router wiring.
whatBreaks: Ticket visibility/scoping bugs could leak cross-workspace tickets or misattribute operator identity in the external support inbox.

role: Test: scoped-admin public-read token minting endpoint
description: Verifies POST /w/:ws/p/:project/v1/tokens is gated to workspace admins/owners and that minted tokens are read-only (write/admin requests get 422, no token issued).
whatBreaks: A gating regression would let non-admins mint API tokens or let a minted 'read-only' token gain write access — a security hole.

role: Test: WebAuthn/passkey registration+assertion HTTP flow
description: Runs a real ES256 software authenticator through the full ceremony (attestation + assertion) against the passkey endpoints via the wax library, without a browser.
whatBreaks: Passkey login could silently break or accept forged attestations, locking users out or weakening auth security.

role: Test: operator-console webhook delivery log/replay/rotation API
description: Covers admin-scoped, dataset-fenced webhook delivery listing, synchronous replay via a recording HTTP stub, and secret rotation for the instance webhook operator console.
whatBreaks: Broken replay or scoping could expose another tenant's webhook deliveries or make secret rotation silently fail, breaking downstream integrations.

role: Conn tests for membership-scoped workspace/project list API
description: Confirms GET /api/workspaces and /api/workspaces/:slug/projects only return the caller's own memberships, guarding the tenant boundary against cross-workspace leaks; also checks 401 unauth and 404 non-member/unknown slug.
whatBreaks: A silently broken membership filter could leak other tenants' workspace/project lists.

role: Security test: private field never leaks via legacy dump or query oracle
description: Negative tests proving private/secret fields never reach unauthorized callers through /api/documents/* legacy dump or as filter/order oracles on /v1/data/query.
whatBreaks: Regression here means private field values (e.g. salaries, secrets) leak to anonymous or unauthorized API callers — a direct data-leak vulnerability.

role: Test: session cookie Secure flag toggling with PHX_SCHEME
description: Small, focused test asserting the session cookie is marked Secure only when served over HTTPS (PHX_SCHEME=https), guarding against cookie leakage over plain HTTP.
whatBreaks: A wrong Secure flag could leak session cookies over plain HTTP, or block sessions entirely if forced Secure on plain-HTTP prod.

role: test for error envelope serializer
description: Unit tests BarkparkWeb.ErrorEnvelope.serialize_v1/1, verifying that validation violation maps are flattened to the standard error array shape.
whatBreaks: Malformed API error responses ship undetected, breaking clients that parse the error envelope.

role: Live-IdP interop test for OIDC/SAML SSO against real Keycloak
description: Opt-in suite (@moduletag :idp_interop, excluded by default) that drives full OIDC PKCE and SAML handshakes against a real Keycloak container via scripts/idp-interop.sh, proving interop beyond in-repo mocks.
whatBreaks: Undetected SSO interop regressions would only surface with real enterprise IdPs in production, not in the default CI suite, risking broken customer SSO logins.

role: Integration test pinning the plugin before_publish halt→409 contract
description: Exercises MutateController→Content.publish_document→Plugins.Hooks halt path end-to-end, asserting the canonical error envelope (code/message/request_id/hint) and that no published copy is written on halt.
whatBreaks: A regression could silently publish content despite a plugin veto, or return an error shape the CLI/SDK can't parse.

role: Integration tests for legacy /api/documents/* CRUD compat surface
description: Pins GET/POST/DELETE behavior and Deprecation/Sunset/Link headers for the Go TUI's backward-compat endpoints, plus plugin halt-on-write/delete behavior.
whatBreaks: Legacy TUI clients relying on /api/documents/* could break without any other test coverage catching it.

role: Integration test for media asset delivery/rendition path
description: Uploads a tiny inline PNG and exercises the Media/Assets delivery pipeline, cleaning up files and DB rows created outside the SQL sandbox.
whatBreaks: Media rendition/delivery regressions (broken image URLs, missing renditions) would go unnoticed.

role: Integration tests for /media/* upload/list/meta/serve HTTP surface
description: Pins upload auth requirements, 400 on missing file, listing, per-file metadata, and byte serving with 404s for unknowns; manages on-disk cleanup since uploads escape the DB sandbox.
whatBreaks: Media upload/serving regressions (auth bypass, broken 404s, disk leaks) would ship undetected.

role: integration test for mutation success paths
description: Pins the publish, unpublish, and delete success paths on POST /v1/data/mutate/:dataset, complementing existing failure-path coverage.
whatBreaks: Regressions in core document publish/unpublish/delete mutations ship undetected.

role: Integration test for the /v1/preview/* draft-preview pipeline
description: Drives the full AcceptBarkparkVendor→RateLimit→PreviewToken→QueryController pipeline with real JWTs, confirming drafts are served only with a valid Preview token and every other shape 401s; JTI replay protection means each JWT is single-use.
whatBreaks: A broken preview-token check could either block legitimate previews or leak draft content publicly.

role: tenancy-leak guard test for preview routes
description: Guards against the regression where the :api_preview pipeline lacked AssignDefaultScope, which allowed preview-JWT requests to read other workspaces' drafts across tenant boundaries.
whatBreaks: A future pipeline change could reintroduce cross-tenant draft reads via preview tokens without detection.

role: Integration test for plugin resolver chain (top_menu/desk/schemas) end-to-end
description: Confirms a plugin's top_menu_entries, desk_items, and register_schemas contributions surface through legacy/admin schema endpoints and the scoped Studio LiveView chrome; also unit-checks Registry.collect_* directly.
whatBreaks: Plugin-contributed nav/schema entries (e.g. OnixEdit) could silently stop appearing in Studio or the API.

role: Integration tests for admin-only schema CRUD (POST/DELETE /v1/schemas)
description: Covers the write side of schema management: create/delete with admin token, 401/403 on missing/non-admin auth, 422 on malformed body, 404 on delete of unknown schema — the path plugin schemas land through.
whatBreaks: An auth or validation regression here could let non-admins mutate schemas or corrupt schema definitions.

role: integration test for search suggestions API
description: Tests the v1 search suggestions endpoint, verifying autocomplete/typeahead responses under various query shapes and auth conditions.
whatBreaks: Search suggestion endpoint regressions go undetected, degrading the finder UX.

role: Integration tests for the v1 Media collections API
description: Exercises the media collections endpoints (create/list/attach assets to a collection) over HTTP with an admin token, draining the async processing TaskSupervisor between assertions. Covers Content/Media/Assets plumbing together, not a unit test of any single module.
whatBreaks: A regression in the media collections API (auth, dataset scoping, or association shape) would ship unnoticed to the Studio media library and public media endpoints.

role: Integration tests for media checkout/governance (locking) API
