description: Verifies asset checkout/lock ownership semantics (e.g. 'checkedOutBy' label correctness) using two distinct tokens to avoid a token-hash collision gotcha documented inline; also covers SignedUrl usage.
whatBreaks: Broken checkout/lock enforcement could let two editors silently clobber the same media asset or misattribute who has it locked.

role: Integration tests for image rendition processing failure handling
description: Uses a swappable ImageBackend behaviour and a stub FailBackend to simulate libvips/ARM 'Failed to find load' errors, asserting SVGs are skipped by the rendition gate and PNG rendition failures are handled deterministically.
whatBreaks: Unhandled image-processing failures could crash the async task supervisor or leave assets stuck with missing renditions on ARM prod hosts.

role: integration test for media search insights
description: Tests the media search insights endpoints that return analytics/stats about media search usage.
whatBreaks: Media search insight regressions go undetected, producing incorrect analytics data.

role: integration test for media search suggestions endpoint
description: Integration test for the v1 media search suggestions API, covering search event recording and suggestion retrieval with auth token setup.
whatBreaks: Media search suggestion regressions go undetected.

role: Integration tests for the v1 Media search endpoint
description: Uploads PNG assets via multipart and asserts they become searchable/filterable through the media search API, draining async processing before assertions.
whatBreaks: A broken media search index/query path would make uploaded assets unfindable in the Studio media library.

role: Core integration tests for the v1 Media upload/CRUD API
description: Covers basic asset upload, read-only vs admin token permission gating, and CRUD flows against Barkpark.Media/Assets — the baseline happy-path suite the other media_* integration tests build on.
whatBreaks: A regression here means the core media upload/permission contract is broken, affecting every media-dependent surface (Studio, SDK, public API).

role: Test: Papers reader self-hosts Source Serif 4 font
description: Needle test reading layout source (bulldocs.html.heex, root.html.heex) and tokens.json to assert the reader head self-hosts the Source Serif 4 variable woff2 pair above the generated-CSS marker, no dangling TTF src, and font stack order is untouched.
whatBreaks: A regression that drops the self-hosted font-face or reintroduces a deleted TTF reference would ship broken font rendering off-macOS with no test failure.

role: Regression test for the shared Studio chrome layout
description: Asserts studio.html.heex renders canonical chrome anchors (shell, topbar, scope switcher, nav tabs) across all Studio + admin live_sessions, explicitly guarding a past 'nav disappears' bug on admin routes like /admin/bokbasen.
whatBreaks: Studio or admin pages could silently lose their navigation chrome again, stranding users with no way to navigate — this is the documented past-mistake regression class.

role: Test: Studio self-update banner admin-gating and states
description: Exercises the Studio self-update banner in studio.html.heex — asserts it renders only for admin sessions when SelfUpdate.status is :behind, shows curated release notes over raw digest, toggles the apply button by Runner config, and is absent for non-admins or when the Checker is disabled.
whatBreaks: A broken gate could either leak the update-now action to non-admins or silently hide the banner from admins, masking available self-updates.

role: LiveView tests for the per-plugin admin settings page
description: Covers auth gating, dynamic form rendering per declared field/group, save persistence with flat keys, secret reveal/hide via Plugins.Settings.reveal, inline validation errors, and secret-retention-on-blank-save behavior for the plugin settings LiveView.
whatBreaks: Broken secret handling could wipe or leak plugin credentials (e.g. Bokbasen client secrets) on save, or let non-admins reach the settings form.

role: LiveView tests for the admin plugin registry/reload page
description: Verifies admin-only access, one card per registered plugin with callback-override markers, and reload-plugin/reload-all events refreshing Plugins.RunStatus.
whatBreaks: A broken plugin reload UI would leave admins unable to verify or recover plugin bootstrap state without a server restart.

role: Test: Bulldocs task-list block live resolve-at-read
description: End-to-end test that a paper's task-list block with a `query` renders real bp tasks and re-renders live when a task mutates (via tenant PubSub), while a `snapshot` block renders statically offline.
whatBreaks: Regressions here would let Papers embedding live task plans go stale or crash on mutation, breaking the LIVE PLANS feature.

role: Gate-A sentinel test proving Bulldocs Papers live-update without remount
description: Large (1005-line) suite proving the 'no reload' property central to the Bulldocs/Papers convergence architecture: PID identity and DOM sentinel survival across PubSub-driven HTML re-renders, plus broader BulldocsLive reader coverage.
whatBreaks: If this regresses, the core Papers real-time editing promise (live patch, not full reload) silently breaks, degrading the flagship Bulldocs/Studio-chat editing experience.

role: End-to-end test for the sheet embed block's draft/publish boundary in Papers
description: Verifies a published paper's cached sheet snapshot stays frozen against draft edits to the referenced sheet and only refreshes on sheet publish — guarding the draft-content leak boundary for anonymous /papers readers.
whatBreaks: A regression could leak unpublished draft sheet data to anonymous public paper readers, a content-governance/security-adjacent bug.

role: Test for paper LiveView with id-less blocks
description: Tests that the paper LiveView correctly renders and handles portable-doc blocks that lack explicit IDs.
whatBreaks: ID-less block rendering bugs in paper LiveView go undetected.

role: Test: Hyperquiz host/player LiveViews render and live sync
description: Covers host (projector) and player LiveViews for the Quiz plugin: rendering, answer locking, live cross-surface tally updates via PubSub, safe bare GETs without starting a room, and live question swap.
whatBreaks: A regression could break real-time quiz play — host tally not updating or rooms starting unexpectedly on plain page loads.

role: Test: Sheets Studio toolbar autosave status + undo/redo UI
description: Proves the SheetGrid save-status region (Saving.../All changes saved/Save failed) driven by Session.persist_result broadcasts, stale-frame handling, and visible Undo/Redo buttons wired to the same server events as keyboard shortcuts; also asserts the read-only public reader shows neither.
whatBreaks: Users editing Sheets could lose visibility into save state or lose the undo affordance, risking silent data loss perception or actual lost edits.

role: Proof-story test for Sheets Studio grid editor (typing/formulas/paste/a11y)
description: A single continuous-editing-session integration test driving the Sheets grid via the exact DOM-hook events (cell-click, edit-start/commit, bar-commit, paste), plus a11y assertions (aria-activedescendant, role=application, grid indices) and pagination/merge-boundary correctness for large sheets. Exercises Content, Sheets.Session, and paper embedding of a sheet snapshot end to end.
whatBreaks: A pass here gives false confidence that the sheet grid's typing/formula/paste/collab pipeline and its a11y/pagination correctness actually work end to end.

role: Adversarial multiplayer-edge-case tests for Sheets M4 collaboration
description: Skeptic-pass tests covering interleaved undo semantics, structural-undo data loss reporting, brutal process kill mid-edit (presence cleanup), 9-user color palette pigeonhole collisions, public reader row cap, session-restart rev epoch handling, and remote structural op remapping of a peer's active cell/selection/find-hit.
whatBreaks: Regressions in multiplayer sheet editing (ghost presence, silent data loss, stale/duplicated deltas) would ship undetected.

role: Proof-story test for Sheets M4 real-time multiplayer + publish-gate
description: End-to-end story of two Studio editors and one public reader collaborating on a sheet: cursor/selection presence, soft-lock editing indicator, formula recompute, undo/redo syncing across sockets, and the critical publish-gate (draft edits must never leak to the anonymous public reader).
whatBreaks: Draft content could leak to anonymous public readers, or collaborative cursors/undo could desync across sessions, without any test catching it.

role: Tests for the public read-only Sheets reader LiveView (/sheets/:slug)
description: Locks down SheetsReaderLive: published-only rendering, 404s for draft/unknown slugs, the publish-gate (no draft-session leakage), stripped edit affordances, forged-event rejection (no session ever starts), pagination, find, filter, checkbox/link rendering, and social-share meta tags.
whatBreaks: Anonymous visitors could see draft content, mutate a sheet via forged events, or get broken read-only pagination/finding on published sheets.

role: Test: API Tester LiveView authz gating (token default + admin-only run)
description: Verifies the API Tester form defaults to the caller's own raw token (never the all-perms dev token) and that run/run-all handlers require admin capability, denying non-admin members.
whatBreaks: Regression could let any Studio member dispatch authenticated requests as an all-perms token or bypass the admin gate, a privilege-escalation hole.

role: Test: API Tester playground uses themed StudioComponents.Controls kit
description: Markup-pinning test asserting query-param selects/inputs and POST-body textarea render via bp_select/bp_input/bp_textarea (not native unthemed controls), preserving value-match selection and passthrough classes like api-body-textarea and spellcheck.
whatBreaks: A silent revert to native controls or dropped sizing/spellcheck attributes would regress the Studio UI kit conversion with no visual test coverage otherwise.

role: Unit test for ApiTesterLive plugin assert enrichment
description: Unit-tests enrich_with_plugin_asserts/3 — the function that runs plugin assert evaluation over Runner results and merges assert+cleanup data for the response panel; uses synthetic maps, no HTTP or LiveView mount.
whatBreaks: Plugin assert evaluation bugs in the API tester response panel go undetected.

role: Test: API Tester nil-endpoint crash guard on stale ids
description: Pins that select/run handlers no-op instead of crashing (BadMapError) when a stale phx-value-id resolves to a nil endpoint after a dataset switch, and that unknown phx events don't crash the LiveView process.
whatBreaks: Without this guard, an ordinary click on a stale row could crash the LiveView and force a reconnect, dropping session state for the operator.

role: Test: Studio Claude chat LiveView server-half behavior (large suite)
description: Very large (5349-line) test suite for the Studio Claude chat LiveView — lazy subprocess spawn on first send (not eager on mount), stream-json event handling via injected {:claude_chat_event,...} messages, resume/session-id argv proof via an argv-echo fake binary, and AI-title generation with null HTTP/CLI adapters for hermetic tests.
whatBreaks: As the primary regression net for the flagship Studio Claude chat feature (sessions, resume, titling, subprocess lifecycle), a broken test here risks shipping a chat UI that eager-spawns processes, loses resume state, or mishandles stream events.

role: Test: Studio desk Miller-column row-state CSS class vocabulary
description: Pins that structure/type/doc panes at every depth render the same shared row-state classes (.pane-item, .pane-item-label, .pane-item-chevron, .pane-doc-item, .pane-doc-title, .selected) so no pane visually diverges from its siblings.
whatBreaks: A regression could let one Studio pane (e.g. a plugin pane) drift to different row markup than its siblings, breaking the unified desk row-state visual language.

role: Smoke/crash-resilience tests for Studio's Media LiveView
description: Small suite verifying MediaLive renders the native bp-asset-explorer web component and that unknown phx events / stray messages no longer crash the LiveView (regression guard for issue #819).
whatBreaks: MediaLive could crash on any stale or forged client event without detection, taking down the Media tab session.

role: LiveView test for the Studio org-admin portal
description: Covers the /studio/org-admin LiveView: admin-permission gate, per-org SSO/OIDC status display, self-serve SCIM token minting, org-wide require-MFA toggle, and recent audit-activity listing.
whatBreaks: Regressions in org-admin gating, SCIM minting, or the require-MFA toggle could silently ship and expose/deny admin controls incorrectly.

role: Unit tests for the pure Studio paper-canvas run-partition seam
description: Large (1500+ line) test suite for PaperCanvas.partition_runs/1, paper_canvas_enabled?/0, run_id/1, and the WordPress-style metadata sidebar logic; also asserts View/reader CSS parity for buttons. No DB/LiveView mount for the core partition tests — pure logic proofs the canvas render branch depends on.
whatBreaks: Incorrect run partitioning would misrender the paper canvas (wrong grouping of prose vs. control-atom blocks) across every Studio paper edit session.

role: Test proving every portable-doc block type is addable in Studio editor
description: Parametrized test over every addable block type in the add-block UI, asserting default_block/2 output is valid and round-trips through Content.apply_paper_block_op and renders. Uses shared PaperEditorTestHelpers.
whatBreaks: A broken default_block shape for any type would make that block type uninsertable or crash the editor when added.

role: Core CRUD/reorder test for the Studio paper block editor
description: Proves View/Edit toggle, block edit/add/delete/reorder all flow through DocPatchOps via Content.apply_paper_block_op, and that cross-source PubSub broadcasts sync into an open editor without remount.
whatBreaks: Editing, reordering, or deleting blocks in Studio could silently fail to persist or desync from other viewers.

role: Test for article-chrome, diagram blocks, and per-block autosave
description: Covers eyebrow/byline/ingress/pullquote chrome blocks and diagram block editor round-trips plus phx-change autosave (debounced) through the same patch-block pipeline as explicit Save.
whatBreaks: Autosave or chrome/diagram block editing could break, losing edits or failing to persist without an explicit save.

role: Test for v2 composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText field blocks
description: Verifies nested PaperFieldBlock LiveComponents render and persist structured values via paper_op, including a fix for arrayOf-of-composite nested-key form parsing (Plug.Conn.Query flat-key quirk).
whatBreaks: Nested composite/array field edits in papers could corrupt or fail to save structured values.

role: Test for field-* leaf and picker blocks in the paper editor
description: Covers native-control leaf field blocks, reference/image picker web-component bridges, and field-reference view-mode title resolution via Content → Render.
whatBreaks: Field block editing (text, slug, reference, image pickers) could fail to persist or show wrong resolved titles.

role: Unit tests for wikilink and tag search handlers in paper editor
description: Directly exercises Paper.paper_wikilink_search/2 and paper_tag_search/2 against a bare LiveView socket, checking blank/oversized query short-circuits and match/no-match shapes.
whatBreaks: Wikilink or tag autocomplete search in the paper editor could return wrong or crash on edge-case queries.

role: Test for Notion-style slash menu and codelist field block
description: Verifies bp-slash-insert custom events insert blocks via the same default_block/new_block_id pipeline as add-block, and both flat and tree codelist field variants resolve/persist through the registered codelist path.
whatBreaks: Slash-menu block insertion or codelist field selection/resolution in Studio could break.

role: Pure unit test pinning default_block/2 for structural block types
description: Small ExUnit.Case (no DB/LiveView) asserting default_block/2 for action/figure/columns/terminal/table/section matches the canvas slash-menu JS default and is accepted by Render.Compose.compose_block/2, keeping server and client defaults mirrored.
whatBreaks: Drift between server default_block/2 and client canvasDefaultBlock would cause inconsistent or unrenderable blocks depending on insertion path.

role: Unit test pinning Studio deep-link URL builder/parser round-trip
description: Tests BarkparkWeb.Studio.StudioLive.Paths — the canonical Studio URL builder that every Studio link/push_patch/push_navigate funnels through. Contains its own independent inverse parser as an oracle to catch drift between builder and parser (build → parse → rebuild identity).
whatBreaks: A regression here means Studio deep-links could silently produce URLs that don't reproduce the intended dataset/segments/desk scope, going undetected until users hit broken navigation.

role: schema v2 adapter LiveView test
description: Tests the Studio Plugins Adapter's v2?/1 type-detection predicate and render/2 dispatch for v2 field types (composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText).
whatBreaks: v2 schema field types could silently mis-render or mis-route in Studio without any test catching the regression.

role: test for Studio LiveView plugin field components
description: ExUnit/LiveView tests for plugin-provided field components rendered in the Studio UI, covering rendering and interaction of custom field types.
whatBreaks: Plugin field component regressions in Studio go undetected, breaking the editing UI for documents with custom plugin-defined fields.

role: ConnCase test guarding tenant-scoped admin settings/plugins routes
description: Verifies SettingsLive and PluginsLive/PluginSettingsLive live under the canonical /w/:ws/p/:proj scoped grammar and correctly bind to the URL workspace rather than silently pinning the seeded Default workspace — a real cross-tenant data-leak bug it was written to catch.
whatBreaks: Undetected regression could let a workspace-B admin's settings writes land on the Default workspace instead, a tenancy-isolation break.

role: Tests for the scoped-by-URL Studio mount and tenant/grant authorization
description: Large security-critical suite covering LiveScope's URL-driven scope resolution: member/non-member/anonymous mount outcomes, adversarial cross-tenant live-patch re-authorization, flat-to-scoped redirects, workspace-switch URL fidelity, and the airdrop-grants access-grant enforcement matrix (containment, subscope admission, read-narrowing, write containment, expiry/revocation).
whatBreaks: A cross-tenant data leak or a broken auth gate in Studio's mount path — one of the most severe classes of bug in a multi-tenant CMS.

role: Tests for the Studio Settings LiveView (plugin credentials, theming, admin gate)
description: Covers admin-only access gating, themed-controls UI invariants, workspace theme picker, settings save/load/reveal/delete with secret masking and audit logging, a typed settings-schema renderer (bokbasen example), plugin enable/placement toggles, and the scoped-by-URL write-hazard fix (writes must land on the URL-bound workspace, never a forged one).
whatBreaks: Plugin credentials/settings could leak unmasked, or a forged workspace id could write settings into the wrong tenant's workspace.

role: Unit test for Paper.partition_backlinks/1 three-way bucket split
description: Pins the pure partition of a reverse_referencers result into used_by/linked/derived buckets for the Studio backlinks panel, asserting kind (valueref) wins over plugin_source origin and that ordering is preserved.
whatBreaks: Backlinks panel could misclassify valueref referencers as generic derived links, breaking the used-by/impact view for canonical value docs.

role: Unit test for Paper.apply_paper_delta/2 op_kind dispatch, esp. :batch no-op
description: Confirms a canvas :batch frame (broadcast to the editing LiveView's own topic) is a no-op that only tracks rev, rather than falling through to stream_insert with a nil-html block — a real crash bug it regression-guards.
whatBreaks: Editing LiveView could crash or corrupt its block stream when receiving its own batch broadcast during canvas editing.

role: Unit test for figure_render/1 child-only paint contract
description: Pins that push_block_renders emits a figure's child rendered ALONE (no reader <figcaption>) keyed by the figure id, byte-identical to Render.render_block, preventing the editable bpFigure atom's caption input from being doubled by a duplicate reader-rendered caption.
whatBreaks: A regression would double-render figure captions in the editable canvas or break live figure paint updates.

role: Pure unit tests for SheetGrid.Cells display/formatting logic
description: Covers Cells.display/1 formatting rules (booleans, integers, floats without scientific notation except at extreme magnitudes, strings, nil) that render sheet cell values in the Studio grid UI.
whatBreaks: Sheet cells could render incorrect text (e.g. scientific notation for normal numbers, or wrong TRUE/FALSE casing) throughout the Studio sheet grid.

role: Pure unit tests for SheetGrid.Filter per-column filter predicates
description: Pins the filter predicate matrix (blank/nonblank occupancy ops plus value ops delegating to the CondFormat kernel, multi-column AND, frozen-head/growth-padding bands always visible) used by the sheet grid's column filter UI.
whatBreaks: Sheet column filters could hide or show wrong rows (e.g. treating error cells as blank, or breaking multi-column AND filtering).

role: ConnCase acceptance test for end-to-end formula entry/commit in Studio sheet grid
description: Drives the real Studio grid + Sheets.Session through edit-commit/bar-commit events to pin the wish's golden path (type =sum(, select range, Enter → =SUM(B3:B5) evaluating to 6, cursor moves down), verbatim round-trip of formula casing, and client-facing data-fn-sigs/data-t stamp contracts.
whatBreaks: The core sheets formula-entry UX (autocomplete, range selection, commit-and-move) could silently break server-side while client wiring still looks correct.

role: Pure unit tests for SheetGrid.Geometry selection-rect/layout math
description: Covers selection_rect/2 normalization of anchor/cursor coordinates and grid_sel/3's read-only zero-sentinel behavior, plus grid layout pixel constants used to lay out the sheet grid.
whatBreaks: Sheet cell selection highlighting or read-only grid rendering could show wrong/reversed selection rectangles.

role: Pure unit tests for SheetGrid.GridData frozen-row/column clamping and derivation
description: Tests clamp_frozen/2 coercing both integer and string frozen-band values (matching how Core/XlsxExport/Structure parse them) and derive_grid/1's handling of a string-typed frozen_rows persisted by the schema/document editor.
whatBreaks: A sheet saved with a string frozen_rows value could silently lose its freeze-pane behavior in the Studio grid while other readers still honor it.

role: Test: sheet-grid selection/filter/tab remap on remote structural ops
description: Exercises BarkparkWeb.Studio.SheetGrid.Ops.apply_delta against sort/column/tab structural deltas, proving a viewer's active cell, anchor, filters, and open editor correctly follow (or ignore) remote sort/insert/delete/move ops, including a two-LiveView end-to-end anti-clobber golden test.
whatBreaks: Undetected regressions could let a collaborator's remote sort/column-edit silently clobber another viewer's in-progress cell edit or leave a stale open editor after a tab is removed.

role: Test: Studio sheet sort toolbar/menu wire (sort_range dispatch)
description: End-to-end LiveView tests for the sort A→Z/Z→A toolbar buttons and column-menu sort item, covering whole-column vs in-place sorts, frozen-row clipping, filter-active refusal, empty-key no-op, and formula-travels-verbatim/undo semantics.
whatBreaks: A broken sort wire could silently reorder or corrupt sheet data, rewrite formulas incorrectly, or dispatch sorts while filters are active, corrupting stored cell state.

role: Tests for the Studio sign-out form in the shared chrome
description: Small suite verifying the sign-out form/action always renders in Studio chrome and that POST /logout clears the session via the real login/logout flow.
whatBreaks: Users could be unable to sign out of Studio, or the session could fail to clear on logout.

role: Golden HTML snapshot: paper block-editor output with canvas flag off
description: Auto-generated/pinned snapshot of the per-block Studio paper editor render (heading/paragraph/callout/paragraph/divider) used by studio_live_paper_canvas_test.exs to detect any drift in the flag-OFF editor HTML.
whatBreaks: If stale or hand-edited incorrectly, the snapshot test either false-fails on legitimate changes or false-passes on an actual regression in the non-canvas paper editor markup.

role: Tests for the shared Studio top-bar chrome (scope menu, tab nav) across all LiveViews
description: Covers BarkparkWeb.StudioChrome's contract: legacy switch-workspace/dataset events are safe (navigate instead of crash) on non-StudioLive surfaces, the Sanity-style scope popover (membership-gated preview + navigate), icons-only tab bar a11y, and the current_path-derivation hook lighting the active tab across every studio-layout LiveView.
whatBreaks: Any Studio surface (Media, ApiTester, Settings, etc.) could crash on a stale switch event, or scope switching could bypass membership checks / silently break active-tab highlighting everywhere.

role: Test: Studio Access panel (view/revoke airdrop grants) UI
description: Covers the Access panel's honest read/revoke flows: workspace members see and can revoke grants (admin succeeds, non-admin/read-only denied server-side), and non-member grantees see only their own grant.
whatBreaks: A broken deny-gate here would let unauthorized users revoke access grants, or leak workspace grant data to unrelated grantees.

role: Test: Studio 'Share access' (airdrop grant mint) flow
description: Covers minting scoped, time-boxed access grants from Studio: reachability from post-type/workspace surfaces, duration→expiry math, capability picker gated to held caps with no-escalation enforcement, one-time link reveal (never the hash), email delivery, and PubSub toast to online grantees.
whatBreaks: A capability-escalation bug here would let a read-only user mint a write-capable access grant, or leak the persisted token hash/link more than once.

role: Studio array-op path-helper test
description: Unit and integration tests for the nested arrayOf field path-parsing and mutation machinery in StudioLive, covering both pure helper functions and the live array_op event handler against a real draft document.
whatBreaks: Bugs in nested array field editing in the Studio editor are not caught, corrupting document structure.

role: Test: Studio server-side capability deny-gate (BarkparkWeb.Studio.Caps)
description: Proves hidden Studio affordances are also server-DENIED for forged phx events across admin/member/read-only tokens and grant-based sessions, including a scenario where a grant expires mid-session and the gate still re-derives caps rather than trusting stale mount-time state.
whatBreaks: A hole in this gate would let a forged client event bypass UI-hidden restrictions and perform writes/admin actions the caller isn't authorized for — a real security regression.

role: Test: Studio concurrent-edit lost-update guard + new-doc id collision fix
description: Unit-tests StudioLive.Handlers.Lifecycle.doc_updated to ensure a remote save never overwrites a dirty local edit buffer (raises doc_conflict instead) and that new_document no longer mints colliding low-entropy ids.
whatBreaks: Regression would let concurrent editors silently clobber each other's unsaved work, or reintroduce id collisions that overwrite unrelated documents.

role: Test: Studio LiveView dispatch fall-through + bulk-select cap
description: Pins that unknown/stale phx events and unrouted PubSub messages hit catch-all no-op clauses instead of crashing the whole LiveView session, and that Handlers.Bulk caps multi-select at 500 ids.
whatBreaks: Without the catch-alls, any stale client event or stray message crashes the Studio session and loses unsaved editor state; without the cap, unbounded selections could fan out into a large uncontrolled DB write.

role: Test for StudioLive's dataset-leaf URL validation (defense in depth)
description: Verifies handle_params redirects a URL naming a dataset the resolved project doesn't own to the project's default dataset, while a project-owned dataset (including the seeded default) stays put with no redirect loop — closing a gap where the dataset leaf bypassed the project_has_dataset? check applied elsewhere (switch-dataset).
whatBreaks: Studio could be left in an inconsistent state bound to a dataset the current project doesn't actually own, corrupting scope-derived queries.

role: Test: delete-confirmation modal uses graph-aware referencer probe
description: Regression test ensuring the delete-with-reference-check modal in Handlers.Delete uses Content.Graph.reverse_referencers (arrayOf-aware, content_edges-based) rather than the scalar-only find_referencing_docs, which undercounts inbound arrayOf-of-reference edges.
whatBreaks: A regression to the scalar-only probe would under-report referencing documents before a delete, letting users unknowingly break references.

role: Regression test — tenancy scope isolation in Studio desk panes
description: LiveViewTest suite proving the desk (document list panes), write path, and secondary-doc picker all thread the active workspace/project scope so one workspace's documents never leak into another's desk or picker. Guards the P3 scoped-by-URL cutover and the g4a7 membership gate.
whatBreaks: A regression could silently re-leak cross-tenant documents into the Studio desk or reference picker without any test catching it.

role: Studio discard-draft action test
description: Tests the "Discard draft" Studio action: verifies the button appears only when a published twin exists, is absent for never-published drafts, and that confirming removes the draft while leaving the published document.
whatBreaks: Discard-draft regressions (wrong visibility or data mutation) in the Studio editor go undetected.

role: Studio document actions test
description: Tests three Sanity-style document actions: duplicate-doc (clones to new draft), open-secondary-picker (read-only secondary editor pane), and bulk publish (checkbox selection + publish event).
whatBreaks: Regressions in document duplication, secondary pane, or bulk publish go undetected in the Studio editor.

role: Studio Classic/Beta editor toggle test
description: Tests the per-document Classic↔Beta toggle for Expectation-bearing documents, verifying that the Studio editor switches between the schema form and the portable block editor over the document's content["blocks"].
whatBreaks: Regressions in the Classic/Beta editor toggle go undetected, breaking the premium block editor surface.

role: Byte-identity test for StudioLive editor field-input rendering
description: Pins exact HTML output (classes, phx-debounce values, element ordering) for all leaf input types (text, richText, boolean, color, select, reference, image, slug/datetime fallback) rendered via BarkparkWeb.Components.FieldInputs, plus the slug-generate button flow.
whatBreaks: Silent drift in the editor's field-input markup (e.g. losing a phx-hook or debounce attribute) would ship broken client-side bridges (rich text, color picker, image/reference pickers) with no test failure.

role: Test — empty-state hint in a Studio document-list pane
description: Verifies a document-type pane with zero documents shows a 'No documents yet' + 'New document' hint, and that the hint disappears once a document exists, scoped under a dedicated workspace/project/dataset.
whatBreaks: A blank or broken empty-state pane could confuse users into thinking Studio is broken for a fresh type with no content.

role: Test: Studio paper editor <bp-paper-canvas> wiring behind feature flag
description: Verifies flag-OFF editor HTML is byte-identical to the pre-canvas per-block render (diffed against a committed snapshot), flag-ON renders a merged canvas run including canvas-eligible callout blocks, and the paper-ops batch handler persists identically to the per-block ops path.
whatBreaks: A regression could silently change the default (flag-off) paper editor markup for all users, or make canvas-mode ops persist differently than per-block ops, corrupting paper content.

role: Test — in-Studio streamed Paper viewer (Bulldocs) inside StudioLive
description: Proves /studio/:dataset/paper/:slug renders paper blocks in the editor pane alongside the desk structure, that {:paper_block,...} PubSub broadcasts stream block add/remove deltas with no LiveView remount, and that navigating between two papers swaps content cleanly with no stale blocks (dom-id collision guard).
whatBreaks: Streamed paper editing inside Studio could silently remount, drop live updates, or leak one paper's blocks into another's DOM.

role: Test proving grant-scoped Studio panes never leak plugin content
description: Pins that a grant-admitted non-member socket never sees out-of-grant plugin-typed (task/sheet) content on the rendered Studio desk, by asserting scope(opts) narrowing survives through PaneBuilder → Content.Query → Content.Scope.scope_to_grants, with a positive-control member mount proving the content is otherwise renderable.
whatBreaks: A regression that drops scope() from a plugin-content read or adds a direct plugin-context read to the pane path would silently leak cross-tenant task/sheet/media content and go undetected without this guard.

role: Test proving expired/revoked grants stop live Studio reads immediately
description: Guards that an access_expiry_tick or Access.revoke broadcast rebuilds caller_context on a mounted Studio socket and kills/narrows it, closing a mount-time-snapshot leak where reads kept serving granted rows after expiry until reconnect.
whatBreaks: A regression reintroducing the mount-time snapshot leak would let a grantee keep reading rows live after their grant expires or is revoked, until they happen to reconnect.

role: Test for Studio editor's save-status indicator truthfulness
description: Verifies the save-status header never claims success on a failed autosave (paper row deleted concurrently) and that save_status resets when switching documents rather than leaking stale state across docs.
whatBreaks: Editors could see a false 'Auto-saved' badge alongside a failed-save flash, or a stale 'Saved' status carried into a different unsaved document.

role: Test guarding pane-navigation handlers against malformed client input
description: Pins that Scope.select/2 and Scope.expand_pane/2 no-op (rather than crash or mis-navigate) on non-numeric or negative phx-value indices from the client, since raw String.to_integer/Enum.take previously crashed or corrupted the nav path.
whatBreaks: A hostile or buggy client payload could crash the Studio LiveView process or silently navigate to a wrong pane path.

role: Security test — Studio Network Shares panel + per-doc share links
description: Covers the admin happy path (add/remove workspace-scope shares, per-document share-link mint/revoke) and, critically, the privilege-escalation guard: because StudioLive runs in a public live_session, every shares-* handler must re-check admin server-side even though the client button is hidden for non-admins.
whatBreaks: A regression here could let a non-admin (or anonymous) session directly fire a hidden LiveView event to create/revoke content shares or share links, a real privilege-escalation / data-exposure vulnerability.

role: Large end-to-end test suite for the Studio Sheets grid editor
description: Extensive LiveViewTest coverage of BarkparkWeb.Studio.SheetGrid: cell edit/formula bar, undo/redo, number-format + style toolbar, conditional formatting, tab color, keyboard nav/selection, batch clear, per-viewer filters (SF series), and paging — all driven through the real Sheets Session/Engine spine.
whatBreaks: Sheets editing (cell writes, formulas, undo, conditional formatting, filters) could silently break or corrupt stored cell data with no test signal, since this is the primary functional spec for the whole grid feature.

role: Test — real-time collaborator presence in the Sheets grid
description: Two-viewer LiveViewTest suite proving cursor/selection overlays, editing-lock tags, deterministic per-user colors, and presence departure all work through Phoenix Presence + PubSub, plus a render-cost budget assertion for a 500-row grid presence frame.
whatBreaks: Collaborative editing indicators (who's editing what cell) could break or a presence re-render regression could blow past the perf budget on large sheets, degrading real-time UX.

role: regression test for stale nav_path on workspace/project switch
description: Pins the fix for a bug where switching projects left the old project's nav_path and editor_doc on the socket; asserts that after a project switch, nav_path is reset and saves land in the new project's scope, never the old one.
whatBreaks: The stale nav_path bug (wrong-scope writes, duplicate dataset rows) could regress silently.

role: test for Studio task-document editor behaviour
description: Covers task-document editing in the Studio: lifecycle_status select, read-only JSON rendering for array/object fields, content preservation on save for unmanaged keys, and integer coercion for number-typed fields.
whatBreaks: Task editor regressions (wrong field rendering, data loss on save, type coercion failures) go undetected.

role: Regression test — realtime PubSub refresh of the Studio task list pane
description: Proves a task claim (Tasks.claim_by_id/3) broadcasts a document-mutation event that StudioLive's {:document_changed,...} handler consumes to rebuild panes in place (no remount), fixing a prior bug where claims left the task list stale until manual refresh.
whatBreaks: Studio's task board could go stale after a claim/close, silently showing wrong lifecycle_status until a manual page reload, hurting task-board trust.

role: test for graph-edge-aware unpublish guard
description: Tests the Phase-5 unpublish guard: verifies it uses Content.Graph.reverse_referencers (arrayOf-aware) rather than the undercounting scalar query, checks that docs with no inbound edges unpublish inline, and that docs with referencers show a guard modal listing them.
whatBreaks: Unpublish guard logic regressions (dangling references, wrong query path) go undetected, risking data integrity in published content graph.

role: Test proving shared-value writeback is server-authorized, not client-gated
description: Confirms the Studio shared-value inspector's write control and impact preview appear only for authorized in-scope members, and that a hostile confirm event bypassing the UI (or with no panel open) is a no-op because ValueWriteback.writeback/6 re-authorizes server-side.
whatBreaks: A cross-workspace member could mutate a shared value they have no access to simply by pushing the confirm LiveView event directly, bypassing hidden UI.

role: Large test suite — Studio's workspace/project/dataset scope switcher
description: Covers the membership-gated Miller-column scope menu: rendering, member-only workspace listing, workspace/project/dataset switching (with URL push_patch under the P3 scoped-URL cutover), workspace/project create affordances, and a critical tenant-boundary guard preventing writes from landing in the Default workspace after a refused project-less workspace switch.
whatBreaks: A switcher regression could let a session leak into a non-member workspace, expose a foreign tenant in the menu, or misroute a document write into the wrong workspace/project (data cross-tenant leak).

role: Test pinning canonical Studio URLs, legacy redirects, and deep-link state parity
description: For each wave-1 Studio destination, asserts the canonical route mounts, every legacy/flat alias 302-redirects to the canonical URL with path+query preserved, and a fresh deep-link mount yields identical scope assigns as click-navigation would.
whatBreaks: Shared/bookmarked Studio links could silently land users in a different workspace/project/dataset context than clicking there would, or legacy URLs could break/loop.

role: Test that Studio's read-only paper view resolves live task queries like the public reader
description: Ensures paper_stream_items/3 in Studio runs the same Content.Papers.resolve_tasks_in_blocks as the /papers reader for embedded task-list/board/roadmap blocks, while confirming the underlying saved blocks remain unresolved (query, not frozen snapshot).
whatBreaks: Embedded task/roadmap blocks would render empty in Studio's view mode while showing real data on the public reader, and a bug here could accidentally freeze live queries into stale snapshots on save.

role: Test for the admin-gated /studio/styleguide living style guide LiveView
description: Verifies the styleguide page renders using generated CSS custom-property tokens (not hand-copied hex) and statically greps root.html.heex to pin the evergreen-primary token cascade, chrome alias wiring, and self-hosted Inter font (no Google Fonts CDN link).
whatBreaks: Theme-token drift (hardcoded colors, reintroduced CDN font link, broken cascade) would ship unnoticed across the whole app's visual system.

role: Test for the dev-only browser-terminal (tmux console) LiveView server logic
description: Exercises spawn/input/output/resize of the tmux console via an injected FakePty backend (mirroring ExPTY's spawn/write/resize/kill), avoiding a real tmux/browser dependency while covering the full PTY callback path.
whatBreaks: The in-browser terminal console feature (admin-gated dev tool) could silently break spawn, resize, or output streaming without detection.

role: Test — LiveView auth on_mount gating (:ops vs :admin roles)
description: Verifies the dedicated :ops permission grants access to /admin/onixedit/bokbasen without exposing the full :admin-gated settings LiveView, and that unauthenticated/unknown/reader tokens are redirected; drives assertions through the real router live_session chain, not a direct on_mount call.
whatBreaks: A broken auth gate could let unprivileged or unauthenticated sessions reach admin-only LiveViews (settings reveal, plugin secrets) or, conversely, lock out legitimate ops operators.

role: Test that plugin-public LiveView mounts assign admin/auth state correctly
description: Replays the :plugin_public and :scoped_plugin_public on_mount hook chain (LiveAuth.fetch_api_token before StudioChrome) to pin that an admin session gets admin-gated chrome while an anonymous visitor still mounts without redirect — regression guard for a bug where admin chrome silently vanished on plugin-public pages.
whatBreaks: Admin-only Studio chrome (Style/tmux/chat tabs, Share button) could silently disappear for admins on any plugin-public page, or the on_mount ordering change could break anonymous visitor access entirely.

role: test for plugin route highway end-to-end
description: Locks the plugin route registration pipeline: verifies OnixEdit's register_routes callback, Registry.collect_routes, the plugin_routes macro in the router, and PingLive mount all wire together; also asserts the fresh-install invariant that an empty plugins list yields no routes.
whatBreaks: Plugin route wiring regressions (broken registration, missing routes, fresh-install breakage) go undetected.

role: Test — pins baseline security headers across all three API pipelines
description: Verifies ApiSecurityHeaders adds nosniff/referrer-policy on flat :api, :scoped_api, and :shared_docs_api pipelines, and proves it never overwrites a header a controller/CORS layer already set.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let security headers silently disappear or get doubled on some API pipeline without any test catching it.

role: Test — path-scoped raw-body Plug.Parsers body reader
description: Confirms CacheBodyReader only tees the raw body into conn.assigns[:raw_body] on the exact GitHub webhook path (including across chunked reads) and is a zero-buffering pass-through everywhere else, including near-miss path prefixes.
whatBreaks: If raw_body caching leaked to other routes it would waste memory on every request; if it broke on the webhook path, HMAC signature verification would always fail and GitHub webhooks would be rejected.

role: Test suite for the per-dataset CORS plug
description: Exercises BarkparkWeb.Plugs.DatasetCors across simple + preflight requests, per-dataset isolation, default CORS fallback, the /w/:ws/p/:project path-prefix stripping, and unknown-dataset fail-closed behavior. Pins security-critical guarantees like never emitting a wildcard ACAO and letting plugin buckets own their own preflights.
whatBreaks: A regression here would let CORS isolation bugs (cross-dataset origin leaks or broken SDK access) ship unnoticed.

role: test for error envelope version negotiation plug
description: Tests that the ErrorEnvelopeNegotiation plug correctly selects :v2 envelope format when Accept-Version: 2 header is present and defaults to :v1 otherwise.
whatBreaks: Regressions in error envelope versioning go undetected, causing API clients to receive wrong error shapes.

role: Test — fail-closed HMAC gate for inbound GitHub webhook
description: Exercises GithubWebhookSignature against valid/tampered/wrong-secret/missing-raw-body/missing-header/dark-plugin cases, all expecting a 401 halt with the canonical unauthorized envelope except the valid case.
whatBreaks: A broken or weakened test here could let a forged webhook signature pass, allowing anyone to inject fake GitHub events into the plugin's ingest pipeline.

role: test for idempotency plug
description: Tests the idempotency plug behavior — likely covering idempotency key handling for POST/PATCH requests to prevent duplicate mutations.
whatBreaks: Idempotency regressions go undetected, allowing duplicate mutations on replay.

role: test: OptionalToken plug (best-effort Bearer auth)
description: Small focused test proving OptionalToken never halts the conn and only assigns :api_token on a valid Bearer, ignoring invalid/non-Bearer headers.
whatBreaks: A broken optional-auth plug could either wrongly halt anonymous requests or silently accept invalid tokens as authenticated.

role: Test suite for the signed preview-token auth plug
description: Covers PreviewToken JWT validation: valid token flow, replay/expiry/tamper/revocation rejection, dataset-claim route binding, header vs query-param token sources, and a concurrency test proving exactly one of 8 simultaneous requests wins the JTI race.
whatBreaks: A broken test here masks preview-token security holes such as replay attacks or cross-dataset preview token misuse.

role: test for public read access plug
description: Tests the PublicRead plug that gates unauthenticated read access, covering scenarios for public datasets vs protected ones across 160 LOC.
whatBreaks: Public read access control regressions go undetected, risking unauthorized data exposure or blocking public content.

role: test for public share guard plug
description: Tests the PublicShareGuard plug that controls access to publicly shared resources, covering guard bypass and enforcement scenarios.
whatBreaks: Share guard regressions go undetected, potentially exposing private resources via share links.

role: rate-limit plug test
description: Tests the rate-limiting plug behaviour — threshold enforcement, response codes, and header correctness for API rate limiting.
whatBreaks: Rate-limit regressions ship undetected, leaving the API open to abuse or breaking legitimate clients.

role: Test — ingest-tier auth plug (shared secret + admin api_token paths)

whatBreaks: A broken uniqueness/validation here could allow account takeover via a second OAuth provider asserting the same email.

role: Ecto schema for a Cloud Team (tenant boundary)
description: Defines Team schema with slug/name validation (reserved slugs, control-char guard), onboarding-state tracking, and trial ledger columns (trial_started_at etc.) used by Billing.start_trial.
whatBreaks: Bad slug/name validation could crash registration with a raw Postgres 500, or corrupt onboarding/trial state for every team.

role: Ecto schema for pending team invitation with hashed accept token
description: Models a single-use, hash-stored invite token to join a team at a role, with a partial-unique index enforcing one live invite per (team,email); accepted_at doubles as audit + single-use flag.
whatBreaks: A broken changeset could let invites be replayed or duplicated, or block re-inviting after expiry/acceptance.

role: Ecto schema binding a User to a Team with a role (the grant)
description: Owner/admin/member membership row with role-rank helpers (rank/1, admin?/1, outranks?/2) used throughout Authz and Accounts for permission checks; enforces one membership per (user,team).
whatBreaks: Incorrect rank ordering or role validation would break every admin/owner authorization check in Cloud.

role: Pure TOTP + recovery-code crypto primitives for 2FA
description: Stateless functions for TOTP secret gen, otpauth URI, time-step verification with replay-guard step tracking, and recovery-code generation/hashing/vault encryption; the Accounts context wires these to storage.
whatBreaks: A flaw in matching_step/valid_otp? could let 2FA codes be replayed or lock out/allow-bypass legitimate logins.

role: GenServer/ETS fixed-window rate limiter for 2FA challenge attempts
description: Small standalone rate limiter (5 attempts/60s) keyed by pending-login user id, used to throttle brute-forcing the 2FA login challenge.
whatBreaks: A broken limiter would allow unlimited 2FA code guessing, weakening the second factor's security.

role: Ecto schema + changesets for the Cloud User principal
description: Defines the User schema (email, hashed_password, confirmation/pending-email, 2FA fields) with focused changesets for registration, password change, OAuth-birthed passwordless users, email confirm/change, and all four 2FA state transitions.
whatBreaks: A changeset bug could let weak/plaintext passwords through, break login, or corrupt 2FA/email-verification state for all Cloud users.

role: Ecto schema for user session/PAT/email-lifecycle bearer tokens
description: Dual/quad-purpose token table discriminated by `context` (session, pat, confirm, change_email), storing only SHA-256 hashes with revoke/expiry gating. Owns PAT ability normalization (root/deploy exclusivity), email-change brute-force lockout, and the hash_token/1 single source of hashing truth.
whatBreaks: A hashing or context-scoping bug lets a session token pass as a PAT (or vice versa) or lets a revoked/expired credential authenticate on the control-plane API.

role: OTP supervision tree entrypoint for the BarkparkCloud control-plane app
description: Boots Repo, Oban, rate limiters, Azure pricing cache, the Events pubsub scope, then the Bandit HTTP listener for BarkparkCloud.Web.Router. Any missing/misordered child here breaks the whole control plane at boot.
whatBreaks: A wrong supervision order or a fetch_env! failure crashes the entire cloud control-plane process on startup, taking down auth, billing, and provisioning simultaneously.

role: Hand-rolled S3 SigV4 reader for team portable-archive manifests
description: Dependency-free GET-only S3 client (uses :httpc/:crypto/:xmerl) that lists archives/<team_id>/ from Hetzner Object Storage and parses manifest.json into archive structs; team_id strictly scopes the prefix so cross-team reads are structurally impossible.
whatBreaks: A broken SigV4 signature or prefix-scoping bug either makes archive listing fail entirely or, worse, leaks another team's archived-instance bundles.

role: Public context/seam for Azure provider verify + catalog calls
description: Thin wrapper resolving the configured Azure.Client module (FakeClient in dev/test, RealClient in prod) and exposing verify/1 and list_catalog/1 to the rest of the app.
whatBreaks: Wrong client resolution could route prod traffic to the fake client (silently fabricating Azure verification) or vice versa break real Azure connect flows.

role: Azure.Client behaviour + FakeClient/RealClient implementations
description: Defines the verify/1 and list_catalog/1 callbacks for Azure service-principal connect and normalized catalog building; FakeClient is deterministic/in-memory for dev/test, RealClient does the real OAuth2 client-credentials exchange + ARM calls over an injectable transport.
whatBreaks: A malformed ARM request builder or token-exchange bug would break Azure team-connect and catalog listing in prod while tests stay green against the fake.

role: GenServer + ETS cache for Azure global Retail Prices sheet
description: Fetches and caches (serve-stale-while-refreshing, ~24h TTL) the unauthenticated Azure Retail Prices API, filtering out Spot/Windows rows and reducing to cheapest monthly USD per SKU, stamped onto the neutral provisioning catalog.
whatBreaks: A filter regression could let a Spot or Windows-surcharge price masquerade as the stable on-demand Linux price shown to customers picking a server size.

role: Billing context: subscriptions, trials, quotas, webhook lifecycle
description: Large context module owning the whole pay-once/subscription lifecycle: checkout, webhook dispatch/verification, active/past_due/canceled state machine, per-plan instance quotas + reconciliation, and self-serve trial grant/start logic with race-safe ledger claims. Central to whether teams get billed and whether their managed instances stay live or get suspended.
whatBreaks: A webhook dispatch or entitlement bug could either grant free access to unpaid teams or wrongly suspend a paying customer's managed Barkpark instances.

role: Behaviour defining the payment-provider seam (Stripe/Stub)
description: Declares the callback contract (create_customer, charge, create_subscription, checkout session, portal session, cancel, verify_webhook) that both StubGateway and StripeGateway implement, letting Billing context stay provider-agnostic.
whatBreaks: A callback signature drift between this behaviour and an implementer would fail to compile or silently mismatch return shapes, breaking checkout/webhook handling.

role: Verified-TLS :httpc transport for the Stripe gateway
description: Pure request-map-to-httpc-argument mapper plus the impure request/1 shell; enforces TLS peer/hostname verification and disables autoredirect (SSRF safety) since Erlang httpc defaults to following redirects.
whatBreaks: Removing autoredirect:false reopens a blind-redirect SSRF vector where a webhook URL could 302 to an internal/metadata endpoint with credentials attached.

role: Real Stripe API request builder + webhook signature verifier
description: Implements Billing.Gateway against Stripe's actual REST shapes (form-encoded, Bearer auth) and fully implements Stripe's documented webhook signature scheme (HMAC-SHA256, constant-time compare, replay-window check); the live secret/webhook keys are a deferred human task (cloud-17).
whatBreaks: A signature-verification bug could let a forged webhook activate a subscription for free, or a request-builder bug could send a plan name instead of a Stripe price id and silently fail all real checkouts.

role: In-memory dev/test implementation of the Billing.Gateway behaviour
description: Deterministic (SHA-256 hashed inputs, no network/state) fake for customer/charge/subscription/checkout/portal/webhook operations, used as the default gateway in dev/test so billing paths run at €0 with reproducible ids.
whatBreaks: Every dev/test billing flow (checkout, cancel, webhook verify) produces wrong or non-deterministic ids, breaking test assertions across the billing suite.

role: Ecto schema for a Team's billing subscription record
description: Persists gateway customer/subscription ids, plan (free/trial/supporter/support_plus/forever), status, and dunning/lifecycle columns (past_due, cancel_at_period_end, current_period_end, canceled_at); enforces one live subscription per team via a unique constraint.
whatBreaks: Entitlement checks, Stripe webhook lifecycle handling, and trial/forever grants across the whole cloud billing system could silently mis-price or mis-entitle teams.

role: Context implementing the CLI device-authorization (bp login) handshake
description: RFC-8628-style flow: mints hashed device_code/user_code, tracks pending→approved state, atomically consumes the approved row on poll and mints the real session token; also handles expiry reaping.
whatBreaks: bp CLI login would fail, hang, leak sessions, or allow replay/race exploitation of the approve→poll handoff — a security-sensitive auth surface.

role: GenServer/ETS fixed-window rate limiter for device-auth endpoints
description: Generic check/1 keyed by action-prefixed string (poll/start/approve) with per-action limits; sibling of Accounts.TwoFactorRateLimiter but its own ETS table.
whatBreaks: Missing rate limits would allow brute-forcing the user_code or hammering device-auth start/poll endpoints; wrong limits could lock out legitimate CLI polling.

role: Ecto schema for a pending/approved device-authorization ledger row
description: Stores only SHA-256 hashes of device_code/user_code plus client metadata, status, and expiry; changeset enforces required fields and unique hash indexes.
whatBreaks: Corrupt or permissive validation here would let malformed or colliding device-auth requests through, undermining the whole login handshake's integrity guarantees.

role: Domain/TLS diagnostic checklist engine for the control plane console
description: Probes DNS resolution, target match, TLS validity, and serving response in ordered stages per domain (platform + custom), all through injectable transport seams so tests run offline; feeds S13b dashboard/CLI 'why isn't my domain working' UX.
whatBreaks: Domain/TLS troubleshooting UI in the console and CLI would show wrong or misleading stage statuses, misdirecting users trying to fix custom-domain setup.

role: Team-scoped SSE pub/sub built on OTP :pg for the live dashboard
description: subscribe/broadcast over a closed, contract-tested event-type vocabulary (audit, fleet, sites, subscription, etc.); dashboard treats pushed events as invalidation signals only, not state. Raises on unregistered event types.
whatBreaks: Live dashboard panels (fleet, sites, deployments, subscription, github) would stop refreshing in real time, or a mistyped event type would crash the broadcasting request.

role: Maps raw internal deploy/provision failure strings to human-readable copy
description: Substring-matches jargon from the deploy reaper, provision job claims, and provider errors (Hetzner/Azure) into four human classes at the JSON serialization boundary; stored failure_reason stays raw for logs/alerts.
whatBreaks: Dashboard and CLI would show raw internal jargon (e.g. provider error codes) to end users instead of actionable human copy, or worse could mis-humanize unrelated failures.

role: GitHub App context: connect/disconnect a team's GitHub installation
description: Resolves the configured GitHub.Client (Fake by default, Real once App credentials wired), validates installation ids via get_installation before persisting, stores handle encrypted via Registry.Vault, and exposes read state to the dashboard.
whatBreaks: GitHub connect/disconnect flow could store forged installation ids, leak encrypted handles, or fail closed incorrectly, breaking the deploy-from-GitHub feature end to end.

role: Behaviour (seam) defining all GitHub API operations for the control plane
description: Declares callbacks (get_installation, exchange_installation_token, create_repo, push_files, register_webhook, list_repos) implemented by GitHub.Fake (dev/test) and GitHub.Real (prod); central seam letting the whole GitHub integration be tested with zero real credentials.
whatBreaks: A mismatched callback contract between Fake and Real would desync tests from production behavior, silently breaking the real GitHub deploy integration once credentials are wired.

role: In-memory fake GitHub.Client for dev/test
description: Deterministic, dependency-free implementation of the GitHub.Client behaviour used in dev/test; records created repos/pushes/webhooks in the calling process dictionary so async tests stay isolated with no global state.
whatBreaks: GitHub-connect flows in tests would give false confidence or fail unpredictably under async test runs.

role: Ecto schema for a team's connected GitHub App installation
description: Stores one encrypted installation_id per team (unique per team_id) plus a plaintext display account_login; the encrypted field feeds GitHub API calls via the injected client.
whatBreaks: A broken changeset or missing encryption would let a plaintext GitHub installation handle leak into logs/DB or break the one-installation-per-team invariant.

role: Real GitHub App API client (JWT signing, REST request builders)
description: Builds GitHub App JWTs (RS256 via OTP :public_key) and pure request maps for installation tokens, repo creation, file pushes, and webhook registration; only fires over an injected HTTP client, so in dev/test it never reaches the network (no credentials configured).
whatBreaks: If deployed with real credentials, a bug here would break repo creation/push/webhook registration for every team's GitHub integration, or malform the signed JWT so GitHub rejects all requests.

role: Control-plane liveness probe (DB round-trip check)
description: Tiny module: runs SELECT 1 against Repo and returns {:ok,...}/{:error,...} without raising; used for the control plane's own health endpoint.
whatBreaks: The control plane's health/readiness check would falsely report healthy or crash instead of reporting DB outages, breaking uptime monitoring/orchestration.

role: Oban worker flipping silent-agent instances offline
description: Per-minute sweep over stale-online Barkpark instances: bumps unreachable_count, and once past a debounce threshold flips agent_status to offline, records an event, dispatches an agent_unreachable alert, and broadcasts a fleet update; crash-isolated per instance.
whatBreaks: Silent/dead Barkpark instances would never be detected as offline (stale fleet dashboards) or, if broken the other way, healthy instances could be falsely flagged offline and spam alerts.

role: Platform Swoosh mailer for Barkpark Cloud's own transactional email
description: Config-adapter-selected mailer (Local/Test/SMTP by env) used for all identity emails (invites, resets, verification) and as the default transport for alert email; exposes from/0 for the platform From address.
whatBreaks: All transactional identity emails (invites, password resets, verification) and default alert emails would fail to send, blocking onboarding/account recovery.

role: Folds agent health-beat events into a time-series metrics envelope
description: Pure, total build/3 that reduces a window of AgentEvent 'health' beats into cpu/mem/disk/load series plus beat status/service_health, using a nil-not-zero doctrine for absent/sentinel readings; feeds the console Metrics tab and `bp cloud instance top`.
whatBreaks: The Metrics tab / CLI top command would show wrong, zeroed, or crashing charts for instance resource usage.

role: Core notifications context: settings, transactional email, alert dispatch, chat channels
description: Large context module owning per-team EmailSettings (encryption boundary for SMTP/API secrets), transactional email delegation, event-based alert dispatch to email recipients (team members only, exfiltration guard), and chat-channel (Discord/Slack/Telegram/Pushover/webhook) config + dispatch via Oban with SSRF save-time validation; dispatch_event never raises.
whatBreaks: Alerting/notification delivery across the whole control plane (email + chat) could silently stop, leak secrets, or (SSRF guard bug) allow exfiltration via a malicious webhook URL.

role: Embedded schema for one chat notification channel's config
description: Embedded (jsonb-array) schema holding channel type/enabled/encrypted-credentials; changeset enforces known channel types and blocks enabling a channel without sealed credentials.
whatBreaks: A misconfigured channel could be enabled without valid credentials, causing dispatch failures, or the changeset guard removal could let unencrypted creds slip through.

role: Discord webhook envelope shaper for alert notifications
description: Builds the JSON body/url/headers for a Discord incoming-webhook embed, colored by event severity; returns {:error, :missing_url} if no url in creds.
whatBreaks: Discord alert delivery would send malformed embeds or silently fail for teams using the Discord channel.

role: Pushover chat-channel message shaper
description: Shapes a rendered event into a Pushover form-encoded POST (token+user+title+message+priority) against the fixed Pushover API endpoint; errors on missing credentials.
whatBreaks: Pushover notifications silently fail to deliver or send malformed form params, but no other channel or core flow is affected.

role: Slack incoming-webhook message shaper
description: Builds a Slack Block Kit JSON payload (header+section+text fallback) and posts it to the team-supplied incoming-webhook URL; errors if URL missing.
whatBreaks: Slack alert notifications fail or render malformed blocks in Slack; isolated to this one channel.

role: Telegram Bot API message shaper
description: Derives the sendMessage URL from the bot token, targets creds chat_id, optionally sets message_thread_id for forum topics, and JSON-encodes the rendered event.
whatBreaks: Telegram alerts fail to send or land in the wrong forum thread; isolated to this channel.

role: Generic operator-webhook message shaper with SSRF re-check
description: POSTs a flat JSON envelope (event/team_id/payload/timestamp) to an arbitrary operator-supplied URL; re-validates the URL via SafeUrl.check/1 at send time as defense-in-depth against DNS-rebinding SSRF.
whatBreaks: If the SafeUrl re-check is dropped or bypassed here, the generic webhook channel becomes an SSRF vector reachable by any team; if merely broken, webhook alerts fail silently.

role: Ecto schema for notification delivery log rows
description: One row per recipient per event send (status/attempts/last_error/http_status), team-scoped (nullable for user-scoped identity emails), spans both email and chat channels; the durable observability/audit trail for all outbound notifications.
whatBreaks: Delivery logging/audit trail for every notification (email + chat) becomes incorrect or fails to persist, breaking observability and any future retry-worker logic without stopping actual sends.

role: builds the daily fleet-update operator digest email
description: Pure rendering module (isu-w5) that rolls up managed Barkpark instance rows into a summary (current/behind/paused/latest release) and renders a plain-text Swoosh.Email subject+body reporting per-instance update status; delivery is handled elsewhere via Notifications.deliver_fleet_digest/1.
whatBreaks: operators relying on the daily fleet digest would receive a wrong or crashing summary of which managed Barkpark instances are behind/paused, undermining the whole self-update fleet-visibility feature (isu-w5).

role: Ecto schema for per-team notification/email preferences
description: One row per Team holding transport choice (instance/smtp/api), encrypted SMTP/API secrets, per-event alert toggles, and (via embeds) chat channel configs + event routing map; changeset/2 handles the email half, chat_changeset/2 the chat half with cross-validation against known events/channel types.
whatBreaks: Team alert routing/preferences (which events fire, over which transport/channel) becomes wrong or unvalidated, causing missed alerts, wrong recipients, or plaintext-secret leakage if the encrypted-field contract is violated.

role: Builds per-event alert email Swoosh.Email struct
description: Maps event atoms to subject/body text and composes a Swoosh.Email using the team's configured (or platform default) From address; unknown events fall back to a generic subject so the dispatcher never crashes.
whatBreaks: Alert emails for provisioning/deployment/subscription/etc. events render with wrong or missing content, or an unhandled event crashes the alert dispatch path if the fallback clause regresses.

role: Shared event-to-{title,body,severity} text renderer for chat channels
description: Single data-driven table mapping event name + payload to the human-facing message every chat channel shaper (Slack/Telegram/Pushover/Webhook) wraps in its own envelope; severity drives things like embed color/priority.
whatBreaks: Every chat notification channel simultaneously shows wrong/garbled text or wrong severity, since all channels funnel through this one renderer.

role: SSRF guard validating generic webhook destination URLs
description: Validates scheme/host, rejects known-internal hostnames/suffixes, then resolves the host over inet+inet6 and rejects any private/loopback/link-local/ULA/cloud-metadata address (defeats DNS-rebinding); used by Channels.Webhook at both config-time and send-time.
whatBreaks: A regression here reopens an SSRF hole letting any team's webhook config reach internal services or cloud metadata endpoints (e.g. 169.254.169.254), a real security vulnerability rather than a mere feature bug.

role: Builders + senders for identity/transactional emails (invite, reset, verify)
description: One builder per transactional email type (invite, password reset, email verification, email-change code, test email); always sends over the platform Mailer transport regardless of team SMTP settings so onboarding never depends on team config; tokens/URLs are caller-supplied.
whatBreaks: Team invites, password resets, email verification, or email-change confirmation stop sending or send with broken links/codes, directly blocking user onboarding and account-recovery flows platform-wide.

role: Consumer OAuth/SSO context for Barkpark Cloud (GitHub/Google sign-in)
description: Resolves a provider to its strategy module + config, drives authorize/token/userinfo exchange over an injected httpc transport, and implements a cookieless, single-use, HMAC-signed CSRF state (mint_state/verify_state) backed by the oauth_states table. Central seam for every 'Continue with GitHub/Google' flow into Cloud accounts.
whatBreaks: Consumer SSO sign-in breaks entirely or becomes forgeable/replayable, letting attackers bypass CSRF protection or blocking all GitHub/Google logins.

role: GitHub OAuth2 strategy implementing the OAuth.Provider behaviour
description: Builds GitHub's authorize/token/userinfo/emails request maps and parses identity from the numeric id + verified primary email (requires a second /user/emails call since /user omits private email).
whatBreaks: GitHub sign-in fails or could link the wrong/unverified email to an account.

role: Google OAuth2/OIDC strategy implementing the OAuth.Provider behaviour
description: Builds Google's authorize/token/userinfo request maps and parses identity from the OIDC 'sub' claim plus verified email_verified flag.
whatBreaks: Google sign-in fails or an unverified email could be accepted as an identity, enabling account-linking abuse.

role: Behaviour contract for per-IdP OAuth strategy modules
description: Defines the callbacks (authorize_url/3, token_request/3, userinfo_request/1, parse_identity/1, optional emails_request/1) and the shared request-map shape consumed by Billing.HttpClient's transport; adding a new IdP is a config+module edit against this contract.
whatBreaks: A malformed or misimplemented strategy silently fails to compile-check against the behaviour, breaking sign-in for that provider or letting an unverified identity through.

role: Ecto schema for the single-use OAuth CSRF state ledger (oauth_states table)
description: Stores nonce/provider/expires_at rows so BarkparkCloud.OAuth.verify_state/2 can atomically consume (delete) a state exactly once, making the signed HMAC state replay-proof.
whatBreaks: OAuth callbacks could replay a captured state token (CSRF/session-fixation risk) or legitimate single-use logins could be wrongly rejected.

role: Core control-plane context for registered Barkpark instances (fleet, provisioning, health, billing suspension)
description: Very large (4500+ line) Ecto-backed context owning barkpark CRUD, provisioning-job claim/succeed/fail state machines (with row-locking claim-fence and idempotent terminal-state guards), health/staleness detection, billing-lapse and quota suspension, custom-domain attach, and Azure credential resolution. This is the load-bearing seam between the dashboard/API and the off-box Go warm-pool worker.
whatBreaks: Instance provisioning, health monitoring, billing suspension, or the worker job-claim protocol could double-provision boxes, leak credentials, strand billed servers, or corrupt fleet state across all Cloud tenants.

role: Ecto schema for the append-only per-instance agent event audit stream
description: Stores typed (health/status/backup/tls/content/verify) jsonb-payload events belonging to a Barkpark, insert-only with no updated_at; backs onboarding signals and on-demand readiness verification history.
whatBreaks: Loss of instance audit history / onboarding signal derivation (e.g. 'published a doc' checklist) or readiness-verify results not recorded.

role: Ecto schema for revocable on-box agent bearer tokens
description: Stores only a SHA-256 hash of the agent token (plaintext returned once at mint) plus revoked_at/expires_at/scope, mirroring api/'s ApiToken pattern; hash_token/1 is the single hashing source shared by mint and verify.
whatBreaks: Agent authentication to the control plane could be bypassed (if hashing/validation drifts) or all on-box agents could lose the ability to authenticate reports.

role: Pure mapper from raw Azure regions/VM sizes to the provider-neutral provisioning catalog shape
description: Normalizes Azure's location/vm_size API shapes into the exact %{regions, server_types, currency} shape HetznerCatalog.normalize/2 also emits, so dashboard/CLI render one menu across providers regardless of source.
whatBreaks: Azure region/server-type picker in the dashboard or bp CLI shows wrong, missing, or malformed options, or pricing display breaks for Azure launches.

role: Ecto schema for a registered Barkpark instance row (the fleet's core entity)
description: Defines the barkparks table schema (identity, health/agent/suspension status axes, provider-neutral launch fields, encrypted admin/bootstrap/vercel secrets, custom domain, autoupdate policy) plus FQDN/subdomain derivation logic and numerous narrow purpose-scoped changesets that contain what each write path may touch.
whatBreaks: Malformed changesets or FQDN derivation could cross-tenant-collide DNS subdomains, leak encrypted secrets into a public JSON view, or let a narrow write path (health report, staleness worker) illegitimately rename/reassign an instance.

role: Ecto schema for a Site's build/release job, with claim fencing
description: Models one build-and-release row the off-box builder claims and drives through queued→building→pushing→live/failed/cancelled, including a legal_transition? state graph, gh-6 branch-preview environment fields, promote-by-new-deployment attrs, and claim_worker/claim_epoch CAS fencing mirroring the bp task substrate.
whatBreaks: A bad transition rule or changeset lets an illegal status jump through, corrupting the deploy pipeline or wrongly flipping a site's live pointer.

role: Ecto schema for team/instance-scoped encrypted environment variables
description: Stores user secrets/env vars scoped to a Team or a specific Barkpark instance, ciphertext-only via Vault.encrypt, with scope-shape validation (barkpark scope requires barkpark_id, team scope forbids it) and per-scope uniqueness constraints.
whatBreaks: Wrong scope validation could leak a team secret into the wrong instance's runtime env or fail to enforce per-scope uniqueness, causing secret collisions.

role: Ecto schema for the single-row fleet-wide autoupdate kill switch
description: Defines the `fleet_settings` schema holding one boolean, `autoupdate_halted` — the platform-operator switch that freezes new self-update advancement across the whole managed fleet (in-flight updates still settle); read/written via Registry.autoupdate_halted?/0 and set_autoupdate_halted/1.
whatBreaks: a broken changeset or missing halt flag would let the AutoupdateRolloutWorker keep advancing self-updates fleet-wide even when an operator intended to halt them, or conversely leave the fleet permanently stuck if the flag can't be unset.

role: Pure-data allowlist of every Hetzner Cloud API action the proxy may call
description: Defines read/mutate/destroy tiered catalog entries with exact upstream path templates so /v1/hetzner/* proxy calls are unreachable unless derived from this list; also hosts a separate provisioning catalog normalizer (regions/server types/pricing) mapping raw hcloud payloads into a provider-neutral shape shared with Azure's catalog.
whatBreaks: A missing tier filter or malformed path template could let the proxy execute an unintended (e.g. destructive) Hetzner API call, or break server pricing/region display in provisioning UI.

role: Pure-data allowlist for control-plane→customer-instance API proxying
description: Defines webhook.* capabilities (list/show/create/update/delete/rotate/deliveries/replay) with path templates, tiers, and render_path/2 which safely substitutes only declared placeholders using an RFC3986-unreserved-charset guard, preventing path/query/fragment injection when the router proxies to a customer's Barkpark instance.
whatBreaks: A render_path bug could allow path traversal or query injection into a customer instance's API, or break all webhook management proxying from the control plane.

role: Ecto schema for a Team's connected cloud provider credential (Hetzner/Azure)
description: Stores the single encrypted credential column for either a Hetzner API token or an Azure service-principal JSON blob, with per-kind shape validation on a virtual :credential field before Vault encryption; the seam every provisioning flow reads its cloud credentials through.
whatBreaks: A validation gap could persist a malformed or blank credential, causing every provisioning attempt for that provider to fail or leaking a secret shape mismatch.

role: Ecto schema for the queue bridging the control plane and Go warm-pool provisioner
description: Flat 4-state (pending/claimed/succeeded/failed) job queue with stale-claim re-claim via attempts budget, four kinds (provision/deprovision/attach_domain/resurrect), and dwb-14/dwb-16 append-only step + console narration fields surfaced to the /new progress UI; enforces one active job per (barkpark, kind) via unique index.
whatBreaks: A broken uniqueness or step-validation guard could double-provision (double-bill) a box or corrupt live progress narration on the go-live screen.

role: Ecto schema for a hosted website co-located with a Barkpark instance
