whatBreaks: A wrong KNOWN_TYPES set or notFound() ordering causes real documents to 404 or lets unknown types render, and breaks per-doc OpenGraph metadata sitewide.

role: Split-view shell layout hosting the persistent Finder rail
description: Server layout for the (finder) route group; renders <Finder> in the left rail (so it never remounts across navigation) plus {children} as the detail pane, server-seeds the initial browse/search results and a prefix-seed index for instant first keystrokes.
whatBreaks: Breaks the entire finder UX — search state loss on navigation, missing instant first paint, or the master/detail split failing across the whole web demo.

role: Finder landing page (right pane) — graph or map demo
description: Default child route for '/' inside the finder layout; picks between a corpus graph visualization (default, Barkpark docs demo) or a listings map (place-directory template) based on NEXT_PUBLIC_FINDER_LANDING, each desktop-only with a mobile hint fallback.
whatBreaks: The landing pane fails to render or the wrong template demo (graph vs map) ships, confusing the two demo deployments.

role: Server route triggering an Indx search index rebuild
description: POST-only Next.js API route that proxies to the Phoenix reindex endpoint using the server-only read token, then purges the Next.js find cache tag; maps upstream errors to appropriate HTTP statuses (503 for transient restarts).
whatBreaks: Search index rebuilds silently fail or stale search caches never clear after content changes.

role: Inbound webhook endpoint verifying Barkpark cache-revalidation signals
description: Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signatures (dual-secret rotation support, dual wire-format parsing, timestamp tolerance, timing-safe compare) from the Barkpark dispatcher, dedups deliveries in-process, and calls revalidateTag for affected doc/type/find tags — the core webhook-realtime cache-busting seam for the web demo.
whatBreaks: A signature-verification bug either lets forged webhooks bust caches (DoS via cache thrash) or blocks legitimate ones, leaving the whole demo serving stale content indefinitely.

role: Server route recording search feedback signals (clicks, corrections)
description: Proxies 'did you mean' correction-accepts and result-click events to the Phoenix search interaction/correction endpoints using the server-only token; always returns 200 so a recording failure never blocks the UX.
whatBreaks: Search relevance learning signals (click-through, corrections) silently stop being recorded, degrading search quality over time without any visible error.

role: Server route powering the finder's live search/browse and suggestions
description: GET handler proxying search queries and popular/no-hit suggestions to the Phoenix search API server-side (hiding the token), choosing postgres vs indx engine and browse-vs-query mode; degrades to an empty response on upstream failure rather than erroring.
whatBreaks: The finder's live search box (the demo's primary interaction) stops returning results or silently always falls back to an empty state.

role: Route handler emitting the finder's local prefix search index
description: GET /api/search-seed builds and serves a small cached prefix index (via buildPrefixSeed over runSearch browse results) so 1-2 char finder queries resolve instantly client-side before the live WebSocket search replies; also exports buildSeed() for direct SSR use by the finder layout, with fail-soft empty-index fallback on error.
whatBreaks: Finder's instant-typeahead head-start would break or serve stale/empty prefix data, degrading perceived search latency but not causing hard failures due to the try/catch

role: benchmark page route
description: Minimal Next.js page that mounts the `<Bench>` component and sets page metadata for the engine latency benchmark demo.
whatBreaks: The /bench demo page fails to render.

role: Next.js App Router global error boundary UI
description: Client component rendering a friendly error screen with retry/back-home actions for uncaught errors anywhere in the web app's route tree; logs the error to console per Next convention.
whatBreaks: Uncaught render errors would show Next's default unstyled error page or a blank screen instead of a recoverable UI, hurting all users hitting any runtime error

role: RSS 2.0 feed route handler for posts and papers
description: GET /feed.xml builds an RSS feed from the same bounded fetchPosts/fetchPapers queries pages use, XML-escaping all text and never throwing (empty channel on failure so crawlers don't see a 500); revalidated hourly.
whatBreaks: RSS readers/crawlers would get malformed XML or stale/empty feed content, breaking syndication without affecting the main site

role: permanent redirect from /find to /
description: Redirects /find (old finder URL) to / with query string preserved. Ensures backwards compatibility for bookmarks and old links.
whatBreaks: Old /find links and bookmarks break instead of redirecting gracefully to the finder.

role: Next.js root error boundary for the web demo
description: Client component catching errors thrown by the root layout itself; must ship its own <html>/<body> since it replaces the layout, styled with self-contained inline Tailwind since global CSS may not be loaded. Offers a reset button and a link home.
whatBreaks: A root-layout crash would render a blank/broken page instead of a graceful recovery UI, or fail to compile due to missing <html>/<body>.

role: Global Tailwind stylesheet with generated design-token CSS variables
description: Imports Tailwind, bridges generated color tokens (from design/tokens.json via design/emit.mjs — do not hand-edit the GENERATED block) into --color-bg/--color-text etc. for light/dark and multiple bp-theme identities (evergreen/ember/fjord), plus scrollbar styling, search-highlight marks, and disclosure chevron animation.
whatBreaks: Broken theme variables cascade into wrong colors/contrast across every page of the web demo in one or all themes/modes.

role: Root HTML layout for the entire Next.js web demo
description: Top-level App Router layout: sets up self-hosted Inter/Geist Mono fonts, site-wide metadata (metadataBase for absolute OG/canonical URLs), an inline FOUC-avoidance script seeding data-theme and data-bp-theme before paint, and mounts global client islands (QuickSwitcher, LiveBridge, SpeedInsights).
whatBreaks: Every page in the web demo breaks or flashes wrong theme/fonts, and sitewide metadata (OG previews) becomes malformed.

role: Global 404 page for the Next.js web demo
description: Simple static Next.js not-found route rendering a 404 message with a link back home. No data fetching, no logic.
whatBreaks: Unmatched routes would show a blank/default error instead of a branded 404 message.

role: Route-level loading skeleton for /papers listing
description: Renders PostsListSkeleton as Next.js's route fallback during the async RSC fetch of the papers corpus, avoiding a frozen pane on cold navigation and matching the real listing shell to prevent layout jump.
whatBreaks: Navigating to /papers would show a frozen/blank pane or a mismatched skeleton causing a layout jump instead of a smooth transition.

role: Papers listing page (Bulldocs/PortableDoc index) for the web demo
description: Server component that fetches published papers from the production dataset via fetchPapers(client) and renders a list linking to /d/paper/[slug]; wraps in Suspense with a skeleton fallback and shows an inline error panel on fetch failure.
whatBreaks: The /papers listing would fail to render or link to the wrong reader route, breaking discovery of Paper documents in the demo.

role: Next.js robots.txt generator for the web demo
description: Declares crawl-everything policy and points crawlers to the sitemap via absoluteUrl, sharing the same origin resolution as sitemap.ts and the RSS feed.
whatBreaks: Search engine crawlers could be blocked from the public demo or given a broken/relative sitemap URL, hurting SEO/discoverability.

role: Dynamic XML sitemap generator for public reader
description: Enumerates canonical /d/[type]/[slug] URLs for published posts and papers (up to 50 each via shared list helpers), plus the papers listing, tag pages, and home; reuses the same server client as the pages, hourly revalidate, and degrades to static routes on any upstream failure so a flaky API never breaks the build/crawl.
whatBreaks: Sitemap could omit content, throw during build (breaking deploys), or list stale/incorrect URLs, degrading SEO indexing of the public demo.

role: Route wrapper for the web demo's design-token style guide page
description: Thin page component rendering the Styleguide component with page metadata; the living spec of palette/status/type tokens emitted from design/tokens.json.
whatBreaks: The /styleguide route would fail to render or show wrong page metadata; low blast radius since it's a diagnostic/reference page, not core reader functionality.

role: Route-level loading skeleton for /tags/[tag] listing
description: Renders PostsListSkeleton as the fallback while the tag listing page awaits and filters the papers corpus, matching the real listing's shell to avoid layout jump.
whatBreaks: Navigating to a tag page would show a frozen pane or mismatched skeleton instead of an instant loading state.

role: RSC page listing papers filtered by tag
description: Force-dynamic route that fetches up to 200 papers via the SDK client, decodes the URL-encoded tag param, and filters client/server-side (no server-side JSONB containment endpoint used here, though Phoenix has docs_with_tag) to render matching papers with error/empty states, wrapped in Suspense.
whatBreaks: Tag pages would show wrong/no results, crash on malformed tag data, or silently fail to filter, breaking the /tags/<tag> discovery feature in the demo.

role: Same-origin SSE proxy bridging browser live-listen to the token-gated Phoenix API
description: Node runtime route handler that forwards the browser's live-listen request (query params + Last-Event-ID) to the upstream Phoenix `/v1/data/listen/:dataset` endpoint, injecting the server-only READ_TOKEN and piping back the text/event-stream response so the token never reaches the client; this is the mechanism `<BarkparkLive/>` (SDK) depends on for realtime updates in the demo.
whatBreaks: Realtime/live-listen updates in the web demo would silently break (401s or dropped streams) or, worse, leak the server API token to the browser.

role: Route-level loading skeleton for /w/[workspace] landing
description: Renders PostsListSkeleton while the workspace landing route resolves its default project server-side and redirects to /w/<ws>/p/<project>, bridging the redirect await with matching chrome.
whatBreaks: Workspace-switch navigation would show a frozen pane during the server-side redirect resolution instead of an instant skeleton.

role: Scoped workspace/project layout
description: Server component layout for scoped /w/:workspace/p/:project routes — fetches workspace and project lists to populate a switcher, renders a sticky breadcrumb header, and wraps all nested pages in the workspace/project frame.
whatBreaks: All scoped workspace/project pages lose their navigation header and workspace switcher, breaking multi-tenant navigation.

role: Route-level loading skeleton for scoped project post listing
description: Renders PostsListSkeleton as the fallback for the workspace/project-scoped post listing route while its RSC awaits the scoped posts fetch.
whatBreaks: Switching workspace/project would freeze the previous pane instead of showing an immediate loading skeleton.

role: Scoped (workspace/project) post listing page for the web demo
description: Server component fetching posts scoped to a workspace+project via getScopedPosts (tenancy-scoped client), rendered through PostsList behind Suspense; 60s ISR is a safety net while cache tag invalidation is the primary freshness path.
whatBreaks: Multi-tenant scoped post listings (the demo's tenancy showcase) would fail to load or show wrong-scope content.

role: Route-level loading skeleton for scoped post detail page
description: Static markup (no client component, no data) mirroring PostArticle's chrome — back-link, title, byline, body placeholders — since the page awaits getPost() with no inner Suspense, so this fallback paints immediately on cold navigation or cache miss.
whatBreaks: Viewing a scoped post would freeze the previous pane with no feedback during the getPost() await instead of showing a skeleton matching the article layout.

role: Scoped (workspace/project) single post detail page + metadata
description: Fetches a single post within a workspace/project scope via getPost, generates SEO/OpenGraph metadata (triggering notFound() early so 404s return real HTTP status), and renders via PostArticle.
whatBreaks: Scoped post detail pages would 200 with wrong status codes, show stale metadata, or fail to render the article in the tenancy demo.

role: workspace landing redirect resolver
description: Resolves a workspace's default project server-side by listing its projects, then redirects to /w/<workspace>/p/<project>. Used by the workspace switcher when switching to a workspace without knowing its projects.
whatBreaks: The workspace switcher fails to navigate to any project — users switching workspaces land on a 404 or error instead of the default project view.

role: Client-side search-engine benchmark UI (Postgres vs Indx)
description: "use client" component that runs a fixed query set against both search engines via /api/find, timing round-trip and upstream latency, and renders a results/median table; a demo/debug tool, not core product surface.
whatBreaks: The /bench benchmarking page would show wrong or broken latency comparisons; no impact on core reading/search flows.

role: Client gate that mounts children only on desktop viewports
description: Uses useSyncExternalStore on a matchMedia(md) query so children (like the heavy GraphView script) never mount on mobile/SSR, avoiding hydration mismatch and unnecessary script downloads below the md breakpoint.
whatBreaks: The desktop-only graph/map landing would either flash on mobile, hydration-mismatch, or fail to gate the heavy bp-graph.js download on phones.

role: detail pane sticky header
description: Client component rendering the sticky header inside the document detail pane: shows the type badge, document title, optional standalone link, and a close button that preserves the finder's query-string state.
whatBreaks: The detail pane header disappears or the close button loses the finder search state, breaking navigation UX.

role: Server component dispatching document detail rendering by _type (post/paper/sheet/other)
description: Fetches a document via getDocument(type, slug), pre-resolves valuerefs for papers, and dispatches rendering to PostArticle/PortableDoc(or PaperEditorDoc)/SheetGrid/MetaCard depending on doc type; also handles error and not-found panels as a safety net behind the page-level notFound(). Central hub for the unified /d/[type]/[slug] reader.
whatBreaks: Every document type's detail pane in the finder/reader UI (posts, papers, sheets, and generic docs) could fail to render or show the wrong content.

role: Keyboard focus/nav layer for the finder's right-pane document view
description: "use client" wrapper implementing whole-doc vs in-content roving focus (arrow keys, Escape, back-to-list) generically over any rendered document via DOM querySelector, driven by a shared finder-nav-context so it works across post/paper/sheet renderers with no per-renderer wiring.
whatBreaks: Keyboard navigation inside the finder's document pane (reading through content, returning to the list) would break or trap focus.

role: Shared empty-state UI card for list routes
description: Presentational-only component rendering a centered dashed-border card with an optional icon and message; used to unify the 'nothing here yet' look across papers/tags/posts list routes.
whatBreaks: List routes with no items would show inconsistent or missing empty-state styling; no functional breakage.

role: Core client search/finder UI — the web demo's search, facets, results, and keyboard nav
description: Large "use client" component implementing the unified Find UI: debounced query state synced to the URL, live WebSocket or HTTP search across postgres/indx engines, exact-match partitioning, contextual snippets, match-strength meter, highlight rendering, facets, sort, did-you-mean suggestions, prefix-seed instant results, cross-component graph-hover bridging, and full roving keyboard nav (search/list/facets/document). This is the largest and most central interactive component in the web demo.
whatBreaks: Search (the demo's flagship feature) — typing, results, facets, engine switching, keyboard nav, and the finder↔graph integration — could break or misbehave across the whole site.

role: Client component rendering the Obsidian-style doc graph on the "/" landing right pane
description: Wraps GraphView, translating node clicks into finder-preserving route pushes and bridging hover state bidirectionally with the Finder's result list via shared context (useHoveredDoc/useGraphMatches).
whatBreaks: The landing page's graph visualization would fail to navigate to documents or lose its hover/highlight sync with search results.

role: React wrapper mounting the vanilla Canvas2D graph renderer
description: Client component bridging React state (nodes/edges/matches/hover) into the self-contained `public/bp-graph.js` renderer via a window-global factory, handling script-load races and avoiding unnecessary re-seeding via a topology signature.
whatBreaks: The finder's graph visualization fails to init, desyncs from search matches, or thrashes/re-animates on every search keystroke.

role: Canvas2D slippy map rendering listing pins in the finder's right pane
description: Self-contained vanilla Canvas2D map (no Leaflet/Mapbox) with Web-Mercator projection, optional OSM raster tiles, pan/zoom, hover/select bridge to the finder's search results via matches/hoveredId/onHover/onSelect props; replacement for the old docs graph view.
whatBreaks: The directory landing's map pane would fail to render pins, mis-project coordinates, or break the two-way hover/filter bridge with the finder's search results.

role: Mounts realtime live-content subscription for the web demo
description: Client component that builds a same-origin BarkparkLive client (no exposed token) and renders it to trigger router.refresh() on upstream changes; inert unless NEXT_PUBLIC_BARKPARK_LIVE=1.
whatBreaks: Live content updates stop propagating to the demo UI, or (if misconfigured) leaks a token to the client bundle.

role: Right-pane '/' landing wiring ListingsMap into the finder context
description: Thin wrapper that connects useHoveredDoc/useGraphMatches context hooks to ListingsMap, rendering a location-count caption; the drop-in peer of graph-landing.tsx for the directory template's home route.
whatBreaks: The homepage map landing would lose the search-filter/hover bridge to the finder rail, or fail to render listing counts.

role: Generic fallback summary card for untyped/unknown document types
description: Server component rendering a title, type badge, prose excerpt, and a definition list of scalar fields for any document type lacking a bespoke reader; normalizes slug/date fields defensively to avoid React crashes on object-shaped values.
whatBreaks: Unknown document types dead-end with a blank page or a React crash instead of a readable fallback view.

role: Client mount for read-mode <bp-paper-editor> web-component blocks in a Paper
description: Creates one <bp-paper-editor editable=false> custom element per prose block (paragraph/heading/list) inside a paper, interleaving them with server-rendered non-prose slots in document order; mirrors graph-view.tsx's script-load race handling (poll + Script onReady).
whatBreaks: Papers with prose blocks would fail to render editable-look text via the TipTap-based web component, breaking the read-mode Paper embed on the web demo.

role: Core PortableDoc block/inline renderer for the web reader
description: Large server-component renderer converting the full PortableDoc block/inline JSON schema (headings, lists, callouts, tables, sheets, task boards, cards, pipelines, roadmaps, valuerefs, wikilinks, etc.) into JSX; also exports an editor-aware variant (PaperEditorDoc) that slots prose blocks into a client editor mount. Central to how every Paper renders on the public site.
whatBreaks: Any Paper/PortableDoc content fails to render, crashes, or silently drops blocks across the entire public reading surface and the in-place editor.

role: post/document detail view component
description: Renders a post article with title, author, date, body (normalized from string or PortableDoc blocks), excerpt. Supports both standalone page (with header/back-link) and embedded detail-pane mode (no chrome). Shared by flat and scoped routes
whatBreaks: Post detail pages fail to render or render malformed — body paragraphs missing, dates invisible, embedded mode shows chrome it shouldn't; detail-pane integration in master layout breaks

role: Shared post listing view (index + skeleton) for flat/scoped routes
description: Renders the Barkpark demo home listing (header, nav, post cards with date/excerpt) and its Suspense skeleton fallback; used by both flat and workspace/project-scoped routes.
whatBreaks: The demo's post index page (or scoped equivalents) fails to render or shows a broken/incorrect listing.

role: Cmd/Ctrl-O global quick-switcher search dialog
description: Obsidian-style modal search reusing the /api/find route and FindHit/readerHref helpers; handles debounced fetch with out-of-order race guards, keyboard nav, focus trap/restore, and body scroll lock. Mounted once in root layout.
whatBreaks: Global quick-search (Cmd-O) would fail to open, search, or navigate to documents across the whole web demo.

role: Read-only spreadsheet grid renderer (raw tabs + paper-embedded snapshots)
description: Shared GridTable component plus two public wrappers (SheetGrid for raw multi-tab documents, SheetSnapshot for paper-embedded dense snapshots) handling merges, column widths, cell styles, formats, checkboxes, and URL linkification, mirroring the Elixir/Studio sheet rendering logic.
whatBreaks: Sheet documents or embedded sheet blocks render incorrectly (wrong merges/alignment/values) or crash on the web demo.

role: Living design-token style guide page for the web demo
description: Renders palette swatches, status-role colors, and a UI type-scale ladder, all sourced live from CSS custom properties emitted by design/emit.mjs from design/tokens.json; includes ThemePicker and ThemeToggle switches.
whatBreaks: The /styleguide demo page would show stale or incorrect token previews; no impact on production functionality.

role: Theme-palette (evergreen/ember/fjord) select dropdown
description: Orthogonal to ThemeToggle: mutates document.documentElement.dataset.bpTheme and persists to localStorage bp_theme, syncing via a custom bp:themechange event read through useSyncExternalStore; seeded pre-paint by an inline layout.tsx script to avoid flash.
whatBreaks: Users could not switch color palettes on the web demo, or the picker could desync from the toggle/localStorage causing a flash of wrong theme.

role: Light/dark mode toggle button
description: Flips document.documentElement.dataset.theme and persists to localStorage.theme, no next-themes dependency; reads via useSyncExternalStore and dispatches the same bp:themechange event ThemePicker listens for, keeping the two switches in lockstep.
whatBreaks: Light/dark toggling would fail or flash incorrectly on load across the web demo.

role: Header control for switching active workspace/project scope
description: Client component showing/switching the active `w/<workspace>/p/<project>` scope; degrades to a static label when no options list is available (no list endpoint), and routes project changes directly but workspace changes via the landing redirect route.
whatBreaks: Users can't navigate between workspaces/projects, or navigation targets an invalid/empty scope.

role: ESLint configuration for Next.js web app
description: Configures ESLint rules for the web package, enabling Next.js-specific linting. Purely a dev tooling file with no runtime impact.
whatBreaks: Linting is misconfigured or disabled, allowing code quality regressions to slip through CI.

role: Server-side Barkpark SDK client factory (scoped + flat)
description: Wraps @barkpark/core's createClient with server-only defaults (project URL, dataset, API version, read token) and a per-request scoped-client factory for workspace/project routes; the default `client` export backs all flat top-level routes.
whatBreaks: All server-rendered data fetches against the Barkpark API break or become unauthenticated/misscoped across the entire web demo.

role: Checked-in snapshot of demo dataset's Barkpark schemas (fixture)
description: A 45-schema JSON dump (ability, arena, author, book, bossAbility, fagprat_* etc.) from PR #248's typed-SDK codegen; not referenced by any current source file (only found in .next build caches), suggesting it's a stale/unused fixture or consumed only at codegen time outside the app runtime.
whatBreaks: If still used by SDK codegen drift-gating, stale schema data would cause generated types to mismatch the live API; otherwise it is dead weight with no runtime effect.

role: Generated TypeScript types for every schema in the dataset
description: Codegen output (@barkpark/codegen, DO NOT EDIT) that mirrors the server schema hash into TS interfaces for every content type (post, task, book/ONIX, game-design types, sheet, etc.) plus BarkparkTypeMap/BarkparkAnyDocument unions. Any consumer of typed Barkpark documents in web/ imports from here.
whatBreaks: Stale or hand-edited types would silently type-check against a schema shape that no longer matches the API, letting real field-shape bugs slip past the compiler across the whole web app.

role: Canonical Barkpark API URL/token env-var resolution with legacy fallback
description: Single source of truth for reading NEXT_PUBLIC_BARKPARK_API_URL/BARKPARK_TOKEN with fallback to older NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL/BARKPARK_READ_TOKEN names, preserving the public/server split so the token never reaches the browser.
whatBreaks: Every server-side fetch and client API call in web/ depends on PUBLIC_API_URL/READ_TOKEN from this file, so a wrong precedence or accidental NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix on the token would either break all API calls or leak the read token into browser JS.

role: Resilient low-level fetch wrapper for the Barkpark API
description: Centralizes keep-alive connection pooling (undici Agent), timeout, transient-failure retry/backoff across API restarts, and defensive JSON parsing into a structured BpUpstreamError; exposes bpFetchJson and humanUpstreamMessage used wherever code talks to the API outside the SDK client.
whatBreaks: Upstream API calls hang, throw cryptic JSON parse errors, or fail to retry through deploy-restart windows, causing spurious outages across any caller.

role: Cache-tag naming scheme for Next.js revalidation
description: Defines the bp:ds:<dataset>:... tag format (all/doc/type) used to tag fetches so the webhook handler's revalidateTag calls bust exactly the affected caches; re-exports DATASET from config.ts.
whatBreaks: Cache invalidation stops matching tagged fetches after a Studio publish, so the demo serves stale content indefinitely.

role: Web-side structural projections for PortableDoc components, parity-tested against Elixir goldens
description: Pure TS functions (card, notes, pipeline, roadmap, task-detail, columns, terminal, status-legend) that project authored PortableDoc blocks into the same structural shape the Elixir generator emits as golden fixtures; portable-doc.tsx renders from these and a test asserts equality against committed goldens, catching web/Elixir render drift.
whatBreaks: A projection diverging from the Elixir golden would either fail the parity test (blocking CI) or, if untested for that case, silently render task/roadmap/card components differently on web than in Studio/Go pdrender.

role: dataset name constant
description: Single-source-of-truth for the active Barkpark dataset name, defaulting to 'docs' and overridable via BARKPARK_DATASET env var. Centralises a value previously scattered across six call sites.
whatBreaks: All finder, reader, and graph queries hit the wrong dataset, returning empty or incorrect results.

role: client-side spelling suggestion utility
description: Implements conservative client-side 'Did you mean?' suggestions using Levenshtein distance against result titles and popular queries. Fires only for single-token queries of length ≥4 when the typed term is absent from results.
whatBreaks: Spelling suggestions disappear or show incorrect alternatives in the finder UI.

role: Server-side upstream caller for the Next.js finder's HTTP search path
description: Builds and issues the search request to the Barkpark API (postgres or indx engine), handling scope/token selection, per-search recording headers, and timing, then shapes the raw JSON via find-shape into a FindResponse. Shared by the /api/find route and the server-rendered home page so both never drift.
whatBreaks: The Next.js demo's search box and browse/home page would return wrong, unscoped, or broken results (or leak private schemas if the type allowlist is wrong).

role: Pure upstream-JSON-to-FindResponse mapper shared by HTTP and WebSocket search paths
description: Normalizes a raw search payload (documents/count/facets/etc.) into the uniform FindResponse shape; deliberately has no server-only deps so it runs identically in the Node route handler and the browser WS client, keeping HTTP and live search byte-identical.
whatBreaks: Search results would render inconsistently (or crash) between the HTTP fallback and the live WebSocket search path.

role: Shared finder types, doc-type registry, and raw-document normalization for the demo
description: Defines SearchEngine/DocType/FindHit/FindResponse types, the DOC_TYPES registry driving which content types are browsable and their reader hrefs, and normalizeHit which derives title/excerpt/body/slug/date/facets from any raw Barkpark document. No secrets, imported by both server route and client Finder component.
whatBreaks: Every search result across the whole demo site would show wrong titles/excerpts/links, or new/renamed document types would silently vanish from search and browse.

role: keyboard navigation context for finder layout
description: React context that bridges keyboard focus between the Finder rail (Search/Facets/List) and the Document detail pane across separate Next.js route segments, using monotonic nonces to trigger cross-segment focus transitions.
whatBreaks: Keyboard navigation between the list and document panes breaks in the finder.

role: Search-highlight scoring engine — turns query terms + text into colored match segments
description: Implements a keyboard/phonetic-aware Damerau-Levenshtein + LCS-based scorer that classifies each word match (exact/inflection/verbatim/corrected) and derives highlight color, underline style, and quality label; also exports termHitsWords used by the strength meter/ranking to stay consistent with what's visually highlighted.
whatBreaks: Search result highlighting would mis-color or mis-label matches (e.g. claiming a corrected typo is exact), misleading users about search quality; ranking/strength meter could disagree with the highlighter.

role: generic document fetch utility
description: Server-only module providing a type-agnostic two-step fetch (slug then id fallback) for any Barkpark document type, used by reader pages across post/paper/sheet types.
whatBreaks: Document reader pages for all content types fail to resolve documents by slug or id.

role: ISR-cached post fetch helper
description: Server-only helper that wraps post-by-slug fetches with React cache() and unstable_cache, supporting both flat and scoped (workspace+project) clients for multi-tenant post lookups.
whatBreaks: Post pages fetch twice per request or fail to bust cache on publish; scoped post routes may use the wrong dataset client.

role: Server-side fetcher/shaper for the landing page's corpus relationship graph
description: Calls Barkpark's /v1/graph endpoint, normalizes nodes/edges tolerant of field-name drift, computes a root/accent node, and caches via unstable_cache tagged for webhook invalidation; feeds the vanilla Canvas2D renderer (window.BarkparkGraphRenderer). Fails soft to an empty graph rather than crashing the landing page.
whatBreaks: The landing page's interactive corpus graph visualization would show wrong/missing nodes-edges or an empty state even when data exists.

role: Graph–finder hover and match context provider
description: Provides two React contexts: one for the currently hovered graph node doc-id (used to highlight finder rows), and one for the finder's visible result set with weights (used to dim non-matching graph nodes). Both use optimized stable setters to avoid unnecessary re-renders.
whatBreaks: Bidirectional hover highlighting between the landing graph and finder rail breaks entirely.

role: Listing type contract plus bundled sample dog-friendly-locations dataset
description: Defines the generic Listing interface (id/title/lat/lng required, rest optional) shared by the server data layer and the client map component, and ships a hardcoded sample dataset of Norwegian cities so the map-landing template works with zero backend configured.
whatBreaks: The map-landing demo template would fail to render pins or crash if Listing's required fields changed without updating both the server fetcher and the client map component that both import this file.

role: Server data layer fetching/normalizing listings for the map-landing template, with sample-data fallback
description: server-only module that queries the Barkpark API for a configurable LISTINGS_TYPE, tolerantly extracts lat/lng from several possible upstream shapes, caches via unstable_cache, and never throws — falling back to SAMPLE_LISTINGS on any failure or when unconfigured.
whatBreaks: A broken normalizeListing or cache key would either silently drop all real listings (falling back to demo data) or crash the map-landing Server Component if the never-throw contract were violated.

role: Shared helper resolving a link mark's href with attrs-first precedence
description: One small pure function mirroring the Go pdrender and Elixir render/inline.ex markHref logic (prefer attrs.href over top-level href) so ProseMirror-authored link marks render correctly on web instead of as dead spans.
whatBreaks: Diverging from the Go/Elixir twins would make links authored via ProseMirror ingest render as non-clickable dead spans on the web reader only.

role: Pure numeric median utility
description: Tiny non-mutating true-median function (averages the two middle elements for even-length arrays), likely used for benchmark/latency reporting.
whatBreaks: A wrong median calculation would only skew whatever latency/benchmark stat display consumes it, with no broader system impact.

role: Paper document model, block helpers, and inline valueref (live value) resolution
description: Defines PaperDocument type built on the generated Paper schema type, block/slug/title/excerpt helpers, and a full pipeline (collect → resolve via batched fetch → stamp) for PortableDoc inline `valueref` live-value nodes, mirroring server-side drift-detection semantics (resolved/drift/dangling).
whatBreaks: Paper pages could show wrong titles/excerpts, or inline live-value references would fail to resolve/drift-detect, silently falling back to stale fallback text or crashing paper rendering.

role: Post document model + listing/detail fetch helpers, with webhook-bustable cache
description: Defines PostDocument (generated Post type widened for demo data shapes), postSlug resolution, and fetchPosts/fetchPostBySlug; getScopedPosts wraps the scoped listing in unstable_cache with the shared bp tag scheme so publishes invalidate it instantly instead of waiting on ISR.
whatBreaks: Post listings/detail pages could show stale content after publish (losing near-instant webhook invalidation) or fail to resolve a post by slug/id.

role: Client-side bundled 1-2 char prefix search index for instant finder results
description: Builds and queries a tiny in-memory prefix index (title/slug tokenized to 1- and 2-char prefixes, capped per bucket) that gives 0ms perceived search results before the authoritative WebSocket/Postgres search engine replies; includes an adapter to the FindHit shape.
whatBreaks: A broken index/lookup would degrade the finder's perceived latency (results would just wait for the server) or show stale/incorrect early suggestions, but the authoritative search engine is unaffected.

role: Maps Barkpark's write-time preview manifest to Next.js OpenGraph/Twitter Metadata
description: Pure, Next-server-free function turning doc.preview (hoisted top-level per the v1 envelope) into full Next Metadata with graceful degradation (branded default OG image, website vs article type), designed to byte-match the Elixir ShareMeta module and pass a cross-surface parity gate (pc-w4).
whatBreaks: Every finder detail page's link-unfurl (Slack/Twitter/iMessage previews) would show broken/blank/wrong-type cards, and it would violate the preview-contract parity gate shared with the Elixir ShareMeta implementation.

role: WCAG-luminance-based text color picker for arbitrary sheet cell background colors
description: Parses hex/rgb(a) background colors and returns a high-contrast dark/light text color override for Sheets cells so text stays readable regardless of fill color and light/dark theme; unparseable colors return undefined so the caller falls back to the default class.
whatBreaks: Wrong luminance thresholds or parsing would produce low-contrast or invisible text in Sheets cells with certain background colors, but the rest of the app is unaffected.

role: Scheme allow-list sanitizer for PortableDoc reader hrefs
description: Pure function coercing a raw href to a safe URL, permitting only http/https/mailto/tel and vetted relative forms, rejecting javascript:/data:/protocol-relative payloads. Deliberately mirrors sibling sanitizers in the Elixir (`render/util.ex` safe_url) and Go (`internal/pdrender/inline.go` sanitizeURL) renderers — a security seam that must stay in parity across all three.
whatBreaks: A regression here lets CMS-authored PortableDoc content render a clickable javascript:/data: URL in the web reader, an XSS hole.

role: persistent browser search session ID generator
description: Generates and persists a stable per-browser UUID in localStorage under 'bp-search-client', used as X-BP-SEARCH-CLIENT header to deduplicate sessions for correction/synonym auto-promotion. SSR-safe.
whatBreaks: Session-based correction tracking and synonym promotion fail; every search appears as a new session.

role: Sheet grid model — sparse-to-dense conversion, formatting twins, and render-model projection
description: Pure, dependency-free module (no server-only) defining SheetTab/Cell types plus densifyTab/toRenderModel and numberToDisplay/formatDisplay, deliberately kept as line-for-line TS twins of the Elixir Core/Fmt modules (locked by shared fixture files) so sheet rendering matches server semantics exactly, including safety caps against hostile merge/cell ranges.
whatBreaks: Sheet documents would render with wrong cell values/formatting/merges/frozen bands, diverge from the Elixir engine's output, or in the worst case (missing caps) freeze/OOM the browser tab on a hostile document.

role: Single-source public origin resolver for the Next.js demo
description: Derives SITE_URL once from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL > VERCEL_URL > localhost fallback, and exposes absoluteUrl(); every absolute-URL surface (metadataBase, sitemap, robots, RSS, OG) depends on it so precedence never drifts between them.
whatBreaks: Wrong precedence produces broken/mismatched canonical, OG, sitemap, and RSS URLs across the whole demo site, hurting SEO/social previews app-wide.

role: Normalizes CMS slug field (string or {current}) to renderable text
description: Tiny pure coercion helper preventing React error #31 (object-as-child crash) when a document's slug field arrives in the Barkpark object shape instead of a bare string.
whatBreaks: Any document whose slug is the object form would crash the detail pane render with an uncaught React error.

role: Conservative plural/possessive stemmer shared by all client-side search matchers
description: Small pure function folding possessives and simple plural endings (deliberately less aggressive than Postgres' Snowball stemmer) so multiple client matchers (fuzzy highlighter, strength meter) agree on what counts as the 'same word', without over-claiming relatedness the engine's ranking wouldn't back up.
whatBreaks: Search highlighting/matching would either miss legitimate plural/possessive matches or over-match unrelated words, causing visible inconsistency with the engine's real relevance ranking.

role: Buckets resolved task-board snapshot rows into 5 white-ladder columns
description: Pure, unit-testable web-side twin of the Elixir task board organizer; takes an already-resolved (server-side readiness) snapshot and groups rows into open/ready/in_progress/blocked/done plus a cancelled tally and momentum percentage, using shared glyphs/labels from component-projections.ts and design/status-manifest.json.
whatBreaks: Task-board PortableDoc blocks embedded in web papers would show tasks in the wrong column or a wrong/NaN momentum percentage.

role: Generated design-token constants (canvas colors, match-quality palette)
description: Auto-generated by design/emit.mjs from design/tokens.json — DO NOT EDIT by hand; feeds listings-map.tsx canvas colors and finder.tsx's HighlightLegend gradient. Regenerating requires re-running the emit script, not manual edits.
whatBreaks: Stale or hand-edited tokens desync the map/finder UI colors from the canonical design token manifest, producing visual drift or a broken theme edit that gets silently overwritten on next generation.

role: Client hook for per-keystroke search over a persistent Phoenix WebSocket channel
description: React hook that opens a Phoenix Socket/Channel direct from browser to the Barkpark API (bypassing the Vercel/Next hop) when co-located WS env vars are set, pushing each keystroke as a channel query and resolving via the shared find-shape mapper; stamps a monotonic seq so stale replies from superseded keystrokes are rejected. Ships dark (inert) unless both WS env vars are configured.
whatBreaks: Live/instant search would silently fall back to slower HTTP (if disabled correctly) or, if the seq-guard is wrong, could flash stale results from an earlier keystroke over newer ones.

role: Next.js build config for the web demo
description: Pins the Turbopack workspace root (monorepo vs standalone build detection via pnpm-workspace.yaml presence) and defines 308 redirects from legacy per-type reader routes (/posts/:slug, /papers/:slug) into the unified /d/[type]/[slug] detail route.
whatBreaks: Wrong Turbopack root breaks dev/build resolution of the @barkpark/core workspace symlink, and broken redirects would 404 every legacy post/paper link across the web demo.

role: npm manifest for the Next.js demo app
description: Declares dependencies (Next 16, React 19, @barkpark/core and @barkpark/nextjs SDK packages, phoenix client) and scripts (dev/build/lint/typecheck/test) for the web/ demo consuming the Phoenix API.
whatBreaks: A wrong dependency version or missing script breaks the entire web demo's build/dev/test pipeline and SDK consumption.

role: PostCSS config for Tailwind CSS
description: Minimal PostCSS config enabling the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin for the web Next.js app.
whatBreaks: Tailwind CSS fails to compile, breaking all styling in the web demo app.

role: Minified single-file CSS for the standalone paper editor/reader widget
description: Generated/bundled stylesheet (light+dark theme variables, ProseMirror canvas block styles, wikilink menu, callouts, cards, etc.) shipped as a static public asset consumed by the bp-paper-editor bundle; not meant to be hand-edited, likely built from a source SCSS/CSS pipeline.
whatBreaks: Visual breakage or theme mismatches across every embedded Paper editor/reader instance on the public site.

role: Vanilla-JS Canvas2D force-directed graph renderer for Studio's blast-radius pane
description: Self-contained (zero npm deps, zero network fetches) Obsidian-style graph visualizer exposing window.BarkparkGraphRenderer and a thin Phoenix LiveView hook (window.BarkparkGraph). Implements its own velocity-Verlet physics sim, camera/pan/zoom, hover/keyboard a11y tree, theme-aware rendering, view-state persistence in localStorage, and defensive numeric-divergence guards; large (~3200 lines) and public-surface-documented at the top.
whatBreaks: The Studio document-relationship graph pane would render incorrectly, freeze, or silently fail (e.g. runaway physics blanking the canvas or persisting a diverged camera to localStorage) for every user who opens it.

role: Minified bundled JS (ProseMirror-based) for the standalone Paper editor widget
description: ~493KB generated/minified bundle containing ProseMirror core (Fragment, diffing, etc.) and editor logic, served as a static public asset for embedding the Barkpark Paper editor outside the main app; not hand-authored, build output from a bundler.
whatBreaks: The embeddable Paper editor would fail to load or malfunction wherever it's embedded (public demo pages), since this is the entire runtime for that widget.

description: Standard Next.js 16 tsconfig: ES2017 target, bundler module resolution, strict mode, @/* path alias, includes .next generated types.
